reviews.text: Pretty pastel color!! First time trying Rent the Runway and Im hooked!! Dress was perfect for the June wedding I attended with my boyfriend. Dress was tight around my hips but thanks to the reviews I was able to pick the perfect size.
Very elegant for a wedding.  Highly recommend choosing a dress one size larger than your normal dress size. The lace does not stretch.
Pretty in Pink It was a lovely dress and I would recommend it for others, but it washed out my skin tone too much for my taste. It definitely was a girly and romantic dress.

Not the right top for my body style.  I rented this for engagement pictures and it didn't end up working out.  The color is beautiful and the fit was really nice, however the chest area was not very flattering for my body type. It flattened my chest, so I ended up wearing a different dress!
Fast , simple and  asesine results It was a beautiful dress but a bit unconfortable but i would rent it again

YES YES YES I've rented so many dresses, and this was finally "the dress" that I didn't want to give back! Fits true and so elegant. Didn't have to worry about undergarments showing (big plus) and just made me feel like a million bucks. I didn't get a great picture, but I will definitely rent this dress again.  Paired with small pearl earrings and nude suede heels.

Nice formal look for a fancy event! I wore this dress for my daughter's First Communion. It was very church-appropriate and I had a lot of compliments on it. My main complaint was the fact that the bottom layer and top lace layer aren't really attached at all, so the bottom layer kept ruching up underneath the lace layer and I had to sort of shimmy it down. Because that made me uncomfortable, I can't give it five stars. But, I loved the look and would recommend it. I did feel like it sort of accentuated my middle and I don't think it would have been as flattering if I carried most of my weight there (I carry mine in my hips). You can sort of see this is in the photo around the stomach area.

The dress in just Stunning! The color is beautiful, it hit me right above my knee.  The lace covers you so beautifully, makes you look so sexy and elegant at the same time.  The dress has no stretch so make sure to have a back up.  IT just made me look and feel amazing.  I wish I could of kept it

perfect for an outdoor summer wedding I agree with the other reviews, no give at all, but, it fit like a glove.
the lace made it so classy, yet it's fit made it sexy.
detail was exquisite

You can't go wrong with this elegant lace dress by Monique Lhuillier!! I wore this dress to a black tie work function and I received so many compliments. The dress is very comfortable and the lace looks even better in person. As always, Monique Lhuillier doesn't disappoint! 
I'm a little over 5'8, so I'm always concerned about the length of the dresses I order. This one however was a perfect fit. There's no slit in the back, which was great and I still had plenty of room to move about. The dress was a little loose around the shoulders/chest area but it wasn't anything major. I'd definitely recommend this dress. Great find!

An amazing night and got a ton of compliments!! The fit was great! It highlighted my curves but was still professional enough for work. I was able to wear a nude bra with straps that didn't show which was a plus! Would definitely recommend this dress!!

Beautiful and elegant dress... Perfect for a wedding. I could have worn either the 4 or the 6, but some of the thread holding the top of the slip up in the front was broken and I was concerned about it slipping down all night. The 6 was more comfortable anyway, but if I had been looking for a little bit more of a sexy fit I would have preferred the 4. Overall the dress was beautiful and I would rent it again.

This dress was perfect for my engagement photos. Very pretty dress that is feminine and sweet.  I found the overall fit of the dress to run small.  We could not get the size six to zip up over my ribcage.  You will need a strapless bra to wear this.  Only criticisms were there was a small stain on the bust of the dress and the bottom under skirt liner hangs lower than the lace overlay which I didn't like.  A little double stick tape along the bottom hem remedied that issue for me.

Perfect Bridesmaid Dresses! Compliments all day long! A girlfriend and I were selected as bridesmaids for a wedding with short notice. Rather than search for a dress and have it altered, we opted to both rent two different dresses from RTR and then determine which one looked better on. In the end, we chose this gorgeous dress to wear and we both received compliments all day and evening about how the dresses were the best that anyone has ever seen on a bridesmaid. The dress underneath is a simple tube style, but what really makes the dress is the lace overlay and piping details. The lace has cap sleeves that don't cut into your armpit and has a cute little cutout on the front. The piping accentuates curves but does not compete with the overall lace. The dress definitely leans more towards a pale blush pink rather than the ultra pastel shown on the site.

I could wear the size 2, but gave that to my girlfriend and wore the 4. Either size would have worked, but the 4 gave my boobies a bit more breathing room. Both sizes of the dress hit at the bottom of my knee (5'-0" tall) while it hit mid-lower thigh on my 5'-6" friend. My measurements are 34D-27-38
Got a ton of compliments on the pretty color! Classy and fitted but still fun- perfect for a wedding

My rehearsal luncheon was a success! I ordered this dress in a 12 and a 14 to ensure that it would be long enough - the 12 was fine on my 5'10" body. It was a beautiful dress, but was a little bit more pastel than I realized - just off-white. It wasn't the best color for my pasty complexion!
The dress fit beautifully though! I wore a strapless bra and nude patent wedges - it was perfect for my outdoor wedding rehearsal and luncheon! I'm not sure when I'd have another occasion to wear the dress, but it was perfect for that!

This wedding was more casual than expected (cowboy boots, etc). It still looked great with my boots. Everything was fine, but it was a bit longer than I like.  I still got compliments even though I dressed it down when I found out 2 days before the wedding that most people were wearing cowboy boots and dresses .

Loved the dress and got so many compliments on it!  After reading the reviews I opted for a size 14 instead of a 12 because I heard it ran small.  The 14 fit well but sometimes I felt like my chest was trying to escape haha. If you're a little bustier, make sure you have a good strapless to wear with this dress.

Perfect for a girly baby shower! This dress fit perfectly with no extra help from Spanx, etc.  Really comfy, which is important when you are hosting an event!  Very feminine and went well with our floral theme.  Highly recommended!

Felt like a million bucks I wore this dress for my engagement party. I have a pear shape figure so I'm usually a 4/6 up top and a 8/10 on the bottom. After reading that the dress ran small in reviews I decided to order an 8 and 10. I decided to go with the 8. The top fit perfectly. The bottom was a little snug and it was a little hard to sit but the 10 was way to big up top to wear. The dress has no stretch to it. The material is very elegant and I recieved compliments the whole day.

the dress fit me to a T I am very small up top and my waist is very small in proportion to the rest of my body.  The small waist was perfect for me.  Adding a pearl filled necklace was the perfect accessory.

This dress fit perfectly and was a classy, chic cut and style.  The dress maybe fits a bit on the smallerish side, I definitely went with the 6 over the size 4.  I loved the length and the lace around the collarbone area frames the face nicely so there isn't much need to over accessorize.  Was super comfortable and I had it on all day and night!

Beautifully designed dress. Perfect for a spring/summer wedding! As this was my first RTR rental, I was a little nervous that one size larger was not available, but took a shot with only ordering my size (4) and am so glad I did. Dress runs true to size. Definitely recommend this dress for someone on the taller side. Extremely comfortable and easy to dance in. Had small issues with the zipper getting caught in the back, but otherwise, perfect! And actually - my friend in the pic also wore an RTR dress and it too was a winner!

Rocked the party! I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE the detail on this dress! It runs large up top, and true to size in the bottom. The hips were more comfortable in the 2, but due to how big the top was, I went with the 0. I will be renting it again!
It was elegant and comfortable to wear at the same time.  The fit was perfect for my body shape.

Perfect for Napa wedding Fit perfectly!  This was my first time using RTR and I'm hooked!  I received so many complements. Felt like the best dressed (other than the bride) :).

The only concern was the ribbon around the waist does not give.  But it was fine and comfortable through the night

Beautiful dress, both sexy and appropriate.  I loved this dress despite it running very small! I usually wear a 4 and the 8 was a perfect fit. Extremely flattering on an hourglass shape with the waist detail. My date to the wedding's first words on seeing me were "you look stunning"-and he's not an easy man to impress! It was good for dancing the night away despite the lack of stretch.

Great fit but did not end up wearing This dress is was beautiful and was good length for my 5 foot body.  I did not end up wearing this dress but swapped it out for another dress.  I wanted to say that RTR's customer service when I swapped out the dress was great.  They were patient with me and were so helpful.  It's reassuring to know that if something did not work out, RTR is very good to its customers.

Beautiful dress for my rehearsal dinner.  I love this dress! The 10 was a little snug so I went with the 12 and it fit great. I received many compliments and loved how it fit. Gave me enough room to breath.  I would recommend this dress, it is gorgeous in person!
Perfect for the wedding I went to!  Overall beautiful dress.. Color is more vibrant in person but comes off as a lighter pink in pictures. Tons of compliments on the dress, was very pleased with it!
N/A Pretty comfortable dress, no give around the waist line though.

Beautiful Lace The dress was pretty, but I wasn't crazy about it. The bottom layer was longer than the lace, and it had wrinkles in it that I couldn't get out. I kind of hoped for it to be more of a blush pink, but it was more nude. The part that covered by chest was definitely too small, but since the dress was basically the same color as my nude bra, you couldn't really tell.

Nice, Classy Dress When I received it, I did not like the color.  It was sort of a muted pink.  I thought the color was old ladyish, however, when I put it on, the first thing my husband said was how much he loved the color!
The dress fit my shape nicely and was quite comfortable.  The lining was double thickness and that made it feel nice to wear.  I wore the 6 because it didn't want it to hug my body too much because it was worn for Sunday Easter Brunch.  I got many compliments.  Length was just above the knee.

Fit well and loved the lace! One thing to note, it's quite a bit pinker than the picture indicates, not so much a blush but a true pink. The fit was pretty good. I am small-chested (A) and the top fit a bit loose, but wasn't too noticeable. The bottom was very fitted, but had some give and was a good length. I was a bit worried it wouldn't be long enough because I am very tall, but it worked our quite well.

Beautiful dress! I rented 2 different dresses for a wedding because I wasn't sure the look I was going for. This dress was very formal for me but was beautiful and fit well. I'm usually a 0P, and this dress fit more like a petite. It was a little more conservative but would have been perfect for a more formal evening wedding!

Great dress for a wedding! Definitely runs small.  I'm usually a 2/4 but could have used a 6 due to a tight band that wraps around the waist. Otherwise, a great look for a spring wedding and comfortable despite the tight fit!

Perfect dress for this wedding! I ordered a 4 and a 6 and the 4 fit perfectly. I'm usually a 4 but ordered a 6 because I read it ran a little small.  I got so many compliments on it and am still getting texts from people who saw it in pics on Facebook asking where I got it. This was my first Rent the Runway order and I will DEFINITELY be doing it again!

Lovely! I received so many compliments on this dress - I loved it so much I did not want to send it back! I read the reviews for the same dress in coral before renting it and a lot of people said the dress does not stretch. It really does not stretch, but unless you are trying to do gymnastics in it then you should be fine. The lace on the shoulders is cut perfectly so that you can also lift up your arms all the way as well.

"Your dress is gorgeous"  I was nervous about the color of this dress being too light pink (read: white faux pas at a wedding) but it was perfect. I wore it with nude pumps and minimal jewelry and got several compliments on how gorgeous the lace and dress was. I'm a very petite size 0, so I always worry about dresses running too large. This dress was great.
There was room for me to move, and it also flattered my non-existent curves. The one con was the lace near my left armpit kept rubbing with my dance moves and I ended up with a little burn mark. I would definitely rent this dress or a similar Monique Lhullier again.

Blush lace perfection! This dress was perfect for my rehearsal dinner with my wedding colors being blue, gold, and blush. I got compliments all night and only wish I could have kept the dress! It is true to size but is fitted through the hips so I would def size up for the back up size! I'm sure I will find a reason to rent this beautiful dress again!

Beautiful dress, the lace is so delicate, such a soft pink, very cute dress! Sorry the picture is so bad, but the color really is a soft baby pink. It isn't as light as the color on the model. I was worried about it being too light for a wedding and clashing with the bride, but it's definitely pink. It's a perfectly soft light blush pink. The cut is very flattering, and the cap sleeves are very comfortable. The fabric is very soft and slightly giving. I wore spanx just to help keep everything together. The dress was so nice, highly recommend. Don't really need accessories besides earrings and maybe a bracelet.

Felt like a princess! When my boyfriend saw me in this dress, he just said "Wow -- you're so beautiful," and couldn't take his eyes off of me all night.  It's incredibly classy, and the color is beautiful, especially if you're really pale, like I am.  It does run pretty small, so size up, but it is nice and stretchy.  The only con was that it felt very worn -- some holes in the lace, but not very noticeable, if at all.

I. Loved. This. Dress I wore this to a wedding in Oct and I loved it. I felt confident and beautiful, danced easily in it and my hubby loved it. I am truly a 00 or 0 kind of gal and reading reviews helped me choose this. When someone says a dress runs a little small, that's for me!! I felt like this dress would look great with teal shoes, red (like I worse), nude, silver, or gold!

Cute dress, but watch out for big boob problems This dress is so cute, but it is not for women with a bust size of over DD. I got the size 10 as a backup, but ended up wearing it because the size 8 would not zip up over my chest. But then on the size 10, the lace in the back was so loose, I had to tuck the extra into my bra band so it would not flap around loosely.

4 stars because it is such a cute dress, I do love it, but its not great for big busted women.

Awesome dress. Wonderful comments from actual attendees and people who only saw it in photos!
 Fit great in all the right places! Beautiful color.

I wore this dress for my work's holiday party and got TONS of compliments. I'm normally a size 10 and while it zipped up it was super tight (just like many other comments stated).  I went with the size 12 which I could breathe in a bit more but it was loose up top - even with being a 34DD.  I had to pin the top to my bra to make sure the bra didn't show.  Really loved the dress though, very good material.
STUNNING DRESS! Absolutely breathtaking. Love the color and the details. I was not able to wear it because it was too tight
Classy in pink! I rented this dress for my bridal shower.  It fit perfectly and I received so many compliments.

I wore this for my son's wedding it was such a beautiful dress. I LOVED IT! Received Many complement The fit of the dress around the waist was tight , I am thin and usually never have issues in that area but overall I truly LOVED this dress. It was comfortable, Beautiful and I thought the color was perfect. I highly recommend this dress.

I felt very beautiful in this dress. Perfect for a summer wedding. Ordered the size 8 and 10.  The 8 was a perfect fit.  No bra required, but did wear spanx  to smooth out the bottom half. Very flattering color and style.  Received tons of compliments.  Wore with lighter silver shoes and I think a nude would have looked better.  I am pretty fair skinned and this color was perfect.  
This was an outdoor, summer wedding and the dress was just dressy and light enough.  Perfect! Another win for RTR. Also, customer service is top notch with this company.

This dress was perfect for my husband's black tie work dinner in Florida I love this dress. The fit is perfect and the color is beautiful. It was perfect for a summer black tie event. I received many compliments.

Want to Keep!  This dress was even more gorgeous in person and perfect for a wedding! The lace detail was flawless and I loved the keyhole in the front. The color was a pale pink and would look great with all skin tones. Would definitely rent again! 

I am a size 4 up top and usually a size 4 or 6 on bottom and thats exactly how the dress fit on me. The top area in the bust was a little loose but decided not to get the 4 because the fit in the hips was perfect. Great dress!
Beautiful bridal dress! I loved this dress!  Fit like a glove and so beautiful!  I felt like a princess.  Lots of compliments.  Surprisingly comfy too!  Easy to wear with a strapless dress.

Perfect for a formal affair that isn't black tie! Other reviews said to go up a size with this dress.  I typically wear a 4 so I ordered a 4 and a 6.  I actually didn't feel a noticeable difference but I ended up wearing the 6 because I knew I would be dancing and eating a big meal so I gave myself a little breathing room!  Comfortable and clean.  Whole process was seamless.
This was a gorgeous dress and a perfect fit!! I rented this dress for a Sunday Labor Day Weekend wedding. It was so comfortable, fit perfectly, and got me many many compliments all day.

Beautiful dress. True to size. Wore this for a baptism. It was beautiful and conservative enough for a church but not matronly at all. I ordered the 2 and the 4 because I'm typically between sizes. I didn't notice much difference between the two. I ended up wearing the 4 because I knew I would be in  a church and wanted to err on the side of caution. The ribbon around the waist is the tightest part of the dress and has no give.

Beautiful dress! Perfect fit! I'd definitely rent again or buy! The length and fit was just perfect for my body type. The color was also perfect for my complexion and hair color. I really loved this dress.

n/a Beautiful dress, received many compliments. The 4 was a little tighter than I anticipated, but the 6 was too big in the midsection. 
The picture is me in the 4 :)

Beautiful dress! I received compliments on it all night long!  This is a classy, beautiful dress! As other reviewers have said, there is no stretch so you are a little restricted on terms of arm movement (no YMCA in this dress), but it wasn't too bad. It does run a little small. I am between a 2 and a 4, and I chose to wear the 2 because it was more fitted through the hips and waist. I wore a strapless bra and spanx. The back of the dress is stunning, and I wore my hair up to showcase it. I also rented the earrings and bracelet, which really completed the look. I highly recommend this dress! It is even more beautiful in person than on the model!
Receiving two different sizes worked out perfectly, especially since it arrived the day before. The size 4 fit my body better, but I needed the size 6 for my bust and shoulders.

Print and Fit- Perfect! I have rented 6 dresses so far from RTR, and this is my favorite to date.  The weight and fit fabric is perfect for fall/spring, it is not too heavy but makes you feel like everything is secured without any special undergarments.  I received so many compliments and was so comfortable all night!  Don't be afraid of the print; the cut of the dress is so conservative that the bold print in a sea of super short dresses and plunging necklines still feels like a safe choice. Besides the beauty of the print makes it impossible to seem to loud. If you are between sizes, so smaller; the fabric does kind of bunch if it's big in places

Brilliant colours! The dress material is a thick neoprene but I wasn't hot or uncomfortable outside. It's a beautiful print with vibrant colours.  I chose to wear the small over the medium because the medium was too baggy in the mid section. The small was tighter, but still slightly baggy. Every few steps I had to pull the skirt down as it bunches around the hips quite easily. Maybe not the best pick for an hourglass shape. Nice dress that looked great in photos but certainly not my favourite!

Beautiful and bright print. Absolutely loved this dress! The dress is form fitting and the material hugs all the right curves. I got so many compliments on how bright and detailed the print was. I'd love to own this dress!

Beautiful and vibrant This dress was perfect for a bachelorette party. The colors were beautiful and bright.  The pattern emphasizes curves and the back makes your butt look fantastic. I normally wear a size 8 and am a pear shape. The medium fit well, but as with many dresses on me, the top was a little loose and the hips were a little tight, causing the dress to ride up throughout the night. I pulled it down a few times, but it wasn't a major problem. Overall, would rent this dress again.

Perfect for a Cinco de Mayo theme! The medium fit like a glove. I could have gotten away with the small since it was stretchy, but the medium was less confining and more comfortable. The material was different from any other dress I've worn. Another reviewer described it as scuba material, and I would agree with that. But it was comfortable and I didn't have to pull and tug at all during the night to keep it in place. Great first rental!

This dress is perfection. Comfortable, flattering- I got compliments all night! This dress is much more flattering than I expected from photos. The material is so interesting, and since it's scuba it hides almost all of your flaws. The dress ran a little large, so I'm glad I got both the small and the XS. It's really fun, especially for a night out or a party! It's a little tight and short to wear to a formal event but for a fun night out with friends, it was perfect.

Amazing! This has been my favorite RTR rental.  This dress fit like a glove and was extremely comfortable.  I got compliments from strangers all night long.  The colors and pattern are fun without being too loud.  Highly recommend!

Slimming print and great material This dress was great.  True to size- I'm 5'7 and 125lbs and wore the xs. I was worried about the print being too much but it was actually really slimming the way it was colored towards the waist. And I liked the reeverese print on the back. I would order this brand again.
Country Club New Year's Eve - everyone else in black, I celebrate a colorful New Year Comfortably fitted and flattering, tasteful riot of color, lots of compliments

I felt so beautiful in this dress!  Everyone I talked to said I looked amazing in this dress and I felt that want all night! I would highly recommend this dress to anyone that wants to feel great and confident!

Great dress, but not as flashy as I expected I rented this dress for a wedding and thought that it may be too edgy.   It the end it was a great dress, but maybe not formal enough for a wedding.  I wish I had picked something a little more exciting.  I wore it to a loft party after and it was a better fit there.  I felt a little under dressed at the wedding.  I ordered a small and a medium and went with the small + spanx.   The medium as a little too big and the fabric rolled and bunched.   The small was form fitting, but not uncomfortable.  It did start to chaff under the arms by the end of the night, but at that point I had been wearing it for nearly 12 hours and had been dancing A LOT.

Much better in person! SO many compliments and the colors are gorgeous! I am not normally a fan of a cap sleeve, but it was just enough to round out the shoulders. It doesn't ride up, it is a nice heavy material that gives you credit where deserved! Fun dress, paired with some spicy black sandals and a pop of bling in a bracelet to let the dress say it all! Would definitely rent again!

Rented for a salsa dancing date night and loved this dress! I went size up from my normal size (M) and glad I did! It hugs the curves in a really great way, but I feel it would have been too tight in my regular size. The pattern is lovely and looks really different and great on. The fabric is heavy as others mentioned - more of a scuba material - but I loved how that hid any little flaws. My fiancee loved the dress too!

Wore this dress to my night graduation ceremony. Keeps everything sucked in!! This dress is awesome! Accentuates your waist and the fabric keeps everything looking smooth. It did ride up quite a bit throughout the night, but I'm used to this, as I'm tall and have a bit in the back. But if I could, I would totally buy it!

This dress was a lot of fun! The material was almost "wet-suit" like. Very form fitting and helps to push everything in. I liked this dress because it stood out as not just another black dress my husband's formal work event.

Loved this dress! I wore this for a wedding shower. The picture does not do this dress justice. It  has gorgeous colors. The fit was perfect, snug for sure but nice thick fabric smooths problem areas. I wore spanks with it to make sure. Will rent again!

Loved the design, colors and fit I ordered S and M and wore S as it fit perfectly. I have a small waist and wider hips and the dress was not too loose around the waist as some are. It was quite form-fitting but comfortable. The only issue I saw was that the dress was riding up when walking (quite a bit). I only wore it for a celebration dinner where I mostly sat, but if I went to a party or a club, it would have been annoying to constantly tug on it. 
Otherwise, I absolutely loved the colors and design, it is sexy without being revealing and you can wear it for many occasions. It works perfectly with black, aqua or even red earrings/bracelets.

Sexy and Streeeeetchyyyyy I wore the large because of my pear shape, the M would have done me better up top but the L was necessary for my bottom. I didn't have to wear a bra with this! And I wouldn't have worn more support than the tights I had on. It's made of scuba suit material, substantial and comfy. The cut of the arms is flattering too, and I don't usually love cap style sleeves. Pattern is great if you need belly camo. Recommend.

Dress was beautiful and comfortable! This dress was absolutely beautiful in person, and photographed even more beautifully. The small fit fine but was a bit loose and bunched up a bit. I would go with either your size or a size smaller. The material is thick and stretchy, very comfortable and flattering!

I loved this dress!  
it is scuba-like in material.  
fitted + comfortable + sophisticated + fun a really great dress-
i was complemented endlessly

Thanksgiving The graphics of this dress are marvelous. The neoprene material is also very interesting to wear and feel on your body. The only con for me has to do with cap sleeves in general. I am a climber with very muscular arms/shoulders, so cap sleeves tend to not be very flattering on me. However, I still really like this dress and have rented it twice.

Amazing colors and design. Looks great standing still, but material rides up while moving. I absolutely love the colors and pattern on this dress.  The material (like scuba gear) fits like a glove but was constantly riding up during the party.  I had to keep adjusting / pulling it down.  I have long legs, but it felt too short for my comfort level.

Fun and Sexy! I rented this for a girl's night out. It was super fun and extremely flattering! With the pattern on the front and the thicker material, I felt great in the form-fitting cut. It is really vibrant and unique, definitely a fun rental!

Great dress that wears superbly. I felt amazing in it! Bummed I didn't get a great pic of me in it!! Pros - The thicker fabric keeps everything in place.  Loved the cut of the sleeve to show off the "guns" I've been building at the gym! ; ) Perfect length and the colors were vibrant and beautiful.  A very sleek look that was perfect for my event. The colors are vibrant and beautiful.  Didn't need anything but great shoes and a pair of awesome earrings! The dress stands alone very well. 
Cons- Not any I wasn't expecting. The scuba fabric is quite thick so it was a little warm for this May night that was pretty warm.  Not unbearable though. 

I believe I ended up in the Small although I can't recall for sure.  Both fit well and I could have gotten away with either but felt more comfy in the S.

Fantastic dress. I want to buy it! I wore this beautiful dress in Hawaii for a December day wedding. Received soooo many compliments. I had the dress send to my aunt's house in Hawaii and received the dress on the DAY OF THE WEDDING (Saturday) not the Thursday as I had originally planned. Keep that in mind when shipping to the islands. It was nerve wracking waiting for the dress and hoping it would look good and fit. I tried on the Small, looked and fit great but I felt too fitted for a day wedding. The Medium was much more comfortable for the day wedding.  I loved everything about it. Regular bra and spanx is all you need.  I tried looking to buy this dress but it is no longer sold. I will definitely rent this dress again.

I received complements all night! This is my second time renting from Rent the Runway-I've had a positive experience both times.  The dress stretches so I felt comfortable wearing it all night long.  Someone earlier said because it stretches it doesn't hold you in.  I found that support undergarments did the job.  Thank you again Rent the Runway for making my renting experience easy.
Great dress! Perfect bodycon for a wedding!

Great pattern Loved this dress! Was a little nervous based on non-number sizing but it worked out pretty well. Definitely heavy fabric and rode up a bit due to the nature of the scuba-gear like fabric. I'm 6'0 and it hit me mid thigh. The print is great for concealing lumps and bumps. Wore it for a wedding but is definitely versatile for a night out.

Comfortable All Night!! This dress hugs your curves in a great way. The colors were beautiful and got tons of compliments. Hubby loved too! It was a little thick but i was still comfy. Only con is there is no zipper. You have to put the dress on over your head. Otherwise loved the dress!
Great fitting dress that I wore to Thanksgiving dinner. The dress material was figure flattering, almost a Lycra feel.

Gorgeous pattern and fit like a glove I wore this dress to my best friend's (holiday) engagement party.  It fit perfectly and I got so many compliments on it.  I have trouble finding dresses as I am only 5'0" and am a little bit curvy.  Honestly this dress would look great on all body types.  Would definitely recommend.

Bold and vibrant dress! Great for a night on the town! When I saw this dress online I had to order it. Such an interesting dress! 
I normally wear a size 2 to 4 in dresses. The small was a little too snug, but the medium fit perfect. A little loose in the waist, but not a big deal. The fit is very forgiving and comfortable while very form fitting and sexy. I loved wearing this dress!

I received so many compliments for this dress!  The small fit perfectly, an extra-small would have been way to tight. This had such a unique design on the front and back. I received so many compliments! I really loved this dress.

Unique print, very flattering I wore this to a wedding and got several compliments. The pattern is very unique and fun. I rented the medium and the large, but wound up going with the medium. The large fit a little better in the hips, but had too much extra fabric in the waist, under the arms, and the back of my neck (typical pear-shaped problems). I did have to keep pulling the skirt part down like other reviewers mentioned and the fabric got pretty hot during a 92-degree outdoor ceremony, but it wasn't unbearable and still worth it. I'm happy this website exists; even though I'd love to own this dress I'm pretty sure if I wore it again this dress is so unique and memorable I'd get an, "Oh! That's the dress you wore to the wedding!" at the next function.

Great pop of colors for a night out! Wanted to love this dress but on the fence. Did love the colors on the dress, good fit but was not as form fitting as other reviewers expressed. The material is stretchy and I was stuck between the small and medium. Went with the medium because of length (small was just a tad too short). Definitely accentuates your waist, which is a plus. However, would probably not rent again.

The print on this dress is GORGEOUS and it's so comfortable. I'm a big Clover Canyon fan and rented this for Valentine's Day. The colors are gorgeous and I also LOVED that the back is different from the front. My boyfriend couldn't stop complimenting me on it and he would randomly ask our servers, etc. if they loved it, too. It was pretty hilarious! I got tons of compliments (not all prompted by my boyfriend) and was very comfortable. The material is thick enough for cold weather and I wore it with simple jewelry and heels since the pattern is so bold. I will rent this again and probably buy it if it goes on clearance.

Fun, sexy dress. Great pattern. The pattern of the dress was great. It made it look like you had a small waist. Also, the dress was tight fitting and hugged your body but it wasn't uncomfortable or constricting. It felt great and looked great, too! The only complaint that I had was the back of the dress. The pattern made it look like you were wearing a black thong!

Got lots of compliments.  Super colorful and fun. Fits great.  Clingy but thicker fabric so  you can wear a bra and panties with no lines showing.  Sexy but you feel covered at the same time.  Easy to move/dance in.  Would consider renting it again for a Vegas trip though so little time....so many dresses.  Second dress I ordered from RTR.

Beautiful and comfortable! This dress fit very true to size- nice thick material so no need for spanx!  I don't typically wear body hugging dresses as a mom of three, but this felt classy without being too revealing.

Unique and Gorgeous! I absolutely loved this dress! The style was so unique and beautiful. I was covered, yet felt sexy and stylish. My only complaint would be that the skirt kept twisting a bit on me, even though it fit perfectly. Otherwise- the dress is a 10!
Great color without feeling too girly. It was body hugging so the medium was a bit tight on me but I liked the smaller fit. Great interesting way to wear color without being too loud or girly.

Knockout colors and easy to wear This fabric is like built in shapewear. :-) The design also helps camouflage. I loved the colors and it was easy to wear; not binding or pinching at all. I normally wear a size 6 or 8 in the designer gowns at RTR; the size small in this dress fit me perfectly.

I received compliments all night while wearing this dress to a birthday party.    The photos don't do this dress justice!  It's beautiful and the material (like wet suit material almost) is very unique and forgiving.  I would recommend this dress to anyone who is interested in wearing a classy, sexy form-fitting dress to a party.  Rent this dress and have an awesome time showing it off!!
I did love the colors in the dress! The fit was good, I was comfortable not too tight.  Danced all night, did ride up a bit but I move a lot.

Tight!  This dress is SUPER unique and fun. But be prepared to suck in all night! :) I didn't end up wearing this, because I felt more matador than sexy. But in the right setting on the right person it could be fantastic!
great dress color and fit the dress hugs you and give you a rest shape without being too tight and uncomfortable. color is vibrant and beautiful. I will rent it again

Worn to a fundraising gala.  At first, I was nervous the dress would not fit since it seemed extremely small. The stretchy/scuba suit type fabric hugs every curve and therefore I needed spanx to smooth out the lines. Being 5'1", the length great. Overall the dress was a hit and I loved it!

I wore this for a friend's wedding and LOVED IT! Lot's of compliments and I felt great in it! The fit was very tight but the fabric was slimming and the print forgiving. I got a backup M but ended up not needing it at all. I felt sexy and comfortable all night and got many compliments :)

Unconventional Rehearsal Dinner Option I rented this for my rehearsal dinner.  I wanted something original and different than the typical white dress.  I received so many compliments.  I love the fit of the Clover Canyon dresses.  I have an hourglass frame so it can sometimes be hard to find dresses that hug me in the right places that don't need a ton of alterations.  This dress was the perfect length, had the right amount of class and sexy to it.

Beautiful pattern, great fit! Gorgeous print, very comfortable, great fit-- hugged curves but wasn't tight. I dressed it up with a pleated black silk jacket. Would definitely recommend this dress for a cocktail party or date.
Beautiful Vibrant colors, runs a bit snug, very form fitting.
I'm 5'11" and roughly 140 and the medium fit perfectly Excellent and very comfy.

Great dress.  Rented twice! I love this dress.  It's a fun alternative to the LBD. Caution, I always order up a size with Clover Canyon.  Also, be prepared for the "scuba" material.  I like it, but if you tend to get hot you might not.

Perfect birthday dress! I rented this dress for my birthday dinner. I loved the fit of this dress, it sucked me in without making me feel like I couldn't breathe and it is probably one of the more comfortable dresses I've ever worn. I like that I didn't have yo accessorize too much because if the vibrant pattern. I wore an aquamarine colored bracelet and earrings. The only complaint I had was that it did ride up a bit, not too much but I did find myself pulling it down a few times throughout the night. Other than that I love this dress and received many compliments. I will definitely rent another Clover Canyon dress in the future! I also want to thank the staff at RTR Georgetown for their amazing customer service!

Really neat fabric. It holds its shape really well and hugs your body.  I rented both the S and the M, I ended up wearing the 6 because the 4 was a little 'club-y'. Pretty short. But the print is amazing. Very bright and very colorful a great option for a wedding if you want to mix it up!

Easy, fun, exotic dress! The medium fit me super snug so those who aren't as comfortable with a really tight fit should size up. The material is really stretchy though and is meant to be worn pretty body-con. It is very exotic looking and fun and I wore it from work to a work party!

Such a fun dress! Comfy and perfect for an art gallery fundraiser. I got compliments all night. The fabric was very soft and stretchy, extremely flattering. I am normally a medium and I wore the small because it fit tighter on my waist and showed off curves. I loved the bright pattern, it was unlike anything I've even worn.

It was my BIG birthday party! This dress is all of that.  I loved it.  That said the reason I didn't give it 5 stars is that as others have said it did ride up and I felt my self tugging on it through out the night.  I tend to wear a lot of black and this was a nice departure for my BIG birthday celebration.  It is definitely an attention getting dress.
Dress felt and looked great A cousin who I had not seen in 10 years introduced herself to me as if I was a stranger;  that's how good the dress looked.

Perfect for a winter wedding Was surprised the Small fit me, as most body-con dresses are too tight on me. But this fit perfectly in all the right places! I had to tug it down a lot, but it didn't ruin my night or anything. The material was kind of hot, so I wouldn't recommend it for summer. Loved the pattern! Overall I was quite pleased.

Beautiful Gala Gown! This dress was amazing!  It was comfortable and elegant.  For reference, I'm only 5'3" and with 4" heels, the length (regular) was perfect.  The cutout on the stomach was just enough of a sexy touch.  I had a baby 6 months ago and I'm not 100% with my body right now but this dress made me feel good.  I highly recommend renting this winner!
Amazing customer service!  The dress fit beautifully. I loved that I did not have to adjust it all night. It was very comfortable and figure flattering.

LOVE this dress!!!! Fit me like a glove!! Very flattering!! Only problem is that it was still long even with my highest heels. I'm 5'2'' and wore 4.5" heels and it was still dragging. I stepped on it a bit while dancing and walking around, but the slit helped move the fabric out of my way.

I got so many compliments on this dress: the cutout really spiced up this classy dress! At 5'3'', the length of the regular was a bit long, but nothing some high heels couldn't fix.  Also, I wore a strapless bra, and I did notice the bottom lining of my bra peeked out a few times throughout the night.  Overall, though, I would highly recommend this dress!

Beautifully tailored gem of a dress with fun cutout details! This dress was extremely well made and would absolutely be worth buying at retail price. The material is on the heavier side, wrinkle free (NO steaming needed) and flows beautifully when you walk. The fit/construction is very flattering and also very comfortable. I found the fit was very TTS, I am usually between 4/6 and the 4 was perfect. I truly considered not sending it back ;) Note that the dress is not very long - I am 5'6 and wore sandals with a 1.5" platform for the dress to just reach the floor, and it was not dragging when I walked. I tried on the dress with 4.5" heels and it looked really silly (like in the model photo as someone else also pointed out, but the length issue is even more pronounced in person), but flats ended up working out better anyway with all the walking I had to do! If you're any taller than 5'7 (even in flats), the dress will probably be off the ground. Happy renting, I'll be on the lookout to purchase this to own!

LOVE LOVE LOVE I wore this to a fall wedding and got TONS of compliments. I felt amazing all day- the fit was great-very form fitting, and the color is super flattering. I'm 5'1 and about 110 lbs with an athletic/petite build. The 0P was out of stock so I wore the 0R with 4inch heels. It still drug on the floor a bit, but the slit made it easy to walk and not trip on the dress. The 0P probably would have been perfect for my height and shoes, but still two thumbs WAY up for this dress!!

This dress was perfect for a black tie wedding! The dress fit wonderfully and I felt great! The length was just right with 4 inch heels and I was comfortable the entire night. I highly recommend renting this dress for formal occasions.

I wore this dress to Prom and absolutely loved it.  The color is flattering and the fabric is comfy. Wearing a bra with dress is not necessary, but I wore a strapless one just because I felt more comfortable. I have a small chest and a wider hips, and since the dress has a little stretch, it worked perfectly. Normally I would wear 4, but chose the 2R.

Black tie ready gown I ordered a 0R and 2R - I ended up wearing the OR and it fit like a glove.  I'd say it runs pretty true to size.  I wish that the peek-a-boo area was a little smaller, but I think my dress was a little big in the midsection so it made it hang a little lower.  I received compliments all night long and was even able to dance the night away because the dress was so comfortable. I wore 5 inch heals (I am 5'3.5") and the bottom and side touched the ground.

Best RTR dress for a Fall wedding! Loved this dress very much, amazing color and fabric. Very true to size. I usually wear 4 or 6 in dresses but went with the 6 because it was a little more giving so I could move around and sit down easily. The slit is not as high up as it is in the picture and the opening in the stomach area is right below the chest area. The fabric is thick enough where you don't need a bra. Loved it!

I got engaged in this dress and couldn't have felt more sophisticated!  Loved this dress. It was super comfortable and the material seemed to be high quality. Rented both the 2R and 4R and though both fit, I went with the 4R to ensure that the dress wasn't something I was aware of or had to think about all evening. I wore a fur wrap over it and felt glamorous, sophisticated, and perfectly dressed for an upscale mid-winter date. Recommend one of those bras that adheres to the sides of your chest and a bit of fashion tape if you're smaller chested like me -- I taped the front of my bra to the front of the dress so my underwire wasn't peeking through the cutout. Highly recommend this dress!

Great dress! I wore this dress for a wedding and it fit perfectly. I am 5'1" and was able to wear the 2P with 3 inch heels and it was the perfect length. My backup size was a 0 (Regular Length) and I tried that on out of curiosity and found it to be way too long. Great dress  - would definitely recommend!

Love this dress! Super flattering and fun but still classy. Wore this to a semi-formal wedding and it was just perfect! The material was quite thick which was nice for being on the ocean and for smoothing coverage as well as when it got cooler at night, but if it had been any hotter it would have been too much. Fit true to size.  Wore it with 4 inch wedges and it was the perfect length.

Perfect for med school formal. For reference, I'm 5'8'', 125 lbs with 32A-34A bust, 25-26'' waist and 35-36'' hips. The 2L was really great, although it could have been more fitted in the waist and top. I could not have gotten by without 3-4'' heels. I probably should have ordered 0L as a backup instead of 4L, but overall cannot complain!

I wore this to a black tie wedding and got tons of compliments! Loved it. Amazing fit. The fabric is a bit heavy and is very flattering.  The cutout and slit are sexy but understated, and the high neckline balances it out perfectly. Would absolutely recommend this dress!

GLAM, BAM, Thank You Ma'am! Amazing fit and quality materials. Fit like a custom piece and received tons of compliments. Flattering color and smoothing fit for any shape. I wore it with a strapless bra as my own preference, but none was required.

Showstopper  I felt so glamorous in this dress - i honestly felt like a vilaness from a James Bond film. I was worried about the little tummy cut away but i was still able to wear spanx under it. I wore 4 inch heels so i ordered the Long size and i had no problems with the length, it was perfect. I didn't want to return this dress and i would wear it any chance i could if i owned it.

I wore this dress at my sorority sister's wedding. This dress was perfect! It showed just enough to make me feel good but not too much to be inappropriate at a wedding. The fabric was thick so I felt really comfortable. I have a large bust and did not need to wear a bra as it fit so well. If you are looking for a dress to a black tie wedding, I would definitely recommend this one!!

Stunning dress! Simple but chic!!  Fits great! I was worried that it would be tight around the hips since dresses usually hug my curves a little too tightly; but I was pleasantly surprised that the dress fell perfectly and fight right in all the right places. The cut out hits at a flattering spot and if need be, you can definitely wear a strapless bra with it! I'm 5'3" and with heels, the regular length dress was a perfect length.

I wore this dress to a wedding at an art warehouse in Chicago. It was perfect for the venue. The dress fit perfectly! It would have been too long without heels, so if you are 5'4 or shorter, you will want to wear shoes with a heel. I received many compliments throughout the night felt great in the dress. One of my absolute favorites!

Beautiful and Classy Dress! I wore this to a friend's wedding. It was beautiful and classy. It was a little darker than I expected - it's a dark navy. Nevertheless, I felt great in it and received many compliments. The cutout really makes the dress standout. It is very comfortable and true to size. I'm 5'4 and wore 3 inch heels so the length was perfect. I really loved it and recommend it for a wedding or other formal event.

A wonderful dress! Elegant & Comfortable The top was a little large, would have liked to have the 4L that I ordered but it was unavailable due to someone returning it damaged so wore my back-up size of 6L. The slit was just enough and when I sat down there was enough fabric to cover my legs. I would rent again!
This dress was comfortable and so pretty in person.  The fit was perfect and the dress was comfortable overall. Loved the cutouts for a little interest but still felt classy and elegant in it!

Amazing dress that was perfect for a black tie summer wedding on the water in Chicago. Definitely a show-stopper. Received a ton of compliments. The only reason I gave this dress a 4 instead of a 5 is because my bra kept showing in the cut out. I probably needed to size down so that it was tighter under there, but other than that, I love this dress. It was breathable and easy to dance in. I would suggest sizing down. Wish this dress came in other colors too!

Gorgeous gown. Tons of compliments! This dress was everything I hoped it would be. It was classy, subtle yet sexy, and made me feel beautiful. I got countless compliments. It ran true to size. I have a very tiny frame and am about 5'6"... This dress fit me almost perfectly (a little roomy in the bust only because I am very flat chested), but everything else, including the length, was perfect. It had enough stretch that sitting and dancing was comfortable. My only complaint is that I could not wear my regular strapless bra... I had to buy a stick on bra that I could position a little higher than a usual bra sits, otherwise the bottom of my bra poked out from the cut out. Overall, highly recommend. I love this dress!!

Great Fit  I was nervous for the fit of this dress since I am on the curvier side. I was pleasantly surprised how slimming this dress was! The cut out was especially flattering. I was also nervous about the length. The 6R was a perfect length on me with flat sandals. The fabric was amazing and so comfortable to wear. Loved everything about this dress!!

I absolutely loved wearing this dress! I felt like a princess in the gown! The overall fit was true to size. The fabric had a stretch which was a huge plus and no under layer which made it much easier to wear. I have hips, so this dress hugged in all of the right of places. The length of the dress worked for me and I had 4 inch heels on. Overall, it was a great fit!

Semi-formal military wedding  Perfect dress! I wore 3" heels and it was a good length-didn't drag at the bottom. Stretchy and flattering fabric. There was a little extra space around the chest (there usually is for me) but you couldn't tell at all. I've never received so many compliments on a dress before! Super comfortable. I wore it to a spring wedding and it was around 73 degrees and I wasn't too hot. Highly recommend this dress!

Gorgeous Dress, Perfect Fit This dress was perfect for a formal masquerade ball. Heavy fabric flowed very well and was wrinkle free. I ordered a 4R and 6R. 4R fit perfectly, 6R fit well also. Almost couldn't tell much of a difference. I wore 5 inch heels and the dress hit at a great length for my 5'3" frame (did not drag the floor). Overall, very pleased. This was my first rental and I will definitely be renting again =)

Classic gown with a beautiful flare.  The fit was great and it fit true to size.  If you have a large chest I recommend going one size up.  Overall, this dress was beautiful and I felt amazing in it the whole night.

AMAZING!!! I can't say enough good things about this dress. Fit perfectly and is super flattering! The only thing I would have changed is the slit. On the model it looked as though it would come up higher on my leg but it barely even showed. That said, the rest of the dress was so perfect I forgot all about the slit. Definitely recommended!

Absolutely LOVED this dress! I would recommend it to any and all! I wore this dress to my high school prom and it was perfect! I usually wear a size 6 in dresses, but ended up wearing a size 4L since I am relatively tall (5'9'). The dress fit perfectly and I got so many compliments on it throughout the night. It's classy but fun and you really cannot go wrong with this dress at all!
This dress was amazing!  I received compliments all night!  It was a gorgeous dress and fit perfectly.  The dress was a little long but I wore 4 inch heels so it wasn't an issue.

Loved it, but a note to my busty sisters... I loved this dress. Loved it. And I got compliments all night. However, I probably should have worn a 2R but they didn't have that size available my weekend, so I ordered a 0R and a 4R. I ended up wearing the 4 because the 0 was too clingy and the 4 hung nicely in a way that showed off the dress's true shape. BIG BUSTED LADIES BEWARE... I highly recommend getting a size that's small enough that you don't have to wear a bra. I needed a bra because I went a size up, and the bottom of the crop kept riding up all night and showing my bra (which was flesh colored thankfully). I tried fashion tape but it did nothing, so I was fidgeting with the dress all night. I think a size 2 would have been perfect, and I wouldn't have had that problem. All in all, though, I loved this dress. I felt trendy and classy, a good combo.

Interesting in all the right places Rented this for a black tie optional wedding in November. Such a comfortable dress and hugs in all the right places. I wore the petite length and it was still a couple inches too long with just a low heel (wore Steve Maden Irenee heels). I had a 0R as a backup size which would've fit better for size but also would've been too long. The extra inches didn't get in the way of dancing or walking but I had to be more mindful in crowds so the bottom didn't get stepped on. The slit on the leg is a showstopper and the cutout hit in just the right spot and was very flattering. The fabric does show a couple of lumps and bumps so I smoothed it out with Spanx. For the smaller chested ladies (me), I wore a strapless bra and taped the top of the cutout (the part that goes under your breasts) to keep any kind of breast or bra-related accidents from happening. Looking back, sticky boobs would've probably been a better idea. There's enough going on to make it not another-navy-formal-dress but comfortable enough to not fidget with it all night!.
Looked wonderful for the event.   Great length!

amazing dress! This dress fit like a glove, I didn't want to send it back! The material was thick, and the cutout stayed in place all night without any adjusting or tape necessary. It was easy to move in for an outdoor day to night wedding. With 5" heels, the 0R fit to a good length, even though I am short (the 2P alternate size was too loose).

Elegant yet fun showstopper! This dress was a hit, with the deep navy color and luxurious fabric fitting my form perfectly!  Loved the cutout to subtly show off the abs, and can't beat the shape of the neckline.  The 0R was too short for 2" heels, so I wore this dress with flat sandals and absolutely loved it - was comfortable all night! I'd love to rent this again in a 0L to try it with heels!

Gorgeous dress! Loved this dress, I felt both trendy and classic in this gorgeous dress. The dress also moved super well for dancing the night away, had good stretch to it and the bottom twirled really well, if you're in to that. Also, for the ladies with hips and a bum, mine looked freaking awesome in this dress. It was a little tough to decide between the 6 and 8, 8 was a little more roomy around my hips but the top was just too big for a 34B and bottom of the 6 worked, esp with some spanx stockings for the ceremony. The cut out looked fab and despite the stretch to the dress, didn't make anything pooch out. The navy was really lovely and the inside lining was a brighter blue that was a nice highlight but certainly not distracting.

Ideal for a black tie wedding when you want to standout, but not TOO much!  The other reviewers were incredibly helpful and spot on with the fit. I am usually a 2 in dresses, but the 2P was much too tight (and the slit looked scandalous), so I went with the 4P, which fit like a glove. As someone who is 5'4", long dresses are usually problematic, but 3 inch heels made this one very easy to walk and dance in in.

The slit and cutout take this dress from being a boring black one to something more fun and stylish, but you don't feel like it's too revealing. A chunky necklace or large earrings pair well with the cut of the neck and how it lays.

Beware of the Color: This is a very dark shade of navy, ALMOST black, but not. So just keep in mind if you are matching shoes or a wrap. 

A bra is not needed with this dress, and I am usually wary of people who make that claim, but it is true with how this dress is cut and lined. 

Overall, I received tons of compliments. I wanted a fitted dress that I could actually breathe in, and this did the job!

This dress was gorgeous & I received compliments on it all evening!  I ordered the 0R and the 2R, and ended up wearing the 2R so I felt more comfortable eating dinner & not feeling like I had to suck in all night! That said, the fabric on this dress is thick & pretty forgiving, & I was really comfortable all night. The only thing was that my strapless bra showed the slightest bit on the top of the cut-out once the night wore on as the bust section was loose on me; luckily it was nude & most people probably didn't notice since it was a nude color (hopefully!). I am short & wore 4 inch heels, & still had length dragging on the ground, though the slit helped when I walked. I really loved this dress & would highly recommend renting it for a formal occasion. I wore it to my husband's work event & it was a statement dress without being too risqué.

Beautiful for a black tie affair This dress was gorgeous! The cut out in the center was extremely flattering and I was complimented on the dress all night. For being floor length the dress was light weight. I'm 5'4, 140lbs, 36c and wore 3 inch wedges and it was perfect. My favorite rental
Beautiful fit - classy but edgy at the same time I am 5'8" and the regular was about half an inch too short, but everything else was perfect!

My senior prom :) (more casual than other schools) I was really worried about renting because this was my first time, but the dress fit PERFECTLY! I loved how I looked in it and I loved how I felt in it (it was SO comfortable!). This was one of the only photos I took that showed most of the dress.
Loved it!! I got so many compliments! The 4 fit as well but the 6 laid better p.  I was able to wear a strapless bra.
A high quality dress Rented for a medical school banquet. High quality fabric and it was the perfect length.
This dress was amazing! The dress was the perfect size. Fit like a glove. It was heavy enough that I could walk and it wouldn't cling to my legs and the length was perfect with 3.5 inch heels.

Great dress...but for a smaller bust Loved the length, quality, split was sexy without going overboard -- however, at 34G my bust was too large to go braless and/or to wear a strapless without bra or boobs showing.

Perfect dress! I absolutely loved this dress. It was comfortable, yet slimming and kept the girls in place (without a bra). I wore this for a black tie optional wedding in March and I got a ton of compliments on it. I highly recommend it for your next formal event!
Great dress for a formal fundraiser.  Sophisticated with a little peek-a-boo sexiness. Fit really well.  Very good quality and very comfortable.  Stunning.

Super comfortable and flattering dress.  Really beautiful dress that was perfect for a summer black tie wedding. I wore a 2P and usually wear a 2 but if I had been wearing higher shoes the 2 probably would've been needed (I wore 2.5/3inch heels). As other reviewers mention the fabric is thick but it's not quite as thick as I was envisioning so might have gotten spanx to go with it or something for clearly lines. I wore a strapless bra. So many compliments, was a gorgeous dress!

Loved this dress! Felt very comfortable and got a lot of compliments.  I'm 5 feet tall and this dress, although petite, was still a little long for me with heels. Plan to have temporary hem tape on hand. That worked great for me.

Elegant Overall, this dress was stunning. I am quite a small person and definitely could have benefited from a Petite size, but none were available. The 0R was long, but I managed. The dress fit pretty true to size. I have a larger chest (32 D) and could not wear bra with this dress due to the cut out. It ended being okay (just had to 'boob scoop' throughout the night) The dress is made out of thick material and does not wrinkle- good for packing/travel. 

My only gripe with this dress was the cutout. It gaped a little and did not lie flat as you can see in the second image. I believe this is because my back is wide, but torso is short and narrow. So it is really trial and error in this case.

Definitely recommend!
Loved this dress! This dress was great! I thought I might not be able to zip up the back because my chest is larger for my body type, but fit perfectly. Received complements all night.

Was this made just for me? This dress was wonderful. I didn't want to take it off! It was so wonderful to wear a long gown that wasn't too long on me. Granted, I was wearing 3 inch heels, but this is the first long dress that I didn't need to alter or use hem tape to make it work. The top fit my bust well - I felt sexy with the cutouts, but completely secure that nothing would unintentionally show. The top was lined, and no bra was necessary. And the slit-- I loved it! I felt truly amazing in this dress and want to wear it again and again!

Sexy & trendy yet classy! Runs true to size — maybe a little bit long. Quality material. The slit in front is large enough to notice but small enough to stay on the classy side. Would totally recommended this!
Loved, thick material to it to avoid those imperfect areas Received so many compliments. Loved the dress, thick material to it to avoid those imperfect areas

It was fun! The dress was beautiful and very well made. I got a lot of compliments on the dress. Despite all the wonderful things about the dress, it was a bit loose around the waist and a bit long for me. I'm 5'3'' and wore 4 inch heals, and the dress still dragged on the ground a little, but I can't complain because I was expecting that based on other reviews. Overall, it was a great dress, I had a great time, and would definitely rent the dress again!

I wore this dress to my senior prom and it made me feel very confident in myself, and I loved it! I loved the way the dress fit! It hung well on me, and the fabric was thick and heavy without being too warm. There wasn't a lot of stretch to the fabric, but I liked that because I didn't have to worry about cutting an unflattering figure. I highly recommend it!

Beautiful dress for a formal fall wedding!  This is a flattering dress. I was still able to wear spanx underneath even with the slit and cutout. It is a thick material with a little stretch and seems like a quality piece. I am 5'7 and ordered a long which was the perfect length with heels. I received several compliments on it throughout the night.

Such a great, comfortable, and elegant dress! Wore to a friend's wedding and absolutely loved the style and fit! At first, I didn't know if I would enjoy the hi-low look, but was sold as soon as I slipped this on. Aside from  how elegant this piece looks, I REALLY REALLY loved the fact that this dress has large side pockets - so much utility value!. So instead of carrying a separate bag, I could easily slip my phone, and small makeup pouch in the pockets without it looking frumpy or bulky at all.  I'm 5'4" and the dress was a perfect length with ~1 inch heels. The back slightly grazed the ground, but I never felt like i had to lift it up while I walked for fear of getting tangled up. 
100% recommend and would rent again for another occasion.
Worn to annual, all-college gala This dress fit like a glove on my wide waist and broad shoulders.

ABSOLUTELY PERFECT!!!!!!!  A SHOE STOPPER DRESS!!!!! My original size was 10L , I wanted the dress to touch the floor with my 5" heels on, but it fit a little tight.  I could have made it work by wearing some spanks but I wanted to be comfortable.  I'm glad I had a second choice, the 12L as an option. It was perfect!!!!! The length of the dress and the v-neck was just where I wanted it to be.
I had an awesome night thanks to Rent The Runway.  I'll be back for my birthday dress!

Sincerely,
Germaine Garrett
San Antonio, TX.

Fit like a dream! The dress ran very true to size. Being 5'10", finding a full length gown is nearly impossible, much less with an accentuated waist that falls at my true waist line and not mid-ribs. The material was very thick and sturdy. It has a full skirt packed with tulle so it keeps its full shape throughout the night. My heels caught on the lace trim a few times, not sure how I would have corrected that problem since the length wasn't too long. I would definitely recommend this dress. It's a classic shape with an extra flair with the hemline/lace. I received so many compliments all night long!

I wore this dress to a gala and I got so many compliments! Would definitely rent again. I was very worried that this dress was going to be too long as it was a regular length and I am pretty short! But it was the perfect length with my 3"-4" heels!

Amazing dress for a Black Tie Wedding Wore this to a Black Tie (optional) wedding and absolutely loved it. The top was a BIT large but at the end of the day it was nice to be sucked in completely. The Long falls just at the heels to give it a bit of a train which is quite stunning. Plus the best part : POCKETS. Would definitely recommend this dress.

The dress looked amazing and I was comfortable all night. Amazing dress!! And it fit perfect.  I am 5'10, 140 lbs, 34B bust. I received many compliments and felt gorgeous all night! I recommend the Gorgeous bra from VS so you can wear a bra and have the lowered back strap.  I was over all very pleased with my experience with Rent the Runway.  The dress came nicely folded in a cute dress bag and the return label is there ready to go when you return it.

This dress was perfect!  The fit was perfect. I ordered it in a 10L and 12 L. I am smaller in the bust and wider in the hips (pear shape), so the smaller size was perfect for me. I'm 5'9.5 185lbs I wear a 36 c bra.
Fit like a glove!  This was a true 6. Very comfortable and easy to wear throughout the night!

Overall it was a gorgeous dress and I would absolutely get it again. Tons of compliments. :) I ordered the 6R and 8R as backup. They fit nearly identical. The only difference to me was the 8R had more room in the bust. Both were pretty snug in the waist and, again, the 8R felt the same in the waist as the 6R.

Gorgeous and comfortable-- no special undergarments necessary!  I wore this dress for my bridal shower and absolutely loved it. I didn't need to wear any special bra or undergarments which was a huge plus. Easy and elegant. Everyone there loved it too :-)
Amazing dress that fit like a glove! Fit perfectly, required no bra and has pockets! Received so many complements, I wish I owned it!

SO many compliments! People kept coming up to me and telling me how great I looked and asking where I got this dress! The pockets were KEY for dancing around a wedding with your phone. It also photographed extremely well, I love how I look in pictures!

Great dress!  Loved this dress! It was heavier than I expected and I probably would have chosen something different if I knew this (rented it for a summer, black tie wedding), but I am still very happy with my choice.  There is not much stretch in the rib area but the 4L fit perfectly thankfully.  It was a little shorter in the back (did not hit the ground) but it was better this way as I had no issues tripping on it.  The pockets were perfect and allowed me to go without a bag all day/night.

Beautiful, solid dress.  Received compliments all night long. Pros:  Loved the way the dress fit and looked.  I wore it to a ball and received compliments all night long.  I'm 5'7" and went with the 4L.  The dress just brushed the floor with a nice pair of heels on.  The fabric was a nice sturdy materials and the dress had pockets!!!  Any dress with pockets is a win in my book.
Cons:  Was a little disappointed that I didn't have a bra to wear with it since the cut in the back is too low for a standard bra.  I also didn't like the fact that the hang tags in the dress are bright red!  I was constantly worries that they would be visible whenever I lifted my arms.  Since I wore this to a ball dancing was involved.  Every time I stepped back my heel would catch in the lace detail at the bottom/back of the dress.  Made it slightly difficult to dance as I was trying to take care and not damage the dress.

Runs big Wore the size 8R (I'm 5'6) and it definitely runs big. I could've sized down to a 6. If you're smaller chested, you can skip wearing a bra. The v in the back is quite low so I just didn't bother wearing one and it was fine. Overall, loved the dress. The lace detailing at the hem was so unique. Love this dress!

Perfect for a gala This dress fit well, I do think it may be better suited for a taller person, at 5'4" even with 3 inch heels, it wasn't the most flattering for my legs.  But otherwise the dress was perfect, received many compliments, was comfortable to wear.

All of the compliments I'm 5'10 with a pear shape.  The dress was the perfect style to hide my hips, and the regular length was just right (My backup was a 10L, an honestly I liked the regular length better).  The pockets were a nice touch so I didn't have to carry a clutch.  The best part of the evening were all of the compliments including someone who thought it was the best dress out of the 200+ that were at the party.

Fun and different Was looking for something a little edgier for the American Music Awards - this was actually my back up dress.  Wasn't sure about it at first but soooo comfortable and as with the last dress I wore from the same designer, stands out from the sea of sameness.
I loved this dress. It was so comfortable and flattering This fit great. I got so many compliments . Bonus there are pockets
Lots of great compliments:) Love this dress!

In love with this dress!!! This dress is my favorite RTR pick hands down.  I received tons of compliments all night.  I did not want to send it back!!!   I ordered a 0 and a 2 - the 0 fit better and didn't have to wear a bra.   Not one wrinkle on this dress.  LOVE LOVE LOVE!!!

Everyone loved the dress!!! Fit perfectly through the bodice. Full skirt so that was great too. I wore a normal bra tricked out with one of those low back conversion straps and it worked perfectly. I probably would rent the tall version if I rent this again so that the back hem reaches the floor in my heels.  POCKETS!! Loved this dress.

This dress is gorgeous and so much fun to wear!   I received compliment after compliment.  One couple even stopped me and said it was hands down the best dress of the evening!  I ordered the 0R and 2R and went with the 2.  It runs a little small in the rib cage area, but the length was perfect with 4" heels.  I also wore the Badgley Mischka Showstopper Earrings and Cara Accessories Dress Me Up Bracelet.  This was my first time to rent from RTR, and I am sold!  My experience was awesome!

The compliments received on this dress! The dress is absolutely gorgeous.  The overall quality is great.    This dress makes you feel good wearing.  I was stopped many times just to be told what an amazing dress it was.  
I wore to a Halloween masquerade gala and the "spider web lace" was perfect!

Perfect for a Gatsby themed wedding  Perfect fit, true to size.  I am broad shouldered so things tend to fit snug around chest area, however, I chose the 14 instead of the 16 because although it was a bit tight, I felt it was more flattering in the 14 fit.  So many compliments on this gorgeous fabric.  Pockets are always awesome in a gown! I want to rent it again in Navy

I attended a black tie gala with a rock and roll edge. This dress fit beautifully. It was the perfect length (I ordered based on the recommendations for tall), and it was SO comfortable. Also, the pockets were a dream come true. I received many compliments, and danced the night away :) Thanks RTR!

It was a nice evening.  What I did not love was that apparently this dress is sold at Macy's for about the same price that I rented it for.  That meant that 2 other people were wearing the same dress.  I felt sort of duped spending so much on a "designer dress" that really wasn't so designer being that it was sold at Macy's.

Dress was elegant, and I received a lot of compliments. A little wrinkly, but not too noticeable. This dress is good for women with smaller a smaller chest and larger hips. I'm 5'7" and wore a 16WL. I usually wear a 20 in pants and XL in tops. My heels were 3". No way I could have worn the regular length. Get the long! This fit great and looked so elegant. I didn't have to wear a bra, and there are pockets! I have no complaints. This does run big by a size or two. Dress looks best with simple strappy heels. Highly recommend!

Wore this dress to a wedding. I received so many compliments on my outfit. I loved the fit of this dress. I didn't have to wear spanx as I still had a bit of post-pregnancy bump. The shape of this dress hides the bump. I also love the pockets as well as the detailed lacing on the bottom of the dress.

Wow!!! Absolutely stunning. My best rental so far, I had so many strangers come up to me to just tell me how much they loved my dress, everyone wanted to know where it was from.. Girls from 13 to 70 raved about it. Even the photographer corned me in the restroom to find out where I got my dress. The large pockets were great - phone and lipstick - I was all set. Rent this one - you will not regret it! Just an idea - RTR include some business cards with their rentals,  would save me writing it down for everyone at each of my events :)

The perfect mix of glam and drama I wanted & still understated enough. I got compliments all night! The bust was a little too big on me, but I fixed it with cleavage cupcake inserts. The length was perfect for the 4-5" heels I had in mind. Aside from the bust, it wore like it was tailored for me. Loved this dress.

Black tie wedding, and it truly stood out in a sea of black dresses. Classic, elegant, fun! I tried it on at the local Saks several weeks before the wedding, so I knew the 2R was the right fit. It was actually the perfect fit for my body. I have a longer torso, normal legs, smaller bust (32B), no hips, and am thin but muscular with a bubbly bottom. It hugged every curve the right way without being stifling, and it was cut to leave an element of mystery to the dress wearer.  Wear it with your hair up, and cute black pumps, as they will be on display!

Elegant spider queen formal This dress was elegant. Different enough to be memorable, but normal enough to not be the crazy one. I felt a little like a spider queen with the lace, but no one else seemed to notice... they were too busy admiring the dress. 
I didn't wear a bra with this because the back was a little lower than I thought, but the ladies were held in nicely. I am a 36D and wore the 10R and the bust probably couldn't have fit bigger ladies. Still comfy for me, though. 
Be careful that the heel of your shoe doesn't catch on the lace of the dress. It happened to me a a few times and I was able to shake it off. Just be careful. Also, the model (sz. 2, 5'10") doesn't accurately reflect the length. It came below the knee for me and grazed the ground. This isn't as leggy as the picture makes it look. 
Highly recommend; surprise victory on this one. Thanks RTR for your stylists' suggestion!
Elegant and Comfortable Elegant and Comfortable
A lot of people complimented the dress, it was festive and fitting for a black and white ball. It fit true to size and was a comfortable length in heels.

Made for the "hourglass" figure!!! This dress fit like a dream, snug in all the right places. I have a larger bust, small rib cage and fuller thighs. I want to own this dress. Received so many compliments and my husband loved it. I usually always need to wear a bra and this dress was supportive enough that I went without. Loved it.

fun, but not my favorite I wore this dress to a black tie optional event. The hemline made it feel just formal enough, while still being easy and fun to dance in.  The 12 regular was unavailable so I got a 12 long.  I was a bit worried about the length but it was perfect with heels on.  I did feel like the straps were going to fall off my shoulders all night and at one point the webbing on the bottom got stuck to some lighting on the dance floor.

Masquerade Party My original dress that I rented had a tear in it so I went to the RTR store in SF the day of my event to see if I can find a replacement.  There were not too many size options but I'm glad this one worked out!  It's a very easy dress to wear.  You can even wear a regular black bra with it!  The length was great with heels.  It went well with my lace like mask for a masquerade party I was going to.  Very fun and unique.
I loved how this dress made me feel!  It was PERFECT! Elegant and comfortable.  Best part...it has pockets!!!!

This is not the dress I originally picked (the others didn't fit), but I got so many compliments! Everybody loved this dress. It fit pretty well, and was a good length. The straps were a little loose on top, so I had to pin those, but nobody noticed. My heels did get caught in the bottom a couple of times, but overall, this was a great dress.
