The pockets are a nice touch!

I rented this for a wedding and absolutely LOVED it! I've never gotten so many compliments!! Fit was great! Fitted in all the right spots without being rib crushing. . I'm a bit busty but the "girls" were well contained and not at all inappropriate. I was worried about getting a long but with some 3 inch heels it was perfect. Plus, pockets!!!!!!!! What's not to love? Would definitely recommend and if the occasion arises, rent again.

I have never had so many compliments in my life! Not just a normal LBD. Subtle black and beautiful silhouette, but the mesh/lace detail at the bottom made it catch your eye. Perfect for my fundraising gala! Will rent again.
This was a gorgeous dress for a fun evening wedding.  Fit like a glove, with beautiful lace details. Truly chic.

So pretty with a badass feel! I wore this for my bridal shower that had a Victorian goth theme in October. This dress was an endless hit! People kept coming up to me complimenting it the whole party! And tip: it has pockets! I realized it about halfway through the party. It's pretty true to size, but you might need a little help in the breast area if you are a C or smaller.
Beautiful dress.  Fit true to size (I am a 6R). Great hem. Tons of compliments!

Beautiful dress worn at a black tie wedding. This dress is amazing. If I could somehow buy it, I would. This dress fit perfectly. I wore a black shrug with the dress to cover my arms, but it was quite cute without the shrug as well. The dress was comfortable, easy to wear, and I got a lot of compliments! The length was perfect for me at 5'4'', which is a rare thing for a long dress, and I even wore it with flats! The back just hit the ground. It can be difficult to find a flattering dress in my size, and I would recommend this dress to everyone. It even has pockets! This was my second back-up dress as the two previous dresses (my original choice and a backup) were both way, way, way too long. I was so excited that this ended-up being the perfect dress for the night! The only problem was that there was a slight tear in one of the pockets, which you couldn't see when wearing it. Highly recommend this dress.

Gorgeous black tie dress, showstopper  I felt very glamorous all night. It doesn't wrinkle, and the fabric is very forgiving! Perfect for a black tie affair. 

Reason for the 4/5 stars: I'm 5'0, so people kept stepping on the back of the dress. I have a small torso too, so I couldn't wear a bra without it showing in the back. I would have taken the straps in a bit for a better fit.

I received so many comments on this dress! It was comfortable and true to size. The fit was somewhat tight in the bust, and I wasn't able to wear a bra but I didn't need one. The dress fit so tight (but comfortably) that my girls still stayed up and in place. I wasn't sure what size to order as I'm a new mom and my size has been fluctuating, but this fit true to size. I loved it! The only downfall was my heels would catch in the lace every once in a while.

"You Look Like a Princess"  Wore this to a black tie optional wedding and could not have been more pleased. I got compliments the whole night! At one point, a friend came up to me and said "I'm not going to lie, you look like a princess." 

Loved this dress and would absolutely rent it again.
Beautiful and very comfortable. Great quality  Back of dress got caught in heels but I got the dress in the long size. Overall lots of compliments an d a fun dress to wear!
This dress was beautiful. It photographed well.  I needed the 12 . Loved the pockets.  Photographed well. Comfortable and elegant.

Caribbean formal wedding! Pro it fit like a glove. accent my waist and made it look smaller. Smooth across the bust area. Long enough for dramatic effect without tripping over tail. Light weight enough I stayed cool even in the Caribbean. I got so many complements. It was  my brothers wedding and he said I had the best dress on with the exception of the bride with over 60 guest in attendance. No con!

The skirt is amazing! Awesome detail that made this dress stand out among other LBDs. The neckline is stunning, and not too low cut. The rib cage is a little tight, but a bra wasn't necessary which made it work. With the back of the skirt, watch out for the lace. It got caught on the heels of my pumps at least once!
the dress was great for a formal holiday work party.  The fit of the dress was perfect.  No alterations needed.

Beautiful dress!  The dress was absolutely perfect for an evening wedding. I got lots of compliments all night. 

Comments on Fit: I am 5'11" and the 6L was actually long enough to wear 2" heels. The fabric doesn't have a lot of give, which means (1) if you have a larger rib cage, it might be a bit tight and (2) you don't necessarily need a bra.

Elegant and perfect for a wedding I had several compliments and felt really pretty in the dress. I did not fit in my normal size and had to wear the 12. It was sent to me with the front seam torn and continued to pull apart throughout the evening to the point where I had to wear a different dress at the end.

Perfect Dress I am in love with this dress. I rented it for a black tie event and it was the hit of the night. The shape of the dress is incredibly slimming and the high low and spider effect make it stand out from the sea of other black dresses in the room. I wish I could afford to keep this dress- I felt gorgeous all night!

GREAT FOR GALA don't wear a padded bar. it fits nicely and super slim waist.  I got so many compliments with this dress. 
pick a larger size if you don't want the waist area to be tight.
Very pretty dress This would look good if you are tiny. Otherwise, the puffy bottom makes you look bigger than you are. Sadly this had to go back although in theory the dress is beautiful.

Classy and Elegant!  If you're going to read all of these reviews this is going to sound cliched. This gown is gorgeous and made the event special!  I received compliments all night long. I'm definitely drawn to classic pieces that have subtle yet beautiful detailing.  The lace, bodice construction, and beautiful back all hit those marks. This dress is exactly that type of dress that makes you stand out without looking like you're trying to. Would absolutely recommend.  I added a very thin black dress belt to accentuate my waist and kept it simple with drop earrings.  The embellishment on the bodice is enough without adding much  more, especially around the neck.  I usually wear a 4 and it fit great - I ended up wearing the 4L , was a smidge long but I had on 4 inch heels so it hit the floor with very little dragging.  (Beware that there is a slight train - make sure to let your date know too.)  

Hope whoever rents this next has a  magical night too!
Very elegant Lots of compliments.  I felt good in this dress and was completely shocked that it fit perfectly!    Very pleasantly surprised with my RTR experience.
Perfect! Beautiful!! I loved this dress. I wore it for NYE and it fit like a glove. It was kinda hard to raise my arms in it, but I loved it. I would order this again. Perfect length too.

Lovely and Slimming gown! Lovely and slimming gown! The gold and black is beautiful together. I am a very tall girl 5'10 and it was a little short for my liking, it didn't cover my shoes, and so it looked funny to wear heels. However, I fixed that by just wearing some black flats that blended in nicely. I also got the Size 10 as well, and it was a little big, but the size 8 was great!

PERFECT dress for a formal black tie wedding The dress was amazing - I receieved a million compliments, and it hugged my curves in a lovely elegant way. I especially loved how fitted in the waist it was, perfect to show off a little waist. LOVE LOVE LOVE

Black tie gala and unfortunately no air conditioning.  Easy to dance and move in. Subtle elegance Fit perfect except I'm 5'2" and had to wear 5 inch heels which was fine.  Dress shows all your curves so be prepared but very comfortable and classic

Great Dress I loved this dress and got a ton of compliments on it. I had to size up because the bust of the smaller one didn't close - so that is something to be careful of.  Other than that it fit well, was comfortable, and I loved it.

Gorgeous! Flattering and comfortable. Highly recommend the long if you want to wear heels. Dress was very comfortable and flattering.  Did not need to wear a bra thanks to the built-in support.  I went with the long as I wanted to wear heals and I'm about 5'8-5'9.  I received SO many compliments on the dress, it was definitely a show stopper.

Felt and looked amazing! This was my back up dress and I'm really happy this is the dress that Rent the Runway sent me! I rented this for a charity gala and the fit was fantastic! Loved that it had a built in bra so I didn't have to wear a bra underneath. The gold overlay was a couple of cm shorter than the black under shift which was a bit unfortunate but you couldn't really see it unless you looked at my feet. All in all I loved it!
This dress was amazing..  fit like a glove.   Built in corset makes it very flattering. I loved this dress.. I was so sad to return it.   I

This was a surprise back up dress.  Rent it.   I rented 5 formal gowns for a weekful of dressy events.  This was my last pick and I honestly was tired of loooking by the time I choose this one.  It ended up being my surprise favorite out of the 5 rentals.  It is gorgeous.  I wanted to rent the 8 (6 is usual size) but it was not available.  I rented the 10 and crossed my fingers.  It was fine, could have definitely worn the 8 but I was comfortable.  I could not have received more compliments.

I received compliments on this dress all night! It was perfect for my black tie event The only con at all (which is to be expected from this style of dress) is that it wasn't the best for dancing, as the sleeves were a bit restricting, and I hadn't realized this form the pictures online but the back of the dress is a few inches longer than the front (so it drags a bit). These are minor cons though-- I still wouldn't have chosen a different dress!

beautiful fabric Beautiful material, seems very well made however, I immediately returned it.  This is really a "mermaid" style dress.  On the model, it beautifully skims her curves -but not in reality, unless you are one of those women who have no hips and no caboose. I am 5'6, just under 140lbs, and fairly athletic.  The 6R was better than the 8R, but both were way too tight to be able to sit comfortably or dance.  Oh well, I have a store credit for another event...

Classy Dress for any Formal Affair RTR was kind enough to send this as a back up when my original back up was not available. I ended up wearing the original dress. I did think this was pretty and wanted to give my comments if it helped others. This dress has a great built in bra and I sized up because the dress didn't have a lot of give to the fabric. It fit perfectly with even a bit of room to spare. I'm 5'6", size 12-14, 36DD and had on 3 inch heals on. The dress did not touch the ground, my shoe showed just a bit. I usually like dresses a little longer so I wanted to let people know this was not overly long. If you are over 5'6" you should wear low heals or get the Long.
Great for black tie Great fit, very flattering.  Perfect for a black tie event.  Went with my back up size.

Great dress for Gala This dress was comfortable. Loved the small train. The Gala was a 100 anniversary celebration with a Gatsby theme. Loved the dress for fit and comfort. The length was perfect with 4 inch heels.

I could be a part of the wedding without overpowering the bride and could dance the night away after I'm 5'8", 38 DDD and full-figured/hourglass. The fit through the body and hips was great. My bust felt secure. The only issue is that the dress was not long enough for me to wear heels. Flats made it the perfect length, but heels would have made it look awkward.

Great dress that fit like a glove! I wore this dress to a formal event and loved it! it fit very well and was long enough for me (I'm 5'10'). It's a great fabric with beautiful gold lace throughout :-)

Beautiful, beautiful dress.  I LOVED THIS DRESS. It was perfect, and so pretty. I got so many compliments all night about it, and actually surprisingly comfortable, even with the corset built in. And it actually managed to give me curves, which is astounding because I'm built like a board. HOWEVER: if you are 5'6" (like myself), ORDER THE LONG. The regular barely hit the ground when I wasn't wearing my shoes, and then with heels (2.5"), the dress looked a little awkwardly short, because you could see my feet. But, despite that, everyone still complimented me on the dress. I felt like a million bucks.

Comfortable and classic Loved this dress. The 10 fit but was way too short and came slightly damaged, so I went up to the 12 and it was barely long enough. I ordered Longs in both sizes, but am 90% sure I was sent the regular lengths. It definitely hugs curves, so Spanx came in handy. The built in bra was pretty neat too and it was nice to not have to worry about it during all the dancing. This isn't a showstopper, but it's definitely classic and comfortable.

Show stopper! This was the perfect dress for my sorority formal! I got so many compliments all night. The dress does run a bit on the small side so definitely order one size larger as a backup. I am 5'6" and wore 2.5 inch heels and the long length was perfect. My backup size was in the regular length and it was way too short, even without heels. I would definitely recommend this dress!

AWESOME!!! This dress was absolutely perfect for a black tie wedding..  Pros: Fit like a glove (I am 5'6.5" and 130ish lbs) and typically wear a 4 or 6. I wore a 4 in this. It was perfect.  No bra required (one is built in), comfortable, easy to sit (& dance) in, sexy while conservative, tons of compliments
Cons: None
Beautiful! Perfect for anything- great dress!
Accidentally reviewed this twice Accidentally reviewed this twice
Wore this for a grad school gala. Gorgeous dress, easy to move in, flattering.

Didn't want to send it back! I can't begin to explain how amazing this dress is. I received so many compliments and I felt great all night. I usually wear a 2 or 4 so I ordered it in size 4R. It was a little snug so I would say it runs small but it fit me well and I do not have one negative thing to say about it.  The top is a corset style so it will be tight, keep that in mind when ordering sizes. There is a small train but nothing that would really get in the way. I ended up with this dress because a dress I originally ordered wouldn't ship in time and I am SO glad that happened. I chose this one because in all the photos of women wearing it before me, everyone single one of them looked amazing, Tall, skinny, curvy, short. ALL OF THEM. Can't thank Rent the Runway enough!!

One of my favorite gowns ever! The detail on the dress is amazing. I decided to go a size up because I don't like things too tight on my chest and the 8 seemed to be a bit too tight. The 10 still fit well and it was super comfortable!

I absolutely loved this dress and received so many compliments at the black tie wedding! The dress was extremely comfortable, flattering, and true to size! I found the length to be a little short for my liking and the cap sleeves made it somewhat difficult to raise my arms above my head (when dancing), but the dress made me feel beautiful and fit very well. I received so many compliments at the black tie wedding and I highly recommend this dress for any formal event.

Very flattering cut I was very happy with this dress. However, I am not sure how many hooks should be on the interior bodice. This 10 had 3 hooks, the 12 had two, which was clearly wrong. If I were to rent this dress again, I would call a RTR agent and ask him/her to check on the number of hooks. It is challenging to get this dress on solo, with the interior hooks followed by the zipper. The 10L was nearly perfect for my 5'6'' - maybe an inch too long - but the 12L pooled on the floor. I generally wear a size 8, so this dress does run a touch small.
Beautiful Dress It was my back up dress and I loved it! I had just had a baby and it made me feel curvy and sexy. I think the long would have fit better since my hips raised the dress a bit.

Loved this dress! It was unique and impressive, without stealing attention from the bride. This dress fit beautifully. Moderately form-fitting, but without highlighting my pear-shape and slightly poochy post-baby belly. And unlike most formal dresses, which tend to be strapless, I never ever had to hike this one up! I'm super-flat chested, but the cups on the dress are so molded it didn't matter that I didn't fill it out (I did end up using some bra padding anyway). Seriously, this is a show-stopper, and I got so many compliments. And the back!
The train was a teensy bit long, but other than that, the length was perfect with 3" heels.

Beautiful dress, long is really long. I loved this dress, but is was pretty long, with the train, it's a bit hard to walk and not get snagged on your heels.  I'm 5'7" and i wore 4 inch heels and it was still a little long.  I intentionally ordered a long thinking in high heels it'd be perfect....I should've gone with a Regular. Otherwise a beautiful dress.

Felt very glamorous. This dress is pretty amazing.  When I received it I was very hesitant because it was fairly tight so be sure to either order a size up or be confident in your measurements.  The dress has a built in bra, which is an amazing perk.  The back of the dress...to die for.  All in all, other than the small sizing, it was perfect.
I felt (and was told all night how I look) so glamorous in this dress!  Gorgeous! The dress was very flattering - tighter on the hips so a size bigger was helpful.  The length was perfect.

Beautiful dress, small fit The dress itself was beautiful, and got tons of compliments. I was glad I opted for a larger back up size, as the dress runs small. There is a built in bra that is not made for people with larger breast sizes so my chest area ended up looking a little constricted. It was nice to not have to wear a bra, but it was difficult to get into. I am on the shorter side and had a R length dress which ended up working  out perfect with my 5" heeled shoes.

Perfect dress for a wedding I wore this dress to a black tie wedding and received many compliments! I loved the fit of the dress and thought it was completely appropriate for a formal affair. The dress does run a bit short so I ended up having to wear low heels. I recommend getting the long if you are a bit taller. This was my favorite rental so far from RTR!

This dress looked amazing! This dress looked beautiful. It had zero stretch though, making it quite tight in the bust. The corset is quite short and was uncomfortable. I did get a  few comments on how lovely the dress was and it did look great.  My upper arm was actually bruised from the sleeve cap on one side though. It did look great, but I just couldn't wait to get out of it! It is a very flattering cut as well.

Beatiful Dress! Sexy & Elegant!  Dress fits true to size. Definitely not as long as it is in the model photo. I'm 5'6 and the 12 long was not long enough. I went to a retail location and they didn't have anything for me to make an exchange. I got the 14R as a backup but it didn't fit my curves as well as the 12 and the length was even shorter/ the lining was cut weird. Even though the dress was not long enough it was still beautiful and I felt great in it. If you are my height or taller I would suggest  a very low heal to flats, or really nice shoes that you want to show off! If the length was longer I would give it 5 stars

I wore the back and it was perfect! I had to size up one because I have never worn this style. The dress was gorgeous. I paid for another but I wore this which was my back up. Too many compliments. Loved the train. Best choice ever! I choose runs small because I wear a size 6 or 8 but I am glad I choose the 10 L and still the front of the feet was still showing.
Gorgeous and perfect - fit like a dream. Very flattering cut. If you're taller, get a longer one unless you want your shoes showing.

Comfortable dress with a flattering cut! This is a GREAT dress.  Similar to most people, this fits true to size and has a COMFORTABLE built in bustier, so no bra needed.  I was a little worried about this because some built ins are very stiff and start cutting into your side, but this is extremely comfortable.  The bustier is bra material but the the wiring either is more of a thick ribbing or so padded you cannot feel the wire.

This is a very flattering dress and the kick train makes it extra special.   I'm 5 foot 4 and wore 3 inch heels and it was perfect.
This dress loved my curves and I loved this dress! The fit was perfect. The built in (real bra) was amazing- I am a 38G. The dress was light and comfortable. I felt sexy and classic.

Gorgeous dress! Loved this dress and received many compliments.  The 8L was a tad tight, but the 10 was not available.  I did not need to wear a bra (and I usually do) as the bodice/built-in-bra was very supportive.  The lace was beautiful and comfortable.  The "long" was the perfect length for me with high heels.  Beware that there is a small train in the back that others may step on if you're not careful.  Probably not the best dancing dress due to the train, but definitely beautiful.  I would rent this again.

I LOVED this dress. It made me feel so glamorous and I got a ton of compliments. This dress does run a little small. I usually wear a 4 or 6, but the 8 fit me perfectly. The built in bra is a huge plus. Dancing was a little challenging as I had to make sure people didn't step on the back (I wore a small heel so the dress did trail a bit in the back - which made it beautiful, but also something to watch out for!). Overall, absolutely loved the dress.

I am a past queen for the Orange Festival in LA.  This was the Coronation Ball.  It was great!  I normally wear a 4, but when I tried the 4R I could only zip it comfortably to mid back.  The corset underneath wasn't nearly wide enough, and I'm not busty at all.  I wore the 6R instead.  It was still a little tight around my back, but I had extra room in waist and hips.  The train was a little cumbersome.  I tripped, and I had to trim the loose threads that were trailing behind from the underneath black layer.  It was still a stunning dress though, and I got many compliments.  I can't seem to load my size info but I'm 5'5" and 128 lbs, bust 34B.
Meh. Not as nice looking as picture, and very tight. Weirdly short even with heels (I'm only 5'4")   As above
it was a wedding tight, but next size was too big

The dress was absolutely gorgeous and fitted perfectly.   This was my back up dress as they did not have the second size I had asked for my first dress. I ended up wearing this one since my first choice dress was too big for me. I actually liked it more than the other and was happy with it. I got so many compliments for this dress, it was incredible. The dress is beautiful, looks elegant and is very flattering. 
This was my first time using the renttherunway service and I was very impressed with every step of the process: the communication, the shipping and the product. I will use it again when I need a new dress.

The dress was perfect for the occasion I wore it to. Everyone loved it and I felt amazing in it!  The dress fit perfectly. I normally wear a size 6 so I chose the 6 and then an 8 for my backup as some said it ran on the smaller side. Both actually fit perfectly although the top of the size 8 was a little bigger fit than I liked so I went with the 6R. I'm 5'6" so the Regular was perfect - it was a little long but with heels it was fine. I'm so glad I went with the regular. Everyone loved the dress - got so many compliments and I felt like a movie star! Would definitely rent this again!

Beautiful dress. I received several compliments. I loved it! With my athletic frame, I couldn't zip it all the way up. No worries, I pinned it back and made a deeper V-backline. No one knew the difference and I danced the night away!

This dress is beautiful and highlights all the right curves. I wore it to a diplomatic ball. I got a size 2, I'm usually a size four but I have a very small bust so the 2 fit perfectly! Cons, I live across the street from Rent the Runway and everyone at my university goes there for the same occasions. Unfortunately, there was one other duplicate (but that just goes to show it's a popular dress). I think it's a great dress for slimmer body types, because it hugs the body and accentuates the wait.

First Black Tie Wedding This was my very first experience with RTR and I'm very impressed.  I traveled from out of town and it was great to have the dress waiting for me.  It does run small so I quickly had to order a larger size and was happy it came so fast in time for the wedding!  I received a ton of compliments.  This really was a beautiful dress and very flattering.  I personally hate wearing heels but if your tall like me and want to wear heels be sure to order the long version for the regular size for me was just touching the floor without shoes.

Elegant fit with the right amount of shine! I took the advice of others in assuming this dress runs a bit small - I normally wear a 4, but the 6 fit perfectly! (By the end of the night, it was getting a bit uncomfortable around the ribs, so I can only imagine how tight the 4 would have been!)  I normally wear a Long, but wanted to wear flats, so chose the regular - it was maybe an inch too short, but worked well with the shoes I had!  I would highly recommend this dress - its very flattering & elegant!

Striking! GORGEOUS dress for a formal affair.  I normally wear a 4, however, I ordered the 6L as a back-up style because most people mentioned it ran a bit small.  I'm glad I ordered the 6L.  It fit PERFECTLY!  It had a built in bustier that was snug, but it's how it should fit.  No need to wear a bra!  The only thing about this dress is that it was LONG.  I am 5'10" and wore 3-4 inch heels and the train was still grazing the floor.  I was concerned I was going to trip on it or tear up the bottom, because we would be doing a lot of dancing.  I opted not to wear this dress for this reason.  However, now I know!  Maybe I will rent this dress for another occasion and get the regular length.

Beautiful, beautiful dress I'm in between the height requirements for the dresses - I'm 5'6.75". So I rented the long, and figured with the extra height from my 4.5" heels I'd be fine. Not so. I still had a tiny train and of course I was paranoid about that. The built-in corset was clutch. I also wore some extra-strength Spanx underneath - it's the type that goes up to just under one's bra, and it wasn't visible at all. 

I will say, I got some hips, and with the corset and Spanx and tight, I felt like I could not breathe. I felt like I could have gone with the 8. But everyone assured me I looked fine in the 6 and should wear it, and I definitely could move. (I didn't rent the 8 as my backup. S-M-R-T) People came up to me and complimented the dress so much. (whether that's the dress wearing me, or just that I looked awesome and the dress was great too, you decide) It's really just as lovely in person as it is online.

Selected this gown for a black tie wedding in Boston.  Loved the train and flow of this dress.   Built in bustier was great, very comfortable, no worries about dancing.  The flow of this dress was very nice, a little shorter in front, but not a problem.  Very elegant, classy and the back was an added plus to the overall beauty of the dress.

I wore this dress to an award ceremony and it was phenomenal (got so many compliments!).  I have a fairly large bust (34 DDD) so it was a bit tight there, but the gold overlay did a great job of keeping the cleavage work appropriate. The zipper in the back was tough to zip up (not related to the size of the dress, it was just kind of sticky) - it took two people to help me get it zipped up.

Unforgettable Dress! I wore this dress as a bridesmaid in a black tie wedding. The gold overlay is gorgeous and has a little stretch to it. It has a little train (just of the gold lace), which made it even more elegant. I did have to be careful walking and recommend holding the train up/down stairs because you can snag a heel in the lace. It has a built in small corset (just two latches) which really helped the shape of the dress (i felt that my waist was a little lost otherwise) and made me feel comfortable without a bra. I felt supported all day/night. My only issue with the dress was the length. I'm 5'8" and ordered the 8L--it just grazed my bare feet. I wore 2 inch heels nonetheless, I didn't think it looked too bad to see my shoes clearly but would have preferred it otherwise. The train helped give the illusion it was a little longer than it was. I wish I had a picture of the back- but the scoop back is lovely and the dress hugs one's backside just enough to make it a little sexier but not inappropriate. The detail of the gold lace overlay is even more striking in person! Its a gorgeous dress for special occasion!

Felt like a queen! This was my first experience with Rent the Runway.  Despite being nervous about receiving my dress only a day before the event, the delivery was easy to track & on time.  I usually wear a size 0, but ordered a 2 as well just to be safe.  The 0R fit a little snug but comfortable once zipped up.  The length was a tad short but worked fine with my 3 inch heels. If you like your dress to pool, then you would need the 0L  I just had to be careful not to step on the back hem.  I loved not needing to wear a bra with this dress as it has built in support.   I enjoyed numerous complements throughout the night & felt very glamorous.  I think this design is very flattering on a smaller frame & recommend it highly!

Runs small in chest, beautiful dress.  I have a 34B bust and the size 2 was way too small to fit them in. Other than that, the dress is beautiful and classic and I would totally have worn it other than the bust problem.

Beautiful dress I normally wear a size 8, but that wasn't available so I rented a 6R and 10R.  The 10R ended up being perfect due to the body-hugging fit.  I wore one of those low-back bra converters due to the swooped back and it worked great.  I did find it strange that the 6R had a side zipper but the 10R didn't have any zipper.  So needless to say, pulling a sequenced dress over your head requires that you do your hair after you're already in the dress.  I also found the dress quite short since I'm 5'3" on a good day and when I put on 3.5" heels it was nearly up to my ankles.  I ended up just wearing flats and the dress was only about an inch too long.  Despite these minor complaints the dress was absolutely stunning and I received a ton of compliments.  It's definitely a showstopper.

Stunning gown, was sad to return after! I wore this to a military ball, absolutely loved this dress, and got tons of compliments! I wouldn't hesitate to rent again. I am typically right on the fence between a 4/6 depending on how fitted the ribcage area/back are; both sizes fit well, but there were 2 deciding factors on why I went with the 6L. First, the length was something the reviews mentioned and the 4L was just too short. I'm just over 5'5 and the 4L still would have shown most of my foot in any shoe that was not a flat. I wore 4" heels and the length was perfect. Second, the 6L fit just a little more comfortable/less restrictive in the armpit area.  The back was just low enough that I wore a sticky bra instead of a strapless, but not especially revealing. I def recommend this dress - the sparkle style and floor length made it formal, but a total steal at what I paid for the rental.

What I absolutely loved about this dress is that it's truly an eye catcher! No other dress compared. I'm 5'3 weighing in at 115 pounds. The size 2R fit me nearly perfectly when I had on my heels and truly stood out from any other prom dresses I had seen. The only con I would have for this dress is that the sleeves are a little uncomfortable but other than that it's an sensational dress and not one negative thing was said about it!
Beautiful dress but too short.  This dress is beautiful but even the long was so short on me. I'm 5'10 and the dress was about 3-4 inches short without heels. Beware tall ladies.

Easy to wear Hollywood glamour This dress is beautifully built, flattering for any body type. Being 5'2" I already knew it would be long so I bought the hem tape and hemmed it up, about 3-4 inches, and I still wore 3 inch heels. It was pretty easy to move in, I liked the cap sleeve.  Even with the cowl back I was still able to wear a normal bra. I think for curvy women this dress hugs in all the right places and forgiving in all the right places.  This is my first RTR experience and I look forward to renting again. I did rent a second style for backup and since they don't give 2 sizes for the 2nd style and it didn't fit RTR overnighted another dress. I called Friday and received it Saturday just in time. I ended up with my first pick but it was nice to have my back up replaced.

This dress made me feel confident in my own skin. I wore this dress from prom, an I received so many compliments. I recommend this dress if you want to make a statement. The dress was not to tight or too loose, it fit just right. I danced all night with out a problem. the sequencing look classy and if didn't scratch me at all.

I was getting compliments the entire day on this dress! As MOH for a wedding, it was a hit! Like the previous reviews said, it runs short. At my height, the front of the dress hit right above my ankles, but the back came down to my heels so it didn't look awkward because of that. It fit my boobs and hips great, but it could have been a little snugger in the waist. Other than those things, I adored the dress! It was so comfortable all night and I didn't get overheated dancing the night away in a barn in August without air conditioning! My underarms were never scratched by the sequins and if you're leery about getting this dress, don't be! I loved it and so did everyone else.
I felt like royalty in it. The dress was breath taking on stage and received tons of complements! Fit really well but the shoulders keep falling so I had to secure them with fashion tape.
I was complimented in this dress all evening. This dress fit like a glove. It was long enough and comfortable.

Children's Hospital of Los Angeles Noche de Ninos Gala: beautiful event celebrating good people. The fit was very nice where it hugged all the right curves.  It wasn't too tight though, so I didn't need to wear spanx which was nice.  It does have a low back though, so I had to wear a backless bra.  I'm 5'2" so the dress was a bit long even with my 3 to 4 inch heels.  Overall though, I got tons of compliments on this dress and I felt beautiful wearing it!

I was complimented on the dress all night long. I felt like a star.  This dress fit perfectly for my Hollywood themed holiday party.  I received compliments all night long, and the bartender said we were best dressed! :) I felt so wonderful all night long. The dress is SUPER comfortable. I know some people had trouble with the beading under the arm, but I did not feel much. The dress hides imperfections, so you won't have to worry about wearing anything under the dress. I usually wear an 8, but went for a 6.
I received compliments all night on this dress. It was an absolute hit! I rarely get clothing without trying it on first, but this fit great!
I enjoyed this dress.  I thought I would love the dress more and I didn't. It's true to size I got a regular size 2 and it fit perfectly it was not long at all which made me worried originally

I haven't gone yet, it's tomorrow night I rented this dress but didn't wear it because it was WAY too short. I am 5'11 and got the 12L and  this dress hit just above my ankles. I also got the 14L but it was way too big. Glad I ordered a back up dress.

LOVE IT! Would wear again. When I first got the dress, I thought oh my this is heavy, but once I got it on I had no worries. I loved this dress. I wore it to my husband's military ball. The dress was very comfortable and as long as you adjusted the waist area it was flattering. The back is a lower back dress so you would need a low cut bra for the dress. It is a bit long. I'm 5'5" and wore 4 inches shoes and it worked well for me.
N/A Beautiful dress!!!! would recommend to anyone
I got more compliments on this dress than ever! Definitely red carpet worthy  #hollywoodglam

Divalicious! Ordered both the 6l & 8L decided on the 8L only because of the sleeves. On the 6L the sleeves were a little snug...I wore a regular bra and tucked in the draped part which didn't take away from the dress. I received numerous compliments even from the bride herself!

Fantastic. Just get it.  This was my first experience with rent the runway. I was a little nervous as I'm sure you are too – but just go for it! This dress is gorgeous, fits very well, and fits true to size. I had read some people complain that the dress was too short. I am 5 foot four inches and wore the regular dress with 3 inch heels and it was perfectly long enough without being difficult to walk in. At the end of the night I finally noticed the sequins rubbing my underarm. I was concerned the back would flap open or the front would dip weird when I bent over, but it doesn't.

I wore this for my senior prom and loved it! It was an amazing night  It is so comfortable and easy to dance in. I'm 5'7" and wore a 0L. It was definitely very long, but when I put on my 5 inch heels, it was perfect. I recommend getting the long if you like wearing tall heels like I do. I loved how it was fitted around my waist and hips, and the draping in the back showed the perfect amount of skin without sliding or falling down.

A little short  The dress was beautiful. I ordered a 4R and and 6R. I wore the 4R because it fit better, but it was a little short. Other than that it was comfortable and very pretty. I don't have too much of a tummy but I still had to wear spandex with it to smooth everything over. I will definitely rent again though! Great first experience.
Wonderful dress and fit perfectly! Great dress for a formal event

You will NOT want to return this gorgeous Badgley Mischka gown! First off, let me say that this dress is AMAZING! I needed a dress for a photo shoot with my husband, and I wanted something glitzy and glamorous. This dress certainly fits that description. I am typically a size 6, so I ordered a 6L and a 4L. I tried on the 6L first, and that fit so well that I didn't even try on the 4L. I am 5'10'', and I wore 3" heels; the dress was the perfect length. The ONLY reason I didn't give the dress five stars is because the sleeves are somewhat tight on the upper-arm, and it made it difficult to lift my arms at times. I personally went without a bra because the back is cut just a bit too low to wear one. The dress was in great shape, and I didn't notice any imperfections. This dress is truly stunning, and I would recommend it to everyone.

this is a great dress. it was very comfortable, had a great lining inside. must get low back corset! if you are wearing heels you must get the Long Length. if you are over 5'6"  you must get the long length. other than that, great dress.

Unbelievable Dress! Wonderful Dress! I didn't want to ship it back! Because I am 5'1" I would say this dress runs a little small. I wore a 4R and the length was PERFECT on me, where most dresses usually run long on me. This dress was so flattering and I received so many complements. I would rent this dress again if I just had an occasion for it! My only small nag would be that I occasionally felt the sequence rubbing under my arm but nothing that bothered me too much or caused any pain.

I got so many compliments on this dress. I felt like a million bucks in it.  The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars is; 1) it does limit your movement a little bit. Not much, but enough to notice, and 2) the color in the photo online is not as true to the actual color of the dress as I would have hoped. The actual color is darker. Overall though, a gorgeous dress that i'd wear again and again.

This dress makes you stand out in a crowd! Tons of compliments. I have rented several dresses from RTR and this one did not disappoint. I usually wear a size 4, and the dress ran true to size (if not a bit smaller). The length was perfect with 3" heels, and I am short. I would go with the long length if you are 5'5" or taller and plan to wear heels. I wore a convertible bra that came down low in the back. The is enough material in the back that you can cover a low-ish strap. Very old Hollywood and glamorous! I would definitely recommend this dress! Very flattering on all types of shapes and sizes.

So many compliments, fit perfectly! Very comfortable to wear all night. Runs short! I wore this for a bridesmaids dress. It definitely runs short so I chose L size and even that was a little short with heels. I wore my own nude bra with a backless converter that I also bought through RTR. I definitely recommend this dress! It fit like a glove, and I received compliments all night long!

So many compliments! After looking through reviews, I was afraid to get anything other than a long. Since there were none available at the time, I ended up getting a 0R and 2R. I kind of think it depends on which dress you get because the 0R was quite a bit longer than the 2R and also had a train whereas the 2R did not. However, the 0R ended up fitting me so well, length and everything! I am 5'3", 115lbs and wore 4 inch heels. This was the most comfortable dress I have ever worn! The fabric is stretchy and breezy, but still thick enough to where you can wear it without a bra if you have a smaller chest like me. The compliments lasted all night!! I definitely recommend this dress and can't wait to rent it again myself! I do suggest taking advantage of ordering a backup size length wise because it does run short.

Awesome dress.  So many compliments.  So comfortable to wear! I was on the shortest end of the tall size but since I never wear talls I was worried to try it.  (It also wasn't available in long).  The regular was great.  I wore 3 inch heels and it was perfect.  I had a back up pair of shoes that were about 1 1/2 inches but I would have stepped on it all night long.  I am usually anywhere from a 0-2 but the two worked great.  Not too tight and not too loose.

Super flattering color and fit. So comfortable! I loved this dress. But beware...get the long if you are 5'5 or taller. Trust me. You'll be pulling it down all night. I love to wear heels and I ended up going with a 1.5 inch heel because the regular is very short.

I am usually a size 6 so that is what I ordered, the length was perfect and it fit like a glove!  The dress fit perfectly, a backless bra was needed due to the open back of the dress. It had no zipper and easily slid over my head and fit snugly on but still had room to dance in.  I loved this dress!

Compliment City! I wore this dress for a black tie optional wedding in Savannah, Georgia. I felt so glamourous in this dress. I love that it was conservative with just a touch of sexy. I had people coming up to me all night complimenting me and the dress. The sequins didn't bother me, and overall I found the dress quite comfortable.
This dress was super classy.  It fit my hourglass body perfectly!
Perfect bridesmaids dress.  Beautiful dress - very flattering.

The dress was incredible! Super comfortable, but sorta itchy underneath the arms since I was dancing The fit was perfect, although I wore the 6R instead of the 4R because it fit longer with my heels. I'm 5'4" and without heels the hem pooled over my toes. If you plan on dancing, it might itch a little! But not enough that it will bother you. The dress was stunning and I highly recommend it :-)

I got so many compliments on this dress!!! Fit's like a glove! There is no zipper though so it needs to go on over your head which can be a disaster for hair! Other than that it was perfect! I wore 3.5 inch heels and the length was fine.

Loved it! I felt like a princess and was super comfortable all night. The fit and length were perfect. I wore nude flats with it so the R was perfect. I got a backless bra to wear with it, which worked perfectly. I was able to wear spanx under it without them showing. The arms were a bit tight and they rubbed on the sequence but it wasn't anything major.

The dress was absolutely beautiful. It shows off every single curve you have.  The dress fit small and I'm 5'3" and the 10R barely touched the ground. The package was opened when it was delivered to my house and I didn't receive a garment bag. 

Overall everyone told me I had the best dress yet and looked like a Hollywood star. It is a beautiful dress but is more of a copper color than pictured.

STUNNING. Absolutely perfect for our glam-meets-desert engagement shoot. THIS DRESS. Seriously. I had a stark contrast in my vision for an engagement shoot... you know, the typical casual, holding sunflowers and rustic signs in a haystack. Instead, we thought it would be very unique to put a formal twist on the photos and went the formal route in Red Rock Canyon in Las Vegas. At first, I was worried this dress was going to be over the top... but it was PERFECT. When I initially put it on, I felt like a complete glamazon bombshell. It is incredibly comfortable, easy to move in and flattering to any body type (and I didn't even need to get a special bra for the low back)! I have absolutely no butt and it made me look like I had one... again, very figure friendly! It may look flashy, but it is unbelievably classy. Can't say enough good things about this showstopper!
Fit was great! Dress was pretty comfortable, had some stretch to help. I loved the look as a bridesmaid dress to accent a wedding gown.

I wore this to my prom & just felt like a movie star! It gives off such a old Hollywood glam vide! Normally I am a 4, but if you're going for a more form-fitting look this dress's fabric is very easy to stretch and work with your body, so keep that in mind. I usually assume that my body is too lankey for a regular in length, so I got the long. I did find myself stepping on the back when I walked so, I had to hold it a lot. but normally I would recommend going bigger. keep jewls simple, THIS DRESS SPEAKS FOR ITSELF!

This dress was absolutely beautiful! I kept getting compliments all night. The dress fit perfectly! I was worried about what kind of bra I would wear but I ended up not needing one. I wore flats because I got a regular since the long wasn't available the day I needed it. It worked out though because my feet weren't hurting at the end of the night. I'm so glad I rented this dress!

Amazing Dress! This dress fit me beautifully.  It has a bit of stretch and hugged my curves in all the right places.  I wore shapewear but no bra.  I'm a 36 D and was worried that I might  not be able to get away with it but the lining is very heavy and thick and was a snug fit so it wasn't and issue.  I'm 5'6" and wore 3"  heels. It was a tad bit long but not enough to be an issue.  It does have a small train in the back which really adds to the elegance but just a tad in the way for dancing. It was totally worth it though.  I was very comfortable and received many compliments. I rented the rose gold lawson cuff and alex earrings by Kendra Scott and complimented the dress perfectly. I also rented the Rose Gold Metal Mesh Minaudiere by Sondra Roberts. This was a perfect match and big enough to carry phone, lipstick, glasses, and a few other small items.
Amazing dress. Was very comfortable. I received so many compliments. Would definitely rent again. Fit is true to size. It also has some stretch to it, making it very easy to dance the night away.

10 months later... and i'm STILL getting compliments on this dress Although i was hoping the dress was long enough for me to wear heels with, i had to go with flats, but it didn't matter because the dress was amazing. I got compliments all night... week, month about this dress. it was the perfect formal dress every and i would recommend it to everyone!
Great wedding, great dress. As always, got tons of compliments on my RTR dress selection :)          Dress definitely true to size.

Beautiful classy gown!! Tons of compliments!  This dress is simply stunning and classy. I followed the reviewers and ordered the long... Glad I did! I wore 3 1/2 inch heels and it perfectly skimmed the ground on my 5'6 height. Recommend wearing hair up, dark pink or reddish lipstick and dangle earrings...this dress is beautiful, no need to take away it's glamour.
My bridesmaids wore this gown for my wedding! They looked absolutely amazing! I highly recommend!! It fit all my girls shapes and sizes and looked beautiful on each individual body type!

An unforgettable classy dress This dress was beautiful and classic. I loved the fit of this dress, I felt comfortable all night.  I am 5'3 and wore a 3" heal and the length of the dress was perfect. I wore it for a black tie Vegas wedding. The dress did slightly rub underneath my arm… But no reason not to rent the dress.

I've never worn something so beautiful. This dress is incredible and the simplicity will make anyone shine. On the model, the dress looks lighter in color and the fabric looks thinner than it actually is in person.The color is definitely more of a rich champagne (so buy jewelry accordingly) and it's actually fairly sturdy. (Sturdy enough to flatter any body type!) It's also EXTREMELY comfortable and felt fantastic the entire night. The only word to describe this dress: breathtaking.

PERFECTION My best friend picked this dress for me to wear as my Maid of Honor dress for her wedding - it's INCREDIBLE. All night people asked me where I got it - I got compliments from random people. It's just stunning. Its really a rose gold color, but for some reason in some pics it looks silver. Either way is amazing.  I was a little concerned about the length at first but i wore it with 3.5 or 4 inch heels and it was the perfect length. I felt like a million dollars. If I could afford to actually buy it, and if i had somewhere to wear it, I would. INCREDIBLE!
I loved this dress. I received so many compliments. Con: I wanted it to be a bit longer.  pro:  great fit, a little stretch helped

Amazing customer service, and the urban express people worked hard /overtime to get it to me! The long was still a little short on me. I am 5'9 and it was OK when in bare feet, the dress hit the floor, but once I put heals on, it was about 3 inches too short.
Dress really shines.  Slightly itchy material.

Gorgeous! This dress was absolutely gorgeous and it was beautifully made. Unfortunately, the other dress I rented along with it fit me so much better and was just as beautiful. Definitely would like to rent this again but in a 0P. It does have some give to it so hopefully they'll come out with a 00P ;)

Sequins are a girls best friend!   I wore this to an awards show and I'm so glad I did!  This 12L fit like a dream.  I got SO many Compliments!  It was a little big on the top, so I wore my padded bra.  I usually take a 10, but the 10R was SO  short on me, so the 12L was my back up.  I am SO glad to have the extra length - I'm only 5'6", but in heels I'm close to 5' 9" and the length is a MUST!  The material is stretchy, so I could have gone with a 10 or a 12, but I needed the length.  Were the sequins a little scratchy under the arms?  A little, but I got over that so fast when I started getting compliment after compliment!  Loved it!

So perfect for a sorority formal! I rented this dress for my sororities Red Carpet formal. I LOVED it! It was so flattering and fit like a glove. I wish I would've been able to rent the 2, but the 4 fit pretty well. My only complaint is that the sequins kind of start to rub after awhile!
Seriously got so many compliments. Was absolutely obsessed with this dress!  Fit was great. The rose gold color of the dress was gorgeous. It was so classy and glamerous.
Rented as part of an at home try on. This dress is gorgeous. I did not want to send it back.

This was a beautiful fit! It was the perfect dress for a NYE wedding. The dress is mostly true to size. I was advised to size down just because of the stretch in the dress. I'm normally 4-6 but did wind up wearing a 2 since the dress stretched that much.

Gorgeous sparkler that got so many compliments! The long was a little long, I had to make sure I held it up when I walked. Wasn't a huge problem though! The dress did rub under the arms due to the sequins - it HURT by the end of the night and I had raw skin. It was worth it for the compliments in the dress though!

Absolutely beautiful dress with just the right amount of bling! I ordered this style as my backup for a formal awards gala for my work. It was the perfect balance of sexy yet appropriate for an environment at which colleagues are present. The combination of the side slit and the one-shoulder style made for the right element of alluring without presenting too much leg or too much cleavage. The dress fit very comfortably and I found it to be pretty true to size, and I'm 5-5, and was able to wear 3.5" heels and still have a nice length of dress barely skimming the floor. Some reviewers found the sequins to be uncomfortable in the armpits, but I didn't experience that issue. I was also able to comfortably wear a strapless bra, although you could probably wear a convertible bra with just one shoulder strap attached. Plenty of room in the bust for D/DD. Received SO many compliments on this look!

Loved the one shoulder look and the color of this dress, perfect hue for NYE This dress is absolutely beautiful. I rented it for a NYE wedding. Loved the sapphire sequined look! This dress fit true to size . The cons about this dress was that I didn't care for how high the slit was on me, I kept feeling like I had to adjust the slit. Another con was that my arms scratched the sides of the dress and by the end of the night I was done with it! All in all it was a beautiful dress but I am not willing to sacrifice wearing a dress that scratches me and makes me feel like I need to adjust it every few min.

WOW!  I did not like saying goodbye to this dress.  It was a stunning show stopper!   I am a pretty small girl and I was so excited by how well this fit true to size.  Perfect length for me.  I could have gotten away with flats because of the slit in front, but I wore 1-inch heels and it was exactly right.  It is super flattering.  It is stretchy so it's very comfortable to wear.  My boyfriend would not stop complimenting me, and I got compliments even from strangers.  Happy customer!

This dress exceeded my expectations! This dress fit me perfectly, I am 5'2" and wore 3 inch heels. The folds in the front camoflaged my problem area nicely and the leg slit accentuated my legs. The top fit great, not always the case when I wear petites, since I have a fairly big chest. I was able to wear a one strap bra. This was a fantastic first experience with Rent the Runway.

I received tons of compliments on this dress!  So, somehow my first two dresses I ordered were unavailable because someone returned them both late. After being extremely frustrated I found this one in an 8L and a different dress. I got lucky and they both fit. In the end I felt the most confident in this one. I did wear spanx because I still have a little belly from being a mom :). It is form fitting but there is also ruching around the stomach so that helps. It was easy to move in and plenty long enough with heels. I will say right at the top of the slit the sequins go on the inside so after a night of dancing my leg is all irritated from it rubbing against it all night. But overall it was a great dress that made me feel very confident and get lots of compliments!

This dress has serious celebrity status. I received compliments all night from strangers The gathering at the mid section is perfectly designed. It hides any small problems while not adding an illusion of extra either. I was nervous to wear such a form fitting dress, but it fell on all the right places accentuating the right spots. I wore a long, which I normally do not considering I'm 5'5" but so glad I did. I wore a higher heel, and the extra length helped to elongate my body, and I'm my opinion, slimmed down my large hips.  I'm so glad I took the risk and chose this dress.
This dress was very comfortable, was able to dance all night, and is form fitting.  Very form fitting but extremely flattering.

Stunning dress for a formal wedding!!! This dress is amazing!!! I wore it to my brother's formal New Year's Eve wedding and it was just perfect.  It is a gorgeous dress that is also extremely comfortable and easy to dance in...which we all know is very important.  The color is just stunning, even more so in person than in pictures.  I typically wear a size 4,  I am 5' -4" and 128 lbs., and the size 4 Regular fit perfectly.  With my 4" heels, the dress was the perfect length and I had no issues with it.  I also did not wear a bra with this dress, not that it was an issue seeing as I am only a B cup.   I received so many compliments throughout the night on the dress.  I LOVE sequins and anything sparkly, and this dress delivered...big time.  The draping/ruching is very subtly, but very flattering.  I highly recommend this dress...you can thank me later.

This dress was absolutely beautiful! I wore this dress to an Academy Award night black-tie fundraiser, and I felt like I was dressed for the real red carpet. I recently lost some weight so I wasn't sure of my size. I thought the 8L would be right (with 10R as backup). When I got the message that the size would not be available, I called customer service and they immediately added both the 8R and the 6L to my order, so they sent three different sizes. I ended up wearing the 6L because the dress has some stretch, and it was perfect! I needed help to zip up because of the zipper position. This was my first RTR dress, and I absolutely loved it.
Really beautiful dress in person and very comfortable to wear. Fit perfectly, I wore 4 inch heels with it so the length was perfect, but would have been too long with shorter heels.

I felt sexy and powerful! Every movement caught someone's eyes, I loved the sparkle effect. The dress was about 1.5 inches shorter than I would've liked, but I just chose shorter heels to offset this. I loved the heavy lining, but there was some scratching from the sequins right underneath the armpits. Very comfortable dress, I love to dance and twirl, and this dress was able to keep up with me without showing too much of the goods! This dress hugged me in the right ways, while still making my waist look thin (it might be magical, just saying).

The dress made me feel beautiful  and it was fun to wear to the military ball. Lots of compliments! Great fit, easy to wear, not heavy at all. Stretchy material and sequins did. It bother me a bit. Wear a strapless bra.

This dress was absolutely stunning! I received so many compliments and felt amazing in it!  This dress fit true to my size 8 curvy frame. The length was perfect with my 3 inch heels and fit like a glove. I had room to move and was happy that the sequins didn't rub my arm raw like I was worried about! I would definitely recommend this dress for any formal affair!

beautiful color while on - definitely matched my Marine's dress blues, sparkle is a showstopper the fit in the middle is extremely comfortable, extra room to breath - fits true to size, had a baby in July = wore this dress in November and felt brand new in this gorgeous gown! sparkles does irritate arm under the right side, be care how it rubs, the slit was perfectly placed and a beautiful accent, it was amazing on and pictured well!

Beautiful color, flattering cut, not too heavy! I ordered this dress and one other to try on and decide. I really liked both and ended up going with the other one, but would have loved to find an excuse to wear this too! The 4R fit me perfectly- the length was just right with heels and everything zipped up nicely. The dress was surprisingly lightweight given all the sequins and the thick lining lead me to believe that it wouldn't rub or irritate my skin, even if I wore it for an evening.

Simply stunning. It wasn't gaudy with sequins. It has that sparkle that is classy and elegant. The fit was perfect, and the was the right length. The only thing that bothered me that no one noticed was where it zipped on the side. At the bottom of the zipper it bulged out a little and I didn't like that. No one noticed, though.

Amazing, comfortable dress! So many compliments on this dress! It was fun to wear and was really comfortable. I wear a size down because I liked the way it fit better. The dress was very flattering. I felt amazing in this dress and definitely recommend it!

Me and close friends all rented dresses and were dolled up for a birthday celebration we all loved. The dress fit was good, not as flattering on a plus size person with a lot of belly. The length was just right with a 3in heel.

Felt so glamorous! The dress fit incredibly well and was very flattering. You need to hook the top of the zipper before trying to zip it up-- it makes it so much easier. The inside of my left arm was a bit irritated by the end of the night from rubbing against all of the sequins but nothing too worrisome. The slit showed just the right amount of leg. I loved this dress and got tons of compliments!

Wore this dress for a graduate gala in Boston. Loved the fit, the material is stretchy so it hugs your curves so having an "exact" fit isn't an issue (my backup smaller size was unavailable so a different dress in a size 2 was sent).  The top of the dress was somewhat large on me, or possibly stretched out, so I did use double sided fashion fabric tape to secure it to my bra.  I wore a one strap convertible bra and had no issues with having to "readjust" at all the entire night.  The color of the dress is a black fabric with navy/teal colored sequins (my daughter actually called it green so it isn't a true navy).  You can accessorize with black though because of this which was a plus for me as I had limited shoe options.  I am just shy of 5'3" and wore 3 inch heels which seemed perfect with the Petite size.  The regular probably would have been too long for anyone under 5' 3" even with taller heels if you are planning on dancing.  The only reason I gave it 4 out of 5 is because I did experience sequin "burn" under my arms.  However I was seriously dancing for at least a couple of hours.  Loved my first RTR and will use again!!  No filter or editing on my photos as I wanted to give a realistic impression of the dress.  Again, got lots of compliments!!
FUN & FAB Great dress for a formal affair (black tie wedding) No need for a strapless bra, slit is not to high so it makes this a sexy but comfy dress.

I wore this gown to a gala event and received many compliments from total strangers! Dress fit well (I'm 5'6" and 131 lbs), and was comfortable and easy to move in. Nicely lined, only a little scratchy under arms where sequins rubbed a bit. I wore a 1-strap convertible bra, but dress lining thick enough to go without. There were a few loose threads on the one I had but overall looked great and it made me feel glamorous without being too flashy.

I loved this dress so much. It was comfy, and glamorous.  The fit was perfect. I rented it for my sorority formal, and had no issues. I am usually a 2 or 4 and the 2 worked perfectly. The dress wasn't too long or short, I had probably 3 inch heals on and the dress was barely hitting the ground so it was great and I didn't trip once! I got a lot of compliments. I wore it for about 4 hours probably in total, and had no problems. It scratched a bit under my arms because of the sparkles but nothing to where I felt super uncomfortable.

Love this dress, it was perfect! I wore it for my engagement session. I got so many compliments! The 14R was a little loose but still fit well.  The 12L was much better. It accentuated my curves and made me feel so sexy. I received so many compliments wearing it around DC for my engagement session. I wish it were longer through. Even the 12L was pretty short. I wore flats and it barely scrapped the floor in the back. I would absolutely rent again!

Glitz and glam Dress is very comfortable and flattering on. I tried it on with 2.5 inch heels and had no issue with length. My only complain is I am small chested and the strapless side was HUGE on me. I would've needed double sided tape to keep it from showing everything off! I didn't end up wearing this dress for my event, but absolutely loved it and would rent again.

I loved this dress!  Before I even arrived at the ball I was getting compliments!  I rented this dress for the Navy Submarine Birthday Ball in Honolulu, HI. This dress was perfect! It wasn't heavy and not too hot to wear in this very hot climate.The compliments started even before we arrived at the ball and they kept coming all night long!  I rented a 6 and an 8 and ended up wearing the 6 because the bust in the 8 was a tad too big. But both sizes fit me. The length could not have been more perfect. I'm short, 5'2, and I wore 3 inch heels and the dress length was spot on! The train of the dress added a little more elegance as well and not to mention, it made my bum look fantastic!  The ruching in the midsection was wonderful to hide imperfections like lingering pregnancy weight. Overall I was extremely satisfied with this dress. This was my first RTR and I will definitely be back to rent again.

Perfect Fit. This dress accentuates curves perfectly. I loved this dress! It was so fun to wear, I took it our for a round 2. This dress seems to run true to size. I have a curvy figure and it fit my curves. This dress turned all the heads & many compliments were handed out.

Great dress! I received many compliments! I absolutely loved this dress.  I ordered a 2R and a 4R. The 2R fit well and grazed the floor perfectly, but came in a darker color than the actually dress I ordered.  The 4R was the correct color, but much shorter. RTR was accommodating with my concerns of having two different color dresses that were not the same length. I went with the 2R and the color blue matched perfectly with my date. I would definitely order this dress in the future!

It was our 7th ball and my second time using RtR. The ball was good but the dress was great! I ordered the 2R with the 4R as a backup. The 2 fit my body type extremely well but since I am on the taller side, it didn't quite suit my height, even though I was wearing flats. (I wore a 2L last year and for some reason ordered a 2R this year. What was I thinking?!) I wore the 4 instead and though it was loose (and didn't have the hook and eye closure at the top of the zipper), it was still flattering and earned me quite a few compliments. I never felt at risk of wardrobe malfunction, the dress was comfortable the whole night, the fabric was heavy enough to feel conservative even with the tantalizing leg slit, and it was the perfect color to compliment my date's uniform. The length of the 4 was perfect for my height. I have been singing the praises of this dress, the designer, and especially Rent the Runway every time someone comments on my dress. You will love it! (The picture of me by myself shows the 2, the pictures with friends are the 4.)

New Years Eve Party, 2017 I am in between sizes right now because of my broad back muscles. But this dress is stretchy and forgiving, so the 10 was too big. The long was perfect for my height plus a 2 inch heel. The dress looked better in person than it photographed. It wasn't too heavy regardless of the head to toe sequins. I felt like a classic movie star beauty. To avoid chafing from the sequins, I applied Body Glide to my underarms and to the skin along the top of the dress. It is a product I use while running to avoid chafing and can be purchased at sport stores or online. However, I woke up New Years Day with massive chafing on my thigh where the slit was. The sequins had rubbed my thigh raw and it lasted for a few days. I am sure Body Glide would have helped that as well. Overall, it fit like a glove, looked amazing, and was easy to move around in. Great for a night of dancing!

Great dress! Fun to wear. The slit up the leg makes it sassy. It worked great. I got the 6 and 8 but chose the 6 because the length was better for me. The 8 was a bit too long.  I'm not big on one shoulder dresses but this one worked great.  Overall, a great dress!
This was my first order from RTR.  It was so easy! I am glad I ordered the long length rather than regular.

I have never received so many compliments and stares on a dress.  AMAZING! Fit perfect.  Great length for 3.5 inch heels.  The dress was a little heavy so I wouldn't wear if it is hot outside.  Highly recommend this dress.

Attended prom theme birthday party. Felt like I received my h.s prom. Loved it !  Cons: I'm small in the bust area dress was a bit lose on the strapless side but not to the point of needing alterations.
Pros: Fit perfect every where else

So GLAMOROUS! I absolutely loved this dress! I wore it to my husband's Air Force Military Ball. It was stunning and so glamorous. I got tons on compliments. The fit was great, perhaps a little bit snug when trying to pull up the zipper, but it felt comfortable and was perfect. The sequins sparkled beautifully. I felt like the belle of the ball. I didn't want to take it off. I highly recommend this gown. This is my 3rd time renting from the runway, and I love it! Will definitely do it again.

Great Bridesmaids Dress! This dress was is fun to wear! Sparkly and classy with just the right amount of give in the fabric so you can breath and move comfortably. There is ruching in the tummy area. The leg slit is the star of this dress - very Angelina Jolie. The dress was comfortable all day, even through pictures, limo rides and a night of dancing. I didn't have to pull at it or adjust at hardly at all.

Beautiful gown! I ordered the 12L, with a 10L backup and a 14L (Just in case).  The 10L fit great,  but was a bit short, the 12L was a little roomy, but better in length, the 14L was the perfect length, but huge.  Ultimately I wore the 12L and received compliments all night.

The dress was wonderful and only added to the majesty of the red carpet event we attended. I ordered the 4L and 6L based on other reviews.  They both would have worked, but the 6 had an issue at the slit, where the lining was showing outside of the dress.  

The 4L was PERFECT.  The zipper is difficult to get up where the ruching is, that should be expected with a sequin dress however.  As mentioned in the other comments the sequins do start to be bothersome under your arm, again understandable with a sequin dress.  The dress had just enough give to be super comfortable sitting or standing and hugged in all the right places.

I wore 4 inch heels and I am just shy of 5'8" and the length was great.  The back of the dress did get caught in the heel a few times so I had to walk carefully, not too quick or with too much kick, which is what seemed to make it get caught.

My experience with RTR was awesome!  I was nervous for sure but so assured with the extra size and the overnight guarantee if it didn't work.  My sweetheart was sad to see me send the dress back, he loved me in it so much!  I would rent this dress from RTR again and any other for that matter.  I sure do appreciate all the details in the individual reviews, which helped me make the right choice.

Gorgeous Dress! Perfect for Formal Events I am 5'9" and I wore 3 inch heels so I went for a 2L with my backup size being a 4L. The 2L fit absolutely perfectly. I am a teacher, and I wore this dress for my students' senior prom this year. The dress was glimmery and sparkled in bright light and dim light. It looked absolutely amazing and all of my coworkers said that the dress was absolutely stunning. I would definitely recommend it. :)

I received so many compliments!  I felt like a princess!  The slit made me feel sexy, but everything was covered nicely.  I wore a strapless bra, and no spanx!  The gathered fabric on one side covered any insecurities I have about my midsection.

Perfection!  SO many compliments - it is a gorgeous dress - elegant and glamorous! It fit like a glove!  It was comfortable - not tight and constricting - it was everything we wanted!  At first, I had my reservations about a top to bottom sequin dress....we wore these as bridesmaid dress and did not want to look like the bride's back up singers - but this dress was so far from chacha diva status!  it was elegant!  shows a perfect amount of leg and shoulder - perfect!

I looked fabulous and received so many compliments!  It was so fun wear such a beautiful dress. The fit was awesome.  I am 5'4" and with 3" hills the length was perfect.  It was like the dress was made for me.

Perfect dress for the occasion.  Received lots of compliments.  I felt glamorous and so dressed up.  The fit was great.  I ordered the 8 and 10.  I used the 8 because it fit the best.  The 10 was too big.  I did notice that the 10 and 8 fit the same around the torso.   I'm going to assume it was because the 8 had been stretched out.  The only problem I noticed, were the zipper ended at my hip area it buckled a little.   It made me look hippy and I have no hips.  In the light I would pull it down in the area, but after the lights were lowered, I didn't care.

Ruching did not work for me I ordered this as a backup dress for a charity gala, and I was glad the first dress worked out. The ruching in the stomach area is very thick and drapey. On a small person like myself, I felt like it drew unwanted attention to the stomach and looked very weird.

The sequins really made me stand out.  Fit well,  length of dress is longer in the back, which was a lovely touch.  Some reviews complained about the sequins itching the upper under arms, this was not a concern for me.  Extra material around the stomach area would be a nice touch if you're looking to hide a little belly.  Overall, a great dress for a very formal event!

The dress is classic and glamorous. It is also functional, I felt dolled up but still was comfy I wore this dress for my University's Senior Ball. I ordered the 4R but after reading reviews I decided on the 2R as the backup. I ended up wearing the 2R because I felt it hugged my shape a lot better and wasn't as loose/baggy in the stomach area. I was originally worried that the dress wasn't long enough because it didn't sweep the floor in my 4 inch heels; however, that ended up being a blessing because I didn't have to worry about people stepping on my dress all night. The slit in the dress also kept me cool after getting hot from dancing in the ballroom. I originally wanted a black dress, but this gown is a dark enough blue that some people mistook it for black in the dim light. In certain lighting the dress shows up as a brighter blue, just depending on where you stand. The dress is easy to move in and breath, even after eating dinner. I was also worried about the sequins hurting me from reading reviews, but I barely noticed them all night. Overall I have no complaints about the dress. I thought it was beautiful, made me feel glamorous and allowed me to have fun.

Great Dress but hard to zip The 2 and 4 both fit me but I wore the 2. My only complaint is that this dress is extremely hard to zip up, if you don't have someone to help you zip it don't rent it because you will not be able to get it yourself, seriously! Other than that I received compliments and did not experience any discomfort on my arms as other reviewers stated. The length was fine but I should have worn 3 inch heals instead of 4 inch heals but I didn't have any.

PERFECT DRESS! Wore this to a formal event where almost everyone had on sequins, but this dress still stood out and I received many compliments. It's a beautiful cut, and the slit makes it sexy without being too much. I would absolutely rent this again, in blue or another color. I wish I owned it! I felt like a movie star or a princess (I have work other dresses by the same designer and this one is my favorite!). Length was a tiny bit too long, even with heels, but other than that it could not have been any better.

I did a presentation in front of a black-tie group...felt wonderful! This dress looks so sleek, but at the same time is very comfortable.  Its the second time I've rented.  I followed 3rd runner up Miss America to the stage, and felt great!  Its true to size, and I received many compliments, just as I did the first time I wore it!
Dress looked great. Dress fits true to size but the armhole is very small so it's a little tight. I'm 5'7 and wore 1" heels and dress length was perfect for the regular length.
Loved it! It fit like a glove and I got so many compliments.
Loved it.  I'm usually a dress size 2, but sized up for this one. It was a tid bit on the long side, but I could have gone higher on the heels.

Beautiful, sparkly, comfortable dress.  Perfect for Mardi Gras masquerade ball! Very stretchy and comfortable. Beautiful dress and color. The sequins didn't really scratch or bother me. Zipper is a little bit temperamental, but you just need help getting zipped in. Runs true to size. I typically wear size 26 jeans, size 2 regular clothes, size 2-4 in formal dresses. I got the 4R and it fit great. Didn't try on the 2R although I suspect it would have fit.  There was lots of stretch and room in the 4R.  I'm 5'4" and the regular length was just right. Skimmed the floor with my 3 inch heels.

I loved this dress.   I wore this to the Grammy's and it was the perfect dress!  I felt like I belonged on the red carpet!  It was very comfortable and I had to wear this dress all day until late in the night.

Stunning Dress!!! This dress could not be more stunning!
And when in the right light is lights up!
I wore this to a Black Tie Wedding in Miami. 
Compliments All Night!
I am 5'3, 140lbs, 36B chest, wide in the shoulders, tiny waist, w pretty athletic looking square thighs. 
The 4R was a lil long on me since my height of 5'3 isn't tall and I have a longer Toro then leg but it worked.   The dress has stretch so it accentuated my curves & went smoothly over my thighs.    The small amount of rouching in the front worked out well too as I have 3 kids! 
Definitely Give this dress a shot!
The slit was the perfect height! The dress moved well and it made me feel great! The dress rubbed my arm from where the strap was, but that's my only complaint. I loved it!

My husband and I attended a hospice gala, the theme was Mardi Gras. The dress was outstanding! I ordered an 8 & 10, I wore the 10. The 8 would have worked but I don't like really snug clothing so I went with the 10 which gave me more room. The dress did not rub under the arm like other ladies stated.   I wore a nicely padded bra and it gave me a good look since I am only an A. I wore 2 1/2 inch heels and the dress barely touched the ground, I had no issues dancing the night away.  I had the dress shipped to my hotel and there were no issues. This was my first time to use this site and greatly recommend it!
