Got many, many compliments on the dress and how well it fit! Dress fit really well; my biggest problem with dresses (and this is not specific to this dress) is that they are not long enough. I wore flats, and it just *barely* touched the ground. I was glad that it had a small train on the back, because this gave it a little extra length. I consider myself to be right in between a 6 & 8, and I was able to fit into the 6 and it flattered every curve and looked fantastic.

Great service from RTR, but this dress runs SHORT!!! I am 5'6" and the regular length didn't come close to reaching my ankles.  I'm glad I ordered a backup dress and sizes.  Also, my arms aren't terribly muscular, but the "sleeves" on this were quite snug.

Stunning AND comfortable! I frantically had RTR overnight me this dress after my 1st choice didn't fit.  I was reluctant to have them send me this one because it just doesn't look that spectacular online to be honest.  But I loved it!!  It doesn't look like much on the hanger, but completely transforms when you put it on.  The fit was perfect and the dress has just the right about of stretch and ruching to be flattering yet forgiving.  It's very fitted, but in such a way that it holds you in while still letting you breathe.  It's a very classic dress that is different enough to stand out, but understated enough to let you go all out with jewelry and/or makeup.  I wore the 4L and with almost 4 inch heels it barely grazed the ground.  Stats for reference: 5'9" 133 lbs, Pants: 6, Dresses: 4, Chest: 34", Ribcage: 28 1/2", Waist: 25.5", Hips: 37"
Looked like a million bucks Fit like a glove. The ruching hides a multitude of sins.

Wore this to a black tie wedding - it was the best dress there! I loved this dress!  I wore it in  Feb in Indiana to a very cold and snowy wedding.  I found the dress to be very comfortable and it did a great job of hiding and accenting all the right areas.   I hope I have another event like this in the future so I can rent it again!  RENT IT!!

Classic beauty  This was my back up dress and I didnt end up wearing it, but it was a lovely gown and I would rent again. If I rented again, I would rent size 2 for more room in bust (32D). The zero fit, but was Very tight due to the hidden boning in the gown, and you definitely need help getting it zipped up since your arms are in the sleeves and its just awkward. But other than that, lovely. Good length with 4 inch heels.

I felt beautiful and go tons of compliments from people not even at the event. Fit was tight.  I opted for the 6 instead of the 4,  Stretches, so it's easy to sit in,  wore 3 inch heels until I couldn't take it anymore!
loved it! super comortable. fit true to size othr than length. tall girls - do not get a long. it was ridiculously long, like 8 inches too long. go for the regular length.

This dress was sooooo flattering!  I felt like a million bucks wearing this dress!  It hid all of my "trouble parts". The material was a little heavier than I expected, but that was perfect since it was freezing outside. Dress was true to size, and I might have even been able to go a size smaller because I have such a small bust. There is a small train on the back which you can't see in the display picture, I loved the train but just had to be careful that no one stepped on it throughout the night. If you are going to an event that will be crowded, I would suggest wearing heels high enough so that the train doesn't drag very far. I HIGHLY recommend this dress if you want to feel elegant and keep certain parts disguised!

I wish I had a photo to share, but I don't have one right now. This fit beautifully.  A 16L was all that was available, so it was long but I could hold it enough that it seemed like nothing more than a train.  I was complimented all night long.  I have a very large bust and this worked well for me.  I'm still carrying some baby weight in my tummy from a recent pregnancy but you would've never known it in this dress.  I also have big arms (WINGS!) and the sleeves fit over them snug but didn't make me immobile.  I would rent this dress again and again.
Perfect dress for a black tie wedding!  I was nervous about the length since i'm short but it was perfect with 4 inch heels. Very flattering absolutely loved this dress.
Stunning dress. Great fit and design.  The only problem was the wire in the dress broke through the fabric and pinched me the whole night.
This was a great dress for this occasion! Everyone kept complimenting me on it! The fit was great; I love how it covered my upper arms!

The dress is a blank canvas, ready to help make ANY look possible!! The dress is amazing! The ruching makes one look slimmer and curvier than they might be. It hides those trouble spots a gal might have, as well. The dress is a classic look, but can be dressed up or down a million different ways.

I was figuring the dress would be miles long, but I was pleasantly surprised. The dress isn't so long that it drags, even if I was barefoot. It just hit the ground, in 4 inch heels my shoes peeped out. I dressed the look up and opted for a 40's Hollywood vintage look- and the dress for the bill.

It is such a slimming dress, by the way, it hid an 11 week baby bump!
I felt comfortable in the gown all night. Received several compliments:)! Excited to rent again. Very fitted, especially around the arms.

The perfect dress-classic, with just a hint of starlet sauciness.   The structure and material were substantial.  The bottom of the dress flowed into a slight train...beautifully.  There was a stay that was poking through under the right arm.  I covered the pinching edge with a strip of moleskin.  No problems.

I went to a gala in this dress and had people I didn't know treating me like a princess all night. I originally ordered the 8L because I am a "real pear" shape, but I found that it ran about an inch short with 1.5" heel. I then tried on the 10L and it fit perfectly all over. I posted multiple pictures because I am 5'10" and super curvy in the hips and for those women who are this type, this dress will bring out the "Marilyn Monroe". This dress allowed me to display my curves without looking ill-proportionate and kept it classy. The dress is a jersey knit type, so it stretches in all the right places. I read that some people had problems with the train, mine was no problem, not even on the dance floor! Just take into account that everybody's body type is different. I have long legs, and long torso, so the dress did work for me.

I  also wanted to say that I decided to go to this gala at the very last minute, so I was a little worried if the dress would arrive on time, nevertheless fit. I ordered my dress on Friday morning and for a small extra fee it was delivered by 10am the next day ! It was so worth it because I did not have to hit the stores hunting for the perfect dress. The return policy is EASY, so no stress there either. I will DEFINITELY be renting again, over and over.

Amazing! Felt wonderful, comfortable, and beautiful! The fit is meant to be a bit tight, but it very slimming. I am 5'6 and the regular length was a little too short for me. I wore 2 inch heels. It did help for dancing though. I felt like a million bucks and received compliments all night! Perfect for a winter wedding and a classic and classy look.

Hugs all the right curves in all the right places! Loved this dress! I felt sexy yet classy, and it was perfect for a Governor's ball.  The ruching along the boddess and the rear was so flattering, especially with spanks to keep everything in place.  The off the shoulder was great too for covering that weird armpit pooch, and my winter white skin tone! I wore a size up due to length.  I'm 5'81/2 and needed the 10L to cover my shoes (which were only 3inches).  The tag didn't say 10L so I'm not sure if there was a mix-up or if it just doesn't say the L.  Great for busty girls.  I wear a 36DDD (yes triple!)  and it held me really well with a strapless bra.  You can't really lift your arms past your shoulders but it didn't matter because I felt amazing, and my boyfriend couldn't stop complimenting me! Highly recommended!

The dress was different from all others I saw that night. The dress fit well and hid alot of my "trouble" spots (arms, tummy). The material made it comfortable to wear all night. I will be renting it again.

Form-fitting, classic long-black dress with a little sexy, a lot of class and a tiny train!  This dress is as described...Im usually a size 2 and I am so glad I ordered the 4 as a back up because it is tight. The ruching in the torso makes it more flattering, but it certainly doesn't leave much room to hide. I got a ton of compliments on it all night and you feel very old-hollywood sexy in it. I am almost 5'8" and I wore 4" heels and the 4L was JUST long enough. The top of the dress brushed the tips of my toes. I have athletic arms and the sleeves were a little tight and restricting, but nothing to really make note of. It was expected considering the cut. Overall, I would order again. It was fun and comfortable and warm!

Had so many compliments on how sexy the dress was.  Definitely hugs the curves! Was a little difficult to move with the way the sleeves are.  I was expecting some stretch all over, and while the dress had stretch, the band along the bust/arms does not.  It made it a little difficult to dance and hug people, but overall completely worth it.

Very emotional evening, glad I felt as good as I did in the dress! I ordered the 12L and the 14L. The 12 fit perfectly but because I had the 14 and it looked good too with more wiggle room I went with that one. I LOVED it. Felt glamorous! I am 5'8 and the length of the Long was perfect. I wore 3" heels and it did hit the floor but as part of the long dress look I like to hold it up upon steps or outside. I did not drag, it was just perfect.

Train is too long The dress fit true to size, but the train is way too long.  It was difficult to walk in.  The sleeves were completely stretched out, so it looked strange.  I'm not sure if some renters have been wearing the sleeves pulled up over their shoulders or if the stretching was because of the hanger, but the sleeves looked saggy.  The ruching was flattering, and I loved the fit of the body.  I'm 5'5", and the 6R was the perfect length with 4" heels (except for the train).  This would be a great dress if the train and sleeves were fixed.
I didn't end up wearing this dress.
Would wear over and over! SO many compliments on this gown.  Very comfortable to wear, though heavy for dancing (got very hot, very quickly).

Easy shipping! Loved the dress. I ordered a 2Long because a 2 is my normal size. And I had ordered the 4Long as my back up size! The 4 barely fit!!!! I am 5'6 and I wore 4 inch heels and the dress barely hit the floor. It kept gathering above my butt and that made it look like it didn't fit...the dress is very tight, so if you have big arms, I don't recommend getting this dress. You can't lift your arms up in the air because of the way the arms are designed. The dress was exactly what I needed, I just wish I could have figured out the size a little better before I ordered it!

Beautiful dress. But not for me. Rented the dress for a wedding. Was my first option, but I ended up falling in love with the 2nd dress. I will say that it was a little tight around the arms, and I think the train would have been a pain to dance with.
The fit was perfect, dress was not only comfortable but beautiful . RTR is the BEST !! Loved everything about this dress .

Loved being able to rent and not go store to store for weeks! 5'2 110 34D
It was a little long with 6 inch heels but I lifted when climbing stairs, etc. The sleeves were also a bit stretched out. Over all a beautiful dress. The body of the dress fit very well.

Great gown for evening glam / gala I ordered an 8R and 6L.  I typically am more of an 8.  However, the 8 was miserably uncomfortable... the 6 fit much better,  I liked the length of the 6L, too.  I wore regular 3 inch heels (no platform).  8R seemed too short.  The train did get stepped on a few times throughout the evening. Loads of compliments. Very flattering.

Very disappointing Icould not get it to zip up. Very disappointing I got 2 sizes larger than what I wear because it was all they had in stock for my event. When the dress arrived I  could not get it to zip up. I ended up having to go out and find a whole new dress before my event.
STUNNING! Classy! I would wear this dress to every wedding! Fits amazing...extremely comfortable. The compliments I received kept coming all night. Its the absolutely perfect black dress.

Beautiful and classy! I have a really hard time finding dresses (and clothes in general) that fit. I had a formal gala for work coming up so I wanted to look beautiful, but also professional as I was seated with the president of my company. This dress was perfect! It hugs in all the right places and the ruching is really flattering (I wish I had a full length photo to share). I am at a heavier weight that I'd like to be, so I really wanted to find something forgiving that would cover my arms and flatter me and this did it. I wore Spanx, which really helped smooth everything out, but the dress was very flattering and comfortable. I was a bit concerned about the length. Even though I am only 5'3", I like to wear tall shoes and this came right to the floor. It ended up being fine though once I ironed the bottom. Overall, I highly recommend it and will definitely rent again!
Loved it! Received many compliments. The dress was quite lovely. It fits the body like a glove. Elegant yet comfortable. Equally nice for dancing, and sitting down.

LOVED this for my Mardi Gras ball! I got SO many compliments! My preferred size was unavailable, so they sent my backup and an alternate gown in my preferred size. I didn't get the email until the day it was supposed to ship. And due to the security concerns of my job, I don't have access to my phone to have any input on which alternate dress they shipped. I hated the backup gown. I didn't even try it on. Luckily, the dress I chose fit fairly well. It was a size too big and ran a little long, but with heels and luck, I made it work.

Complimentary & Flattering I got a ton of compliments on this dress and how beautiful I looked. The gathering in the bust and hips helped to hide the not so flattering parts of my body. Other reviews I read stated that larger busts wouldn't have much room in the top of the dress, but I had plenty. I've lost weight and wasn't really sure of what size I would actually need to wear, so I ordered a 16R and a 18R for fear of it being too tight on my bust, probably could have gone smaller. Dress does have a slight train and occasionally someone would step on it. Other than that, I was very pleased!

Easy to wear, elegant dress Fit: I'm 5'4, 123 pounds, 34B chest. I rented a 4, which fit, but the 2 would have been better as it was a little loose. The length was perfect for me. I wore 4 inch heels. For accessories, I wore the Oscar de La Renta rose necklace (big statement piece) with gold earrings and gold bangle. I received compliments all night. Would definitely recommend.

Loved this dress! I wore this to a black tie gala in January.  Very Comfortable and accentuated all of the positives.  Was the perfect length - I wore with 2.5 inch heels.  You can personalize this dress with accessories of your choice.

I felt and looked AMAZING!! I attended a wonderful fundraising gala...and felt like the Belle of the Ball. All parts needed concealing were concealed.  One more compliment and I wouldn't have ever taken the dress off again!  Thank you RTR!

Comfortable and Simply Elegant  Simply designed gown, the fit was nice. The material was heavy and hung loosely, which made me feel like the dress was sliding down. I should have ordered a 0P as my second size, to make the bodice slightly tighter and shorter. Overall very comfortable!
Great fit! It's figure flattering and I received a ton of compliments all night.! Perfect fit

This dress was perfect for a wedding in mid March.  This dress fit very true to size and was very complimenting. You could wear this to a very formal event or even dress it down a bit. The material was very comfortable as well!
Gorgous gown I LOVED this dress.  It is absolutely beautiful.  The material is very flattering is you have curves and black is always slimming!

This dress will make you feel gorgeous.  I ordered a petite. 2" heels it was a little long. I felt beautiful in this dress. I received lots of compliments. I am between size 4 and 6. I went with the 6 for comfort. Highly recommend.
This was a great fit for me. I researched many styles before deciding. It was nice to have a petite option. The dress was snug in all the right places.

Classy and elegant dress! My first time using RTR, won't be my last! I love the free second size and the included fashion tape - also, returning the dresses was very easy and convenient. I ordered my usual size 4L but chose to wear the back-up 6L for comfort, there isn't any give from the waist up so if you are between sizes I would recommend sizing up. This dress was so easy to style and wear, it is incredibly flattering - I received compliments all night, wish I owned it! A great choice for a classic, glamorous and timeless gown.

This was my boyfriend's first movie premiere! It was a night I'll never forget. Depending on the dress, I either wear a 0, 2, or 4. After chatting with one of style consultants, I was advised to get sizes 0L and 2L in this dress. If I could go back, I would have got a 2L and a 4L. Though the 2L fit, the boning of the dress pressed into my skin on my chest. It wasn't too noticeable, but it was a bit uncomfortable. Also, even though I went with the longer size, the dress still didn't reach the floor in the front. Overall, however, I think the dress was beautiful and made me feel like a movie star.

Loved the dress!  I loved this dress. It was perfect for the event I attended. The rouching on the side was really flattering and the sleeves added just right the amount of coverage and class. I am only 5'2" so I wore about 5 inch heels with the dress. Would rent again. I typically wear an 8 so the dress was a little lose but still great. I added a thin belt to add definition to the waist.

Love, Love, Loved this gown!! Formals can be stuffy, but this gown was the complete opposite.  I wore this to a Debutante Cotillion, and even after the long presentations, crowning, and dinner, I was still ready to dance the night away in this dress.  It hides what you dont want seen, and accentuates all the positives.  Highly recommend!!!

This dress is so comfortable and beautiful it made my night! The dress is very comfortable, slight train but easy to move in and dance.  The ruching hides any/all insecurities.  Loved the dress and especially loved how helpful the staff was in answering questions.  I was able to change the shipping address last minute with no problems.  Thanks RTR!

The event was wonderful, and wearing this dress was definitely the icing on the cake! First I am 5'3" and weigh about 196. The fit was a little loose but I did not mind at all. The ruching around the dress was perfect for hiding imperfections. The dress was a little long even with heels for me. Over all it made the whole night so much more enjoyable feeling beautiful and not worrying about how my arms or stomach looked in a tighter dress!
Sexy Fit well, very flattering.  Stayed up fairly well, although I wouldn't recommend anything too active.  Would wear again.

The dress was a huge hit! The dress was a huge hit! I am 6 feet tall  I ordered a 10 L and I was able to wear small heels it was great. I received so many compliments. I am a curvy girl and it made me feel skinny!

Classy but sexy I'm 5'9'' and the 4L was just perfect with 2" heels.  There was a tail in the back but it didn't pose any problems.  It is a beautiful dress; it definitely stands out in the crowd.  The only thing that bugged me was the wiring down the right side over the breast.  It kind of stuck out; it wasn't really noticeable but it annoyed me a tad.  Otherwise, I loved it!
It fit great. I rented this for a formal. We end up not going. So I sent it back. I will rent again  Great fit comfortable classic. Love it
The way the dress fit was absolutely amazing! No complaints!

Felt beautiful and confident! This dress fit perfectly!  Positives: Forgiving fabric, great seams, classy, perfect coverage.  I am larger chested and it had additional support.  Negatives: The back zipper was bunched, and I could not get it to flatten out.  The top slid down a little through out the night.  The boning would poke me every now and again.

I was not disappointed.  This dress fit like a glove.  I had so many compliments. Will do it again
 Will rent again
The way my husband looked at me!  A little tight in the bust, but it still was an amazing dress and very comfortable to wear all evening

Truly had WOW factor! The fit was great if not for a bit too long. I think a regular may have been better. I can't think of a single con...the dress was beautiful, truly flattering fit and perfect for the occasion. 

This was my first experience with Rent the Runway and I couldn't have been more pleased with the entire process. I won't buy special occasion dresses anymore since they usually are worn once and hang in the closet until I give them away. For less money I can have a designer gown I'd never afford otherwise and be happy to send it back in the prepaid envelope.

Not a maternity dress I wanted to wear this for a gala event that I attended and I’m 34 weeks pregnant. Unfortunately, it did not fit at all. Material does not stretch at all. I would not recommend for third trimester maternity dress.
So pretty! I got the small and medium. I ended up wearing the medium because the small was too tight around my chest. The dress is so pretty. Would for sure recommend  :)

Great fit, sparkly and fun! I rented this to see Britney in Las Vegas and it was perfect! It did run tight but u wouldn't say small, I went with the medium and wear a size 6 dress. The color is gorgeous and I got compliments all night.

Wore this to my gym's Grand Opening party and it was a hit! Everyone loved it! I felt amazing in it. It's true to size.  It's very low cut in the front so if you don't like to show the "girls" off it might not be for you.  Also, the material is very thick on the inside, keeps you very warm.

I absolutely loved the dress, I did not want to send it back!!! I got this dress for my high school semi-formal. I was so nervous that it would be too short and too low cut, but it was perfect. The length was perfect, and the tight fit made it so comfortable for dancing. I wore a tummy control, and a stick on bra. The dress has little to no stretch to it, which is nice to keep everything in. The sequins tear up your underarms, but it was so worth it. I got tons of compliments all night long. I loved my RTR experience, and would definitely rent again!!

Sparkle In A Sea of Black I wore this dress for a charity event and it truly was stunning! A few people made comments on how gorgeous it was especially since everyone was wearing all black. I love this dress and would highly recommend it!

Turning 30 and got Engaged! I loved this dress and got compliments all night! It was great for my 30th birthday, and looked wonderful in pics for my surprise engagement! I am a 32/34C and the top was slightly big (I didn't wear a bra) so I had to keep an eye on that, but the length was perfect (I'm 5'3" and 118 lbs) and it hit in all the right places!

Beautiful dress! Perfect for Vegas bachelorette party! This dress is beautiful! I wore it for a bachelorette party in Las Vegas and it was PERFECT for the occasion! The color is gorgeous and it showed cleavage without being *too* much. I got a lot of compliments and felt great. I ended up sizing up to my backup size because I was more comfortable with the length of the L but could've worn the M if I wanted to. I wore a plunge bra for a little lift, but definitely could've gone braless. I must note that I did scratch the heck out of my forearms from rubbing them on the sequins though--be careful if you wear it for several hours/dancing!

No such thing as too much sparkle!  Perfect birthday dress but it truly fits like a glove. I tried on the large first thinking it was the medium and it fit perfectly so I didn't even bother trying the medium. It shows all your curves so be aware of that.

Flashy! Great dress, but a bit uncomfortable with all those scratchy sequins! It was a lot lower cut than I wished for, as well.  It seems to run a bit small, as well. I usually wear a 4 or small, but I had to go with the medium.
This dress didn't fit in the least - too tight in the bust, hip, thighs and way too short.  It was very pretty but too small.  I normally wear a 12 or 14 in a dress.  The XL fit like a size 10.

I LOVED this dress - I rented this for a holiday cocktail party - it was perfect!  This dress fit perfect!  The length was great - not to short.  The material was stretch enough as not to be restricting, and was comfortable all night.  I felt fantastic in this dress and will hopefully have a reason to rent it again.  I did notice small scratches on the underside of my arms the next morning - but I didn't even feel anything during the party, so not even a big deal to me.

Perfect for a night out in Vegas Fit true to size, I am usually a size 10/12 and wore XL. They sent a L but I didn't even try it on. The arms are a little scratchy but I got so many compliments it was worth it!

GORGEOUS Color- so Scratchy!! This is a beautiful dress, and it fits like a glove! I think it runs a bit small- based on other reviews I got the small (measurements are 34,25,35) even though I'm usually an XS/0/2. It has just the right amount of stretch but is thick enough to be forgiving and hold in those problem areas. The neckline is quite deep- I found it came to an inch or so below where the base of my bra would sit. I wasn't worried about anything moving too much- again fit like a glove- but I threw a little fashion tape on the edges so I could dance worry free. The only downside of this dress is how scratchy the sequins are! I've worn other sequined dresses with no problem- these seem especially malicious! I tried it on and within five minutes my underarms were so cut up I was bleeding on one side. No exaggeration. I also cut up my left hand which I had used to zip up the back. Seriously, I could not make this stuff up. Desperate to wear this dress, and being a reasonably good seamstress, I tacked on some nice black fabric in the shape of a triangle to match the neckline under each arm- sweet relief! I don't think it even showed up in the picture, but for me it was absolutely necessary to make the dress wearable (don't worry RTR, I very carefully undid my work before sending it back). Despite my additions, at the end of the night I had scratches on the undersides of my arms, and a few on the back of my legs from adjusting the hem (it didn't ride up too much, but I did have to pull it down a few times during the night). While dancing with a friend, I brushed against her shoulder and she jumped away in pain with a nice new scratch to commemorate the night. Not a dress to wear if you are trying to get close!

I rented this dress in a small (and medium for my backup) for homecoming and the small fit perfectly  I read a few reviews that said it was itchy around the arms which it was, but it wasn't unbearable. It is a super pretty dress, I highly recommend it! (:

I loved this dress! It fit great. This dress fit great! I did not find the sleeves to be scratchy like in other reviews. I got a lot of compliments. I did end up wearing a plunge bra with it, but it might not have been necessary (just made me feel more comfortable).

Another win from RTR.   Love this dress!!! Comfortable w/plenty of stretch. Sequins were slightly itchy @ arms but not enough to be a distraction. I don't typically go without a bra but was comfortable doing so. Would totally wear it again.

Fantastic color, good quality sequins, and not scratchy! The thickness of the sequin layer coupled with a liner layer underneath made this body-con wonderfully forgiving.  But, as you can see, BOOBS.  My 34 Cs had plenty of cleavage even without a bra.  If you don't want to show yours off, may not be the dress for you.

Stunning This dress is great for a dressy occasion where you want to feel a little sexy.  It is form fitting, so be ready for that, but the cut is not too low so it keeps it classy.  I received tons of compliments.  The cons are that it is a little short.  I am 5'4" and if it was any shorter it would have been inappropriate.  I also found it ran small.  I am typically a 0 or 2 in designer dresses and this 2 was very, very snug.  Maybe that is simply the way it fits, but I think I could have easily worn a medium.  Also, the sequins was very scratchy and easily got caught on things.  It ruined the scarf I was going to wear with it.
GORGEOUS!  Everything about this dress was amazing!  From the color to the fit to the fab deep neck, everything about this dress was fabulous!  I stood out in a sea of black and felt fantastic!

I received to TON of complements on this dress!!!  I ordered both the large and the XL. I chose to wear the XL because it was a little longer and I wanted the extra hip room. The dress is also comfortable.

It was a perfect dress for my sorority formal. Everyone loved it. Looks great in pictures. It was a little itchy around the arms, but it was bearable. Can be worn with a bra, I would tape it up so it doesn't show your bra. Perfect fit. Perfect length, does not ride up. I would definitely recommend this dress!!!

Sparkly and Comfortable Head Turner *This dress is not the same color in pictures as it is in person! To me it looked bronze or copper in the photos, it's actually more burgundy/purple with silver. Also, it's a little more revealing than I anticipated, (I'm about a B cup) but the dress is fitted so everything is kept nice and tight. I got this for a wedding on NYE eve that specified cocktail attire, but the wedding started at 4 pm - I used a fitted black blazer as a cover up bc I thought it was a little too early for that much shine,  then I just took the blazer off as the night progressed.  I'm 5'2", about 130 , and this dress was in the medium size was on the more snug side for me. Snug but not uncomfortable. Got lots of compliments on it and felt amazing.

Loved the dress! Got lots of compliments from other ladies! Wore it for Valentines Day so fit was ok The dress fit, but was almost like wearing a pair of Spanx.  It is very fitted, and hugs all your curves.  It is cut a little low, but for Valentines day it was appropriate.

Snug fit, perfect sparkle, fabulous color - very eye-catching! You'll get compliments all night! It is very form fitting, but has a little give.  LOVED the way it fit actually. Material is thick, so hides any bumps and underwear lines. The color is a burgundy red and I promise there will not be another dress like it at your event! I wore it with a sticky bra, just in case the low v-neck slipped while I was dancing - didn't want any "extra" exposures! I hated to send it back - it was an absolutely perfect dress for a semi-formal dance!

Very Glamorous Night Out in Vegas!!  I had to go up a size to avoid my dress from being too short or sexy. My usual size fit but it was wayyyy too suggestive. Overall I loved it and I didn't have any chaffing from the sequins with the larger size. I would def rent again!!

This dress was beautiful and comfortable, even though I ordered it extremely last minute!  This dress was amazing!! I wore this to my homecoming dance and it was absolutely gorgeous! I am slightly over 6'0'' without heels so dress length is often a struggle for me. However, I had no problems with this one! The fit was comfortable, the sequins didn't rub on my underarms, and it was perfect for dancing! The only cons to it would be that due to the low cut, I couldn't wear a bra with it and the sequins scratched up my forearms while dancing. The dress itself was supportive enough that the bra wasn't an issue and the scratching is to be expected of any sequin dress. Overall, I definitely recommend this dress, especially if you're tall!

loved this dress!!! I would recommend sizing up for the backup size, but the size S worked out well for me! Lots of compliments all night. I got away with wearing a normal bra, but it looks great without one too.

Perfect for the Holidays!! Wore this for a Red Dress event and got so many compliments.  The color was spectacular.  It was a bit revealing but overall I loved it.  If you are large chested, be prepared!
The sequins were a bit scratchy The dress is great and was perfect for a Vegas party

Fun to wear and very comfortable!!! I wore the XL simply because it was longer and more comfortable for sitting down. That made the top a little larger than I would have liked, but nothing that some fashion tape couldn't fix! Definitely recommend taking two sizes just cause the length could be too short for some people.
Birthday Glam! I wore the size large and was able to wear a black bra underneath!  Yes!  Felt like a million dollars on my birthday.  I would rent this again!
Christmas Party Lots of compliments, beautiful wine color. Very fitted, and has a waist seam that I didn't think showed in the picture that created a little bulge.

Loved it!!! I received a lot of compliments I rented this dress for my birthday celebration.  I thought I was going to wear the XL, but the L worked just fine!  Dress is comfortable, and has the perfect length.  It keeps the boobies in place.  I loved the sparkle it brought, it wasn't too much, it was just elegant, fun, just perfect.

Gorgeous and fun dress! I went a size up just for length!  This dress is beautiful and fun.  It is definitely a "busty" dress. I ordered my size and a size up and went with the larger size purely for length. I feel this dress is shorter than it looks so the size up was key!

Love this dress-- felt great and received a lot of compliments I wore this for a holiday party and I loved it. I wore the size larger to give myself room and to also provide more length and it was really comfortable too the entire night. I love the low cut and it was just extremely flattering overall. I highly recommend!

Great dress for Vegas!  Super cute sexy dress for Vegas! Got lots of compliments! It is a little low cut so if you are bigger on top be aware. It is also short!  It was exactly what I wanted for a fun night out at the clubs. Be aware the the beads are scratchy so by the end of the night my under arms were a bit scratched up but worth it!
Prefect! Wore this for my 30th birthday and it was awesome! It is very low cut though, so fashion tape is a must! It hugged all my curves in the right places! It was perfect!

Stylist Review! I absolutely LOVED this dress! I was a bit nervous about the silhouette and the sequin, but it was my birthday, so I went with it. This dress ended up being a huge winner. The length was great and it hugged every curve in the best way. There is not a lot of stretch, at all, but I didn't mind because it kept everything in its place. You will definitely show some cleavage in this style. It is a perfect going out or party dress. I will definitely be renting this style again!

The sparkle is just right and the burgundy color flatters just about anyone! Thought I was going to need the XL since I wear a 11/12 with a medium size bust and was super pleased when initially trying on the L and having it fit perfect, even with shapewear and a normal bra underneath. Required assistance from my husband to zip it as the zipper is not super smooth to slide for me. I read that the sequins had scratched on arms and I did find that to be the case as well but it was worth it! The compliments I received on this dress were endless. The only downside was a slight bit of extra fabric at the small of my back. Likely was just due to the shape of my bum and how the dress sits on it. My husband said it wasn't as noticeable as I thought it was. Definitely recommend for a fun night out in Vegas!

Amazing color & the glam factor is undeniable! I wore this date to a sorority semi formal and I kept getting compliments the whole night! The color is very unique and this is "the party dress". The dress is a little heavy, low cut i)f you're not used to cleavage), and runs a little small but over all very flattering and photographs like a dream!

Got so many compliments on this dress all night!  Didn't look that good on the hanger, but once I put it on it was gorgeous! Some people said the sparkles scratched their under arms, but it didn't bother me.

Fit very nicely and got lots of compliments! I am 5' 3" and 120lbs, and the small fit very nicely. I was also able to fit into the XS well, but it was a little snug. The sequins are pretty sharp and made many many small cuts under both arms, but it wasn't that big of a deal. You can also wear a regular bra with this, which is nice.

Flashy and Fun! Just what I was looking for to let loose without the kids for a bachelorette party!  The dress is so flashy and fun but the darker purple brings it down a notch from a lighter sequin dress.   

I bought some tulle at the fabric store anticipating that I may need to line under the arms as other reviewers mentioned the sequins cut their arms but I didn't use it because I didn't have that issue.  

I wore an underwire bra that sometimes peaked out barely despite dress tape but I felt I needed a bra because otherwise my boobs sadly sag to my waist line.   

It did run small though (especially after a meal ; )    I'm happy I sized up.
I wore it in Vegas and loved it! I'm bigger busted but could wear a bra with it.  Fits snug, true to size. Really comfortable! BIG PLUS - CAN WEAR A BRA WITH IT! I loved it.

Fit like a glove! Very pretty dress that turned heads all night.  I wore this to an award ceremony with "cocktail" listed as the attire. I did have to trim several loose threads off before wearing, but did not affect the appearance of the dress.    The small fit me, but I felt the medium was just a bit more forgiving.

So many compliments! Hot dress! I'm 5'10" and I'm always concerned with dresses being too short, this one was perfectly long enough. Wouldn't have wanted it to be any shorter, but I still felt comfortable all evening. Sequins were a little bit scratchy on the underarms, but it wasn't that bad and I'm glad I wore it anyway. Wore a regular bra (yay!) and spanx, since the dress shows your shape. Usually wear an 8-10, so I ordered M and L, wore the L. Might have even preferred the XL. Medium was too tight to get on. Loved this dress, everything was on time, and I would rent it again!

Really flattering, fun dress! I wore this to my sorority semi-formal, it was such a fun dress! I got so many compliments! The bust line is very plunging (especially for someone who is a little more conservative), but I never felt uncomfortable or like there was going to be any wardrobe malfunctions. The dress overall was super flattering, a little itchy at first but I got used to it. I would highly recommend this dress!!

SEQUIN BLING !! Could not wear/fit but I wish I could have. NOT much stretch at all. Even with the XL, dress runs small, I could not get chest in (D+) so would recommend size up for backup. VERY deep v-neck, expect to show cleavage. Not quite maroon in color (shoes are red/maroon, dress more dark purple maroon). Definitely a "look at me" dress, it is GORGEOUS!

The dress is gorgeous! I received compliments all night long.  The dress does run a little small, I normally wear a medium but went with the large. 
The cleavage is not THAT much, all depends on your bust size. It was tasteful for me. 
The only con is that is does scratch up your under arm area. but that didnt bother me. 
Its a must have for holiday parties or NYE, gorgeous dress!!

So flattering!  What a party dress! This dress is just perfect!  Will def rent again.  I'm usually a M/size 6-8 and the M was perfect.  Its not thick material, but thick enough that it smoothes things out.  Sorry I don't have a full body length pic, but i'm telling you, it was fabulous!  Also, the M was tight enough that i didn't need a bra!  It was was short but not too short and I got so many compliments!  color is great! don't worry about the low cut, it's just super flattering.

Vegas Showstopper Just like others said when I first opened it I was nervous about it being too small but it was the perfect bodycon type dress underneath and was actually quite comfy. I didn't have to wear a bra and even if bending over the top stayed tight. The only con is the sequins will and can scrape you! I used chaffing cream on my arms and that seemed to help. It wasn't enough to make me not wear the dress but it's definitely a noticeable feeling throughout the night. I got so many compliments from male and female on this dress and it is really flattering. I would definitely rent again!

Perfect Vegas going out dress! Amazing dress! Perfect for a girls night out in Vegas. The sequins were a bit scratchy for dinner but otherwise it was so fun to wear. Sizing was standard or a hint on the small side.

PERFECT Birthday dress!! I got SO many compliments on this dress all night long! I'm larger chested, so I did end up putting a cami underneath in order to not COMPLETELY expose the ladies. It was the perfect amount of sparkle but not overbearing, and it made me feel like I was sparkling all night! The sides did rub a bit under the arms, but I expected that, and it wasn't awful, so it was worth it to me to feel fabulous wearing this dress. Definitely recommend this dress!!
Wore this for a birthday party in Vegas. Fit was very flattering.  The sequins did rub under my arms a bit which was a little uncomfortable.
Beautiful dress  This dress made me feel as beautiful as it is. It is slightly lower cut in the front than I expected which made a bra a bit of a challenge but I worked it out

This dress made me feel so confident & sexy!  The S was snug but in a good way. I wore a push up bra, but this dress made me look like a 34C! I wore spanx, too. Overall great dress! The only downside was that the sequins ripped up my bachelorette sash. There were strings everywhere but still felt like a million bucks.

Sparkles! I'm on the left in the phone ;)  The dress was fantastic!  Runs very small, I wore a large (would usually be a M).  Being short, the length was a bit on the longer side, which I liked since the neck was such a deep v.  Unless you have one of those crazy strappy bras, this one is going to be a no-bra dress.  Very fitted but in a good way, held everything in (of course, spanx were involved as well).  The sequins under the arms DID scratch as other wearers have noted, but if you have a cocktail, you'll be fine.  Overall, I felt very cute and got a LOT of compliments.

Perfect for NYE! Rented this for a fancy New Year's Eve party in the meatpacking district in NYC. Loved it. Ran a little small - I'm normally an 8/10 in dresses and I wore the XL. Fabric was nice and thick to smooth out the mom-belly, the sequins were all secure and didn't scratch. Perfect length to dance in comfortably.

WOW! Just WOW! The dress fit true to size.  I typically wear between a 10-12 dress and the large fit me perfectly.  For reference, I'm 5 1', 133 pounds, and a 38DD.  Length was just right for my age (above the knee).  Dress was also very comfortable and forgiving for someone who doesn't have the perfect figure.  The sleeves did scratch a little but not enough to not enjoy this beautiful dress.  My husband loved the dress and couldn't take his eyes off me.  I also received multiple compliments while we were out celebrating our anniversary.  This was my first time using RTR.  I can't wait for another special occasion so I can rent another dress.

compliments. confidence. crazy good looking!  I only say this runs small because it is skin tight. Maybe more than I was used to. The back up xl was too big in every sense so I stuck with the large and put some spanx on and no bra! Winner for me! I absolutely loved the dress and got so many compliments.

Favorite dress to rent so far! I loved this dress so much! I would have preferred the 4L but it was already reserved. The 6L was a great second option. I'm just under 5'8 and the 4R was barely long enough to hit the floor but the L was the perfect length for my height. It hugs your curves in a flattering way without being tight. I wore this to a black tie wedding and it was very appropriate. It also has a slight train in the back which was a classy upgrade. Dying for another event to wear this dress.
x It fit perfectly. Being 5'2", I was worried about it being to long but with 3" heels, it was perfect.

Beautiful, amazing, flattering, and perfect! I loved everything about this dress! It was about 1 inch too long in my 3 in heels, but I generally expect that due to being 5'2". I'm still very glad I got the petite, or else it would've been too difficult to walk in. The fit was perfect, a little loose which was okay since I was at a work function and didn't want it to be too tight. The only thing I didn't love was that the material is really heavy and warm and it was June in Chicago.  I managed to keep the sweating to a minimum, and received a ton of compliments on the dress. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a classy, formal dress!
I wore it to a charity gala. It was one of the more subdued dresses there.  This dress is really comfortable, is well lined and doesn't wrinkle. It looks elegant. Great dress.

The dress was simple but stunning I ordered what was available which was the 10R and the 12L. I ended up going with the 12L vs. the 10R because  the 10R was a little too short. The L was a bit long so I wore 4inch heels and it was the perfect length. I went with the 12 v.s the 10 because the 10 was a bit too tight in the rib area. The 12 fit like a glove. The perfect hold for someone with a larger chest, I did not have to worry about a bra.

Classy dress that showed off all things good I was actually surprised that the 6L fit vs the 8L. I am typically between a 6 and an 8 in pants depending on the brand. When I tried the 8L on everything fit except the stomach was baggy. And I do not have a flat stomach which is why I was surprised at so much extra material. The 6L had the exact same fit throughout the rest of the body but gave me a more defined silhouette. There was no room for spanx under this dress but I didn't even need them because there were a few thick layers of material that held me in. I wore a strapless bra because I am a C/D cup and can't just let those things hang. The top of the dress perfectly complimented my chest making the dress a perfect mix of classy and sexy. I also wore 2" heels (I am 5'9") but could have gotten away with 3" as I had to pick up the dress a little bit when walking around so I wouldn't trip. I will definitely be renting this one again!  

For some reason my measurements aren't coming in with this review but I am a 36 C cup, 160 pounds, 5'9", with an athletic build in case you want to compare.

It was a perfect fit for me. I have an hourglass shape and it was beautiful on! There wasn't really any stretch to the material in my opinion. I was comfortable all night in it and got many compliments. I am 5'7" and wore short heels with it (2in heels) and it was the perfect length.

Flattering and comfortable  Thicker fabric and black color helped suck me in without being constricted and was very flattering, as was the neckline. I was so comfortable all day and night dancing as a bridesmaid, and received a lot of compliments. Wish I owned it.

Classic formal black dress Originally wanted the 2 but it was out of  stock, and the 4 ended up fitting perfectly for a night of dancing. The 2 would have fit more snug where the 4 a little extra room.

Best dress ever! I didn't want to send this dress back! It is so flattering, so comfortable, easy to wear. I wore a normal strapless bra and fairly high heels (I'm 5'0", and the petite was still very long). The fabric is on the thicker/heavier side, which I think gave me a smoother look. I would 100% recommend this dress.

fit well, flattering This dress is really simple, but pretty. It's a thicker material so I felt like it made the 'clingyness' more flattering. I am only 5'2, and even with 4'' heels it was a tad long for me. Also, as others reviewed mentioned it is a heavy material. Definitely would not wear this for a summer event -- I wore this for a November wedding in NYC and it was still kind of warm.  I ordered the 10/12, ended up wearing the 12 as the 10 fit but it was tighter than I felt comfortable in. I didn't wear a bra and the coverage was fine -  I am a 36DD.

Classic yet sexy This dress may look pretty basic, but I felt everything but basic.  This dress is sophisticated yet sexy.  Fits pretty true to size.  I didn't even have to wear a bra with is.  I was comfortable and was able to dance all night long.  I would recommend this for a black tie affair in a heart beat.

The dress was perfect! This was my first time renting from RTR and I would absolutely do it again! My husband and I had to attend a black tie charity event for his work and I wanted a dress that was simple yet elegant. This dress checked both of those boxes. It was absolutely perfect and I got so many complements throughout the night. I ordered a 6R and the 6L as my backup size. I am sure glad I did because I actually ended up wearing the 6L because with heels the 6R was just a tad too short with my heels. I will 100% be using RTR again!

Nice dress - plain, good fit, good fabric Very nice dress - I liked it. I rented this and another similar dress (Nicole Miller Black Blades Gown). I really needed a 2P (5'3'' 128lbs), but only a 2R was available. I figured I'd try it, although I always get nervous when renting a long dress. It turned out to be too long. If you are a true 2R the length shouldn't be a problem with heels, if you need a petite you might be able to get away with this with very high heels. If I didn't have a back up I would've been happy in this dress.

I got so many compliments! This dress really showed off my curves in a great way!  Fit snug with a little stretch. I didn't have to wear a strapless but I did wear a sticky bra. And I'm super short but I had 3 inch heals that worked well with the regular size. No tripping.
Simple, sleek, elegant gown worn for a black tie wedding.  I'm 5'1" and wore a 2P with 4 inch heels and the dress was still slightly too long for me. I wish I would have had some hem tape handy.

Simple but Elegant Everythin gabout this dress was perfect! I felt so comfortable in it all night. It hugs the body in all the right places! And - for a tall girl - the tall was perfect (I was able to wear heels)!
Great dress for a formal wedding. I loved the way this dress fit. It was fitted, but the material was thick and stretchy so very flattering.
Perfect for a black tie wedding  It was not form fitting-loose on my waist, but very elegant.

Such a chic, elegant and most importantly comfortable gown to dance and dine in all night! Fit was great, glad I opted for the short (I'm 5'3" and with 2 inch heels it was the perfect height, definitely would have been long if I had gotten the regular length). I wore a strapless bra and it looked fine with it. Size was true to fit (I am usually a 2 and I wore a 2P). I wore spanx underneath but probably could have gotten away without them. Dress was fairly form fitting but hugged in all the right places and wasn't tight  to the point where i felt like it was too tight. I have a pretty athletic build and the dress was still able to create a beautiful silhouette. I got so many compliments...definitely would recommed!
My dress! Fit was great, the train made dancing difficult. But overall a great dress!

Beautiful, simple dress for prom Loved this dress, I actually ordered it as a backup after my first dress didn't fit right. Customer service was great! This dress fit in all the right places, though I took off a star because it was a little bit awkwardly short with my heels. Overall, very comfortable, great for any formal occasion :)

Beautiful, impeccable condition, and perfect for evening event. This gown fit beautifully true to size and was perfect for a black-tie-optional, evening wedding. I'm 5'6" and wore 2.5 inch  heels and the dress hit at the perfect place just at the top of my toes. It drapes beautifully and is extremely comfortable.

Heavy but timeless! I'm 5'3, normally a size 4, and picked the 2P for a perfect fit with heels! I was a little worried it would be too plain but it was just classically beautiful. 10/10 would recommend to any wedding with plain, dangly earrings. I personally hate when dresses are low cut on the side because I feel like my boob will pop out, but this cut was perfect - (I included photo of side view so you could see the cut under the arm.)
beautiful runs a bit small, and there is no give in the material at all. however, really beautiful, really flattering, classic, gorgeous. i wished i could have kept it.
Great fit. Great fit, a tad snug but alas! I'm 5'4" and wore 3.5" heels and it was just hitting the floor.

This dress was classic, glam & chic with great length & a beautiful neckline.  Fit perfectly - the length was great and I could still wear heels.  Definitely body skimming but the fabric is thick enough to feel comfortable.  I was able to wear a strapless bra and paired it with a cropped fur jacket for the church and received lots of compliments!

This was one of my back-up dresses, so I wasn't expecting to love it, but it was actually perfect!
 I got both the 4P and 6P - I could have worn either, but ended up going with the 4P since it was a bit more secure up top since I was going braless. If I had the right kind of bra, I probably would have gone with the 6P. Regardless, the material has a good stretch and I was very comfortable all night through the wedding ceremony, eating, and dancing. I'm 5'2" and I wore 4-inch heels and the hem just barely touched the ground. I ended up taking my shoes off later in the night but the length was still manageable. 

It really was the perfect dress for the occasion - it's simple but definitely elegant, and you can really dress it up with your accessories. I got tons of compliments.  I wish I could keep it!

I got compliments all night!  Figure flattering, chic & elegant all in one!  I wore this to my brother-in-law wedding that I was a part of (day ceremony/night reception).  I have an hourglass figure so I did like that the material had some stretch to it and hugged my body in the right places.  I do think it runs a little big so would recommend getting one size smaller as a backup. I wore a  medium heel for the ceremony and then changed to a short heal for the reception and at only 5'3" it was perfect.

I felt super glamorous and sleek; stretchy  fabric & dress rouches complimented my shape Great for big chested women with curves.  At the time I was 38DD, size 14, 5'3"&164 lbs.
Stretchy fabric and rouching at waist emphasize shape. Classy & sleek even for 54 year old.

Simple, but sophisticated! This dress was perfect. Simple black, but still had a lot of character. The skinny straps, high zip back and flowy bottom of the skirt were details that made this dress elegant. I'm 5'8" and wore flats - the 6 regular fit perfect. If you are planning on wearing heels, go to the 6L. I typically wear a size 4, but I'm a few months post-baby - so I opted for the 6 to give myself a little more room in the midsection. It was definitely fitted, but because the material was not thin/clingy, I felt like it really was forgiving and I wasn't constantly worried about it appearing too tight. I felt very comfortable in it.  The dress came in great condition, as usual. Would definitely recommend.
Elegantly simple dress My regular size 6 fit perfectly - lots of compliments on a very simple floor length gown for a formal wedding. Would definitely rent again!

I was the Maid of Honor for my sister's wedding this past weekend and this dress was perfect! This dress was absolutely amazing! It fit me absolutely perfectly and with the spandex in the material, I could dance, sit, and eat without feeling uncomfortable or having to hold me breath!  I highly recommend this dress to anyone looking for an elegant and sexy dress!
A celebration night. Classic and flattering.   A perfect black dress!  A great dress to hide all my flaws.
Hollywood fun! This dress is fantastic- easy to wear, elegant, easy to dress up or down w/jewelry or shows. I'm very tall and it was long enough.

Classy, sexy, and comfortable! In my search for the perfect black tie dress for a charity event, I favorited several dresses and then asked my husband to pick his favorite. He immediately picked out this one because it is form fitting. I was slightly reluctant because I tend to choose more "fit & flare" styles. Also I have a full bust, so I wasn't sure how a halter would look. I am short, so I ordered a 4P and a 6P as the backup size. The 4P was very tight. It would have worked in a pinch, but the 6P was much more flattering. The bust was perfectly supportive and I could *almost* have gone without a bra. A regular strapless bra is perfect under this dress. 

As for the fit, it was amazing! The fabric is a bit heavy and thicker than most other dresses. This results in a very slimming effect and I looked amazing! My husband and friends were giving me compliments all night long. This dress was super comfortable and classy. I would definitely rent it again for another black tie event.

The dress was amazing. Perfect for a black tie fundraising gala.  The dress fit amazing. It was totally true to size and was so flattering. The only negative was it was a tiny bit too long with the heels I wore--but I did wear shorter heels so that was mostly my fault.

Slimmng, comfortable, and beautiful for a black tie event. I was obsessed with this dress and wish that I owned it. Black is obvious very flattering, but the style of this dress makes it even more slimming. The fabric is soft and stretchy (not casual appearing though) while being thick enough to suck you in and smooth everything out. I wore this for a black tie wedding and felt it was perfect. Also-- this was my second choice dress after I hated the first one and RTR was amazing to overnight it to me in time for the wedding!

This dress made me feel glamorous! I originally ordered this dress in red but it was unavailable in my size so I wore the black version. I really like the cut of the dress even though it was a little big up top. I also liked the length.
Loved it. The dress is sexy, but not overdone. Comfortable. Nice, quality fabric.  Beautiful gown. I hated returning it.  I just felt really sexy and comfortable in it.

Very flattering I ordered a 12L, but they did not deliver it. Therefore, it was a bit loose around the armholes/cleavage area; I did not find out until the day before the event, so I couldn't find the proper bra in time and felt a bit unsupported. Perfect length for a 5'8" woman with 5" heels. Great color. Wrinkled upon delivery. Simple yet sexy.
This dress exceeded all my expectations! It was form fitting, although it was a little long for me. This problem was fixable--I wore my tallest heels.

Very classy dress Love this dress and would/will rent it again.  Very comfortable, yet chic.  Wore it to a professional awards dinner and dressed it up with pearls.  Perfect to look fabulous and sexy, but not overtly.  Normally wear an 8 or 10. Ordered 10 and 12 based on comments.  Glad I did.  The hips/stomach were too tight on the 10.  Lovely dress!
This dress! <3  Simple, classic, comfortable!

Prom This dress was great! It fit very well and I had no trouble with it at all. The material is very comfortable and easy to move in. I wore heels and the length was perfect with my height. I truly think the dress flatters everyone and is great for any formal event.

Simple Elegance. This dress was absolutely perfect for the black tie wedding I attended. 
 The dress fit like a glove. No undergarments needed for this dress! It was very comfortable to dance the night away in.

Beautiful dress - loved it! This was my first time to use RTR and will definitely rent again!  I'm 5'3, 122 lbs and the 2P fit perfectly.  The 2R would definitely have been too long.  I was a little nervous about the cut being too low by the arms but it was fine and I was able to wear a strapless bra.  Simple but beautiful dress!

Felt confident and beautiful! Loved this dress! I felt confident and great in it. The silhouette is tighter than I normally go for, but the thick fabric kept the dress flattering and slimming - I felt smooth and sleek in this dress. Received lots of compliments. It is classy and classic yet still trendy. I paired with fun earrings and a chunky bracelet to add some personality.

This dress was absolutely fantastic! As someone who is 6 feet tall it is always difficult to find a dress that is long enough. This dress was a perfect fit. I was even able to wear a 4 inch heal. I would recommend this to any of my tall ladies out there!

classic, elegant, great base for a formal event I am 5'8, 135, athletic-ish build and the dress was pretty loose on me. I am almost always a 6, and if anything I occasionally size up to an 8. So I ordered a 6 and an 8 but the 6 was super baggy around my hips (again im not super curvy, but i was still shocked that the right size would have been a 4).
I wore this dress to a banquet at West Point. The fit was great, material is stretchy and very comfortable.

Black Classic Dress I loved this dress! I wore it to a wedding that was a black tie event.  I am curvy so I wanted to choose something with a bit of a stretch.  I am 5'4" so i ordered a 6R and 6P bc I usually buy dresses and have them taken up so they don't drag the floor too much.  I figured I would wear the 6P but actually the 6R fit me perfectly in length.  I would definitely recommend this dress if you're looking for something classic and safe.  Was satisfied with this choice!

Gorgeous Dress! Got compliments all night!   This was my  backup dress. I ended up wearing it instead of my original dress. It fit a little bit big, but since i am a 36DD it worked out perfect considering the cut of the dress around the chest area is a little narrow. This dress was extremely comfortable! My boyfriend kept asking me if i could keep the dress because he loved it so much! I definitely recommend for any formal event! I will be renting this again in the future!
Loved everything about it!  Very flattering. Great material. Perfect length w/4 inch heels.

Black Tie Wedding Beautiful, elegant dress. I planned on wearing the 4 as I have a good size "bubble butt".  However, the 4 was a bit baggy in the chest, whereas with the 2 I didn't have to wear a bra. Luckily the dress has a bit of stretch to it so the 2 was fine and I was able to sit comfortably. I wore 3.25 inch heels and the length was perfect.

Rented this dress for prom! Loved the dress, really well fitting fabric and stretches/hugs in all the right places! Loved the subtle high-low hem. Awesome dress if you want to show off your shoulders/curves! Little bit tight fitting around the hips, but the fabric makes that okay.

Simple, but elegant! I wore this to a gala that I was working and it was perfect for the occasion. It was elegant, but also simple so that there wasn't too much attention on me. (It would've been a different story had I been going to the gala as a guest.) Regardless, I got so many compliments. As you can probably see, I'm 5 feet tall so the dress was very long on me and that was slightly an issue when walking around, but I made it work. Maybe I could've gone a size down, but it might not have been available. I still think it was completely worth it and was flattering on my body.

Love love love! This dress was so comfortable and beautiful and I highly recommend it. I feel like this dress would work well with any shape. Beware, there is a small train at the back so you can easily step on that. I would wear it again in a heartbeat.
Flattering and elegant dress!  I was comfortable and got a lot of compliments all night. Overall a great dress that I'd wear again!

This Dress was great! ESP for a momma to BE! I am normally btw a size 2/4 in dresses but i am expecting and am 5 1/2 months along, i ended up wearing a size 6 and it fit perfect! the fabric has some stretch for my growing belly so it was great! Im normally 5'4 and about 130 pounds, at the moment i am about 145 with the weight i have gained from the pregnancy. Got a ton of compliments and black was slimming for my growing bump!

Wore this for formal pictures and LOVED IT!  This fit like a dream. The material is great and very flattering. If you want to show off some curves.. this is the dress! The dress was very form fitting but I felt very comfortable in it. I am pretty short so I was concerned about the length, but with heels, it was perfect. HIGHLY recommend this! This was my first RTR experience and wow!
Compliments ALL night long!  I love this dress! I am glad I had the backup size, I needed the 4L and it fit like a glove.

This dress will get you compliments! Fit:  The fit is perfect for an hourglass figure!  The dress is structured perfectly to hug your body in all the right places.    The bust is shaped by wire (instead of stretchy material), so smaller cup sizes might want to go down a size.  

Length:  I'm pretty tall, so I opted for the long.  I had about 2 inches to spare for heels.

Cons:  I wore this dress to a formal event.  While on the dance floor, I noticed the thick material made me feel really warm--more than I'd usually feel when dancing. 

Overall, I would rent this dress again.  It is truly timeless.

I adore this dress! I absolutely adore this dress. It's simple but elegant and the bottom makes it unique. I didn't get to wear it :( because it does run small in the chest area (the boning and no stretch material). I tried forever to get that zipper up. It's gorgeous!!!!! RTR was so nice and fast to send me another dress to wear. I won't be buying another formal dress as long as RTR is around. Very impressed!!

Everyone at prom loved my dress! Even though it was simple, it still stood out! This dress was amazing! It was so comfortable and looked so good! I highly recommend it to everyone (especially women with curves). It was a little long even with the regular, so I needed to wear a little heel. I am almost always a 6, but surprisingly I was a 4 in this dress. When you order it, definitely order your size and the smaller size just to be safe, also with the 4 it was still very big around the bust. Overall, this dress is so simple and elegant, and looks perfect with a big necklace!

Too long! The dress was great, but I'm 5'5" and the regular was a little too long. Hopefully they can make it in a short/petite version soon. I had to wear VERY high heels so that it wouldn't touch the floor.
Classic Gown I liked it, however it ran a little big in the bust and I'm pretty busty sooo.

So many compliments. Perfect!  I'm a 32C. It fit good around the bust. It's long so if you're 5'4, id suggest 3-4 inch heels! 3 worked for me! But overall, loved it! Perfect dress. I looked stunning for prom and it was timeless.
The dress Pros- very flattering for curvy bodies.

Nice, safe dress I ordered the dress n 10R and 12R, since I normally wear a size 10 and often formal gowns run small.  The 10R fit perfectly.  I did have to wear 4.5" heels to have the dress skim the floor properly.  There is a bit of stretch at the hips but really none in the chest.  The small train was manageable but I didn't attempt to dance with it.  I didn't find walking difficult as some mentioned.  The dress was really just okay.  You probably won't be the center of attention because I didn't think it was a show stopper.  Ultimately, a pretty gown, safe choice, and it definitely shows the curves.  Overall, wouldn't rent it again, but it was okay.
my date ;) perfect dress. perfect fit - comfortable. classic.

I felt like a model!!  I cannot say enough wonderful things about this dress.  Despite it being a "plain black dress", I received so many compliments. It fit me like a glove! I sometimes feel self conscious about the lower tummy pooch and saddlebags portions of my body, but this dress covered those areas smoothly without clinging and actually made me look thinner! The fishtail portion hits at just the right spot on your legs to elongate your body and not shorten it. It was stretchy and easily moveable. If I could buy this dress, I would- its that good. I feel like it would look great on anyone!
Great dress Dress fit great a little stretch. With my heels the 0 petite was the perfect length.
Beautiful but short Very pretty dress. I am 5'9" and ordered a long and found the dress very short. I was not able to wear heels and still wish it had been a little longer with my flats

Dress was gorgeous and I felt very glamorous! Great dress for a curvy body!  Was a little big in the chest area, but was able to keep it up.  Ordered both petite and regular length and ended wearing petite length even with 4 inch heels.  Got tons of compliments and RTR customer service was awesome.

This dress is so elegant, classic and downright stunning! The dress fit like a glove! I read through reviews and figured I would take my chances ordering the long as I tend to wear very high heels. Next time I would definitely stick with the regular being that I had to hold my dress up most of the night. Wore this to a wedding and was told all night how stunning I looked! I felt like a movie star! Slightly restricting when dancing but totally worth it! I would rent this dress again and again! A great go to!

not a summer dress! This was my backup dress and I didn't wear it. It's June, and although black can be appropriate, this is a VERY heavy fabric. It also has lace panels down the sides, on the hips and legs, giving it a 'gothic' look I didn't notice that when I rented it. It's very substantial and very formal. Lots of weight to carry around.  It is an amazing hourglass and is very forgiving of small body flaws, since the fabric is substantial, and not at all flimsy

Perfect For Black tie event The dress was amazing and I think it would look good on anyone. The 4L was a little bit too long on me and could've probably gotten away with just the regular with heels. The waist area could've also been a little tighter but I was the only one who noticed that. I loved how it fit besides that! It was perfect.

I wore this dress to my friend's evening, black-tie wedding. I loved this dress! The fit is very flattering and it has some stretch in it to give you a better fit. I am 5'6" and wore the regular with 4 inch heels and it just swept the ground, so it was the perfect length.

Absolutely perfect. This dress is to die for, I wanted to keep it!  Seriously fabulous, the quality is AMAZING and i honestly believe this dress would flatter anyone. I have so many great pictures I could've chosen, this dress made me look like a million bucks! I usually wear a 2, but the 0 fit so perfectly I didn't even try on the two. I didn't wear a bra, and didn't need to- I had plenty of coverage. So comfortable and SO SEXY - felt like I was really on a runway. Made me look very long and thin! Couldn't have had a better dress. I wore very high pumps and didn't need a long size, so I would suggest the regular.

LOVED this dress! I wore it for a black tie optional event and it was a huge hit!  Very form fitting but material is extremely comfortable and flexible. Definitely shows off your curves! I am 5'3 and wore 3.5 in heels and it was a bit long. Overall would absolutely recommend it and would definitely rent it again!

Formal, yet comfortable I ordered a 2R and 0R. I wore the 0R which fit perfect in the hips, but was large in the bust. The length worked well with 4'' heels. This dress was fine for the event, but it was not as flattering as shown by the model. For ladies with an hourglass or pear shape, this might not be the right dress as it emphasizes one's hips and bum. Easy to walk in and room to breathe.
The customer service was awesome.  The dress didn't quite fit, but overall great process
lots of compliments all night long snug fit throughout down to knees, slightly difficult to dance in, loved it though!, very flattering

Lovely dress for formal occassion This dress is heavy!  The bodice has wired support, and the material is thick.  The bottom fishtail is fun, however it does add to the weight of the dress.  Proper heel height is a must, otherwise I could see it being easy to trip and get caught up in the bottom of this gown.  It's a beautiful dress and well-made.  I would wear it again.

Did not wear this. Chose my backup dress instead. Bust was a little big (stretched from wear). Had to keep adjusting. Also, pay attention to how the model stands in the photo. This is not how the dress will look unless you stand the exact same way all night. Just a reminder!

Loved this dress! Everyone kept asking me where I got it and I had eyes on me all night. I am 5'3" 125lbs. It fit me perfect in the body except the bust was much too big. I am a 32B and even with my bombshell bra on it was still to big. It wasn't so big that it fell off though. I would definitely recommend this dress.

It was an amazing dress! Perfect in all the right places for an Inverted Triangle body type. It was an amazing dress! Unfortunately, I didn't get to wear it for my event as the wedding attire was not as formal as anticipated. This is perfect for a black tie event/wedding though!!

Seriously stunning! Never have I ever received so many compliments!  Let me start by saying this wasn't my original dress. The one I wanted had been returned damaged and RTR was AMAZING and let me choose alternate dresses. All three were Gorg in person but I ultimately ended up going with this one and I'm SO happy! (Boyfriend was happy too) ;). It's stunning seriously fit like a glove, hugged my curves perfectly, was so comfortable, I felt like a million bucks.. I highly recommend this dress, the shape is just beyond!  I did rent a 4l and 2l (typically a solid 4) but I ended up wearing the 2l so I def suggest going a size down!
Great fit and very comfortable for a formal dress.  The best part, I didn't have to pull it up all night!

Formal wedding  Beautiful dress for a formal wedding, great material. This dress was very heavy, but helped hide any trouble areas (like my tummy). I should have worn taller heels, even though I was already wearing 5 inch platform heels, the dress still dragged on the floor and I was afraid of tripping when I walked. I ordered the 10 and 8. I'm in between sizes trying to loose some baby weight - I probably could have even fit into a 6, but it might not have fit in the chest area. The 8 was still snug enough that I wasn't lifting the top all night. Definitely would rent again for a fancy black tie event!
The dress;) Stunning dress. Fit perfectly.

Stunning, hugged every curve. Extremely comfortable, top stayed up easily.  I highly recommend a pair of shape wear (spanx, etc) as the dress will show every curve. Strapless bra was fine, and the top of the dress has been shaped to fit a full bust and stays up, I didn't adjust my dress once the entire night! Huge bonus for a strapless dress! The Long length was perfect for my height with a pair of 3 1/2 in heels, no tripping and was just above the floor so no dragging. Would rent this again in a heartbeat!
10 out of 10 Absolutely stunning. Stretchy fabric is comfortable and makes the dress fit like a glove. Highly recommend!
This dress was gorgeous. A little big but really beautiful.  Dress was a little loose  mostly due to stretching, I think. Otherwise, very beautiful. Fit was pretty good. Length was perfect.

It was my son's wedding.  I got so many compliments on the dress
 It was a little too big for me.  I should have ordered the size 6.  I had to pull it up constantly
Didn't end up wearing this dress. Would have been very nice if it fit. Very stretchy fabric. Too large every where on me. Wouldn't even stay up.

Gorgeous Dress for a beautiful Night! Fits perfectly! It hugs every curve of your body in all the right ways. Being a mom of 3 with a little belly still, I was worried about my stomach. But the slight ruching made it appear flat. Loved the dress!

Comfortable Class Wore this dress to a wedding and loved it.  Very comfortable and accented all my curves in just the right ways.  The dress can be made very formal or more casual depending on jewelry selection, so it's perfect for a formal wedding with a fun reception!  Got many complements throughout the evening.  The only downfall, I had to wear flats with the regular length.  This was okay for me as my feet were super comfortable all night, but it would have been nice to have the option of heels.

This dress was so comfortable and very flattering for a girl with some curves!!    The dress fit great!  I'm 5'-4" and wore my tallest black heels and the dress just touched the floor.    #blacktiewedding #wedding

If you are large in the bust...this is not the dress for you! The dress was beautiful in person, from the waist down, the fit was wonderful.  However, it was extremely small in the chest.  I ususally wear a size 8 an ordered a 10 because I have large breast and the  zipper could not zip at all in the chest area and I did not want to force it.  However the Renthterunway staff was exteremely helpful when I called and immediately sent two other options overnight, which should arrive today and I hope theyf it!  While this dress is beautiful if your cup size is more than a D, then this dress is probably not for you.

Great dress Exactly what you expect based on the picture. Very simple and pretty. Runs slightly big and is a little long for someone of my height (5'4"), but definitely still wearable. I wore 4.5 inch heels and it dragged on the ground a little in the back.

Perfect silhouette Va! Voom!  Curve hugger, comfortable, heavy construction and forgiving.   This dress shows off what you got but you HAVE to accessorize with punchy stuff or the look falls flat.  Hence the major hardwear necklace.
 I didn't need a bra since the bodice is very well built.  I wore something spanx-like as a comfort measure (first day of period) but it's not necessary. It's long, the 4S wasn't available, I wore 2 1/2-3 inch heels and just picked up the skirt if I had to walk very far/stairs/outdoors.  Unless you're quite tall, there's not much reason to wear KillMe heels- save that budget for jewelry or a flashy minaudiere .  I was in Uggs at the end of the night, nobody saw them and I lasted all night.   I'm a 32DD  (not 34D, but it's as close a match the profile list had)--  a smaller bust or someone less muscular could squeeze into the 2R.  It came in perfect condition, clean, odorless, no snags. Don't plan to dance hard in this dress--.There's enough room at the knees to walk and take stairs.  Slow dance and or don't move your feet much or you'll step on the hem and fall-- there's no give at the knees to catch yourself!   (swing dancer,  lots of experience in this department)
