I'm still getting compliments a week later.  I couldn't get the necklace I wanted at RTR, but found a perfect one for $40 at a ubiquitous discount retail chain that I liked better than anything. 
I've rented 3 cocktail dresses (sadly no pics to review) before, so I was pretty comfortable renting this one. Definitely doing it again.
I wish I had an event to wear gowns to every weekend.  sigh....
Loved how I felt and looked in the dress Can't wear shoes that will snag the dress, but it was very forgiving for my belly with spanx underneath

The dress was beautiful and classy. I got compliments all night. The size 2R fit me perfectly. This dress has a little stretch to it, which made it so so comfortable. I wore 3 inch heels and the length was good. I think it would work well with all bust types. I seriously loved this dress and would recommend it to anyone. I also rented the necklace that the dress model is wearing and it looked great.

Easy Wear! This was actually the backup dress sent to me after my first choice was unavailable. It was a size under what I normally wear and therefore ran tighter on me than what my true size may have fit like. However it wasn't uncomfortably tight for a relatively structured dress and actually moved really well throughout the evening (sitting, standing, dancing). I typically don't wear strapless as I have a large bust but the dress was very supportive and I experienced very little slippage. Overall, great dress!
Beautiful! Looked great and very comfortable.  Just be aware, fabric is very heavy.  Good for covering imperfections!

Perfect combination of elegant and form fitting The dress is beautiful - the material is stretchy so there is plenty of room after a big meal, the heart-shaped neck line is flattering , and the rouched fabric detailing along the sides and bottom (where the dress fish tails) is a subtle touch that makes this dress anything but ordinary. I was concerned that the trumpet shape of the dress would impair walking and movement but the dress was incredibly comfortable and allowed full range of motion so I was on the dance floor all night! Sizing runs large (I wore the 2 but needed the 0) so I was pulling the dress up all night, even though I wore a strapless bra. Make sure if you rent this dress, size down, rather than up. Despite my tugging, the dress hugged my curves perfectly everywhere else and is extremely flattering - the compliments flooded in all night. I like this dress so much that I already rented it again for an upcoming event in a couple weeks.

Great Black Dress I wore this dress for a formal professional dinner for my boyfriend's company. I ordered a 6 and the 8, usually I am a 6 but ended up wearing the 8… because it was so much more comfortable. This dress fits like a glove. Height is true to size, I am 5'6 and wore 3 1/2 inch heels. I wasn't a huge fan of the ruching, but you can't really tell. It's a beautiful dress, doesn't stand out, but doesn't take away. I think it's perfect for professional formal events or even weddings where you don't when you don't want to be over the top. Keep in mind the back is longer than the front, I wasn't expecting the small train, but it worked as long as I didn't step on it.

I never have curves but I sure did this evening! Elegance at its best.  Overall this was a great dress, it’s formal yet fun and fairly comfortable to move around in. I had to pick it up going up and down stairs because it’s tight through the knees, but that also may be because I had to get a regular instead of petite. The darts were also poking me all night, again may be because of torso length and I should have been in a petite. Most importantly I did really feel glamorous and appropriately dressed for my first time at a very fancy black tie cancer research fundraiser! This dress is a knock-out, you will definitely get compliments on your figure!

Loved the dress! Wore this to wedding reception.  Ordered a 0R - it fit well (the dress really hugs your curves in a flattering way!) but it was still slightly long (I am only 5'2 and wore 4 inch heels).  I should have ordered a 0P but this size was not available when I placed my order, but otherwise I was very happy with the dress.  It is a simple black dress but I styled it up with some long silver earrings, and all my guests loved it.  Would rent again!

The quality, the great fit, having that extra size just in case!!























       



 This dress really hugs your entire body! Because of that, you're not having to constantly pull up and adjust the dress. The fabric had a bit of stretch to it which contributed to the great fit. By the end of the night, the dress was dragging on the floor. I think it was a combination of the weight off the dress and the fabric of the dress. It just stretched out lengthwise over the course of the evening. Keep that in mind when choosing the dress length. I'm 5'7" and was recommended the L. It was too long to begin with even with 3" heels. I went with the 6R and the length was perfect (with an exception towards the end of the night).  I would definitely rent this dress again!
Perfect! Great customer service!  Dress was very comfortable!  Very pleasant experience!  Will def rent again!

Formal, classy setting. Gorgeous dress, perfect for a black tie wedding. I didn't want to have to return it.  Several reviewers had mentioned the normal length running long, but I wish I had ordered the 4L as a back-up size - the 4R justtttt grazed the floor and sent me searching for flat dressy sandals the day of the wedding. Otherwise, perfection!

Perfect dress for any formal event! This dress is perfect for any formal affair. It is classic, and highlights a beautiful silhouette of your shape. True to size. I'm 5'10" and wore a size 2L and it fit like a glove. Had very nice compliments all evening long and I felt very pretty. Thank you once again, RTR!! Highly recommend this dress, ladies!

Compliments all night! I LOVED THIS DRESS. Fits true to size. I am 5'10" and the long was perfect. My only complaint was while walking and dancing I noticed the dress kept turning on my body and the zipper would end up on my hip. It was an easy fix, just annoying.

Nice plain black gown I am usually a solid 4 but I ordered the 2 as a backup and thank God I did because that's what I wore. I'd say this dress runs large, especially in the chest area. I consider myself a pretty chesty girl, but the 4 was super big up top. 

Also, if you are on the border of 5'7"-5'8" go with the long. Even if you wear 1" heels the regular will be too short. 

Overall it's a solid, well-fitting black strapless gown but nothing too fancy or special; perhaps not worth the rental price.

Absolutely stunning gown, would recommended it to anyone! Hides your flaws & turns them into a plus! The gown fit like a glove, I was able to move in the gown and danced the night away without a wardrobe malfunction!

It was a gorgeous dress and I received so many compliments. This dress was absolutely gorgeous and I felt great wearing it. I wore a size 2p and although the dress fit perfect around the hips (i'm a bit larger) it was slightly long and I had to pull it up throughout the night. The dress fit perfect around my curves and it was comfortable to wear. I would recommend this dress.

I felt so glamorous wearing this dress.  I didn't want to return it!  Badgley Mischka is awesome!  The bottom portion is very flowing, while the upper portion is more fitted.  I wore it to a friend's wedding and received numerous compliments on it.  I would definitely rent it again.

Elegant and Chic!  This dress is the cutest and most comfortable dress I have worn yet from RTR!  It hits your waist at the exact spot it needs to and flairs out to the perfect length. I felt classy and elegant! The 2 fit me perfectly ! Paired with some bright jewelry it was a smash!

A perfect little black dress for a party! It fit great and the material was a perfect heaviness. The flared skirt was a little too poofy for me because I have a larger butt, but otherwise, I loved the dress.
Beautiful dress but has a short torso  I didn't wear this due to the short torso. Very pretty though if this style works for your body.
This dress was perfect for the wedding I went to.  It was cocktail attire and fit in perfectly. It fit extremely well. Very true to size.  The fabric is great and it has a twirly skirt! I loved it.

Fun wedding dress I ordered the 4 and 6 and ended up wearing the size 6 because the 4 was a little tight around the arms.  This dress has a full skirt that becomes shorter in the back when you sit.  During the wedding reception, I was very self conscious sitting down because it felt like my butt was out the entire time.  Once we hit the dance floor, I felt much more comfortable.  I would probably not rent this dress again due to the way it shifted while sitting.

My husband and I attended a Dancing with the Stars Fundraiser.  I was a perfect party dress.  Rent the Runway staff sent me this dress as a back up.  It ended up being perfect.  I normally wear a 10 but the 12 was only one available. It worked and I felt beautiful.  Would rent again!!! Cant say enough about Customer  Service!!!! It was a wonderful experience.
Nice but too tight for my bust I'm a little busty and couldn't get this zipped without smushing. I'd say go up a size if you are top heavy.
Gorgeous Dress for a Formal Affair This was my backup dress and I did not end up wearing it because the other one fit the location.  But it would be absolutely beautiful for a more formal affair.

Great skirt Wore this for my wedding after-party. I'd rented it before and it was a touch too tight in the ribs, but the 6 fit.
Great skirt for dancing!

Great LBD to wear to any event.  I wore this to a wedding and it was a warm day. Heavy fabric could be hot for some, but it was great for the structure of the dress. The flare of the skirt held it's shape and doesn't wrinkle at all. It's a slightly shiny fabric and heavy enough that it doesn't show your undergarments at all.  It was very comfortable and I wished that I could keep it!

A perfect little black dress with a statement.  Great dress! The fabric is high quality. I wore this for a corporate awards ceremony in November. The silhouette of the dress is very complimentary. The measurements on the site made sense aside from the waist. The waist line measurements seemed very small so  I originally ordered the 4 and 6. But ended up changing last minute to a 2 & 4. I typically wear a 0 -2 size dress. I ended up wearing the 2 and it fit perfectly. So if you typically wear that size, I would order that. I wore this with sheer black tights and black suede wedges topped with gold jewelry. This dress is so fun and flirty- it would be great for work event or a night out.

This dress fit so incredibly well and is so fun! This dress fit me incredibly well, and I received so many compliments at my company Christmas party.  It does run slightly small but not much. Anyone a  bit pear shaped I'm sure will be fine with their normal size, but anyone hour glass or with broader shoulders will definitely want to size up for back ups just to be sure.  The dress is fun and flirty, I think I may need to buy it now!

It was my first  order with RTR and I LOVED my dress.. had plenty of compliments! Thanks again! Iam 5"5 and  my body type is a bit athletic with  big arms, but  usually wear a size 2 .  With my arms , I was not comfortable in the size 2 due to my arms and it was tight  by armpit  so I was more comfortable in size 4  with my arms out. Overall I loved the dress and it fitted perfectly . I have a small  bust and wear 34A,. I do recommend a larger size for women with larger bust because it will flatten your boobs looking like it is not your true size. The bottom part of the dress is fine . I was able to  swing it on the Dance floor..lol

Perfect December Grad Dress! I wore this for my fall college graduation, the color and thickness of material was perfect for December, and it was tight at the top and flared out a little above the waste so it was figure flattering. I loved wearing this, it looked great with my Louboutins and with Converse for later. So fun, would TOTALLY recommend. Fit was true to size and would rent it again and again.

Gorgeous well made LBD! Absolutely loved this dress!! Fitted at the waist with a full skirt that was so much fun! Nice heavy material that was perfect for a fall wedding. Got so many compliments! Definitely an upgraded version of a standard little black dress, classy and beautiful. Size 8 fit me perfectly (5'6", 155, hourglass shape). Would definitely order again.

Cute, classy, tons of compliments Loves the dress. I wore it for our family Thanksgiving dinner, and received tons of compliments. The only negative I found is that it was very tight in the chest. I can usually fit my bust into a 6, but this fabric had no give or stretch to it at all so it was extremely constrictive. If you are well endowed, I would definitely recommend a  size up. otherwise, the dress was perfect and I have no complaints! As always, customer service was impeccable as well. I just love RTR!

Super cute party dress I originally ordered a 10 and 8. With reviews saying the chest part was kind of tight I got nervous and ordered my back up as a 12. I'm glad I did. The 10 was not available and I ended up wearing the 12. It fit perfectly but was a bit large in the waist area/chest. I added a thick belt and called it a day.
This dress is adorable.  I got a lot of compliments on it.   It was the perfect length for me. I am usually a size 2 or 4 when it comes to dresses and the 4 fit me perfect.

Super cute dress, great for a wedding!  The arm holes were a little big snug, but otherwise fit great! I almost wore the 2 but decided to go with the 4 at the last minute for a little more room. The dress was comfy and super fun.

Made me feel great!!! Love this dress! On the model it came to her middle thigh, but I'm pretty short so it was about an inch above my knee. The dress is light weight and extremely comfortable. It was amazing to wear a regular bra with it too.  I was getting compliments everywhere I went that night (walking outside, at the restaurant and event). I have big hips for my size, so I fitted the dress to the size of my shoulders. I hope I have a chance to rent this dress again because my boyfriend loved me in it!

favorite ensemble i've ever worn! I rented a 2 and 4 and ended up going with the 4. As other reviews have mentioned, the top is tight (I am not big chested either). The sleeves did cut into the front of my shoulders but not enough that it truly bothered me.  My boyfriend and I loved the dress on me. It was so flattering! I wore it with the Kate Spade fame and flowers necklace which went perfectly with the pink shoes I had. The skirt is full and fun to twirl in. The fabric is heavy and I was concerned about being too hot, but I was inside a well AC'd room. Overall, a great rental!

I LOVE THIS DRESS This dress was AMAZING. I wore it for New Year's to a party downtown. It was super cute and flattering, the little fuller skirt was so much fun. I was a little worried the polka dots would be too much, but they were barely noticeable and just gave it a little bit of shimmer. I would've loved to keep this dress. It was adorable and I felt so confident and fun in it. Definitely would recommend for any occasion!

It was a beautiful dress got loads of compliments! This dress was beautiful out the bag. I ordered a 4 and a 6, thank goodness because the 4 was to tight under my arms and around my bust. It was an outdoor wedding so this dress was a little hot, but i got loads of compliments and it was easy to dance in! I would rent this again!

Perfect LBD I wore this dress for a wedding on Halloween and I LOVED it. I was so sad to send this back...I wish it was mine! It was perfectly sophisticated, and hit me in all the right spots. Great dress to dance in as well! I have larger hips, so this dress was great to show my waist and hide my hips a bit. Seriously loved the dress and I would totally rent it again!

Looks better in person. Super comfy! I absolutely LOVED it and want to own it!  Fun skirt! Wore for my birthday. Was comfy and warm (which in Boston in Dec. is key). Lots of compliments! The skirt was so fun. Fit nice and snug.
Fun Fun dress, lined so it is a bit "thicker" I wore it to a dinner party and it was a hit! It's not your typical LBD, it has a bit of edge to it!
worn for an awards dinner  flared out at the hips more than i would have liked
Fun and Festive  I loved the print and the full skirt.. but the material had no stretch and it was tight / uncomfortable around my chest and shoulders.

Great LBD This dress fit perfectly.  I was so surprised at the flexibility of this dress. I was able to move around and dance comfortably all night. I will definitely be interested in this dress again for a night out.

I wore this dress for my boyfriend's semi-formal. It was PERFECT. I received so many compliments.  The dress fits just as the picture by the model shows (tight on top and then poofy at the bottom). I was afraid the black circles on the dress were going to look cheap (like sequence) but they weren't. It is a very classy black dress. The only con to the dress is that is can be short for tall people like me. I am 5'10" and the dress was a little short. I just had to be careful about not bending over. But since the dress is poofy I was able to get away with the shortness of the dress. I would definitely rent again if needed for a similar occasion!

Fun dress for a formal event I wore this dress to a black tie event.  I didn't want to wear something long or super formal, so I chose this dress for it's fun cut.  You can dress it up easily - I wore a short sparkly necklace and a sparkly bracelet.   It fits true to size.  The skirt is a very full skirt, so might be a bit too much material for some.  I personally would have preferred just a little less fabric, but the bigger skirt works well for pear shaped people like myself.  I'm 5'2" and the length hit around the knee which was good for a black tie event.  The only complaint I have is that even though there is a lining under the skirt, the underside of the top materal is itchy so when I was sitting down my legs felt like they were getting pricked by something.

Very nice dress! I was super nervous about renting a dress online, but after reading lots of reviews on this one I decided to risk it...so glad I did! This dress was perfect; it had a nice weight to it, the skirt flared a bit and landed about to my knees. 

Depending on the dress I can usually wear a size 8-10, and based on reviews I decided to go with a 10 in this dress. Others mentioned the arm holes being too small and a bit irritating so I ordered a 12 for backup. I found the arm holes to be just fine in the smaller size, but the very top shoulder/bust area was a little spacious. The waist part was just the right size so I doubt a smaller size would've fit. I would say I have an average bust size, but not much of an hourglass figure, so perhaps this dress would be even more flattering for those with a larger bust and smaller waist? It wasn't a terrible fit for me though, overall I think this would be a nice dress for most body types. 

I would recommend the dress and consider renting again.

My husband loved this dress! My husband complimented me all day in this dress.  I wore it to work and then to a photo shoot. I paired it with a coral Stella & Dot necklace and black wedges.  The armpits of the dress were a little tight, but worth it for how the dress fit.  I loved this dress and felt great in it!  I'll definitely rent it again.
Flattering shape This dress is super flattering, especially on someone like me with a bigger bust. The material got a little stuck to some things, but it wore nicely and fit well.

Beautiful dress! Very comfortable. I got so many compliments on this dress!  Fits tight in the bust, but I'm bigger in that area to begin with. Length was perfect on me at 5'3". The fabric is nice and thick. Looks amazing dressed up with bright jewelry
n/a It felt weirdly small around the back/bust area. I usually wear a 2 or a 4, and both wouldn't zip all the way! Still, got compliments all night.
loved it! one of my faves! fits well but do keep in mind that skirt is VERY voluminous and flared
Comfortable!  This dress was fun, and comfy - runs a bit large!
It was a great dress for a black tie optional wedding.   The fit was true to size.  It might've been a bit long if I hadn't worn pretty high heels,  Worked out great though!
Tight in the bust. Dress was tight in the bust. It has a tight fit in the waist and nice flair. The sleeves were a bit tight only because the bust was tight. Has a nice shimmer design.

Adorable shape! This dress couldn't have been more adorable!  The shape is so fun and the dots have a nice sheen to them making it more than your typical LBD.  I usually wear a size 4, and found this to fit, but be rather tight in the chest, so you might want to size up for your back-up.  Looked great with the Frost Wonderland Necklace

Fun dress, absolutely loved it! I LOVED this dress. I did not want to return it. I typically wear a size 2, and it fit great. The length was great as well, as I have a tendency to be picky about the lengths of my dresses. It was such a fun dress. I graduated with my doctorate and had a party as a wedding/banquet hall. This dress was perfect. I couldn't decide what shoes to wear because it looked cute with everything! It was also a very hot and humid day, but this dress was amazingggg. I received so many compliments. I highly recommend renting it!!

It would have been perfect.  I didn't end up wearing the dress because I didn't end up going to wedding. Long story short I got very sick and ended up with pneumonia, so no wedding for me. BUT the dress would have been perfect.
Wore this dress to a NYE wedding it was perfect for the event!  It is a bit tight around the arms, it rubbed my arms all night to where my arms were sore next day.
Loved it! Perfect fitted top with a full skirt. Everything was perfect!

Fun, classy, modern LBD  Classy, modern twist on the LBD.  I actually got this as a back up and ended up liking it a lot more.  The skirt is super full which makes it really fun to dance in.  10 months post baby, this hit in all the right places and accentuated my waist.  I do have to say, it was a bit smaller than expected.  The armholes were tight and I wish I would have sized up (which is why only 4 stars).   My fear would have been if I got a larger size it would have not fit as I would have wanted it to around my waist.   Overall, great dress, just wish the arm holes were a little larger.
Ended up picking alternate dress It would have been a beautiful dress but the fit was off on the bust area. If you have a bigger chest, I suggest ordering a size up.

A PERFECT LBD!  The fit, the sheen, the flare, it was the best LBD ever. Matter of fact, I participated in a flash mob on this night and my dress moved perfectly with me! I got the jewelry too from RTR and I LOVED this together with the dress! It was sad when I had to send it back!
The dress was perfect! Fits very snug. Everyone loved it. Fits quite snugly, if I had gone up a size it would have been too large.  It was very heavy, too heavy for a Florida wedding.

Perfect for a NYE wedding! The dress is very comfortable and easy to dance in. The fabric is good quality. It is thick enough to go without a bra should you choose. The a-line skirt is extremely flattering. This was my first RTR experience, and I couldn't be happier. I will definitely be using this site in the future!

This was the perfect dress for the wedding I attended.  Perfect cocktail dress. You will need help zipping up. Wind is not your friend in this dress. Tight in the rib cage, but hugs in the right areas. Definitely have a size up sent just in case. Love, love, love this dress.

Cute, feminine party dress I'm 5'11" and usually wear a 10, but the 8 fit perfectly and wasn't too short. The fabric had a light sheen to keep the look interesting ( not your average lbd). I got compliments all night long!

Not your average LBD! Super fun and sweet dress!  Even though it's black, I felt like the subtle polka-dot pattern made it fun enough to wear to a fall wedding.  This is also a winner for short girls -- I'm 5'1 and it was the perfect above-the-knee length!

Thank goodness it looked good with tights! Ordered this for an early January wedding in Orlando. The temps were in the 30s and 40s that weekend and I am so glad this dress looked good with tights! Not sure what I would've done if it hadn't. I loved the fit of this dress. It was flattering all over. I ended up running late for the wedding so I grabbed the size 8 when I meant to wear the size 10. I would've been more comfortable while seated if I had worn the right size but it wasn't too bad.

Cute, flirty, and elegant! The waist fit perfectly, but the bust was slightly large - I wore a padded bra.

Also, this was a backup-backup dress.  The dresses I chose were damaged, so Rent the Runway sent me two more backup dresses for free AND a box of Godiva Chocolates for the hassle.  I will definitely rent again!

Fun dress that flatters waist and covers tummy area.  I wore the 10 because the 8 was too tight in the bust (34D).  I was able to wear a regular bra.  Skirt flares up when you do a twist if dancing.  I received many compliments and one that the dots kinda look like leather.  I would order this dress again.

This was the perfect dress for a rehearsal dinner in Vegas.  Loved it! The dress fit true to size and was very flattering and comfortable.  I'm still self conscious because I have not lost all my baby weight but his dress looked so cute and made me feel very confident and pretty.  I even hit some golf balls in it at Top Golf after the rehearsal dinner!  Wish I had a better pic of the dress but this was the only one.  I would recommend this dress to anyone, looks great on all sizes!
Wore this to an interview dinner and absolutely loved it! Very flattering and fun, yet conservative Love this dress. Will rent again. Fits true to size. Incredibly flattering.

Cute and comfy! The 4 fit pretty well, but the arm holes were a little tight, so I went with the 6.  I was able to wear it for hours and was comfortable all day.  The skirt was a little wider than I expected.  There are no pockets :( Overall, not my favorite but still a pretty great dress.

beautiful LBD with some flare! I ordered my usual size 4 and a back up of a 6 as some said it was small in the chest, but the 4 fit wonderfully! I loved how sophisticated this dress was but with some added fun in the pattern and the skirt on this dress was my favorite!  Wore to a spring wedding, but the weather was a bit windy and cool and the fabric was perfect as it was a bit heavier.

Loved it, fit perfectly, and dressy enough for a formal affair.  I'm 58 and it looked great.         Felt like a model, was very comfortable to wear and VERY flattering.  Have a little belly but did not wear spanx and was fine.
Timeless, classy and comfortable! This was for a winter wedding and it was SO amazing! Still comfortable to dance in, looked great, fit well and really made my night special!
Proper and elegant Fit very well; the little bit of shine woven in against the navy was the perfect touch
Look great without spending a lot The dress is wonderful but form fitting so I would suggest going-up a size.  I usually wear 8-10 but they sent the dress in a 12...fit great with room to move.

Elegant This was my back-up dress but I opted for this one over the first order. It looks much better on than in the photo. Wore it to a Sunday wedding and felt very class and elegant. It was also a nice break from the traditional black.

Many compliments! I got many compliments on this dress. I wore it to an evening wedding. It fit well and was comfortable. I wore a strapless slip because straps would've showed. I was worried the gold accents would be too disco but it turned out fine. The bracelet was a perfect accessory.
My only caution would be that the overlay is lacy and can catch on jewelry.
Too Tight in Sleeves, A Bit Matronly The sleeves were too tight and it just made me feel a bit matronly. My husband was not a fan of the dress.

Compliments from Strangers all Night! This dress is so amazing. Very comfortable and fit perfectly. I wore this to a wedding and people were commenting on the dress all night. I had three separate girls (that I did not know) tell me they saw me in the lobby prior to the wedding and had to come over and ask me where I got the dress. I even had a hotel maid stop me in the hallway and tell me my dress was beautiful. Only downside was having to ship the dress away the next day!
The complements I received about how I looked. The fit was perfect..it even sucked in the tummy!
Super comfy, sleeves are very slim and I have thin arms Size up! I wore two sizes larger than I normally am because the sleeves were so tight.

Lovely dress This was my second choice and I did not end up wearing it. The dress has a side zip under the arm to enhance the snug fit. This dress hugged my curves and looked fabulous. It just wasn't my favorite in comparison to the other dress I rented.

I felt like this dress was perfect for the occasion, form fitting yet classy. I thought the sleeves were going to bother me because they were tight on my arms, but they didn't, and the tight fit looked great.  The length was relatively long, but I liked that because it gave it a more mature look, perfect for a wedding.  I recommend spicing it up with some interesting high heels.
It was okay.  It wasn't what I excepted for the dress.  It had sparkles in it that I really didn't want and it was worn down.  I am sure it would have looked better on someone smaller.
Classy and unique! A bit longer than it looks on the model, but still a very pretty dress! Minimal stretch to the fabric, so not for those who are trying to hide any "body issues!" I loved it!
I received many compliments  about the dress. The dress fits tightly, I am a bit hippy.  The slip that is part of the dress kept slipping upward.

Wow! Stunning, elegant, and beautiful. This dress was amazing. This was my 1st RTR experience now I'm addicted. I had so many compliments throughout the night and was told I was the best dressed from the girl who I thought was best dressed. Everyone was asking where I got the dress from and I felt amazing all night. The length was great for a wedding and the dress is so much prettier in person the details are amzing! Loved it.
Classy lace for the fall Loved the lace dress but the arms were a bit tighter than expected. They stretched a bit but, being from Florida, I'm not used to long sleeved dresses! Would wear it again
Was comfortable the whole night, really liked this dress. Arms fit fairly tight, but otherwise was very flattering.

Would be better as a petite length but good for a Fall wedding Wore this as a guest of a wedding and received tons of compliments and a good way to tell everyone about RTR. There's not much, but a bit of stretch in the lining of the body of this dress. Not really any give in the sleeves. Still very comfortable - nothing rubbed the wrong way or irritated me. I'm petite and have a narrow waist with a full bust and wider hips. I'd reccomend a strapless bra with this as the neckline was almost off the shoulder for me. The length worked fine but if it were a petite size, it would likely fit better and be at or above nknee level, whereas, it sat just below my knees.

Comfortable, chic and super-stylish! Great dress for a cocktail party, wedding, or other formal event.  Very comfortable, easy to move and dance in, and very stylish and fashion-forward.  The gold thread running throughout is a gorgeous detail that doesn't show up very well in pictures, unfortunately, but is very evident in person, so make sure you have gold jewelry to go with!  Loved it!

I loved this dress! So simple but made a sexy statement.  
I loved this dress. I felt sexy but classic.

I received so many compliments. I was at an early wedding so I didn't dress it up with any jewelry. But can be dressed up as well. 
 
I am curvy and there isn't any stretch to the dress so getting the right size is important. 

You will love it!

Perfect for Christmas Eve event! I wore this dress for Christmas Eve mass. It was a great dress for Christmas Eve because the arms & length were more conservative. I agree with other reviews that the arms are a bit tight, but once I got the dress on it didn't really bother me at all. A great dress for a wedding or holiday party.
Absolutely gorgeous dress. Many compliments. I'm usually a  0 , however the size 2 fitted more comfortably on the  chest area.  A bit snug at the hips, but overall  a tremendous success!

Classic Elegance After reading other reviews, I was prepared to size up from my usual size 4 to a size 6, with a size 8 as a backup. Since both 4 and 6 were unavailable, I took a risk and ordered a size 8, and was glad I did. I think the 6 would have been fine, but the arms would have been snug, as other reviewers have mentioned. The 6 would have fit better in the bust and shoulder area, because when I lifted my arms, I could see a little bit of extra fabric, and the the neckline extended all the way to the edge of my shoulders. I liked this looser fit, but, it's worth noting that someone my size with a larger bust could fit in the size 8 even better.  The right arm had a little hole in it, but I just turned it toward the inside and it really wasn't noticeable. I also noticed a snag on the back, but with the dark fabric, again, it really wasn't noticeable when pressed down onto the dress. I appreciated the camouflaging effect of the side-ruching fabric and the way the gold thread dressed it up, making it perfect for an evening event. Overall, I was happy with the size I chose, loved this classically elegant dress and had a positive first-experience with renttherunway.com.

This dress looks great!  Sexy but classy and very comfortable to wear.   Fit was perfect, the lace was beautiful and the length just right. Got a lot of compliments on this dress at the Company Christmas Party!

What a beautiful dress! I wore it to a corporate Christmas party - conservative, yet unique! The color was a beautiful royal blue with gold thread woven through. It was a tight fit, but not uncomfortable. Reminded me of a "first lady" dress... I can't wait for my next rental!

Beautiful, comfortable, elegant dress I rented for my mother for a party. I wanted to share the RTR experience with my mother.  

We decided on the David Meister Sass meets Class dress and the rental was a success.  My mother looked truly awesome in the blue lace dress.

Perfect for winter events! I rented both the 2 and the 4, and both were extremely tight-fitting through the arms/shoulders.  I ended up wearing the 4, even though there was a hole in the sleeve.  Otherwise, this is a beautiful dress-- the bit of gold shimmer in the lace is gorgeous.  Very classy!
I loved this dress and so did everyone else! The fit is very true to size. Very comfortable and easy to move around in.

Wanted a classy lace dress for a fall rustic wedding.  Dress was exactly what I was looking for! When the dress came, it looked teeny tiny on the hanger!  But as other girls said, the dress stretched and ended up fitting perfectly.  I wore nude pumps, simple jewelry and my spanx underneath to give it a seamless look. Got many compliments on this gorgeous dress!!!  Thanks RTR!
The service is amazing. This is a very classy and beautiful dress.  Also extremely comfortable.

LOVED IT!!  STUNNING DRESS & IT FIT AMAZING Beautiful lace detail that hugged my body just right!  I do suggest Spanx ~ the dress does not have a very thick/heavy lining therefore it shows any problem areas you may have.  I think this dress is perfect for any evening occasion!

Great fit, good for dancing.  Cons - I wasn't totally expecting the asymmetrical bunching of the fabric to one side, but it wasn't a bad touch! I really liked the fabric on the sleeves and received many complements.

It was ok The dress runs small and the fabric around the shoulders and arms are extremely itchy.  I wore this to a wedding and I was extremely irritated by the end of the evening and couldn't wait to change.  The length was just right...not too long, not too short...that was comfortable.

CLASSY DRESS! I loved the dress! Everyone else did as well! The color is soooo in! I'm usually a size 4, but I still have a little of the baby weight from my pregnancy. I just had a baby a month before the ceremony. lol. The dress is definitely true to size. The size four definitely did fit me, but it was a little too snug for me to wear to a church ceremony...

I wore this dress to a very nice dinner, and it was perfect. Very classy and polished. It is very form fitting and snug, especially in the sleeves. I normally am in between a size 4 and 6, and this size 4 fit perfectly. It's very flattering, and my boyfriend loved it!

Great dress!  This was a great dress. I felt so classy. It was covered up enough for a charity event hosted by my husband's firm, but didn't make me look matronly. Fits well but there's not much forgiveness in the material so I definitely wore Spanx.

Comfortable to wear, beautiful, versatile.  First true to size. I am very small in the bust (34AA) and I was happy that there was no excess fabric. However, the bust will easily and comfortable stretch. Its form fitting but not at all tight. I wore it to an evening wedding in October and it kept me warm throughout the night. I received SO many compliments while wearing this dress, everyone wanted to know where I got it!
It was a great night with lots and lots of compliments Definitely a spanx dress. I went with the larger size because of the length in the arms as well as the hemline.

Gorgeous dress, beautiful color and fit.  And comfortable too! I received so many compliments on this dress, which I wore to a New Year's Eve wedding.  The lace on the arms was a bit itchy, but overall it was comfortable, flattering, and appropriate for the event.  I would definitely rent this dress again.

The perfect dress! I wore this dress to a wedding, and received multiple compliments. This dress is just so ladylike and classic! The fabric has a bit of stretch to it. The sheerness of the sleeves is incredibly flattering. It was a comfortable, beautiful fit. Definitely true to size!

Comfortable, flattering, and definitely not too short! Although I have found that some of the RTR dresses run small, this one was true to size.  I didn't realize there is also a zipper hidden on the side that helps when putting it on.  The dress was super comfortable and stretchy. One thing to be careful of is that the dress is easily snagged since the top layer is lacey. Also, the length was a little bit long for me - hit just below the knee. Would have preferred if it was juse above the knee instead. Overall though - it was great!

lady like length, elegant dress, easy to wear! This event called for "snappy business" which could mean something other than this.  I wore it with simple gold jewelry, earrings and a ring.   Wearing it was a statement but not over the top.  Dress was snug in the bust but not obviously so.  I would definitely rent again, but maybe size up so I could eat dessert!

Worn to school fundraiser/auction and was a big hit. Perfect for colder weather event! This was actually a back up dress as the alternative size for the dress I wanted was not available - great customer service experience - and I was so glad to get this dress as I wound up wearing it instead of my original choice. Fit was good - could have gone up a size and I think would still have been good. Awesome first time rental experience.

Stylish and elegant Pro - it came with 2 dresses. the 8 fit perfectly.
Con - the 8 had huge holes in the lace. The 6 was fine, but I was tugging at the hem all night. 
I still got a ton of compliments!

Perfect dress for an evening wedding for an older woman Nice material with gold threads throughout the dark navy fabric.  The wide neckline may require a strapless bra.  The close fitting dress is stretchy but I had to size up to a 6 from my usual size 4.  Wearing Spanx was helpful. The length and 3/4 sleeves are nice for an older woman.

Makes you feel like a princess! Perfect for tea with the Queen, this dress is the epitome of class. Would be a great fit for a formal wedding (or an event where you are hanging with the guy's parents), or an outside soiree in the winter, you will feel both classic and sexy in this dress. Two thumbs way up!

Wanted to love this dress...
 This dress photographs beautifully however, I feel like it runs really small. It created a muffin top on me and I felt self conscious in it all night. I tried wearing spanx but it actually looked worse. 

The sleeves of the dress are lace and  delicate.. I think the dress also looked a little "worn" because I saw some nags in it.

Hugged my curves without looking matronly!  Loved little bit of sparkle in geometric pattern Inner lining smooths without being heavy, very comfortable could wear regular bra (34ddd), sleeves a little scratchy but not too bad. looked great from every angle  I probably could have worn the 10  because of the stretch of dress.

Worn for my birthday dinner, this dress let me be the "It" girl for the evening. Worn for my birthday dinner in Vegas, the wide neck and length of this dress made me feel like Joan from Mad Men. The zipper was tricky and had to be coaxed up, but the lace was beautiful. Perfect for an evening of indulgence.
Great dress and fits really well! I am 5 months pregnant and this dress had just enough stretch to accommodate my baby bump.  It was a great fit and I received a ton of compliments.

Wore to hubby's company awards dinner! I tried this on for the hubby after I got it, and got the "sexy momma" compliment so I was sold.  It honesty wasn't my first choice, but I'm glad I wore it b/c I got lots of compliments.   It was fitted, but comfy.  I liked how it was a little gathered across the tummy and how it fit across the shoulders.  I wore this with gold strappy shoes and navy nail polish on my finger nails (nude polish on my toes)!

LOVED this dress! The dress was very comfortable and very flattering. It was a great length for me, I'm 5'9". The sleeves were a bit tight (no elastic) but they loosened as the night went on. I would definitely rent this dress again!

This dress is very classy and easy to wear, very comfortable and received tons of compliments! The dress hugs your curves without feeling binding.  The fabric was very flexible and the design was extremely flattering.  I love this dress and I would wear it again!

Perfect dress for an engagement party!! This dress was awesome! I wore it for my brother's engagement party and it was perfect. I got so many compliments on the dress and felt amazing! I ended up wearing my normal size, but it did run on the smaller end, so I recommend ordering your backup size a size up just in case. Highly recommend this dress!!

I loved this dress & got so many complements on it!  It fit perfectly!  I wore it with the necklace shown on the model and gold glitter pumps!  One thing I didn't realize till my sleeve got a little caught on it was that there is a side zipper, I shimmied into it without using the zipper, which would have made it easier to get on.  Overall i loved my first Rent the Runway experience!  Will definitely rent again!
Sexy and classy.  Great fit, super comfortable.  I got a lot of compliments.  Will wear it again.

Watched my Mom knock 'em dead as Mother of the Groom! I didn't actually wear the dress to the wedding. My MOM did!!!

I received only the size 10 which was my backup size. Thank goodness, because the dress runs small in my opinion. It was very pretty and sparkly with a bit of silver or gold thread running through the lace. It hit just below my knee. I loved the neckline, so flattering for my broad shoulders! However, i have recently lost about 25 lbs, and this dress shows every single bump and flaw. Even with spanx, which didn't really fit either, i just felt very self conscious about my loose skin and not perfectly toned body. Not the results I was hoping for.  :-(

My mom tried the dress on, and she looked FABULOUS!! Definitely an unforgettable look for the mother of the groom. She knocked the place dead! (btw, Mom is an inch shorter and 10 lb lighter than i am. Smaller on top, and bigger on bottom.)

i would recommend this dress for the more conservative types. It is classy, but not really fun and vivacious! If you are at all insecure about your body, this isn't the dress for you.

I absolutely loved this dress! The dress hugged my curves without being racy.  I felt sexy and elegant the whole night and got lots of compliments on it!  I ordered an 8 and a 10, but went with the 10 because my arms are a bit muscular and didn't want the sleeves to be too tight.  I was really comfortable in it and didn't have any of that tugging and readjusting nonsense I worry about with other dresses.  A perfect 10.

RTR made choosing a dress for the wedding I went to a breeze. It arrived early & fit perfectly. Runs true to size, but as I am 5'1" it hit me just below the knee. Keep in mind if you have a curvier figure (as I do) this dress really accentuates your curves (which I thought looked great but not everyone likes to show their curves off!) Perfect for an upscale evening wedding, I chose to pair it with pearls & nude pumps.

Very glamorous I rented this for a masquerade-themed holiday party. The dress does run on the short side. Normally 16R would be long enough for me to wear 3+ inch heels, but I was able to actually just wear flats, and even then I think it was a tad short. The back is gorgeous, and the dress has POCKETS! Didn't have to use a clutch!

Perfect dress for my Pageant! I absolutely loved this dress. It fit perfectly in every way, it was so comfortable, and I was getting compliments just walking on my way to dinner. I didn't want to take it off! Totally recommend this dress and the back was gorgeous. You'll feel like a princess :)

This dress is pure elegance! This dress is a stunner. I wore it for a formal photo shoot and received numerous compliments from random people walking past us. I normally wear a 4R but the 2R surprisingly fit better. My bust fit well in this dress despite not being able to wear a bra. The length worked just fine with 4" inch heels (I'm 5'4). I can't recommend this dress enough…it made me feel regal and truly beautiful. The skirt of the dress is really fun also. So elegant!
The ease of renting the dress made the night even more enjoyable.   The dress was stunning!  Fit perfectly and very flattering.  I would suggest some sort of "bra tape"
I LOVED this dress. I have never gotten as many compliments as I did when wearing this.  A petite wasn't available, so the dress was too long. However, I used hem tape which helped.

Dress was perfect! I loved this dress! I usually wear a 0 to a 2 so I ordered both sizes and ended up wearing the 0. The only con to this dress was that it was long. I wore 4 inch heels and still had to hold it up when I walked around. Regardless, I received a ton of compliments all night, felt comfortable and completely appropriate for the black tie gala I was attending. Would totally rent from this designer again.

It was an elegant dress to wear for a great cause benefiting early intervention kiddos.              It was the perfect size, yet a little too long!!  I'm small and 5'5, and it was a bit too long even with 5 inch heals to help.  Other than the length, it was perfectly elegant for the Gala.

It was a great dress. received many compliments..................voted top dress for Prom! top may be a bit big/loose but once pinned looked great.
Very Classic
More prom-y than black tie. Beautiful dress and loved it online, but didn't love it in person. Felt more like a prom dress than one I should wear to a wedding.

Beautiful and stunning! I received several compliments. This dress is just classic and beautiful. I wore it to a gala. I've never done a dress that exposed my back, but it was just the right amount of exposed back. The top was large, there were areas that buckled. I used tape to hold the shape in front.

Fun Dress!
 This was my backup...thank goodness!  The dress has a bit of an Audrey Hepburn feel, and I love that.  Getting it on is tricky, so if you have your hair fixed, be aware that you'll need help getting into this dress.  The zipper was a tad sticky, but once I got the dress on I felt beautiful   If you are worried about size, I would order up for your free next size.  Traditional bra won't work, there is no built-in bra, I wore an adhesive bra and it worked well..  Pockets were and extra fun addition.  Overall, I loved this dress.
I ended up NOT wearing this dress  the bust was HUGE! It fit everywhere else but way to big on top, I am a 36D.
The perfect dress for the event I loved  I loved everything about the dress, the options, the fits and  the process to order it! Thank you! I’ve been advertising freely ever since!!

Everyone LOVED the dress - it was for my engagement party and was a HIT! Like the others say it is VERY long - I am 5'2 and wore huge heals and it was still long, if you have to walk around a lot and are not tall I would not recommend this dress. The material was beautiful and the pictures don't do the dress justice, much better in person. Overall I loved it and wanted to keep it and get it custom hem and fit but it worked great for the night!

Everyone loved this dress! This was my first time renting and I love RTR. Dress came on time the night before and it was a big hit at the event I attended. Beautiful dress. I'm in between a size 2 and 4 so I decided to wear the 4R. It was slightly tight around the waist but loose in the top. The back fits kind of weird so you'll definitely need some body tape. I noticed more of the problems with the fit than others.

Really a show stopper! Love the dress!  It fit great, although a bit difficult to get into.  The zipper on the side can be a bit difficult to zip (even when on the hanger, the zipper itself is just difficult to zip).  This dress is a show stopper for sure though.  It makes such a great statement and I had tons of compliments.

Governor's Inaugural Ball.   I got a 2R and a 4R based on reviews.  I normally wear a 4 or 6 and the 4 fit but it was really snug.  However, the regular length was about an inch to short.  I don't wear heals so my shoes were only an inch to inch and a half high but I needed just a little more.  I ended up not wearing the dress because of the length.  However, Rent the Runway was great to work with!! They credited me the full amount (less shipping) to use at a future date!  I will definitely try again!

Beautiful dress!  Comfortable! LOVE the pockets! This is a beautiful dress!  I felt confident and beautiful wearing it.  It's really comfortable too, and I LOVED the pockets.  The waist has little room for give, so make sure the size is right!  A lot of reviews said this ran long, but I did not find that to be the case.  I wore kitten heels and the dress was just above sweeping the floor.  I didn't want to send it back!

great gown for a formal affair  I loved this dress and had a wonderful time wearing it. The pockets were an incredible bonus, the fit was soooo fun and super comfortable even after several drinks and dinner. The bell of the skirt allowed me to wear a bright red flat as my shoe which offered comfort all night and a pop of color whenever my toe popped out. I was glamorous and so so comfortable which is such a rare combination for me at least. I accessorized with a dangly black and white earring and the pop of color shoe. I chose to wear my hair up to show off the open back. I am a DD bust and did not need to wear a bra with the gown. again. I have never felt so comfy and simultaneously chic at the same time possibly ever. I do think the gown may run small, so size up but I highly recommend.
Gorgeous dress! Had an issue with the zipper, though.

Black tie wedding and tons of compliments! Rent the Runway came through when the hotel sent back my original dress on accident!  This dress fit really well (although a little large in the bust) and I received a ton of compliments.  It was easy to dance in too.

Perfect NYE Black Tie Wedding Dress This dress couldn't have been more perfect for a NYE wedding. It was the second dress I ordered after the first style didn't work (too small). This one was comfortable and I got more compliments than I could count that night. I'm a bit bottom heavy - so the full skirt really looked great. The waistband can be a bit tight (although it wasn't uncomfortable) and the top part was just a tiny bit loose. The length was perfect for 3.5" heels and I'm 5'3''/ 5'4''. All in all though it was great and I would totally rent this again.

I would recommend  this dress to a woman with a full chest, top was large, waist fit perfect  pro- the waist fit great, the pockets are a fun added touch to the dress
cons- the top bowed out a bit, I had to hide with my hair
For Prom - She looked very Elegant... It is an elegant dress.  The straps are beautiful in the back but are a little long for a short waisted girl.  There was a bulge of fabric near the waist.

Elegant Dress Wore this dress for a ultra black tie cirque-noir-themed charity event. It was perfectly elegant and comfortable. I loved the pockets. The only difference between this rental and the others I've had with the same style is that this particular dress has beading at the waist- so it has absolutely zero give. Otherwise, it's amazing. I received lots of compliments.

I received many compliments on this dress, the pockets were a big win!  I attended a black tie event The dress was a little tight in the bust.  I am 5'2 and wore 3 inch heels and the dress was a little long, but I wasn't stepping on it.  I loved the pockets!

I really wish I could keep this dress! I got compliments all night and it was so comfortable.  It fit perfectly everywhere except my bust area. After two kids, the girls just aren't as perky as they used to be. Since its backless, I couldn't wear a bra. I had to go buy one of those completely strapless adhesive bras.

I also tripped on it a couple times.

The pros definitely outweigh the cons!
quality gown loved the gown very classic and the back is beautiful. only con is the bodice of the dress is short making the waist higher than usual.
Absolutely stunning  dress. So many compliments. Fit well. no bra needed. perfect length.

Very classy, comfortable dress I didn't end up wearing this dress because I had rented two dresses and preferred the other one better. However, this was a very pretty and comfortable dress. It was very sophisticated looking, but just preferred my other choice by a small margin. Can't go wrong with this dress. Would be best suited for a very formal event.

I met the president! I found the other reviews to be spot-on. The waist fit true-to-size. The top was a little big under the arms, but not as bad as I thought it would be. The back of the dress was fun, but still classy. The pockets were handy for keeping my cell phone close, so when I was next to President Obama, I was able to hand off my phone for someone to snap a picture :)

An interesting dress So, the bottom part of the dress, with pockets, is nice and shiny/chic. The belt with small added strass is, to me, not the best idea and does not add to anything. Then comes the top: as many have said, it is difficult to make it hold nicely in the back: it keeps moving, looks lose, and there were also openings on the side when I walked (maybe the dress is made for bustier women). To summarize, I like it, and am happy that a 4 fits me, but I could not wear it because the whole interest of the dress is its back and top, and it is the very part that looked faulty on me.

My partner was the main organizer of this event, so it was great to have a dress to match his tux!  It is a stunning dress and I received lots of compliments. Both the 10L and 12L fit nicely, but I opted for the 10L since it was a better fit in the waist (12 was a bit loose). I only wish it were a little bit longer so it could graze the floor - I wore ballet flats and the dress was still an inch or two off the floor. That said, I am 6ft tall, so the L would be just fine for most people. It may be a bit tight in the bust for larger-chested ladies.
Way too big. This dress is way too big for a person with a petite frame––the top didn't fit at all, and the material on the skirt was far too voluminous.

I was able to wear the appropriate attire without the price tag or loss of closet space! Loved this dress! I am 5'9" so I ordered the 10 Long and it just hit the floor with no shoes on, so if you are tall, make sure to order the long.  The fit was perfect, snug around the waste with a little bit of room in the shoulders/breast are so it made the dress super comfortable to wear!

Great dress! Stunning in person and in pictures My mom wore this stunning dress and it fit really well! She looked beautiful and hardly wears dresses, so she was very happy. Under the arms/side of the bodice though it was a little bit big. She is not super young so she did not love the open back. It has a great back though!

Our first formal event together since our wedding in July! I really wish I'd gotten a full-length picture of me wearing this dress. I usually wear an 8 but have found that formal gowns tend to run small, so I ordered the 8R and 10R, and ended up wearing the 10. The 8 was too tight to zip and also short - I would have had to wear flats with it. The other thing I noticed about the 8 was that the white top was a bit dingy, like it had been dry cleaned too many times. The 10 fit perfectly and looked really nice on, and I got tons of compliments. Plus, as many others have mentioned, the pockets are awesome! This was my first time renting a dress, and I will definitely turn to Rent the Runway for our next event.

I wore this dress to prom and one word to describe this dress: Stunning.  Fit: The dress was a little snug around the waist area. 
Con: I ordered an 6R and it was a little long, but with heels on it was just the right length.
Pro: The contrasting colors of black and white was extremely unique and made me stand out during the entire night of my prom. The pockets were a plus, I absolutely adored them. All in all, I absolutely adored this dress and will definitely be using Rent the Runway again for sure.

Perfect for a black and white ball!! Classy and fun at the same time! Fabulous rental! This was the most comfortable formal dress I've ever worn and it has pockets which is the best idea EVER!! It probably would have fit slightly better if I had a bigger bust but I wore one of those sticky bras so that I could fill it out a little better. If you have bigger hips and a smaller chest, this could be an issue for you, too. I would also recommend doing hair and makeup before you put this dress on. Due to the small head opening, it would be very difficult  to put this dress on without getting makeup on the white collar or totally messing up your up-do!!  Overall it was a fabulous dress for my black tie fundraising event!

Top was too big for a small chested individual top is not really white but more silvery I wear a size 6 , I ordered  a 4 and a 6.. The 4 was too tight in the waist, the 6 too big in the chest. The top was not really white but more silver

This is a beautiful dress just didn't fit right.  Very pretty dress but it didn't fit right.  The back was gaping at the bottom and was too big in the front too.  Too much extra room.  This dress was a back up for the previous one I ordered that didn't fit and I was disappointed that it just didn't look right.  I ended up having to go out and buy a dress the day of the event.

I loved this dress!! Thick material, went braless This dress was amazing. It had pockets which I love, and the open back is to die for. Because of the open back (and my under-preparedness) I went braless and the material was thick enough, it was also not loose so I didn't feel like I was sagging on top. The waist is definitely the limiting factor on this dress, I wish the top had been a little tighter compared to the waist, but it fit perfectly. I am 5'9" and I ordered the regular length since I was wearing flats and you could barely see my shoes, but I didn't feel like I was tripping on it while dancing all night. The zipper was a little tough, but I had my friend do it for me no problem.

The open back and pockets were wonderful on this dress. I ended up wearing the 6R, which would have fit fine except that it had clearly been hemmed by a previous renter.  The size 4R which I also had to try was much longer and hemmed much cleaner.  That was my only disappointment in the dress.  Otherwise, it would have fit well.

Everybody was in awe over my dress! I'm so glad I rented it! I am absolutely in love with this dress. I wore it for my senior prom and I could not have been happier with it. I received so many compliments on it! It definitely runs a bit large in the bust area, which was perfect for me. I felt like a princess and I am eager to rent it again in the future!

Beautiful dress but awkward fit I fell awkwardly between the size 6 and 4 in this dress.... 4 was right in the bust but too tight at the waist, 6 fit well in the waist but was too big in the bust. Waist was also a little too high on me... but I am tall (5'10"). So it wasn't the most flattering fit. I had to tape down the dress near the armpits (but there was still bulging in this area).  That being said, the dress itself is very glamorous. It may just be better suited for someone with an hourglass figure.

Received lots of compliment with this dress.  I wore this dress to a formal ball held at my law school. everybody really liked the dress. I thought the cut was extremely flattering; it was still very classic with a hint of modern flare to it. I thought it paired well with a bright red lipstick. Overall, I would recommend this dress to anyone who wanted to go for a classic look with a little twist.

Runs small! I decided to get the 8R rather than the 8L because I did not want to wear heels. This dress ran short (I am 5'10) and did not touch the ground. Also, the bust area was very tight and I was not able to wear a bra because of that.

This dress was so comfortable! It received so many compliments, and the pockets were clutch! Fit around the waist/hips/shoulders was perfect. I'm 5'6", and had to wear 5 or 6" heels to get it off the ground (just a heads up).

So many compliments! Loved the back! This dress was a pleasure to wear. I normally wear a 4r but the 2r was a better fit. I might have even been able to go to a 0 because the top was a still roomy. However being small breasted didn't help. Also this dress is Long!! I'm 5'4 and had to wear my "stripper heels" for me not to stumble on the dress. The zipper is a little hard to get up.  Overall I got lots of compliments on the dress; it was comfortable and very appropriate for the masquerade ball.

So CHIC! I absolutely loved this dress! It was the perfect fit for a formal wedding. So many compliments...
I'm usually a size 4, but in this case, it was a little large at the top, so I opted for the size 2. RTR never disappoints! :)

Can I keep it? First off, let me say how impressed I am with RTR and how they quickly got me a replacement dress out when a FedEx train derailed and my dress wasn't going to arrive until after I'd flown out for a wedding. Superior customer service. 
On to the dress. I adore this dress. If only I could keep this dress. It was a beautiful gown and I got compliments on how elegant it was all day and all night. I wore it for our engagement pictures and then on to a wedding. It really was stunning. The only issue I had with it was the zipper - maybe the particular dress I got was just worn one too many times? I wound up having to go up a size to the 16R instead of the 14L because the zipper was such a mess. It was a little loose and a little short compared to the 14L but a good trade off considering that zipper was just not going to cooperate. It also might help having a 2nd set of hands getting in to it... I found up needing help getting my head to go through the right holes because of the strappy back and oddly placed zipper. Despite the few cons, this dress was awesome.

Spectacular dress, too large on top for petites/short torsos This dress is really beautiful - well structured (plus pockets!) and chic.  The problem is that the bodice has too much fabric up top (and I am pretty curvy for my size - so this is unusual - I suspect it's more because I'm short/short-torso'd).  The fabric is too thick to consider any sort of pinning - so sadly I couldn't wear it.  Sad though - because it's a really great dress otherwise.

Great, classic dress.  Fit was wonderful - wore 3.5"-4" heels, but could've worn flats. Very comfortable dress and it was nice to have the pockets for ID/cash/phone. You need to wear petals, given the beautiful back.

LOVED this dress! It looked so elegant!  The dress fit great, the middle part of the zipper got a little tight but once I got it all the way zipped up it looked perfect. I was thrilled with this dress and received so many compliments all night. I would DEFINITELY  rent this dress again!

I received so many compliments on how pretty the dress was, it really made me feel special. The event was in Vegas in the summer so I knew I might get warm, but this thing was like a heat tent. Also the top part was not very well fitted.
Classic and elegant! This was an incredibly comfortable and classic dress to wear for a black tie wedding. I received complements all night long!

Belle of the Ball! I love this dress! I got the 10L and 12R and ended up wearing the 10L. It was a little tight zipping up but held my boobs up. The 12R, despite wearing a 36D, was WAY too big in the top and you definitely can't wear a bra and look good. The back of the dress is absolutely stunning and I highly recommend an updo. My hair was similar to the model in the front but upside-down French braided up the back. I would recommend this dress for sure!
Got a lot of nice compliments on the dress Length was good, top was a little big but worked

Great gown! I wore this to a black-tie benefit gala and it was perfect! I got many compliments and it was a perfect dress for the occasion. I rented both the OR and 2P. The 0R was way too long for me (I'm 5'2) so I went with the 2P which was a perfect length with 3 inch heels. When I tried on both though, I was surprised to find that there wasn't much of a difference between the 0 and 2 in the top/chest area. The beaded part is where I felt a difference - it was more fitting in the 0 but the 2 fit perfectly fine here. I needed to use some fashion tape to secure the top (neckline, shoulder, and near my underarms. I also had to wear my VS backless bra plus extra padding to help the dress fit in the chest.  I would have needed the bra and tape whether I wore the 0 or 2. The back fit great. Hope this helps someone that is more petite - it was some work to get it to fit perfectly but it was worth the effort. I loved wearing the dress to the gala.

Not My Favorite This is probably my first RTR experience where I wasn't thrilled with the dress.  I had asked for recommendations from a stylist and described my body type, and really don't think that this was the best idea for me.  I am quite thin, but have a larger stomach right now after giving birth to twins.  I'm also very small chested.  The good news was that you couldn't see my stomach at all in the dress.  The bad news was that it was so tight around the waist.  It was so difficult to zip - partly because it was so tight but also partly because the zipper wasn't in great shape.  Now, the top on the other hand was very large.  I had a 2 as a backup and it fit better in the waist, but it was huge in the top.  So I was uncomfortable with a too small waist in the 0 but still with a too large top.  Also, the white part was slightly dingy.  There was another girl at the event in the same dress and there was a noticeable difference in the whites.  The size 2 also had make up marks on the top of the dress (not noticeable when wearing the dress though).  

The dress was just a touch long - I'm 5'5" and wore 3 inch heels.  Just slightly too long, it wasn't much of an issue.

All in all, the dress is pretty and I don't think that it looked bad on me, but it just wasn't the right dress for my body type.  And the zipper really was a pain.

Beautiful dress The dress was very beautiful! Runs small I wear a 16 and this 16 was a tight fit, had to buy spanx. I didn't get to wear the dress to my event because it was a canceled, just got to try it on. Wish I could have actually worn it. More beautiful in person. Tight around the middle where it's cinched in and tight on the hips, bust and straps are loose.

Great experience and gorgeous dress!! Glad I went with the long. I am 5'5" and wore 3 inch heels and it was perfect. I used fashion tape in the front and wore a normal bra and it was great. I did not feel like the sequins under the arms were bothersome at all. Dress was gorgeous and very thick which was great for a fall wedding! My first experience with RTR and it was perfect!!

I loved this dress.  looked amazing and was very slimming.

 great dress

Va va voom!  This dress has a little stretch as well as draping in front of the waist so it was forgiving for a postpartum pooch. It isn't clingy either and there is texture so it covers any imperfections, though it he sequins make it thick so it is a little bulky. I was able to wear a normal bra with it as well. This dress was very glamorous and I loved it for the black tie event I attended! You definitely need help with the zipper and it took a little patience but we finally got it closed (the hidden zipper and sequins make it tough to close!)
LOVE THIS DRESS!!! I loved this dress. It was comfrotable, fit well, easy to move in, and looked great. I got tons of compliments. I would definitely order this dress again, and in other colors.

Dazzling Dress in a Classic Style! The chest was a little big, so I had to pin it. The length was perfect in 2 1/2 inch heels (I'm 5'6) and otherwise it fit like a glove! Very flattering fit, hugs the curves and made me feel like old hollywood glam! I managed to get a few compliments, even with my boyfriend's attention-stealing kilt :). It was very comfortable; I definitely recommend it for a black tie affair!

Amazing customer service!!! Gorgeous dress and compliments all night long... Plus comfortable!!! I ordered the dress in gold but in the long length.  WAY to long even with my 4" heels.  I'm 5'7.5" and nothing short of stilts would have worked... So I had a problem. I knew the size and dress were perfect so I called customer service. Gold wasn't available but black was-- and they not only helped me, but threw in some earrings complimentary. Cannot say enough-- such great customer service!!!

Perfect dress! Gah, I LOVED this dress. I wore it for my 30th Birthday Masquerade party. It was definitely a hit. It really compliments your curves and is very forgiving in the stomach area. I did have to put a safety pin in the top so my boobs were held in a little better, but you can't even tell. Definitely recommend this dress!

Comfortable all night - highlights your best parts! The perfect dress. Period. Not too low, comfortable cleavage for all sizes. Cinches at natural waist to flatter everyone, draping on the side accentuates or creates an hourglass figure for anyone. Definitely get a long if you're taller than 5'6 and want to wear heels over 2" - would rent this dress over and over!!

I wore this dress for my senior prom. It made me feel like a movie star! The fit was lovely. I would recommend using fashion tape on the bust line though. The straps easily concealed my bra straps -- a must for a busty lady! The dress was truly stunning. I didn't find the sequins itchy at all. It was bold enough that I didn't need much jewelry -- an updated classic. I got so many compliments! I recommend wearing your hair up with this dress so it doesn't get caught in the sequins. Also, don't worry if the zipper is a little tough. I had to wiggle mine a little, but it went up easily after that!

I emceed a pole dance competition and was told I sparkled the whole time I was on stage.  :) I loved that I could wear a regular bra with this dress because I have big breasts.  Therefore, I do not like being bra-less.  Also, I am only 5'3'', so I chose a long dress as opposed to regular due to the fact I wear 5-6" heels.  The length was perfect and the size was perfect.  I got many many compliments.  Very happy with everything!

Perfect for  A Formal Affair! This dress is such as easy fit! The empire waist and deep v-neck make it extremely flattering. I also loved the sequin detail, definitely made the dress really special. This dress runs pretty true to size, I would recommend sizing down in backup especially if you are smaller. Overall, you can not go wrong with this gown!
Beautiful, but too big! Dress was too big, went for the smaller size.

pretty but not for small chested girls  really pretty dress but more for hourglass shape, will definitely work for a more fullchested pear girl but not short smaller busted women. And if your 5'2 or shorter go with the petite

Great customer service and help selecting dresses for my little baby bump. Runs true to size but I chose my second dress option because this dress was too heavy, made my chest look too small and my hips too large...

Even the long was too short Pros: 
This dress makes you feel very glamorous. The heft of the sequence is substantial and you feel very sexy in it. No one had anything as elaborate at the Ball I was at. 

Cons: 
1) It is too short if you are tall. I am 5'10" and even the 10L was too short once I put 2" heels on. The 8L looked so much better on me, but the zipper would not go past the waist seem. Had to wear the 10L which was not as flattering, nor was it long enough once in shoes but I wore it anyway and felt very sexy. 
2) The top is large: As most others said, the top is large which was ok for me since I am a 34F. But most women are not that size. 
3) The sequence itched / bothered my arms but this wasn't a huge deal. 

Otherwise, it was a lovely dress, my boyfriend liked it and I received many compliments.
Loved the classic old Hollywood feel to it. Super comfortable and easy to wear! Fit true to size for me. Really glam and luxurious looking.

Anothe great dress with RTR! Loved this gown, I held my own in a  ball room FULL of glitzy gowns! I typically would wear an 8L so I got the 8 and the 6. As other reviews had mentioned it did run large and the 6L was perfect. Some had mentioned the long was too long... I am 5'9 and only wore 3 inch heels and it was perfect. As others mentioned the zipper on both dresses was a bit challanging but I think its because its made so well with the ruching and the nice lining.. 
I also found this dress fit nicer without a bra or body spanx.. I just wore spanx hosery.
LOVE RTR wll be ordering again soon for a March wedding!
Perfect for postpartum!  Several women came up to tell me how beautiful the dress was.   Very comfortable!

This dress fit over my 20-week pregnant bump. I normally wear a 4 or 6 (5'4", 125, 32E). I wore this dress while 20 weeks pregnant. My weight was 141 and my bust is up to a 36G. The zipper is super tricky, especially at the spot where there's a waist band. Assume that you will need help to hike that up, even if the fit is roomy. This dress needed an extra safety pin at the bust for modesty (it is LOW) and was the perfect length in the long. I did wear really high 4-in heels and the dress swept the floor beautifully. It was comfortable for dancing. I didn't notice any issues under the arms--no issues with the sequins (other people reported that). The one thing I wish it had was some bra strap keeps; the shoulders slipped off a couple of times. Overall, absolutely great dress. And I'd call the customer service group for help with sizing. I did also get a 6R, 8R and 14L. The 8R would absolutely not zip!!

I loved this dress! I wore it to a formal ball and received so many compliments! I felt so beautiful and slim while wearing this gown! It masked all the parts of me that I do not like (hips, thighs, and so on), na demphasized my smaller waist.

RTR makes it so easy to look great and not always wear the same dress! I was a little nervousness about ordering the long version because my height is right at the recommended cut off and I don't usually wear really high heels.  The long was perfect!!!
I felt comfortable and pretty! Perfect dress to  hide tummy imperfections!

Perfect for black tie! Great dress. I am 5'5" and it was a perfect length to show off my shoes.  I would rent this gown again, however, I had to pin the V because I didn't want to show that much boobage - but there is totally enough room for even the larger chested girls like me!

Prefect, comfortable black tie dress Fit well, didn't need to wear a bra which is great and unusual for a 34 D+. Was a little worried it was going to be "too much" as it's all sequins but was really lovely and fit the bill for the night.
Amazing dress! Runs a bit big and definitely low cut, but is exceptionally comfortable!

The look on my husband's face as we were leaving to meet everyone for cocktails :)
 This fit well except for the "V" in the chest. I had to pin it. I'm 5' 6" and got the long because I was wearing 3 inch heels, should have worn the regular but it was manageable. This dress is good for an older woman because it hides the flaws around the middle. This is my 3rd time using this service and I have been happy every time.

Perfect dress for a black tie NYC wedding! AWESOME dress! Really comfortable, and looks beautiful on. 
Pros - gorgeous fabric, length was perfect (I wore 3" heels), you can wear a normal bra, very figure flattering.
Cons - very low cut, and if you don't have a large chest it's hard to fill out the top. I usually wear a 4, but the 2 fit me better and looked a little more conservative. Zipper is REALLY sticky (on both dresses I tried on), definitely need someone to help zip you up.
Definitely go a size down if you are in between sizes.

Elegant and comfortable Wore this one to an inaugural ball.  I usually wear a 10 or 12 depending upon cut and brand, and the size 10 fit easily, so I'd say the sizing on the dress is on the generous side.  Great to be able to wear a bra with straps -- found one that was low-cut enough in front for the deep V-neckline.  RTR, thanks for including the fashion tape, which kept the dress rated PG-13.  No need for Spanx or any uncomfortable undergarments.  The 10L was just barely long enough for me.  In bare feet the hem just slightly grazed the floor, so I wore a low heel (whch was fine with me.)  I was surprised by how not-pokey the sequins were, and grateful that I didn't walk around shedding them all night.  Good engineering by Badgley Mischka, I guess.

Wore this for a Mardi Gras ball and it was super comfortable and easy to wear! I ordered the 10 and the 12 and was delighted when the 10 fit perfectly.
