It was a little low cut for my personal taste, but that was an easy fix with a safety pin. The drape of the dress is so perfect that spanx weren't even really necessary. I'm 5'6" and it was short enough that it didn't drag the ground when I had flip flops on (key MG ball tactic), but it didn't look ridiculous with the 3 inch heels I had on earlier in the evening either. It's a really beautiful dress!

Dress was beautiful! I'm usually not a sequins girls so this was a big risk for me, but I loved it!  This dress fit well and was very comfortable! I ordered to regular length and it was just long enough to wear two inch heels maybe even too short for the shoes I wore. So if you plan on wear heels order the long. The top was not as revealing as I was expecting which I was happy about. I also opted not to wear a bra and you couldn't even tell! Great dress!
i've never gotten so many compliments!  great dress. very comfortable, but still formal. i was able to wear a regular bra with this dress as well.

This was perfect for a winter black tie wedding!  This was a great dress - glamorous but subtle (surprisingly for a sequins dress). I am very small chested so this worked great and I could wear a normal demi bra. By the end of the night the sequins definitely rubbed my armpits raw a little but not painful. I am 5'6 and wore 4 inch heels so the long was good, almost too long. I could have worn a regular and shorter heels.

This dress was so comfortable. It was my back up and I loved it! So many compliments. I was the gala chair so I needed something that I could run around it and still look great. This dress was perfect.

felt great in my postpartum body amidst a sea of size 2 WASPs The dress: It came on time and in perfect condition. I would have ordered the 14R as a back up, but it was already reserved so I got the 10R. both 10 & 12 fit but the 12R was long enough to accommodate my 3" heels. the 10 would have worked for flats. I did not need fashion tape. no sequin arm itch. I received loads of compliments. The way the dress was cut worked well with my postpartum belly, as I didn't want something so flowy as I would look STILL pregnant! my strategy was to divert attention from the bump with an abundance of sequins and cleavage...and it worked.
My RTR experience: was fabulous. the reviews were so helpful. My only wish is that I had used their service sooner!!!

I absolutely loved this dress! The cut was flawless and the sparkle was to die for!  I really wear a 14, but RTR did not have that size in stock when I went to order it for prom. Therefore, I went with a 12R and a 16L (this is a very popular dress!) I thought the 12 would fit just fine, but since I am a 36 D bust and my rib cage is abnormally large, I ended up wearing the 16L which actually fit pretty perfectly! All I had to do was pin the straps of the dress to my bra straps so they wouldn't fall down. My problem with the 12 was that it wouldn't zip over my rib cage. The middle section was tight and had no give. This dress looks long in the photo, but I actually had no shoes on! Stairs and heels don't mix well with me (ha) :) I'm only 5'2 and when I put on my 6 inch heals (yes ladies I did it) the dress was right at the floor. Take that into account when ordering! Other than that the dress was absolutely perfect! I got SOO many compliments on it the whole night! While a little warm, it was great for dancing and the sparkle looked great on the dance floor. It was so comfy all night!! 10/10 would recommend renting this dress!

GLAM. This dress had a beautiful fit! It also fit the theme of Great Gatsby for my prom. It fit my body perfectly except it was bit big for someone with a small chest like mine. I didn't end up wearing it though because I opted for the Vera Wang Measure Time Gown since it was a bit fancier and it fit like a glove. But despite that, I'd definitely recommend this dress to someone of my size!
I received many compliments throughout the night! The dress fit perfectly, maybe a bit on the short side. Could wear with normal bra and was very comfortable!

Compliments Galore! 
 30 weeks pregnant, the 12 L was a good a fit as I could expect.  The waist band that hit high on the natural waist was a little tight for my bursting belly though.  Also there is a small gab in the top in between the breast triangles of fabric.  Nothing a little double sided tape or safety pins couldn't fix. Otherwise the dress itself is gorgeous.  I like that it was all sequins and you didn't have to worry about it getting wrinkly in travel or throughout the night.

Amazing dress, loved it so much didn't want to let it go next day :) Fitted me perfectly without any flaws, very comfortable to move around and of course catches all the attention! 
Plus absolutely loved RTR customer service, thank you guys! I think I'm addicted to your website now, will definitely rent again for next occasion!

Loved this dress!!! I read the other reviews before ordering and got both the 12R and 14R.  The 14R fit better in the chest.  It was the perfect length to wear with flats.  I was at a Mardi Gras ball so flats were comfortable and ideal.  I got a ton of compliments on it.  I'll be renting next year!

Beautiful, sexy, flattering gown, perfect for a black tie wedding! Wore this dress to an evening black tie optional wedding and loved it! I wore the 10P but that wasn't an option when creating this review. Warning... I am 5'1.5'' and the petite length fit me perfectly. I was only able to wear a low heel opposed to the higher pair I had intended on wearing so if you are any taller than me (which I assume most of you are!) order the regular or long lengths.
The style of the dress is curve hugging and flattering, emphasizing the boobs and butt and hiding the stomach (my problem area!). Creates a nice hour glass shape. It is very low cut, so if you are uncomfortable showing cleavage, this would not be the dress for you. Overall, I received a lot of compliments on the gown and would def rent again if it wasn't so memorable.. wish they had this cut in several style gowns!
I looked gorgeous and felt like a diva. The dress fit great. The only drawback for me is that it wasn't long enough. I ordered a 6L and it didn't cover my heels.

Vintage Hollywood Glam I rented this for an annual gala event that has a theme. This year was a vintage-themed party around KC's heyday of the Jazz era. I am NOT a basic black dress person but rented it because I thought it looked like it would evoke a vintage glam look while flattering my figure (which a flapper cut would not). My size has been changing frequently; I have a 14-month old and am nursing, so I wasn't sure what to order. I wear a 12P jeans but recently bought a 10P dress from Ann Taylor, and tried on 8 regular formal dresses that fit but didn't flatter. The 10P was too big but the 8P was perfect. I wanted to be comfortable and dance so the 8P hit just shy of my shoe toes. If I wanted it to fit "right" I would have been fine in the regular. But I wanted it slightly short so I wouldn't step on it.

Movie Star I absolutely loved this dress! I was nervous that it might look cheap because of how sparkly it was, but that was quite the opposite. I received so many compliments, and everyone kept saying my date and I looked like we came straight out of an Old Hollywood movie. Rent this dress! you won't regret it.

This dress was perfect! I loved wearing it! I had never rented from RTR before - so, i wasn't sure about the fit of the dresses. The 4L was a perfect fit and the length was great with my heels! I received many compliments! It was very fun to wear!

Event was an Arabian Night theme and this dress was elegantly perfect without causing a stir! the dress fit well through the waist and bodice area. I would recommend to others that this dress fits better on slightly larger busts. I am a D and I could see where with smaller bust it may gap.  It also flows nicely past the hips and thigh area, not too tight or form fitting and also allows for you to actually eat during the affair, which was nice.

Beautiful dress.  Loved it.  It made me feel sexy but it wasn't revealing.  Perfect. My daughter and I both rented from Rent The Runway for the first time and we were both very satisfied.  The dresses were both exactly what we were hoping that they would be, and at an event (Mardi Gras Extravaganza) with over 15,000 people I didn't see anyone else with a dresses like ours. The fit was great and comfortable, and love that this dress is appropriate for practically every age group.
Dress was beautiful. My bust size made it gap a little under the arms and it about 1/2 inch too long for me (5ft 4in) with 3-4 inch heels on.
This dress was a perfect choice!   I received numerous compliments on this dress and felt very glamorous. The dress fit well and I didn't have any issues.

This dress was perfect for the black tie event I attended. I felt pretty & it was comfortable. I also requested the 6R & 8R but the petite was a way better fit for me. The black looked better than the champaign color due to the pinkness of the champaign color and my olive skin tone not looking good. I found the whole experience well worth the money. The ease of ordering & returning was also great. Jut be sure to not wait too long or else risk your size not being available. Also try to shift your arrival date by one day as this might make something available that previously wasn't.
I looked fab It was very loose on me, but worked well since I was moving a lot and dancing.

This dress was truly stunning! This dress was extremely comfortable and fits true to size. I will say that if you rent this dress and have a smaller chest, just be sure to have a safety pin close by! It does fall open on the top just a little bit, but nothing a safety pin cannot fix. I loved the dress and got many, many compliments!

Walking into the party and having the most glamorous dress there! It ran true to size, although based on the recommendations I got the long size.  It was really too long, even with 3" heals ( I am 5'8").  I could have gotten away with the normal length. 
  It was very comfortable, except for a little scratchiness under the arms while dancing, but moved very well.  I felt so amazing and got tons of compliments!

Absolutely perfect! Fit amazing and felt amazing in this dress. No one had anything like it! The fit was great- the length was perfect for me, 5'2 and wore a regular length with 4" heels. Can't say anything bad about this!

FAB-GLAM-ELTON JOHN OSCAR PARTY PERFECT! I ordered a 16L and 14L -- the 16L's zipper came broken so I ended up wearing the 14L which hugged my curves and fit better anyways! No boobs were shown, great success!

Classy and Glamorous  Rented this gown last minute for a museum gala and was satisfied with my choice. With 3 1/2 inch heels, the length was perfect. I have a small frame and loved that the dress gave the illusion of a curvier figure. My only quarrel with the gown was the low cut of the neck, which would not have been an issue had I had the time to put in a small stitch. Safety pin to the rescue!

This was my first rental, and I will definitely be using RTR again.
I loved this dress! I got compliments all night! The dress is forgiving and not too tight around the stomach. I have a large bust (34DD) and the 6R fit perfectly!

A fun, glamorous dress, perfect for a fancy event! I received so many compliments on this dress and was sad when I had to take it off.  After reading the reviews, I knew this type of fit would work well with my figure (hourglass).  The reviews said the dress ran a little big but might be tight for larger rib cages, so I ordered my size and a size bigger, just in case.  I actually ended up going with the larger size for the event because it was pretty tight in the rib cage and I didn't want to be uncomfortable.  It was quite large on top (even for bustier girls) and the neckline plunges pretty far down, so I ended up having to pin it in place, along with the straps, which I was able to pin to my bra straps (you can wear a normal bra!).  The middle of the dress is very forgiving which was nice after eating all of that food!  I am 5' 5" and ended up ordering the longer version, which was perfect for a 2.5" - 3" heel.  The dress hit just above the ground when I had shoes on.  I had no issue with the sequins being itchy.  The dress feels heavy on the hanger but was not heavy on.  This dress will not disappoint and you'll have so much fun wearing it.  The only bad thing was that two other people had this dress (one in black, one in gold) at the same event, but it can happen anywhere and didn't impact the night.
This dress sparkles! Beautiful gown.  Fit is true to size.  Very flattering dress.
Great party dress!  Absolutely loved this dress! Perfect dress for my birthday celebration - received so many compliments!

EH? I think I ordered this dress in a size that was too large? The directions said to size up so I did. I'm not sure what happened but I was not impressed. The quality was not as nice as it appeared in the picture (lace not as cute, sparkles not as sparkly) Really glad I had a back up!
A women came up to me and said that I looked like I came out of a magazine in this dress. It's slightly short but it worked out well for me.

Adorable, way too short for husband's work party If  I would have found this dress ten years ago, I would have worn it 1,000 times. It was just a bit too short for my husband's military function. It's super, super thick which was also an issue because it was summertime in Florida. You cannot wear a bra and the back is gorgeously open. It's a super flattering shade of gold, beige-y, silver. I wish I could have worn it!

LOVED this dress!  The little stretch it has makes it so comfortable.   I wore it to a Roaring 20s charity benefit and it was perfect - the cut, the glimmer and I wore it with slate blue patent heels to pick up on the sparkle.

Helped me shine at my bridal shower! This dress was perfect for my Tiffany's themed bridal shower! There was just enough sparkle and sexy without being too over the top. Everyone RAVED about the dress!!!! It made me feel like a superstar all day. Ordering was easy and the dress arrived on time!  The dress runs large, I ordered a size 0 and 2 and went with the 0. The only draw back I had was that since this is a popular dress, it is starting to show some wear.. the lace (especially on the sleeves) is starting to fray and you can see the fabric below it. Thanks RTR!

Glam, understated sparkles This is a very pretty dress. The back is sexy but classy.  The dress has three layers, the top layer is a thicker material.  Because of the multiple layers I recommend sizing up as the tighter the dress the more wrinkles/fabric pulling.  While I liked the way the 0 fit, while standing completely still, I chose the size 2 as it hung better and I didn't have to tug it down all night.
I was a bridesmaid in my brother in laws wedding.  It was shorter than I expected. I got so many compliments on the dress. Everyone loved it including the bride!

Very Sexy Dress that photographs beautifully!  Overall the dress was amazing. I got so many compliments the whole night. I had rented it for my bachelorette  party and it was perfect. At first i felt that the length was a bit short for me but was told it was appropriate for the occasion! Had a wonderful experience will absolutely rent from RTR again!
This dress made me feel great! this dress is shorter than I expected, but overall it was a great fit and I got a ton of compliments on the dress!

Beautiful dress.  would have looked awesome if size 0 was available Was unable to wear it since size 0 , that originally requested was damaged by previous RTR user (not cool !!).  Size 2 was too big on my 15 year old daughter.  Such a shame, she would have looked breathtaking in the size 0.  Definitively winner.

Absolutely loved this dress! So many compliments The dress fit pretty well. The length was great however the waist ended up being kind of boxy on me but with a thin belt it fit perfectly. the back of the dress makes it fun and sassy but is still conservative enough for a wedding. It photographs much lighter than it actually is. When I first opened up the Rent the Runway box i was discouraged due to the color but it ended up working out great. It's more of a taupe than it is a cream! Just as a warning for those of you who are more fair skinned. Overall, I would wear the dress again i liked it so much!

Perfect Dress for Vegas! The dress was super comfortable and very pretty in person. (However, I found that in photographs if I wasn't standing at the right angle it made me look larger than in person). Make sure to have "sticky boobs" as you can't wear a bra that shows in the back. Overall, felt very glamorous in this dress. Would be perfect for New Years Eve or a Bachelorette party. 

It was hard for me to decide which size to wear because the dress is stretchy, so if I wore the 2 it would have been tight but the 4 was a little loose in the back. I decided on the 4 after all because it was easier to sit down in the less tight one.

Beautiful dress, not right for me I had a hard time figuring out what to rate this dress because the dress itself is GORGEOUS, it just doesn't work with my body type. This is great for someone on the slimmer side but my personal style really relies on emphasizing my waist (which I felt this didn't do, I thought the waist portion would cinch in more) and my legs (this DID do that though!). I also have shoulders on the broader side so the shape of the dress really emphasized that. Finally, not being able to wear a bra with it made me look like a chunky square mess.

That being said, this dress is beautiful, high quality, and came to me in great condition. It is just as gorgeous as it looks in the pictures with a beautiful, shimmery lace overlay. I had been worried it would be too short (I'm quite tall) and I actually felt like it was long enough to be appropriate so other tall ladies could give this a shot (good party length, not so much for anything that involves being in a church...)! I had been planning to wear this dress with the Ben-Amun Cascading Pearl Necklace because it would have looked AMAZING to have the pearls cascading down my bare back. Alas, twas not to be but maybe one of you lovely ladies could give it a shot and I'll live vicariously through your pics :)

As always, the RTR service is amazing and I'm currently in the process of getting another dress sent my way. Honestly, no complaints.

Wore my Back-up Dress Instead Loved the material and structure, but I have a slightly athletic build and small chest, so the 0 fit my chest great but was too small around my thighs (and too short), and the 2 was too big for my chest.  If only...
It is a beautiful Dress This was a nice dress but the shoulders were really big on me! Which is weird because I have wide shoulders. Would recommend ordering a smaller size.

Another amazing rental from RTR! I was so excited to wear this dress even though I wasn't completely sure about the fit since I wasn't familiar with the brand. Thank goodness it fit me like a glove! It was literally the perfect fit for me! I have slightly larger hips so was nervous that it would be a little tight in that area. The material is stretchy so it moves with your body. I felt so amazing in the dress and received a ton of compliments! However, I read reviews and most people mentioned using fashion tape...I had the tape and I am sorry that I didn't use it. I could see in photos from the wedding that the back gapped a bit but nothing too major. Also, the hanger straps inside the dress kept coming through the sleeves which showed in pics :( But all-in-all, I am so incredibly happy that I wore this dress and would recommend it to anyone! I may even order it again in the future!

LOVED THE DRESS!!! I wore this dress to my sorority formal and everyone loved it. I got so many compliments; it was classy with a subtle sexiness to it. I wore a 2 and it fit like a glove! Wish I didn't have to return the dress, absolutely loved the dress!
Very flattering  This dress was perfect for my rehearsal dinner. Loved the sparkle! Wore a sticky bra because the back is very low.

Gorgeous dress.  I received MANY compliments at the 20's cocktail party I wore it to. Loved this dress!  Comfortable and classy.  The open back is just the little bit of sassy you need.  The only complaint I would have is that the sides of the open back did bunch when wearing it.  I should have used double sided tape to help hold it in place a little more.  Overall, I would suggest this dress to anyone.  I feel it can fit all shapes and sizes of women!

Cute back!
 A bit worn but overall pretty look.

Everyone loved my dress! I got so many compliments on the dress and it fit me really well! It does ride up a little but I blame that on my hips. I would highly recommend this to anyone. Like a lot of others I was worried about the color for a wedding but it wasn't a problem at all because it is more beige and silver than white.

Perfect NYE dress I wore this dress to a huge NYE party at a hotel in DC.  Loved the dress and the fit.  It was really comfortable and such a fun dress for the even.  I got compliments all night on it!  The top was a little big but the 0 definitely would've been too tight or small for me.
Beautiful dress. Not too flashy and the open back is just right.  Very short

Awesome dress! Perfect overall! This dress was perfect for my occasion, army flight school graduation! Because of the open back, I went to target and got the $17 stick on cup bra and it worked great! The dress fit perfectly and probably could've gotten away with even a smaller size. Received so many compliments and did not want to take it off! What a fun dress! :)

Comfy, sparkly, formal The dress is really pretty and worked well for prom! The only thing is that there are three different layers of fabric and in pictures it can easily look wrinkled. For me, the length was fine and not too long or short, but the back of the dress was pretty large fitting and i had to use fashion tape to keep the shoulders from falling to the side, and you have to wear a sticky bra or go braless all together! Jewelry is hardly needed but I wore pearls and a RTR crystal bracelet with it.

Fun, sparkly, but still classy dress for a cocktail-style foundraiser Overall the fit was great. I saw some other reviews that the length was too short, but I actually thought it was just fine, long legs and all! The shoulders are built in a nice way that keeps them up even though the back is fully open. My only critique is that the fabric of the dress wasn't as nice as I had hoped. The lace / sparkly overlay tended to come up and show the slip underneath when I was dancing, etc., but it wasn't a deal breaker and the dress still looked great!
So many great comments. Great fit. I wore no bra with just those front bra cups and it worked out well.
I received so many compliments on the dress! It was perfect for my sorority formal. It fit wonderfully, but the back was a little loose, which is easily fixed with fashion tape.

This is a rockstar dress!!  It is simple and understated but SO cute.  It's not scuba-diving gear body-hugging tight like some dresses (read: that's not necessarily a bad thing!), but it does a great job of clinging in the right places and I found it very flattering.  It was perfect and exceeded my expectations.

I wore this dress to my sorority's semi formal, and it was perfect! I received so many compliments.  The color of the dress and the detailing is beautiful, and I was obsessed with the open back design! The only issues I had was over the course of the night the dressed stretched and the top became very loose and I would have to tug it back in place. Other than that I loved it and would definitely recommend it. I got an 8 which fit perfectly on top, but I wish it had fit a little looser on the bottom, but by the end of the night it stretched out and worked great.

So many complements I was glad to have gotten the size 6 even though my usual dress size is 4. The four fit perfectly from the waist up but was just a little too tight in the hips. I chose the 6 and with a little dress tape, the top worked just fine. It was a little shorter than expected (I'm 5'6" and wouldn't have been able to bend over) but felt very comfortable in the dress all night and got many complements. It's photographed beautifully and nude shoes were the perfect choice.
Perfect dress for summer wedding True to size. Fit perfectly. I wore a stick on bra and it was perfect for the back. I received lots of compliments an highly recommend this dress.
so many compliments! The dress did not lay flat on the lower back, but the shipment included fashion tape so the problem was solved! I also ended up wearing sticky boobs

I purchased this dress for a pharmacy ball with a Gatsby theme. The dress was excellent!  I was really skeptical about getting the dress at first considering my chest size and all, but in the end the dress turned out to be fabulous! It's true to size and comfortable as ever. Not too tight and not too loose. The back does gap a little but fashion tape from Victoria Secret does the trick! I danced all night and got nothing but complements. The length wasn't too short with my heels on. Fits comfortably for someone with a larger chest size ( Adhesive Bra from Walmart did me just fine) .  All in all  the dress was excellent !

Got so many compliments! Great fit and color I LOVED the dress and got soo many compliments.  It looked great in pictures and the fit was great as well.  Since it is backless, it does run a little on the large side so I ended up going with the 0 instead of the 2.  I was also a little concerned about the open back since I was renting it for a wedding, but the open back ends up looking really classy! I also ended up not wearing a bra and still felt supported.  Overall, I loved it, would highly recommend this dress and would rent again!

love love love this dress!! perfect for homecoming! got soooo many compliments. great for big bust!! good fit over all! the back was just a bit big and didn't stay to skin. other than that, it is so much prettier in person! beautiful nude dress with silver lace overlay. Cute with bright colored heels (I wore turquoise) and a simple necklace and simple earrings.
GREAT dress. Everyone (including myself) loved this dress. I loved the open back and the fabric was super comfortable. Its quite short, but not terrible!

This dress was perfect for my James Bond themed Gala event! I rented this dress for a James Bond themed Gala event and received so many compliments! The dress was even more stunning in person than in the photos and the length was perfect for my petite 5'0 frame. I did need to use fashion tape to keep the shoulders from slipping off as the back is completely open but it wasn't a problem.
i wore this for my junior prom i loved this dress so much i didn't want to send it back. this dress fits true to size i do recommend fashion tape for the back.  the dress is very comfortable
I got so many compliments on this dress!!! The dress was the perfect fit.  It is definitely short. Kept having to pull it down.

Gorgeous! Perfect dress for a dressier affair The dress was absolutely gorgeous in person. My 2nd size came with a rip in the outside lace but luckily I wanted to wear the other size and customer service worked with me on the issue! Ran a little large up top and due to the low back it slipped off the shoulders slightly but nothing major. The dress was gorgeous and very flattering. Some minor fraying on the lace but nothing noticeable to others. My first RTR experience and I can't wait to do it again!

This dress was flawless and a huge hit at my bridal shower. I felt so glamorous in it.  This dress is true to size and very flattering. Not too tight on the stomach area and the open back made it sexy. It is a little short for my 5'8" height so I went with the size 2.

The most perfect bachelorette dress! I wore this for my bachelorette in New Orleans and it the perfect dress! I am a 4 and it fit perfectly, you also don't have to wear a bra which is splendid for August in New Orleans.  I got a ton of compliments from people who loved it and the pictures made for great memories. This has been my favorite rental yet, I'd totally recommend this one!

Got endless compliments on this dress! It's classy and beautiful. Fits true to size, not a form fitting dressing. The open back can be a bit of a problem as the sides are slightly loose creating an open space.
The material is thin and it's mini! I liked the dress, but found it to be too short and very form fitting.  It was not flattering on me.
So many compliments!! I thought this dress was wonderful. Easy to accessorize with it's neutral pallet. I had no concerns.

Love this dress! This dress was just what I was looking for. I had a huge birthday celebration for my 25th out and it was a hit. The open back was perfect. With larger boobs, I am always nervous having a backless dress but true to the reviews, you are totally fine without one. The dress was comfy and fit very well! The edged of the dress were a little frayed but only if you looked closely would you notice. I would highly recommend this dress for a 'Wow' response! Super cute!

This dress is oh so much fun! I wore it for my bachelorette party, and it was perfect!   It is definitely short. I wore the 4, but the 2 fit better in the bust/waist.  I am a true pear shape, and wanted a little more room in the butt/thigh area, so I felt more comfortable in the 4.  It's very comfortable, and I got so many compliments all night on it!

Used it for one of my bridal showers and it was perfect! I am a little bigger on the hips and legs than I am at the top so I chose the size 4 - which if I slouched could be a little loose from the top as it is backless, but if I stood correctly it was perfect. I loved the dress! It can definitely be dressed up or down. The cap sleeve is super cute.
I'm 5'10 and this dress was almost too short, but I got tons of compliments on it all night.  Pro's: back of the dress is gorgeous
I received so many compliments!  I loved it so much, I almost didn't want to return it. It's comfortable to wear. Also key, it photographs very well. I'd rent it again!

Beautiful lace overlay Fit well, a bit short when sitting.  size 6 was too loose due to the open back (probably not an issue if you are a bit bustier). Minor damage to the lace on the back, but was not very noticeable. Gorgeous silver lace that photographs beautifully.
This was an amazing dress! I received so many compliments! And comfortable enough to dance in :) Very comfortable, cute, and classy!

Best dress ever!!! So classy and sexy at the same time!!! This dress is amazing, it was comfy, sexy, classy, and affordable. Love love love this dress!! The fit was perfect, not too form fitting and the material was thick enough so no bra was necessary. I would totally rent this dress again.
The dress was perfect for a Dress Rehearsal.  Sexy and Elegant! Don't worry about it being too white for a Dress Rehearsal or wedding. Its really more beige. The details are beautiful!

Great Dress!  Got SO many compliments on this. It was a hit, and my favorite RTR dress yet!  The back is one of my favorite parts, and the cap sleeves and neck line go great. I ordered a 10 and 12, and ended up going with the 12 for length purposes. However, it may seem shorter on the model than it actually is in real life. Fits true to size, and while it is form fitting, it doesn't show every curve. I

I was told I looked like a princess! This is a very beautiful dress and the back is stunning but when you move around, since it's backless, the sides don't stay flat and kind of bunch up and flap around in the back. This could easily be fixed with fashion tape though.
Loved it! This dress was beautiful. The fabric is really sturdy, the back is incredible, and it's a nice color in person. Definitely very fitted, but thick enough that it hid my stomach.

The dress was beautiful and I got a few compliments throughout the night. I was very happy with it! Overall I loved the dress. Since it was backless I wore a sticky bra and that helped with the bra issue. Being 5'2'' the dress fell at the perfect spot on me but if you're taller it may be a tad short. I'm short and a little more petite so I thought the 2 would be good but turns out the 0 was perfect. So I'd recommend ordering the size you normally wear plus one size smaller. I wore this to a formal NYC wedding and I was probably the most dressed up but got quite a few compliments so I felt very glamorous! This was my first time renting from Rent the Runway and I'd definitely do it again. It was so easy and my dress came on time. Also the clutch I used (sorry, not pictured) was perfect as well. All in all, the experience was a great one and the next time I have an event, I'll be ordering from RTR again.

I received so many compliments on the color and overall fit...from a lot of guys !?!? I received so many compliments on my dress and my bf was googly eyed all night long :-). 

It was a bit snug/ revealing around the bust for my taste, but I think I may have been able to mitigate this had I went one more size up. The lace still kept it classy and covered them up a bit. I wore a skin toned bra as advised by another reviewer, which worked perfectly. Overall, a very good rental experience as always!

Subtle sexiness and endless compliments Wore this for a rehearsal dinner of a wedding I was in in New Orleans and got 15+ compliments on the dress from friends and perfect strangers on the street.
It is BEAUTIFUL on, from color to fit, and it has a unstated sexiness that WOWS.
I wore a thin-strapped nude bra (38DD) that was not visible through the lace, so NO you do not "have" to wear a strapless.

I wish I owned this dress!!!  I ended up getting this dress shipped to me last minute as an upgrade b/c the dress I wanted had been returned damaged. Seriously, this dress was the most amazing dress I've ever put on. It was comfortable ... the color was perfect ... and it fit me perfectly! I wish I owned the dress. And the folks at Rent the Runway were so accomodating and quick to respond to my emails when I needed to find a replacement dress. I will definitely rent this dress again!

Loved this dress.  This dress fit well and was a gorgeous color.  There were a few snags and a small tear in the netting/lace on the bodice, but ti wasn't obvious unless you were up close and staring right at it.  Lovely.

Just okay. I normally wear a 12 and got a backup size 14. I wore the 14 because it was a lot more form-fitting than expected, and I have a bit of a belly. The 14 made me feel less-self conscious, although I still didn't love it. I just don't think the sheath style suited my apple body type. In terms of length, I am 5'5" and the 14 it came to my knees. The 12 was about 2 inches above my knee. Still, I received many compliments and the color was gorgeous. I wore it to an outdoor fall wedding where I was a reader during the ceremony.

Perfect for a Fall Wedding or Cocktail Party! This dress is so unique and lovely that you don't need to do much more once you've got it on! I was a little concerned about how form-fitting it was, given that I don't usually like showing off my tummy, but with a little help from some spanx and nude tights, it was perfect! It ran a bit shorter than I anticipated (I'm 5'6), but I think that's because my hips and booty kept making it ride up a bit. My boo couldn't keep his eyes off me, and the color, although a bit brighter than it appears on the website, is easily muted in a darker room/late evening event. Word to the wise--be ready to go strapless, and have a friend around to help you zip up the back! If I could do it over again, i think I would have gone for a corset shaper to wear under the dress instead of spanx and a strapless bra, just to smooth everything over, but overall I'm very happy with my choice!

Several compliments on the color!! Beautiful color for a winter wedding! I am currently in between 12 and 14 sizes so 12 was a little tighter but 14 was a little big on me in the waist but left room for dancing comfortably and LOTS of food at the wedding. Glad I chose to wear the 14.
Perfect Color for a Holiday Season affair Fit is great - and so easy to wear -  fabric hugs body, but is also forgiving -
Cute - great color No complaints.  Fits well.  Fabric lends itself to getting snagged on stuff, but most of these lacey dresses do that.  Would rent again, just not my fave.

The color is beautiful and I like being covered up by the high neckline.   This dress was nearly impossible to wear for someone who can't go bra-less.  In front, the underlay went down so low, it showed every bra I normally wear and at times still showed the demi bra I wore that was too small.  Similar problem in the back, as the lining dips super low and required a low back bra.  If I am wearing a dress with cap sleeves, a high neckline, and fully covered back, I don't assume I'll have an issue with undergarments, but I did with this one.  I kept my jacket on for most of the evening, to ensure that my bra didn't peak out.  Otherwise it would have been SO pretty!

Loved it! I got so many compliments, especially on the color! This fit true to size.  I was alone getting dressed and it isn't the easiest garment to zip by yourself, so I would advise getting ready with a buddy.  Other than that it was awesome! The color and fit were great and I got so many compliments.

Dressy and elegant, but SO comfortable. I wore this to my son's senior class dinner at lovely NYC hotel, and it was the perfect blend of hot color and conservative silhouette. I did wear a strapless bra, but didn't even bother with spanx. Great color for me (dk brown hair and eyes, ivory skin), and it was fun to stand out in a sea of black. Nude patent pumps and simple gold jewelry took it down a notch.
Pretty, but decided not to wear. Returned did not wear

The dress was perfect to wear to a fall wedding! Pros: the color, the lace detail, the fit is great for someone who curvy, if your someone who likes some arm coverage but doesn't want to get hot and sweaty then lace sleeves are perfect.
Cons: can't think of a single one!
Very pretty dress! Beautiful dress but it was a little too tight in the midsection. The length was perfect and the quality was good.

Great dress for a wedding The dress's color was beautiful especially in photos.  I am 5'2, weigh in 117 and bra size is 34c.  If you have those measurements, size 4 will fit you perfectly.  The sleeves were initially tight , but they were fine after the wear.

BEAUTIFUL! I orignally rented this dress to wear to my Rehearsal Dinner. My friend and bridesmaid rented the Badgley Mischka dress (also pictured) and planned on wearing that. But when the dresses came, the BM dress was too short for her (she is 5'10''). So we ended up switching dresses bc this dress was a bit longer. It worked out perfect. Loved the lace. Love the bright color. LOVE RTR!
The color was fantastic. The color, fit and material were fantastic. The arms were a bit uncomfortable at first but overall no complaints. I got so many compliments on this dress.

Great dress but size issues I rented this dress to wear to a late afternoon wedding.  The bride works  for me so I wanted something not too low cut.  The dress was very appropriate. However, there were a couple of sizing issues.  I am between a 12 and 14.  So I ordered both sizes. the 12 fit very well except the lace through the upper arms is somewhat confining.  I tried on the 14 and it was a full size smaller than the 12.  I could still wear it but it was much shorter (I am 5'9").  There was a small tear in the lace on the right arm of the 12 but I did not even notice it until right before we left the house.  Since the 12 fit better I did not change into the 14.  Even so I got compliments on the dress.  The tear was not at all noticeable.  I would reconsider this dress if you plan to dance a lot unless you are slightly built through the upper chest and arms.  The lace was confining and if I were to move my arms a lot it would have been uncomfortable.

Fabulous color and compliments all night long! Loooooved this rental. The dress was made well and the color was gorgeous. I am curvy so dresses tend to be a little shorter on me which is why I went with the 12. The sleeves were a little tight on the 12, but the Sz 10 were actually stretched out already.  I loved it so much and my mom is going to rent it next month!

I received many compliments on my dress throughout the night!! The fit was great, a little tight in the sleeves but overall, it fit very well. The only con to this dress is that a strapless bra was not the right bra for this. The lace back cut low as did the slip in the front so I had to use tape in the front but kept fidgeting with the back throughout the night.
Very pretty, classic dress. Fit true to size, flattering dress. Color was beautiful.

Pretty in Pink! Great fit, good for curvy and great cocktail dress.  It worked for the event we were at which wasn't black tie but still formal.  I needed at last minute and RTR once again saved the day.  Dress was waiting for the event in under a few days notice.  STELLAR

Great dress! I loved this dress!  The sleeves were a little tight and itchy but that was not a deal breaker.  I found the 6 to be a little too long on me, even though it fit better everywhere else.  So I went with the size 4 because I liked the length, even though it was pretty snug.  Overall a success!
Great dress for company party! I'm 5'-3", 145 lbs 34DD and this dress fit great!

Sleeves too tight I got the 6 and 8. The 6 would have fit better with my curves, but I couldn't even get my arms through the sleeves and the chest area was snug as well. My upper body is slimmer so it was rather odd. I had to go with the 8 and the sleeves were still rather tight.  Otherwise the color went well with my tan skin tone.
Beautiful dress Loved the color. The fabric on the sleeves has no give.  Fit me well at the bust.

Everyone loved it! This dress was awesome!  I got many compliments from the wedding guests.  The only issue I had was that I had to use a bobby pin to pin the under slip to my bra because it would show if I didn't.  It was very flattering! Get it!

The perfect dress for my daughter's christening!! This is a beautifully designed and well constructed dress!! On the hanger it doesn't look like anything special, but when you put it on it comes alive- especially if you have curves!! The lace was thick, well constructed, and sewn onto the solid lining so it doesn't shift. AMAZING. The darker color and lace overlay hide body flaws pretty well, but I did pair it with Spanx to smooth everything out. I wore it with an adhesive bra as well to not have to deal with a traditional strapless (straps would be visible through the lace). If you are petite and/or pear shaped like me this is a great choice since the shift style does not have a defined waistline and there was plenty of room in the hips. I'm still in the process of losing the remaining baby weight and this dress was very forgiving while still looking sharp.

Everyone has rented it! I do not have a picture of myself wearing the dress, but I do have a picture of when a friend rented it the week prior! She wore it to my bridal shower and I loved it so much I rented it the following week for another friend's bridal shower. The sleeves were helpful on a cold, snowy, February day. The length is very appropriate, but not too long. I wore it with nude shoes. Everyone loved it, and now everyone is renting it!

The staff to be honest! I requested another dress which was not available & was able to upgrade. This dress fit well and flattering to the figure. I'm 5'7 so the length was perfect on me.  What I loved most were the sleeves but I must admit getting a bra to fit perfectly was challenging since the bust line is slightly low.  Overall, great for the benefit dinner I attended.

Perfect pop of color for a champagne themed event! I'm hard to fit at 6'0 but this dress worked.  The fabric was giving and the dress was easily worn with a strapless bra.  The waist hit a bit high on me but that is due to my height and I'm used to 99% of my dresses needing significant alterations. I accented with a cocktail ring and dangling earrings ~ I didn't want to distract from the detail in the lace.  Great night with wonderful friends ~ all also adorned in RTR.

Beautiful dress, very vibrant! I loved this dress, but didn't love it on me that much (because I just had a baby- so the extra weight was a horrible look in my opinion). I'd say if you are concerned about your stomach area, this isn't the dress to rent. 
It is very beautiful, colorful, & fit great. I received a lot of compliments on the dress all night. For shoes, I lucked up and bought a pair last year which matched this dress perfectly.
Worked with cowboy boots for a wedding on a ranch I sized up to have more room for dancing -- length was just right, not too short. Berry color was awesome!
Lovely color! It is a fitted dress, but not tight, or restricting because it has a little give. I received compliments as a wedding guest in East Hampton. High quality lace, too!
Elegant berry bliss Sexy date night fabulous.

PERFECT Birthday Dress I just rented Carmen Marc Valvo for an Oscars Party and LOVED this dress as well. So flattering with the sweetheart and long enough to wear Spanx. Got tons of compliments all night and stood out in the sea of black. It comes on a little tight but holds everything together. Wore it for my birthday night!! Will definitely rent Valvo again soon.
Work party dress Ordered this for a work party and it was perfect. Fit well, but maybe a little loose.
Color is super eye-catching! fantastic dress! was slightly longer than expected (perhaps because of my height?) but overall, it was beautiful.

LOVED this dress!!!! I received so many compliments. My husband was sad that I had to send it back. The fit was true to size. I really would have been more comfortable in a 4 but it was unavailable so I worked harder the last days leading up to the wedding to fit snugly into a 2 :)  I read reviews about the lace sleeves being tight but I didnt have an issue. Definitely wish I had another event to use this dress again.

Beautiful Color! Very comfortable dress, has give so does stretch throughout the night. If I had a flatter tummy I would have gone with the 12 knowing it would stretch but didn't want my less than attractive lumps highlighted for the world :). This Mommy body might have benefited from an actual pair of spanx rather than a knockoff underneath.
I got compliments on this dress all night - fabulous color and so easy to dance in. The 18 would have worked too - but the 20 was a little more forgiving.

This dress was absolutely perfect for a wedding in Nantucket! Early Sept Nantucket wedding, outdoor cocktail reception, tented seated dinner - the lace sleeves kept me perfectly warm while still breathable! The fit was great, true to size and the material stretchy enough that I could move freely.

Will definitely rent again!! Great fit, having the 2nd size set my mind at ease.  Great color! Comfortable! So many compliments! The down side.... while driving to the wedding I noticed the dress had armpit area "funk" from a previous use.  I grabbed perfume from my overnight bag to keep handy at the reception and kept asking my husband to smell me.  I was able to pull it off but will definitely give my future rentals a sniff test prior to running out the door.
The color was stunning! The dress fit true to size and the color was stunning! Received compliments all night. Sad to send it back :-(

I wore this dress for my engagement pictures!! The dress is gorgeous on and the color is striking in pictures. I wish I had gotten a size 10, but the arms may have been a little tight. Also the dress I received the sleeves went down to my wrists, so I did have to pull the sleeves up which definitely helped the look of the dress. The dress does work well for full busted women, just be sure to get a GREAT strapless bra!
I received lots of compliments! Very pretty! The lining of the dress is fantastic. However, I found the collar a little itchy. At the end of the day, I was itching to take it off. Literally.
Got compliments all night on this dress! I loved it, and it fit true to size.  It is slight brighter than the picture depicts, but none the less beautiful!
Great! Beautiful color! Wore for my husband's birthday dinner. Very comfortable!
I wore this to a morning wedding with an evening reception, and it was perfect for both events.  The color was beautiful, it fit perfectly, and was super comfortable to boot! Loved this dress.
So many compliments! Great color, perfect length, and slimming fit.   Lace is slightly itchy.  Other than that, great dress.

Beautiful color! A lot of compliments! This dress seemed to run large. But it was a beautiful color and easy to move in! The length was perfect and didn't ride up. I wore spanx to keep it all look smooth. The sleeves were a little itchy but not a huge deal. However, be very careful with the lace, as it can get stuck on things.
Beautiful Dress--Beautiful Color--would love to own the dress Rented a 10 fit perfect

love, love the dress Absolutely loved this dress! It is gorgeous and comfortable, i rented this dress for a bridal shower and i'm very happy with my choice, i could wear size 10 but the only problem that is the lace is tight arround the arms, the fabric is so sensative u have to be careful with your jewelery, other wise the color is stunning & the fit is perfect
It was a hit! The dress is beautiful and fit very well on me. The arms are a bit snug but other than that I got A LOT of  praise and compliments on this dress.

Simple date night dress Unfortunately I did not get to wear this dress, the weather prevented us from going out for Valentines Day but I thought the dress was perfect for a nice dinner. Love the price and even better that I can send it back , without having to worry about what to wear it to again. The arms are itchy and tight, but it is to be expected with a heavier lace.

Beautiful, Berry Dress I love this dress.   It was a beautiful color and was perfect for a wedding I attended.  I received so many compliments on it.  I would rent this again in a heartbeat.  I love Rent the Runway and only get my special occasion dresses from them.
Gorgeous! I don't know why but this dress reminds me of raspberry sherbet...which is delicious, just like this dress. Haha. Comfortable and gorgeous.
Beautiful gorgeous. Got so many compliments. Felt awesome in the dress. Everybody was awestruck!!!!! Beautiful. U really need a good fitting  strapless bra though... I loved wearing it.

Beautiful lace color! This dress was the perfect color for a fall/winter wedding.  I received compliments all night.  I rented both a 2 and a 4 and wore the 2 because I wanted the dress to be a little more fitted.  The only down side of that is the top around the arms and neck becomes very tight.  Overall, it was a great dress!

Perfect for hourglass figure for fancy event!  The fit was good.  I'm 5'4" 145 lbs.  I have a 38D chest and it was a little tight in the bust and finding the right bra was trial and error.  The length was perfect but you definitely need to gather on stairs!   I loved this dress And got so many compliments (especially the color). Bonus: It was comfy with pockets!

The fabric is a rich shade of blue that made my eyes and glasses pop. It is heavy and comfortable. The fit was close around my mid-section and loose around my chest. That being said, I wore the regular when I normally wear petite clothing, and a petite adaptation would have solved my baggy straps issue. The back also dragged like a wedding dress train for the same reason. If you're on the fence for petite versus regular sizing, opt for petite sizing. The fabric itself is heavy and durable, so if you cannot wear a bra (my experience), then immodesty is not a worry.

I wore this for my own wedding rehearsal dinner.   I love love love this dress. The only down side is that the bust was a little to big in the 4R. I'd tried the 2R on a few months back, but the bust was way too tight, and could be sipped without being uncomfortable. The 4R might have been loose because I lost weight for my wedding so I probably should have gotten a 2R. Still it's a very pretty dress and you feel like a queen. Just be sure you either have a small bust and you can wear stickies or you get a size up.
Easy to wear beautiful color I wore this dress to a gala.  Great dress, easy to wear.  The top runs a tad large so fashion tape is a must.  Pockets are great for a phone.

Perfect for formal/black tie optional wedding! This dress was amazing and lived up to the expectations and reviews by fellow RTR wearers. My only thing to note is that the chest area was almost too tight for my size, but I am a D cup, so if you are less than that you should be OK (C cup) or it might be big (B or A cup). When I tried the backup size 10, it was too big in the chest/shoulders and waist, so it's strictly a bra cup issue.

Love the length in the front - gives the impression of a long gown, but able to move. The dress is beautiful, but it's super tight around the rib cage, and the material in that area doesn't stretch, so beware!

The color is beautiful, it moves wonderfully! It was fun to wear! I am a true size 2 and the waist fit perfectly. The V-neck is low, and I did not wear a bra (very unusual for me) but the V is not super open. I did have to pin the armholes because they were gapping, but a few well-placed safety pins fixed that problem. Once the armhole was fixed, I felt secure in the chest without a bra. 
It does have pockets which is great! It moves really beautifully and was a lot of fun to wear. I wasn't super in love with the fabric, it is a very generic polyester woven fabric. However, it was perfect for the event we attended, and I truly enjoyed wearing it!

Flattering dress. I have an hourglass body shape, with a larger bust, and this dress was actually almost too big in the chest but was still able to wear it confidently.  I loved the blue color and received many compliments all evening.

Loved the color of this dress and received a lot of nice compliments. The 2R was a bit snug in the high waist this sit right around your rib cage. I would have worn the 4R if it hadn't been that th bust was too large. Other than a little snug it fit great!

LOVED IT! So many compliments! I waited until last minute to rent a dress (first timer mistake) and I decided to risk renting the long since it was what was left in my size. I definitely could've used the regular, but with high enough heels it worked out! I am a bit busty so the dress was a little more low cut than the picture leads on, but I would still recommend this dress!

Love it - but VERY low cut! I got this dress for my boyfriend's family wedding, but ended up wearing my backup dress since it was SERIOUSLY low cut. If you have big boobs, prepare for them to be on display. Super sexy, but felt inappropriate for the occasion. I LOVED how I looked and felt in it, though. The color is really rich and IT HAS POCKETS. Since it is hi-lo, you don't really have to worry about it being long enough so unless you're super tall/wearing heels (5'11"+) you will probably be fine with the R. Really hope I can rent this again some day!!

Fun, classy dress!  Perfect for a black tie wedding! This dress was so fun to wear.  It was amazing to dance with and it has pockets!  I repeat.  It has pockets.  I'm normally a size 8 but can size down if it's just fitted in the top.  Unfortunately the 6L was not available but the 8L still did the job.  It was heavier material which made the skirt part look so amazing.  It might be hot for a summer wedding though.

I couldn't stop twirling, it was so much fun to wear. The material and cut of this dress made it incredibly fun to wear. The train would billow out in the wind, I could swish it on the dance floor, and it was a modern look. I'm 6ft tall, the 4L was a perfect length. I would say it runs long so order a shorter length because if I wasn't careful, the train would catch in the back of my sandals or under my chair. I have small boobs, I did not need to wear a bra and no fear at all of gaps. It was conservative enough for the Navy Ball without being matronly or prom dress.

I loved the way I felt in this dress! This dress is beautiful and fits nicely.  It is true to size.  I am 5'11'' and wore 3.5'' heels and wore a long, and it was the right length.  Just be careful in the ladies' room as it is easy to forget how long it is in the back and you might also get a toilet dunk situation.  The dress also has fun pockets that I forgot to use, they are hidden well.  It is a little chesty, but not too bad.  I have a very large chest and I felt comfortable in this dress and felt like it showed off just enough.
Fun, tons of compliments, great color! Gappy in the bust (I'm a B-cup) but easily fixable with some strategically placed safety pins.

Beautiful color, but not good for a busty figure.  Beautiful and fun dress, but definitely NOT good for someone who is busty. I'm a 36DD and typically wear an 8 or 10. It was way too much cleavage and difficult to zip past the chest. Going a size up would have made the straps far too loose. I was very disappointed I couldn't make this work!

The color and dress were stunning!   the hi-lo hemline was so different and beautiful.  this dress was truly stunning.  The neckline was a lot lower than expected.  I am large busted and I wasn't expecting it to be so low.  I had to pull up the straps to provide more coverage.  If you are ok with such a plunging neckline, you need to buy one of those bras where you can't see the center of it.  My bra showed most of the night and made me self conscience.

The disappointed peacock This dress was my original choice for a creative cocktail fundraising event with a jungle/animal theme. While the dress itself fit, there was some strangeness to the fit of the bust. It cut right across the center to create a really strange side profile. I tried everything from a stiffer cupped bra to no bra at all and no matter what, I still ended up with a double boob. Otherwise, the dress was absolutely flawless. However, I think a size up would have been too big.

So many compliments on this fun and flirty gown I felt so elegant in this gown. It swirled amazingly on the dance floor. I wore it to a fall wedding in Massachusetts and I was glad it had a heavier fabric which felt substantial even in the chilly evening. I did have to wear a shawl for my arms. It is low-cut, so if you are busty I imagine this dress might not be appropriate for a wedding....it would be really revealing. I got away with it because I have a smaller chest.

It was absolute beautiful and fit perfectly and the draping accentuated my cures I loved this dress!  I rented it for my birthday dinner.  I am taller but it still hung down enough in the back to make a dramatic statement. It was absolute beautiful and fit perfectly and the draping accentuated my cures

Color, pockets, swish of the the skirt! I got compliments all night. I was nervous ordering so I went with a 6L and 4L but wish I had done 4L and 2L. The dress was the tiniest bit big around the arms and there was a lot of fabric where the skirt met the bodice but even so there was no drooping around off the shoulders or wardrobe malfunctions. I would rent this dress again in a heartbeat.

Vibrant color, well cut, & pockets! It fit well and highlighted might hourglass shape. I did have to wear the 18 for my 40DDD chest, but I still felt covered. I'm 5'7 and wore a 2 inch heel, but I am glad I went with the long version. The short would have been too short for sure. Fabric quality was great.

So fun to twirl in! This dress was very fun to dance in! It's quite low; I had to use the Kim Kardashian method of taping my boobs, which worked ok. We'll see from the photos if it looks as scandalous as it felt. I did get a lot of compliments though!

So much fun to wear - loved every minute in it I wore this dress to a black-tie event that was being put on by my university. The dress was so much fun to wear and I had people coming up to me all night telling me I looked great (there seemed to be a consensus that it was very 50's-movie-star). The dress does have some cleavage, so if that's something you're not comfortable with this may not be the dress for you. The material was heavier than I expected, but the dress flowed beautifully when I moved. 
With my four inch heels the long *just* touched the ground.

Rented this dress for my engagement photos and it was stunning! The dress is true to size and has no give.  The best thing is not needing a bra in this dress, which is a first for me. I love this dress so much.  It is so unforgettable, you'll only want to rent it because no one will forget how you looked in this dress.

Felt like Cinderella, game changer! So many compliments  Be cautious with cleavage if you have decent sized breasts.  Midsection was tight forcing you to sit up straight, not necessarily a bad thing.  High-low offered good breathability, and the color was phenomenal. I would love to rent this again in a heartbeat, just maybe not for a wedding....  I wore the 6R (they didn’t have long available) instead of the 8L just so i had a little breast support without a bra and a little more hug.  The 8 would have been perfect if you are looking for a more comfortable (Breathable) fit.

Unforgettable, but some DIY involved! I read just about all of the reviews when I rented this, and preparedness was key here. True to the reviews, the sizing is odd--the 6R fit perfectly on top but made me look too hippy, so I went with my usual 8R, which flowed perfectly but I had about 2+ inches extra in the shoulders and back, and it did gape a bit in the front when I moved. So, plan on pinning as needed and lots of fashion tape. The length was fine with 4" heels (I'm 5'4")--there was maybe an inch or two extra that became a very small train, which looked great anyway. I felt unbelievable in this dress. If you're on the fence, GO FOR IT!

Had random women asking me where I got the dress.... Very beautiful.  Agreed as reviews said, slightly tighter around waist, I probably should have worn the 8L (mistakenly ordered a 4 & 6)  but I made the 6L work.  LOVED the pockets, could not see my phone while in the pocket.  
Was able to wear a regular plunge bra !   Did make my hips look a little wider, but no big deal.  profile pictures were the best, made the dress look really good too.

Amazing- BOOBS. BLUE. Gorgeous dress! First of all, let me say that despite what other reviews have said about this dress running large, that is not the case. It is true to size. If your waist is over 28 inches, you probably need the 6. Based on the reviews, I ordered the 4 and the 2, and wore the 4, with Spanx. I usually wear a 4, but I do have a 29 inch waist, and wow, there is definitely no room for error. However, it fit perfect in the breast and shoulders (5' 3", 125 pounds). I am a 34D to 34DD, and this dress is PERFECT if you have nice cleavage and want to show it off. Be prepared for the stares! No one, male or female, will be looking at your face! Also, double sided dress tape is definitely a good idea to prevent nipple slips. Overall, I loved this dress. I received a ton of compliments on it, very flattering.

Simply a beautiful dress with a great fit for my body. This is one of my favorite dresses. It is perfect for an elegant entrance and so appropriate for a wedding at a yacht. The chest is quite open and if you are planing to dance the whole night it may want to have an extra support. Nevertheless I got tons of  complements. Overall I would own this dress.

The color is everything.  I'm a small busted lady and so I struggled with the neckline of this dress. Definitely could've used fashion tape. See the third photo for how it crinkles around the chest. However, the skirt is fabulously flouncy and great for dancing. The waist was snug, but fit for a photo-friendly finish. Loved the color the best and got thousands of compliments all night long. Great dress. Fabulous price point.

Beautiful color I loved the color, the material was heavy and beautiful but puckered out around the chest in a weird way and had to be secured to not look funny.  I loved how it flowed when I walked.  It was also a bit loose.
Stunning dress. Would rent again! Perfection and classy.  True to size! Very flattering

Tons of compliments, very comfortable! Loved this dress! I wore it for a black tie fundraiser and received tons of compliments all night! It's VERY low-cut, so girls will bigger chests- be careful! The high/low was not as drastic in person, which I loved. It was comfortable and easy! Will definitely rent again!

I wore this dress to a formal wedding and I got so many compliments. This was my first rental and it really worked out! I am a size 10 and I ordered a size 10R and 10L for backup. The 10R worked perfectly, so I didn't even try on the backup dress. It is low cut, but I didn't have to wear a bra and felt super comfortable - no risk of nip slip!  The length was perfect with 2/12 inch heels. I love the pretty blue color and the high low cut was different in a sea of long gowns. I loved the pockets for holding my cell phone!
I loved this dress! Ordered the 2 and the 4 and ended up wearing the 2. It was a bit snug, but definitely more flattering then the 4. Received many compliments. Would love to buy this dress.

Boobtastic!! Incredible dress I wish I could wear everyday!!  OMG this dress!! Pockets! Ahh! I LOVED wearing this dress! I'm short and curvy and this dress made me feel like a Glamazon!! Super dee duper low neckline means bring the noise and your favorite push-up bra and get ready to take the girls out for a spin! The hemline was just incredible for a shorty like me, I now seek out this type of hemline! Super rich fabric, pockets, great fit and cut (although fit ran slightly big, I normally wear an 8 and wore the 6 in this) I am hoping and praying for the next event I can wear this at again! Just stunning!!

Neckline so low the dress was unwearable. The color and material are gorgeous and I love the hemline, but the neckline was SO LOW it was absolutely unwearable.  An inch or even half and inch higher cut would have made a world of difference.  I bought a specialy deep plunge bra to wear with the dress and it was visible.  The material is way to loose to wear without a bra.  The 2R fit as well but unfortunately the neckline was just as bad.

Stunning gown This dress was amazing! I rented it for a black tie wedding and it was perfect for the occasion. The color is so rich and lovely and the cut is unbelievably comfortable. I did have to do some strategic safety pinning and make use of double stick tape as it's a really low neckline and had some weird armpit gaps going on, but was totally worth it. Wish I owned this one!

Color is amazing; very formal I have mixed feelings about this dress. I didn't wear it because it was way too big, but I loved the color and style. However, as others have mentioned, the top of the dress was very big.  It felt like the length from the waist to the shoulder was way too long (needs 2 inches off the shoulders). Even a very busty person will likely find excess material at the top.

Absolutely stunning dress!  I wore this dress to a black tie preferred wedding. The dress is incredibly gorgeous. Its color and fabric is amazing, and I really think it looks good on any body type. I wore it with ~4" gold strappy heels. The cocktail hour was outside and it was fairly breezy -- this dress looks incredible in the wind as it swirls around and behind you! I received compliments all night long. My only complaint is there's zero stretch in the fabric -- I have a wide rib cage, and the size 2 was super tight. Regardless, would totally rent it again. LOVE.

Tight bust. I actually did not end up wearing this dress. They only had a size 2 available and I was excited since I am always a 2 in dresses. I have a small bust, with wider hips, and the dress was extremely tight on the bust and accentuated my hips in a not so good way. It really is a beautiful dress, and beautiful color, but just did not fit my body properly. I am 5'5'' and 127 lbs, and 34 B bust for reference.

Gorgeous Dress with one flaw Bust - did not fit well and bagged out towards the sides. I usually never have issues with the bust of dresses. It was like there was extra width in the fabric.

Hips - roomy in the hips but the cut of the dress definitely emphasized them and made me look hipper.

Luxurious fabric and flattering cut When the wedding invite says, "cocktail attire" but you feel like showing up everyone... I'm between a 6 and 8, but the 6 was definitely too snug around the waist. The 8 fit pretty nicely, but top was a bit loose. The fabric is a dream. It's thick and rich in color. The high low hem lets you show off some fab shoes and a little leg...but more importantly, I'm prone to tripping on the dress when climbing stairs (despite my best efforts) and this allows you to avoid that awful situation altogether. And why can't all zippers be like that?? Large and easy to use. It makes those dinky side zips look ridiculously cheap. Last word: pockets.

Definitely called attention!  Loved this dress. I wanted it really bad. When I first saw it and attempt to rent it, i was unable to because they did not have my size available, for the date I needed it. I contacted Rent the Runway via chat, and they were not very helpful. After looking over at the dress and reading many comments I noticed the dress comes in "R" for regular, and "L" for long, which can be intimidating to a 5'2 tall petite woman, but ladies don't be fooled, get it! I wore 6L instead of my regular size and believe it is the best thing I could have done. Loved the pockets, but its midline is not stretchy at all.

Flowy like water While I ended up wearing a shorter dress instead, I loved this dress. My size wasn't in so i sized up and it was a bit to large, i could have pinned it up but with the hot weather I decided to go short instead. Nice support and lines. I am 5' 7" and the regular was still a bit long and would need some heels, I'd say only rent the Long if you are over 5' 8".

Feeling beautiful! Fit was perfect. Hit me perfectly at my waist and accentuated my figure. I ended up not wearing this one, but it could have been worn without a bra or with sticky boobs. Heels necessary for the Long version.

I felt like Cinderella! I think this was my favorite rental of all time! I loved how it was the perfect mix between classy and sexy. It was rather low cut, but my boobs aren't big enough to make it too flashy.

Dancing in the dress made me feel like a princess! It was very flowy and gave great curves. The only problem I had with it was the sleeves. They were slightly too large and poked out a bit, but nothing that a little garment tape couldn't fix! Other than that, it was a perfect dress for this James Bond style New Years Eve event!

Black Tie Wedding Unfortunately they did not have my size available (16), so I decided to take a risk and go up one to 18W and brought a few belts just in case! Though the overall fit was big, it was still flattering the way it fell on my pear shape. However, all the tape in the world couldn't have helped the oversized bust area. I am small chested (B) and the larger sizes of this dress are definitely made for a woman with an ample bust.  I had to pin the under arm quite a bit, otherwise it would have been flapping in the wind. Overall still quite pleased with the dress for a black tie wedding, but wish it had been a size or two smaller!

Dress fit well and was comfortable. Great color! The dress was perfect for a formal event - comfortable and photographed well. 
Very awkward construction of the top half though - hard to describe, it just seemed to want to sit in a very unnatural position for a human body.. Don't think anyone noticed but me though, just felt kind of strange..
In any event, thought it was great and would rent again.

Stunning, but LOW cut I got so many complements on this dress.. But it's not really true to the picture.. or at least it wasn't for me. The V cut is DEEP and I am normally not comfortable showing off that much, and I was a bit self conscious all night but I had to go with it since I had nothing else to wear and I have already gotten everything for this dress! Everyone complimented the dress, even though I got a few stares. I LOVED the asymmetrical hem though and the way it flowed when I walked. I came down a grand staircase and the dress moved like a dream. It was Quite tight around my mid-section, so if you rent it a corset or spanks may help with the fit. Also there was no satin band around the hem.. a detail which would have been nice.. if it was there it was not noticeable

Felt so glamorous in this dress! Loved this dress and got a million compliments. Very flattering tight fit around waist and bust but beautiful flow of skirt.  Wide skirt made this a very fun dress to dance in.  You need to wear heals!! I'm 5'5 and wore serious heals and if I didn't the dress would've dragged on the floor.  Also wearing a bra is nearly impossible, the cleavage cut is very wide.  All my bra cups were sticking out the plunging v-neck so I went braless.  I'm a 32D so that's not a normal occurrence.  However I choose to wear the 4 which fit more snug against my upper body which made the no bra choice easier.  Warm weather and an outdoor wedding helped also.   


That being said I wanted to wear my backup size the 6R. It didn't feel as constricting as the four around my ribcage.  However the first time I tried on the 6 to compare fits the ZIPPER GOT STUCK AND WOULDN'T MOVE! I was literally standing in a hotel room stuck in a dress. I couldn't get it off unless I broke the zipper.
So did I have a good time at the wedding and get compliments yes - did I wear the dress I felt more comfortable in NO.  I was upset I was given a dress with an obviously damaged zipper.

Bottom half was beautiful.  Top half not so much. I'm generally between a 4 and 6 for most dresses here. I rented this with only a 4R available, and saw all the reviews, so I knew I was taking a risk. Luckily, I had rented another dress as a backup, and wore that one instead. 

The bottom half fit and flowed beautifully. The design felt very glamorous, and was perfect for a black tie optional wedding. But the top was far too tight, and far too low cut to be that tight. It both pancaked and exposed my chest in an exceptionally unflattering way - and caused some unintentional exposure once I bent down. Perhaps a larger size, and some fashion tape would have helped, but I didn't have the time or patience to try it out for the whole night.

I want to own this dress! I wore this to a ballroom dance competition dinner party, and it was perfect!  The cobalt blue is stunning, and the plunging neckline is just enough...  At first I felt it was a bit snug at the waistline but I got used to it. My backup size was a 4 and that definitely wasn't happening, and an 8 would probably have been too big.  The high-low hemline is the just the right contrast - it felt like the dress had a train while ascending stairs, but it's easy to walk and dance in since you don't have to worry about tripping on it!  Waiting for this dress to be for sale so I can snatch it up!!!

Great Dress! I loved this dress! I got so many compliments on it and it was so much fun to dance in!
Because I'm only 5'3" I was a little worried about this being too long and not falling in the right place on the 'low' portion of the dress. In heels, the back didnt drag too much on the floor, and it still hit in a complimentary place in the front. The top was a bit too big on me and I had to make sure to sit up straight so it didn't bag too much in the front and cause a wardrobe malfunction. 

Overall, great dress!

Beautiful gown for a masquerade ball  Definitely boobalicious. If youaren’t comfortable with your tatas getting attention, this dress is not for you. My lats are huge, so the size 6 was tight around my rib cage. But the color is beautiful. No issues with “falling out” in fact it was tight across my chest and almost cut my boobs in half. Still getting compliments on the dress a week later. RTR was super easy, I’d do it again.

Beautiful color and extremely comfortable This dress exceeded my expectations! The color and fabric were gorgeous. I loved how light the dress was and the pockets were an added bonus. After reading reviews I decided to go with a long length and am glad I did as the dress swept the floor just a little bit which was nice. I did not wear a bra with this and because I'm fairly flat chested, it was a little big in the armpit area but I was comfortable enough not needing double sided tape.

i received so many compliments on this dress even though it gave me a horrible double-boob. this dress color is beautiful! it is not for the fuller-of-chest. i had to tape my boobs as flat as possible and i still had a double-boob due to the horizontal tailoring of the dress. it is heavy weight and it was warm and humid out. wear for something cooler or if you're staying indoors in AC. also, we went dancing afterwards and i had to lift up the back (SO MUCH fabric) and put it on a chair and dance in place.

Great dress. Beautiful color.  This dress was gorgeous. I'm short so I had to pin the shoulders up  just a bit.  The sides at the armpit were a little saggy, but pinning the shoulders resolved this issue too.  It is very flattering for an hourglass figure, but be warned, this dress is cut very low, if you aren't comfortable showing the girls, pick another style.   You definitely need some fashion tape for this one. A couple strips and I was good to go. I wore 4 1/2"platform shoes and the length was perfect for me.  The dress would have been too long had I gone with a lower heel.  I usually wear a size 12 but it was too large in the arm. I wore the 10 and it fit perfectly. Overall I loved wearing this dress and got tons of compliments all night.

This dress was so comfortable but made me feel like a princess! The dress fit like a glove and the pockets were such a fun addition. As others mentioned, the zipper is a bit difficult, but only at the waist where the material is thickest. The length was perfect--I wore 3.5 inch heels and someone thought I had the dress tailored for the shoes. I was absolutely heartbroken to return this dress because its the most beautiful thing I have ever worn. Would definitely rent this dress again!

POCKETS Fit a little snug in the waist, but comfortable everywhere else. I ordered the L because the R wasn't available. But the fabric basically floated while I walked, so the length wasn't a huge deal. I ordered this through Unlimited, so I will try to order a R length for the event!

fit well, looks very formal There was a lot of room in the dress because I wore a size 10 instead of a 8. Both the dresses the zipper was hard to close, another person had to close it. Playing with the net underneath the dress made it bigger which was the look I wanted.
