Show Stopper.  My originally requested size was unable to ship, and the 4R was my larger, backup size - it fit snuggly, but great! I don't think I would have been able to zip the 2R. The pattern looks a little flat/repetitive in the photos, but it's much more interesting in person. The length was perfect with high heels. I wore this to a black tie fundraiser where I had to go up on stage and had no issue walking around (or up and down the stairs). Received compliments ALL night and it photographed great!

Perfect Formal Dress That Is Comfy! This dress fit true to size for the brand (which I have found to be slightly bigger than others). If you are between sizes I recommend going with the smaller size. The top was slightly big for me but was not noticeable due to the cut and material of the dress. I would recommend this dress for multiple body types as the flowy bottom hides any unwanted curves.

I felt like a princess This was my first black tie wedding at an extremely nice venue, and I wanted to look the part! I got countless compliments on this dress, and I still am from people who weren't at the event but saw pictures! I wish I could keep it. It is so comfortable, I had no issues with wearing it all night.

I am a professional performer and sang at a gala of 900 people... Turned every head in the room! This classy, elegant gown would fit any body type.  I am typically a 2L and that's the size I wore... Fit like a glove and wore 3" heels with it brushing the ground just perfectly.  This gown is much more stunning in person than photos.  I think the simpler the accessories, the better!  My only complaint was the return process.  The gowns arrived in a box and the pre-shipping return label was affixed to a bubble mailer.  The gowns definitely couldn't fit inside that and I couldn't remove the label without ripping it.  I ended up cutting it off and taping it on top of the delivery label.  Regardless, I am a huge fan of RTR now and am considering the unlimited package if clothes are this high quality each time!

This dress was an absolute dream to wear for senior prom! I have a hard time finding dresses that fit me right because of my height (5'9") and small chest (34A). I usually wear a 4 in dresses, and because being designer I assumed this would run small, so I ordered the 4L and the 6L but the 4L was huge on me. I'm glad I set my arrival day 2 days in advance, because RTR was able to send me a 0L and it fit almost perfect, just slightly large in the bust but that goes for just about everything I wear.  Overall, I wore this dress for about 9 hours and was extremely comfortable the entire time. The fabric is beautiful and easy to move in. I added a 3 layer tulle petticoat underneath because I wanted the skirt to look as full as possible. I definitely wish I could keep this gown, I felt gorgeous and it definitely stood out among the rest of the dresses at my prom. Overall my experience with RTR was perfect and I will be renting more in the future!

Flattering and Comfortable I loved this dress! Very flattering, and very comfortable. (Plus, pockets! Genius!) I was a little worried that the top would be too baggy, since I was in between sizes and went with the larger size, and am small-chested to begin with, but the drape of the fabric worked and made everything look nice. Just a note--the red is pink-toned, rather than deep red or orange-toned. Would definitely recommend!
This was worn for the formal dinner for my sorority's convention that I organized. This dress fit great!  Loved having the pockets to hold my phone.

Stunning medium-formal gown! Pockets, ample coverage yet still sexy, this dress was a hit! The color is flattering, as is the fit, and it's classically chic. It was a wonderful choice for a charity ball!

I loved this dress!!! I received so many compliments, felt like a star! Didn't want to take it off! The side zipper was really tough: took my boyfriend and BFF to get it zipped. I'm large-busted though, so  that could have been part of it. But we were determined! It was such a comfortable dress once I was in it, though. Pockets! It has pockets! 
I wore a convertible bra that allowed me to wear one strap (again, I'm very busty, so I need a bra.) If I weren't so large-chested, the 14 might have been too big on top. I'm a 38G. You may need to size down, because it fit perfectly everywhere else. I really, really loved this dress. 

My only problem was that the bag the dresses came in smelled bad, and I needed to air out the dresses before I could wear them. That bag needs to be retired!

Gown was beautiful.  Fit: I selected a 6L and an 8R and wore the 8R because the 6 was too tight for me in the bust area. 
Pros: Gown is beautiful. Length was great. Fit my body type perfectly. 
Cons: None in my opinion
OTHER: Dress color is not as dark red as it appears in the pictures.

Felt like a queen at this beautiful wedding in Yosemite. The dress fit well except for a little gapping at the top on the side without a shoulder.   My friend pinned the side seam on that side for a perfect fit!   I could have used more tape for the hem.   The dress was in great shape, and I loved the drape and quality of the fabric.   I did not have any trouble with the zipper but it does help to have another set of hands to manage that for you (maybe hard to put it on alone). I also felt like the skirt was wonderful because of the two petticoat layers that were just right, and the awesome pockets.   I had so many compliments on the dress, especially from the younger generation, and one young man told me that he wanted me to know that both he and his wife loved my dress!   It made this very special occasion so much fun--it was a great treat to be in this wonderful gown for this very lovely evening.   My husband and I were celebrating our 27th anniversary so it was extra special!

Red carpet moment. You will feel like a million bucks in this dress. I wore it to a formal affair and got compliments all night.  It was a red dress themed ball and I felt like my dress stood out from 100 others.  It was unlike any other dress there. I'm normally a 4 and wore the 4 but it was slightly tight in my waist (that's just me though after 2 kids and now over 40).  I'm 5'4 and had to buy the highest heels I could find and it still dragged on the floor a bit. The pockets are a MAJOR win and helped me keep the dress "held up" a bit more when I walked.  You will love this dress.

Beautiful and Elegant This dress fit perfectly from the ankles up. It was a touch too long so I just went and bought higher shoes. Next time I will get a petite dress. Customer Service was phenomenal in helping me place my first order.

So beautiful/elegant. Runs small I am actually not the one wearing the dress in the picture! After receiving it and there being absolutely no way i could fit into it, let me friend borrow it. i have a full bust and a small waist. everything fit besides the chest. i couldn't lift the zipper past my ribcage! however, my friend is a 32B and the size 10 fit her perfectly. very nice colors and such beautiful dress. i would definitely wear it if i had the correct size!!

Beautiful dress for a formal wedding I usually wear a 0 or a 2. The 0 was a tiny bit tight but it looked more flattering than the 2, so I ended up wearing the 0. I felt beautiful and got so many compliments!

This dress is amazing.  It fit wonderfully and was very comfortable.  Pros: fit, comfort, style, and sass.
Cons: the zipper.  It's terrible.

Husband's exact words when he saw me were "it's going to be hard to find a better dress than this." This dress is perfection! It is a bold color and print without being too loud or busy. It is classy and elegant without being boring. I wore the size 0R. Being 5'1", it was VERY long on me, but that is expected with almost every gown. The waist fits true to size, however the bust area is a tad bit loose. Just as other reviewers have said, you will get compliments all night long!

One of the most fun ballgowns I've ever worn! Such a well-made and gorgeous dress! I am 5'8, 140 lbs, and this size 8 fit perfectly. The dress is beautiful, well-made, and made me feel like a princess/queen. I wore this to The Kennedy Center in DC for a video/photshoot, and everyone was complimenting me on how gorgeous it is. I could not wear heels, or my feet would show too much. I wore delicate evening flats instead. LOVED this ball gown!

So many compliments!! This dress was STUNNING!!! I wore it to a gala benefiting the AHA and it was perfect. The material is super light and I was totally comfy all night. The pockets are fantastic and I had my phone in them all night long. I had so many compliments, I was sad to put in the bag and return it!! All the other reviewers are dead on with the tight in the rib cage. I'm a 38DD and was afraid it wouldn't fit. I was able to wear a strapless bra all night with NO issues. the 12R was long enough for me to wear shoes with about a 2 inch wedge on them. Rent this dress!! You will not be sorry!!!
It was perfect! The zipper was very hard to zip but otherwise the dress was beautiful! I loved it! A bit long even with heels but I was very comfortable in it.

Runs very small! I really wanted to wear this dress but it ran very small. It was difficult to get on and off, but when I finally got it on, the zipper would not zip up. If I would've tried zipping it up all the way, either the zipper would have broken or the dress would've been very uncomfortable in that area; maybe even both. The chest area was very loose too. I think if I would have gone up to a size 10, it would have fit. It was a very beautiful dress, it just didn't fit me.

Rich in color and texture. Unique half-shoulder styling. I was choosing between five dresses and went with a different option. But this is a great dress. The length is perfect - for my height I could still wear heels and it grazed the floor - and it just wears so nicely. It's unique but still classically elegant. It's fitted, but comfortable and has pockets. The burgundy color is rich and subtle, but still eye-catching. I didn't use this dress, but for the right occasion, I would definitely consider it again.

Felt like a princess! I loved this dress! As others have said, it is pretty warm. A slit would have been a nice detail, but its still a gorgeous gown. The pockets are fantastic! This dress has NO stretch, so if you have a large chest, consider sizing up.

Beautiful & Comfortable!  I wore this dress for a military ball. I loved how comfortable it was! Even though it is bowl gown-esque it didn't feel like it. It was super light & had POCKETS! A few of the reviews I read mentioned that the top was a little loose, but I did not notice that at all. It fit me perfectly in the 6R and there were no issues with the top. I received many compliments all night, I would recommend this dress!

#michelleobamavibes Beautiful dress. Very light. Very airy. Zipper does suck but was fine when I went a size up. Got so many compliments that I look like michelle obama so there's that. This was my first time renting and I' will definitely do it again
I wore this dress for a Valentine's Day Photoshoot.  Loved the dress & the fit was perfect. The only thing that was a bit annoying  was the zipper.
Beautiful dress!   Dress runs a bit long (even when worn with 3 1/2" heels) but was fine for dancing.

Truly a beautiful dress! I got so many compliments, I felt like a princess! The fit was true to size, I'm usually on the taller end of sizes. So when I find a dress that fits, it's usually too short. But this dress was perfect with length.
Great dancing! Fit true to size - got many compliments.  Colors not as vibrant as photo, but still lovely.

This dress was absolutely jaw dropping on stage.  I hated to send it back! The dress does definitely run small. I'm usually a 2L and the 4L was snug.  I did rent both sizes, but in addition to the 2L being very tight, the zipper was completely impossible to zip up due to the way the fabric bunches in that area.  The 4L zipper was challenging, but OK once I figured out the trick to it.  
I wore this dress, and one other from RTR, for my new jazz show featuring the music and clubs of the 1930s and 40s.  It was gorgeous on stage, very flattering, and still allowed me to breathe correctly, which some formal gowns do not.  I received more compliments than I could count.

I would recommend only going with a long size if you are over 5'8".  I'm 5'8" and even in three-inch heels, it dragged the floor.  It wasn't an issue, but was definitely on the long side.

Beautiful, glamorous Old-Hollywood gown. This dress is pretty spectacular. The colors are rich and the slight texture of the damask looks elegant and expensive. It practically screams "movie premiere runway" with a very classic Hollywood style glamour. The bare shoulder is sexy without being skimpy, and the cut of the dress emphasized my waist beautifully. I am 5'4 and 130 lbs and I wore a size 4, which fitted nicely. I wore 3" gold heels, which made the dress barely skim the floor. No spanx required (thank goodness) although I did wear my do-to strapless bra. The dress is very womanly, and I was worried it would look sort of prom-dressy but it didn't at all. There was some tulle underskirt but it made the bottom of the dress bell out rather than a fully poof. I got compliments all night! I paired the dress with the RTR Nicole Miller Southern Plantation earrings and they were perfect- they allowed the dress to really shine while providing nice sparkle and emphasizing the glam overall nature of the dress. I loved the pockets and the fact the dress was lined. This dress would be perfect for a winter event- I wore it to a friend's dressy party and felt both holiday-appropriate and pretty.
Pretty dress. Fit was great. I'm petite, but received the 0R, which was fine with 3" heels. Nice, heavy fabric.

Best Dressed at the Gala! From the moment I walked in, people were raving about this dress. I was told by multiple people that my boyfriend and I were the best dressed at the gala. It was a thick fabric and beautifully made. At 5'6"/5'7" and an undisclosed weight ( ;) ), I'm usually between a 4L and a 6R and had to go with the 6R on this one as it was a little tight in the ribcage. I'm small chested though, so I had to add a little padding to fill out the top part. I also bought a crinoline skirt to make it a little fuller, but it was pretty even without it!

Beautiful gown for engagement pictures! I LOVE THIS GOWN! I wish I could wear it all the time. It is so flattering, gorgeous, and it has pockets! The 8L was a bit tight on me around the bust (36C) but the rest fit great -- I'm usually a 6 or 8L. My engagement photos turned out so incredibly gorgeous, I've gotten nothing but tons of compliments on this dress!

Love this dress! This dress is everything! Loved the color, and style. The reviews are right, the zipper is a challenge, sort of bunches up, definitely need a second person to assist. But other than that this dress is perfection! I received so many compliments on it. It's the perfect color combo for a winter gala, and no bra needed! Great dress, wish I could own it!

So many compliments and easy movement. This dress was amazing. The fit through the chest was just snug enough so I did not have to wear a strapless bra, but not so tight that breathing was difficult. The airiness of the skirt made it easy to move and dancing a breeze, plus...pockets! The length of the dress was slightly long for me (I'm 5,6" and wore 3" heels), but I received dozens of compliments and overall could not have asked for a better dress.

Loved this dress! Fit perfectly and got many many compliments! I was told it was the best dress at the wedding ;) 
Lots of fun to twirl in and just really stunning - felt wonderful in it.
Beautiful dress!   I am 5'7, 135 lbs and the regular 6 was a better fit than the long 4.
This dress made me feel so glamorous and was SO COMFORTABLE.  Amazing fit! I'm 5'9" and still had to wear very high heels so it wouldn't drag on the floor.
fits exactly true to size fits exactly true to size. great for pear shaped girls. i got many compliments from both men and women!

Showstopper Dress Got tons of compliments on the dress. Fit is true to size. Smallest part is waist and zipper hugs the curves, but for a true 0, it will not be a problem.  Only negative was the length. Even with 4 inch heels, I still needed 2.5-3" of lemgth taken up by a tailor who put itemporary loop stich. Worksd like a charm though.

Great dress for my formal work Christmas party! This is a beautiful dress. I wish this size would have come in "long" as I am 6 ft tall and the dress stopped at the top of my feet.  A few more inches would have been great. I received a ton of compliments on this dress! And pockets are always a plus!

Loved the pockets! I could keep my phone close for pictures without having to carry it around This was a good fit for me because I have a small back/chest and a curvy bottom.  The top part of the dress fit me snug down to my waist (which was very sliming) and then the skirt flared out.  It was very flattering.
Attended a Cotillion Scholarship Ball. Gorgeous dress and it fit perfectly. The pockets were absolutely a bonus. I received many compliments and would recommend this dress for any formal occasion.

New years eve wedding and this dress had me ringing in the compliments all night long! The fit was perfect. It was a bit long, but I ordered it that way. The extra length really helped with the dramatics of the dress.
I absolutely loved this dress.  Its classy and beautiful.  The pockets are the best! I wish the shoulder was tighter.  Otherwise, it was the perfect dress!

Gorgeous Dress = lots of compliments! I wore this to my friend's black tie wedding, and got so many compliments in person & on social media. This dress runs true to size, but is pretty tight at the rib cage.  It is also not very long - at 5'7", it barely touched the floor & I had to wear flats.  I thought it was very flattering - covering up my problem stomach area. Loved the pockets!  The zipper was ridiculously tough to get up - there was zero chance I could do it myself, and I actually had to WD-40 the zipper with a cotton ball in order to get it closed.   The fabric is a little warm, I think it may be too hot for a late spring/summer wedding.  I think the crinoline underneath gave it just enough "pouf" to make a statement, without being obnoxious.  I loved this dress & didn't want to take it off, or return it!  :)

I felt incredible all night and received so many compliments! The dress fit perfect. If I owned it I would have had it hemmed up a little, but it worked (I am 5'4"). The whole process of delivery and return was seamless - no pun intended. :)

So many compliments! Favorite Rent the Runway dress so far! I wore this for a work Christmas Party. It was perfect! The fit is very true to size, maybe runs a teeny bit large. I normally wear a 0 and this fit very well. It could have been a little more snug up top, so smaller chested gals may want to add a padded bra. I got the 0L because the 0R was already rented, it was pretty long, I wore 4 inch heels and there was still about 1/2 inch of fabric on the floor. Also, the pockets.....YESSS!! I highly recommend this dress!

I had to wear my backup dress.  Beautiful material and the cut of the dress is lovely. It was perfectly long and the colors are just right for a fall or winter wedding. However, the rib cage area was so tight that I could not zip it closed. The bust, waist and hips fit perfectly but my rib cage was too big for the area. This dress would be perfect for someone with a 32 or 34" bra size. I wound up having to wear a different dress.

I received so many compliments on a stunning dress! The dress fit perfectly and was great for the gala dinner with the the Black, White and Red Hot Jazz theme. I was approached by numerous people telling me that they loved my dress.  It was very light for a ball gown style and comfortable all evening. I paired it with a pashmina style wrap as it is very cold here in the winter, and I normally don't go sleeveless. 

One note: the zipper is in an awkward place, under the arm, so make sure you have someone around to help you get dressed.  It also gets stuck if it is not pretty close to flat so it is definitely not a one person job to zip up. Other than that, no complaints.

Black Tie Glamour! The length was perfect. I'm 5'2 and wore 4inch heels and it swooped along the floor; I wasn't tripping over it or dragging it. I'm very petite on top (have to wear petite blazers,etc.) so I could have pulled up the shoulder about an inch but it was totally manageable. The fabric is beautiful; there's a nice sheen to it and varying rich red tones. Most importantly it has pockets!! I was attending a black tie party at the Metropolitan Museum of Art so I added a pair of black velvet gloves. It was a showstopper and I would definitely recommend it. The cut of the dress makes it work for all body types.

SHOWSTOPPER! Received compliments all night long on this dress I was unsure of my dress size so I ordered this in both a 6R and 8R. I ended up going with the 8R for the fit but the length was a bit too long for my 5'3" height with 4 inch platform heels. It was a long dress but it wasn't heavy and I was able to dance all night! The one shoulder was extremely comfortable but does need a larger chest in order to feel secure without fear of popping out. I chose to not wear a bra which was an added bonus but still felt held in. The waist was comfortable and flattering for my hourglass figure.
It's a true ball gown made for a special event It runs slightly big, if you're short, be mindful to get a regular fit.

Inaugural Margarita Ball, charity event. I'm 5'9", 130lbs, 36A. The dress fit perfectly, there was room in the bodice so would work for a bigger bust. Length was perfect with 3' heel. Really elegant, got many compliments!

Took a chance on a rental and it paid off! I really liked this dress and was perfect for the occasion. I am 5ft. 4 in. and weigh about 130 lbs. and the size 4R fit well although even with 3 inch heels it was a little long. (I have short legs and a long torso). The skirt is full but not so much that it got in the way. The fabric is really nice and overall the dress was not too heavy. I would definitely rent this one again.

Beautiful Dress, perfect for a wedding! I am usually a size 6, but the 6 did NOT fit and the 8 was so tight i had to have my husband help me into it and zip it up. Other than it being really tight, i had no other issues...received many compliments all night! Loved the pockets! I would recommend this dress to everyone, just order a bigger size!

Perfect for the occasion! I rented this dress for my daughter's elementary school graduation. I was on the PTA and I'm the chairperson for the 5th grade committee. I was told that I had to say a speech at the graduation.  I wanted to wear something that would hide my imperfections but still look really classy AND conservative for the occasion. This dress did it for me. I wore the size 2 instead of the 4 because it was the first dress I tried on and it fit perfect. I loved that it fell just below my knees. Im not a fan of very short dresses. Basically I have no complaints about the dress. Everyone said I looked great so I got my monies worth.
So Classy! This dress looked great. The fit was perfect and it hugged every curve. I added a bronzed belt to match my purse and it just set the dress off even more.

Wish I owned this dress! I love this dress, it hugs perfectly without being too tight or uncomfortable. The material is very light, but still works for a semi-formal/cocktail event. The cut is super flattering, and I really regret not getting my picture taken in it.

Next time I'll rent the 2, and there will be a next time! As another reviewer put it, this is a great dress but lacks the "wow!" factor, so reserve it for something where you want to look great but it's not necessarily "YOUR" night (birthday, shower, etc). 

In terms of size, I usually wear a 4 unless the top is tight and then I need a 6. I rented the 4 and 6, and wish I had the two. The 4 fit great on top but was a little loose in the midsection (I don't have wide hips at all, I wish it were more fitted here).

This dress was really flattering and such a classic style! I loved the fit and how flattering it was to wear.  The only complaint was that the slit in the front felt a little higher than in the picture so I kept tugging the dress down all night. My date said no one else even paid attention but I was just worried the slit would get bigger!

Great LBD LOVED the neck line.  Super fun.  The front slit in the skirt rides up quite a bit when you sit down showing a little too much.  I was counting on a table cloth at dinner to keep me modest but had to settle for a napkin.
great dress that is so easy to dress up...wrinkle free fabric is a A+++ very comfortable dress ...love the fabric

My anniversary dinner with my husband  I ordered this as a back up dress. Luckily, the dress I really wanted fit beautifully so I didn't have to wear this. It looks better on the model. It ran big and the material was not as nice as I anticipated.
Comfortable dress, breezy fabric for a black dress. Great customer service. Too safe, going with color next time.

Classy and Flattering I wore this to my brother's wedding and received a ton of compliments.  The neckline is unique and makes the dress versatile:  It can be dressed up (shoes and accessories) for a more formal event, or dressed down for a daytime business event.  The fabric is a bit textured, which I didn't realize but liked, and it offers enough stretch to look like it was built for my body.  It was super flattering and comfortable.  I'd love to rent it again!
Perfect dress for business holiday party The fit was great.  My middle body is my worse feature.  The dress worked well for me!
Runs pretty large I didn't end up wearing this dress although the fabric felt comfortable. It swallowed me up. Too long and wide.

Dress looked great! I wore this dress to a company executive dinner and thought it was great although perhaps a tad too revealing for me for the occasion. The zipper was a little tough to pull up even when the dress wasn't on and seemed a bit worn. Looked and fit great though!

Stunning dress- compliments the entire evening. I am between a size 4 and 6, I tried on the six first and didn't bother trying on the size 4 until right before the event- realizing that the smaller size actually fit better and hugged my curves beautifully. If you're between sizes, I'd recommend sizing down if you want it to look as figure hugging as it does on the model. Be careful when sitting down because the dress becomes SIGNIFICANTLY shorter and the slit at the front makes it very revealing. I got stopped the entire evening by people who loved the dress. The dress is great for busty girls because even though I sized down, nothing was too revealing up at the top and nothing was "spilling" out of the dress.

Perfect subtle flare for a formal rehearsal dinner! My boyfriend was a groomsman in a wedding, so we had plenty of events to attend, one of which being a rehearsal dinner in a private room at one of San Francisco's nicer restaurants - clearly I had to look good! I wanted something simple and elegant, but with a little pizzazz, and this little black dress did the trick. Knee length with a slit, to keep it classy, and the neckline was stunning! I could wear it with my normal bra and it showed just the appropriate amount of cleavage. The shoulders were a little tight for me, but I tend to have broader shoulders than most, and hips were a little snug, but with some (very light!) spanx, it all worked out perfectly. Even with all eyes on the bride-to-be, my boyfriend's friends couldn't stop complimenting.

The dress was not as flattering as I had hoped - it looks much better on the stock photo model Neckline is very conservative - actually cut higher than the photo shows. The material was different and not what I expected but actually fine - it was a heavy-weight crepe-like fabric. Also the body of the dress was just not very flattering.,. actually made me feel larger than I was. Not really satisfied with the dress but I unfortunately had to settle because I didn't have any other options.
It was not the dress for me.  I need a little more give. I was pretty.  But not the dress for me - I usually wear a 12 - and got the 14 as a back up and both were too tight across my midsection.

Great wedding! Dress was great for the wedding night. I can't tell you the last time I wore a size 2 in any dress, but I managed to pull it off. I have a fairly athletic build, but the 4 was a tad too big. I did not necessarily feel drop dead gorgeous, but it was exactly the simple/classic look I wanted for the night. I loved the neckline (I don't have a good picture of the front - sorry!), and thankfully there was a small slit in the front or else my crossfit thighs would not have made it. I would rent this dress if you are looking for a nice, basic LBD.

Stunning! Beautiful dress. I wore this to my cousin's wedding & I received many compliments on it. I was very comfortable in it and was able to wear a regular bra with no issues. I'm short, and it went down to my knees and I loved the slit in the front which gave it an even sexier look. I would rent this again.

Elegant and classy I needed a striking dress for a serious business-related date, but also something elegant and classy.   This really accomplished all of that.   The neckline is very feminine without being too revealing. And the slit in the bottom of the narrow skirt made it easy to walk in.   A great pair of heels, clutch, and simple pearl drop earrings was all that was needed.   I would love to this travel with!   It doesn't wrinkle, folds up small, isn't heavy, and stops traffic in the streets!
Great versatile dress.  Could be worn to work or to a wedding.   Wonderful dress that is super versatile.  I wish I owned it to wear to work on a regular basis.

I wore this dressy to the Midwest News Emmy's in Chicago. Loved it!  The fit was great. Knee length dress, with very minimal slit... Perfect for semi-formal events. I was able to wear a regular bra and the straps were hidden which is always a plus!

LBD. felt sexy and sophisticated for our 3 yr. anniversary dinner.  fit well on the bottom, a bit looser on the top. Very slimming and had a good stretch yet also supported. I had to keep tucking my bra straps back under the dress straps but I probably could of just tighten those to begin with.

As the maid of honor, I wanted to feel like a knockout: this dress was perfect! My bride was proud! My backup was an 8 because I'd been working out a little. The 10 fit beautifully, though, and had a small bit of stretch in the fabric. It's a lovely dress and I received compliments all night! I have 0 cons, only pros: this is my first of many outfits from this company! Thank you so much!
Cousin's wedding I wore this dress to my cousin's wedding and absolutely loved it! I was a stretchy fabric and very forgiving in your problem areas. I would definitely rent it again!

Perfect for my niece's wedding.   I ordered the 12 with a backup of a size 10 (as I am always somewhere in between) and was very pleased with the fit of the 10.  It was elegant and I had tons of compliments and felt very glamorous!  This is my first Rent the Runway experience, certainly won't be my last.  Super easy return, too!
Great look and a show stopper. Ordered this dress for New Year's parties and received many compliments. The size is true fit and very comfortable.

The front cut was unique and stood out I usually wear a 4  or medium but the 2 fit perfectly. Actually it runs a bit large.  I wish I had a better picture. The cut was so beautiful. And I belted it to give it an extra pop. It's sexy but in a classic formal way.  The material has a thick sweater feel, but it still feels light. I felt I stood out and I loved it.

Classic black dress. The neckline and shape make it sophisticated and flattering.  The neckline and shape make it sophisticated and flattering. Conservative enough for a professional event with a shawl.

Felt like $1 million bucks!!! The dress fit good. It was waiting for me as I arrived home after work.  I went with the size 10. It was a little snug in the bodice, but you need that to get the hourglass figure. The size 12 just didn't hit my curves right. The material is like a gabardine fabric with a slight texture. If you look close you will see it. If fit perfect everywhere else. The armholes are the right size and I didn't have to adjust the dress throughout the night. I wore a regular bra which did not peek through anywhere, and no spanx. I didn't feel I needed it. Make sure you have the right underwear so you don't have pantylines. 

I also rented a cuff and felt it had it's day with this dress. I did not rent a necklace because I didn't want to take away from the gorgeous neckline. 

I already rented again with RTR. It is so easy!!!!! Love it!!! I feel like all the added photos from everyone really helped my selection, so I just had to share!! This is a great dress.
I loved the material! I It was simple and beautiful. Very comfortable. I was actually surprised that the 14 fit.

Great neckline and silhouette for a little black dress I wore this to a fall funeral in Canada and it was the perfect level of conservative and formal, when I paired it with a black moto jacket and black tights. Very comfortable. If I could own this dress without the funeral memories, I definitely would.

Classic Look This dress was a great option for our annual Christmas Party. I am an hourglass/pear shape and float in between a size 4 and 6 right now, and loved how this style fit. It was a little stretched out in the top half but overall, a really lovely fit. The neckline was great for my drop necklace and I received complements all night.
beautiful neckline and front split- beautiful but conservative- good for work event-simply beautiful fit well all around a bit big in the waist but a size small would have been too tight in hips-

I think the dress looks elegant -- perfect for an outdoor wedding. I thought the dress looked great.  However I do think it runs just a little small -- The description on the website recommended that I choose a size up for my back-up and I should have listened.  Typically size 12 fits me fine -- this dress was a little snug, but I don't think anyone noticed but me.  I chose size 10 for my back-up  -- in some brands I am a 10, so I thought I was safe.  There is no way I could have fit into it -- good thing the 12 fit OK.

Loved this dress! This is definitely one of those dresses that looked way better on than on the hanger. It fit beautifully and I kept it simple with red and black earrings and a pair of Christian Loubitans!  Will rent this one again.

Classic LBD - Always a Hit I felt like this dress ran a little small, but I have a larger chest and wide hips so that might be why.  I usually wear a 4 or a 6 in dresses, but I ordered the 6 and 8 in this dress and went with the 8 for comfort.  I loved that I could wear a regular bra with this and I also wore Spanx for a little extra cinching, but they were definitely not necessary.  The slit in the middle was the only somewhat down part about this dress, but once you get used to it and remember its there it isn't a problem.

Sexy and Sophisticated This dress was comfortable and easy to dance in.  I had rented a different dress but it didn't look right on me so I rented this instead.  I really didn't want to wear black but I felt amazing in this!  Its not too low-cut so those of us with a bigger chest needn't feel exposed- gave just the right amount of cleavage.  Lots of compliments too!
stretchy but thick material so it fits really well.  I received a lot of compliments the zipper didn't work on the Size 12 but I didn't need that size afterall
LOVED THIS DRESS, Very pleased  at the superior quality and fit of this fabulous dress.  Pictures hardly do this dress justice. I would rent again without hesitation!

Good Rental! This dress was nice.  There was nothing particularly special about it, but it was classic and fit well.  I wore it to a wedding, and my goal was not to "stand out" anyways (so "classic" was perfect).  The dress fit well.  I rented the size 4 as well and could have worn it, but chose to wear the 6 to give myself a little more room.  The material has some give to it and the dress is great quality.  I recommend this to anyone looking for a nice, simple dress.
Did not get to wear, Nice dress, but a little too informal for the party I was attending True to fit dress, I am a 38DD in the chest and very petite, size 10 or 12

This was the perfect dress for a cocktail attire fundraiser! This was the perfect LBD: very simple and basic so as not to be flashy (I was staffing the event and speaking), but the neckline and the slit in the skirt made it interesting and flirty.  I wore it with a chunky mixed pearl necklace and got a TON of compliments!  The dress fit true to size and was incredibly flattering.  I am 5'5" and 115; I wear a size 2 in most clothing and the 2 fit like a dream.
Almost date night! It fit well. The cleavage was a bit too much for me though...

Classy and simple This wasn't the knockout dress I was hoping for, but it was a very easy-to-wear look (no outrageous bras, etc needed) that was flattering and fun to pair with my more out-there accessories. Perfect for a night that's not YOUR night but you still want to look pulled together.
Nice dress, flexible fabric. It was a nice dress, but I may be running closer to a size 16, so I had to pull the skirt down throughout the night.
I got a lot of compliments. This was my first rental and will do it again! Fabric stretched and was very comfortable. Very flattering.

I love this dress! It is the third time I've rented it.  I ordered a 6 & 8 and the 8 definitely fit better. The material had "give" for a very comfortable fit. The neckline was very flattering but conservative enough for a Chamber event.

This dress was comfortable and easy to wear- I was even dancing in it!  Fit TTS and very elegant. It hit right above my knee and was form fitting, but not to tight.  There is a nice give to the fabric.  I liked the different silhouette of the neckline and it was easy to dress up with fun jewelry.  I would highly recommend for a date or party!
I actually rented this dress twice for 2 separate weddings! I absolutely loved it!  I wore the size 4 but I felt that I could have worn the size 2 - there is a lot of give in the dress.

This was a classic dress that I felt comfortable and elegant wearing.  I usually wear a 4 but order a 6 as backup. I wish I'd gotten the 2 for this one though. The bust seemed to be made for someone much larger than me!  I made it work but would have liked to try a smaller size.

I was presenting at a large international conference and looking Fab helped the whole package,  Love the neckline. The detail was very feminine and sophisticated. Would buy from RTR when its finally on sale.

Great dress for a work event I rented this dress for a work holiday party and paired it with the Ben-Amun Emerald City Necklace and Crislu Laurel Green Drop Earrings.  The dress was appropriate for a work party.  The neckline is conservative.  The overall fit runs large -- I usually wear an 8 and wore a 6 in this dress.  Overall, I was happy with the dress for the occasion, but wouldn't want the same dress for an occasion where I would want a more fitted look.
Fun spin on the LBD! Loved the material, and it was a very easy-to-wear dress ... no special undergarments needed.

Classic cut, interesting neckline i. loved. this. dress. I wore it to my boyfriend's brother's wedding. And this was perfect for that, especially since the whole family was going to be there. The dress hit right at the knee. I would've liked it about 2 inches higher, but I'm short (5'4") so it was normal. The slit made it easy to walk around in and material was breathable, a bit stretchy even. The main thing I loved about it was the neckline. It takes a twist on a black dress while still keeping it classic and timeless. I wish I could buy this dress because I would wear it all the time.

The dress was elegant and classic.  I received compliments all night. The fit was perfect.  The dress has a bit of stretch so it hugs every curve great.  It was absolutely true to size and very flattering.
Great dress. Simple but elegant. Would rent again. True to size. Very comfortable. Great fabric

This dress was great!  I rented this dress for a black tie event for my boyfriends company. It was such a great LBD (little black dress). It fit perfectly - I'm almost always a true to size 6 and that was definitely true for this dress as well. It's simple but the neck line was a great little detail. Would definitely recommend!

Classic black with a twist Classic (probably-should-own-it) black dress. The unique neckline and the front slit keep it modern instead of matronly. The neckline almost makes me think of 'genie in a bottle'. :) The fabric was so comfortable with lots of give. I enjoyed wearing this dress!

Elegant LBD! This dress was effortless to wear. It was very comfortable and fit extremely well. I wore to a professional development event were black was the requested attire. I wish I could have kept it as a staple in my wardrobe.

All that sparkle! This dress was fabulous!  It was forgiving over curves and was comfortable to dance in all night.  Has a thin lining to help protect your skin from the scratchy sequins, and a loop you can tape/pin your bra strap to on the inside to not damage the dress but avoid bra strap showing due to the wide neck.  I fit into both the M and the L no problem, the M was a bit shorter but either could have worked.  Definitely do your hair AFTER you put on the dress, as it is a bit of an ordeal, and much easier if you have some assistance.  Per usual with RTR, in a room full of awesome dresses people went out of their way to compliment mine!

Weird ruching made dress hang crooked.  Man, I really wanted to love this dress! The color was lovely, but that's where it stops. The ruching was off on the sides of this dress so that it pulled up one side higher than the other. It pulled so tight that even the chest was off kilter .  It also made me look very overweight which was surprising. I am a super athletic, 5'7 135lbs. Not overweight in my book, but even my husband said it made me look frumpy. But, he also admitted it could have been just the way the ruching on this one was so uneven. It looks so great on other people, I'm sure it's just this one.
Great dress!  Very shiny! This dress definitely stood out.  I have auburn hair and the color was fantastic!

Wore this to a New Year's Eve wedding. Suffice to say it was a show stopper.  Ordered a medium and large. Both fit well but the large was a little loose on top, so I wore the medium. A bit scratchy on the arms but it is forgiveable. Ruffles do a great job hiding the tummy. It fit like a glove.

Glamorous!  Everyone said I looked like a movie star. I had my hair done in a finger wave. I wore peep toe, black patent leather heals, gold and diamond hanging earrings and a sparkly bracelet. I lined my eyes with black and green with red lips. The dress fits great because its stretchy. I'm 5'8" and it hit 2" above my knees. Shows a little cleavage but for the most part very modest. I will definitely rent a dress again from Rent the Runway!

The dress was fun, but didn't fit perfectly  It fit well, except somehow I was expecting it to be more slinky & less with the sequins. The ruching on the sides added extra fabric through the middle that didn't lie in a particularly flattering way because of the sequins. Still, it was a fun dress!

Britney Spears + sequins = winning. Fit like a glove. The green color was perfect with my blonde hair and hazel eyes. The length was good. I'd come make sure you had a good push-up bra. The arms were tight, but not restrictive. I wore this all night to the Britney Spears concert in Vegas and then we went dancing afterward, so it was comfortable enough for that kind of movement! I didn't give it five stars because there were some loose strings on the dress and the slip underneath kept riding up, so I did have to pull it down and readjust a bit.

The dress fit the theme of the party very well and looked great among the xmas trees and lights The dress was a great color for my skin tone and hair and fit the theme of the Christmas Tree Lot party very well. It is a bodycon style, with little to no give, so I fidgeted quite a lot. Size up if you can!

I love this dress. It was a smash hit and everyone loved it. I received so many compliemnts on it.  The dress is fitted but it has a side zipper. There is slight ruching on one side near the bottom and has some stretch but it is not too much. RTR made my first rental experience a great one. The dress arrived on time and I am glad the second size free was sent. I ended up needing a larger size.  I could have worn the original zise but the larger one was a much better fit.

Dancing the night away in a pretty green sparkly dress!  The medium was a little big from the back so I went with a small and it was great! Just make sure to order your normal size and one size down to be on the safe side. It was a great dress that definitely catches everyone's attention!

Pretty color, comfortable, lots of compliments I would have done better with a L, which wasn't available. The XL had extra fabric around the belly, which, maybe due to the rouching, actually added a little bulk.  But, the M sort of smashed my bust and it smelled bad inside, as well.  I pushed up the sleeves to 3/4 length and they held there all night with no problem. 
I would rent this again if I could get the L.

My husband's unit had a Ball in March, so I thought a shamrock green dress would be perfect! I love short skirt/long sleeve dress combos, and this one was gorgeous! Multiple compliments on the color, which really popped out in a sea of black. I've got Crossfit arms so the sleeves were a little tight, but not enough to bump up a size. And because of the sequins, I didn't wear any other accessories- thought it would be too much. Great dress!

Loved the dress! Super sparkly and got a lot of compliments!
 

 I got a lot of compliments on this dress and felt fabulous! It's a little scratchy but not too bad. It's also a lot more green than it looks in the pictures. Overall a great look and I was very happy with it!

Great cut! PROS: This dress was a really great cut! It hit at the right length on my legs and showed off the girls very nicely. It was also really flattering because of the way the fabric gathered in the stomach area. 
CONS: The sleeves were REALLY tight and did not have any lining. I would have preferred to wear the small because the medium was a bit big on me, but i couldnt even get the small on my arms. The sleeves have no lining so there is no stretch to it like the rest of the dress. Also, my hair kept catching on the sequins so, wear your hair up!

A formal work event with a 'sparkle' theme! Dress fit great and I couldn't have been happier. There was slight gathering on the side that made this form fitted dress much more wearable for a fuller figure. You will definitely get you noticed!

Wore this to the Boston Celtics Shamrock Gala and received multiple compliments on the dress. It fit like a glove! Despite all of the sequins, it wasn't scratchy at all and the length was perfect for a professional networking event. I paired the dress with light gold accessories to finish the look. All in all, this dress is amazing. I'd highly recommend it.

My "other" dress This was my backup so I never wound up wearing it, but when I tried it on I was surprised at how flattering it was.  I'm not big on sequins, but this was tastefully done.  Definitely a great dress for a party.  I only didn't give it 5 stars, because again, I don't love sequins.

The color was great, the sequins were well-done, it looked expensive, and I felt like a rockstar.  In early April, I wore this dress to a formal (black-tie-optional) charity event in Virginia. The color was beautiful. It fit well through the arms, and the side rouching was flattering on my mid-section. I was worried about the length of the dress (I'm 5'7) but, at an inch or 2 above the knee, it was just long enough to be appropriate. This dress was the perfect storm: the sleeve-length, dress-length, sequins, and color were a perfect combination. I felt right at home among the other cocktail and full-length gowns at the event.
Pros: everything
Cons: the sequins did rub together a bit under my arms and a string came loose but neither posed a problem for me in my particular dress.
Note: I didn't wear stockings with this, it was warm enough not to need them.

Worn for a work event at the auto show The dress fit great and was so easy to transport- no need to worry about wrinkles as the entire dress is sequins. There really isn't much stretch in the dress but I didn't find it uncomfortable. This dress fit in perfectly at the auto show and the long sleeves made it a great choice for winter.
Fit well, long sleeves made it great for a December work party. Gorgeous, tons of compliments.

Black tie gala I'd never been to before with the flashiest dress I'd ever worn!  I was so nervous to order what looked like a pretty form-fitting dress, but my anxiety was unfounded. The slight bunching at the waist hid my belly and allowed me the confidence to enjoy the night. Plus the sequins add such an exciting element I don't think anyone would have even noticed any of my imperfections. I tried on the medium (my original order) first but then realized the small (free backup) fit much better. Word of wisdom: the bunching at the waist backfires if you go a size up - the small was much more flattering for this. I got compliments on the dress all night long (went from black tie gala to a show at a bar) and it was super comfortable all night. I'd definitely rent again and recommend!

This dress looks great under lights! Thought it would be to much with the sequins but it looked great on. Loved the fit and it is VERY comfortable to wear. Got lots of compliments. The only con I have is when dancing it keep shifting a little to one side. But this dress didn't fit me super tight so it could of been then reason.

The green sequins were fabulous!  Good fit Great dress when you want something sexy, but to be somewhat covered up in the arms or a pale chest/shoulders.  Nice for colder events.  The arms and bust were snug, but I have 36D chest, so I needed the large to accommodate.  Also, I would order this dress if you are much taller than 5'9', unless you are ok with it going from mid-thigh to mini dress.  I wouldn't have wanted this dress a drop shorter.  I got a lot of compliments and it photographed well

Absolutely perfect for NYE I was nervous at first when I received the dress and tried to put it on. Not the easiest dress to get on,  you have to pull it over your head, so the sequins scratch quite a bit. Once on it fit perfectly. I received compliments on the color all night, and would absolutely recommend this rental to anyone looking to make a statement.

I got a lot of compliments and felt great :) This dress was pretty great. I wore it for a fall wedding and didn't have to wear a jacket because of the sleeves. The fit was comfortable, but a bit funky; it was tight at the bust and hip but the ruching was very loose at the waist and bunched on the left side, causing me to pull the lining down often. Also, had to put my hair up b/c it kept getting caught in the sequins!

But, once I kept getting compliments on the dress, I stopped noticing these things! I was comfortable enough to dance in the dress and really did feel great in it. Would consider renting this one again.

Super fun dress, easy to wear and got lots of compliments! I normally wear about a 6.  I have an hourglass and athletic figure  The S fit, but the M had a little more room so was more comfortable for me.  I didn't feel that there was much stretch in the fabric, the sequins of course are a little stiff.  Its a little awkward getting it on, the sleeves are fitted, but once in it - it was very easy to wear.  I loved the color, a really nice emerald green and of course its very sparkly.  I wore it to our holiday party, and received lots of compliments.  Its just a really fun dress and I felt really good in it.  I would definitely recommend this dress for the holiday season.

Perfect for a glam take on Medusa.  Loved this dress for a fancy, glamorous Halloween costume. I accessorized with snakes and more snakes, and of course fishnets for an extra-scaly look. The dress is a bit tricky to get into but pretty comfortable once it's on. I think the XS might have been a better fit as the S felt a bit loose in the waist and arms, but once it was on I didn't feel like going through the hassle of getting out of it and into another one because I was scared of messing up my snake hair. 

Very fun dress to wear and I wish I owned it!

I recently wore this dress to Britney Spears in Las Vegas, and received compliments all night long! The dress fit very well. It was a little shorter than I was expecting as it wasn't as long on me as on the model photographed. The only real negative was that I have long hair and it kept getting caught on the sequins. It was worth it though:) I had some hiccups with receiving the dress and returning it, but that was more a factor of being at a hotel in Vegas than anything RTR did. I would definitely rent this dress again!

Great party dress! Flattering and comfortable! I was looking for something that was both fabulous and easy to dance in and this was the perfect dress. I knew I was going to be in the dress for a long night and I was so happy with how comfortable and flattering it was. It hugged my curves nicely, while still being slimming around my tummy. It was also nice to be able to wear a normal bra. The long sleeves made the sequins easier to wear (with no sleeves, they always cut up the inside of my arms). Perfect length, not too short for the dance floor but just sexy enough.

It was perfect for a holiday party- it really stood out! I ordered the medium and the small. I usually wear a six so I assumed the medium would fit. I was glad I ordered the small because the medium looked a bit big. It fit snugly- but it seemed like there was extra fabric that bunched around my stomach a bit. The small fit like a dream!
I can't wait to have a reason to use this site again!

The dress is gorgeous and I felt like a movie star in it!  The dress fits very snug. I ended up wearing the medium. I got so many compliments on the dress all night! It was perfect for my wedding rehearsal dinner (my bridesmaids wore green the next day!!).

Awesome formal and fun dress  I wore this for a nice company 125th anniversary party at a museum. Rented the 1X and 2X and wore the 1X. 
I'm 5'4" and it fell right around the knee. It had the right amount of "cling" and the dress has a little give so you can sit/walk around comfortable and it will contour to different shapes. I typically wear an 18 in pants and it was just right in the hips. The gathering at the side helps distract from a belly.

Beautiful! But.. pretty sure one size was stretched out I typically do really well with Badgley Mischka, and this was no different. I was worried about the green based on the review photos, it looked kinda metallic in some and really bright on others. Loved the color -- it was an emerald  that looked almost black in some light. I ordered the xs and the s, the small was a way different fit..it seemed like it had been stretched out in the stomach. Which was a bummer because the xs was a little short for the event I was going to (hit above mid thigh, but I have really long legs). Super cute, I just had to pair it with tights to be appropriate for my husbands work holiday party. I wanted to rent it again in black for NYE but it sold out! Thanks RTR!

Great holiday dress! This is a fabulous holiday dress. The green sequins sit on a black dress so it was actually darker than I thought, but I liked it. When the light catches the sequins it really sparkles. I have worn sequin dresses before that were very scratchy, but I thought this one was comfortable. I did wear it with black tights b/c it was cold outside, so i can't say wether or not it would be scratchy on bare legs. I would recommend it for any formal holiday party!

This dress is a STUNNER! I fell in love with the top of this dress. The neckline and sleeves were so flattering and helped lengthen and slim my arms (which is an insecurity of mine). I typically wear a size 20 with lots of room in the midsection but the 2X in this dress ran far too snug for my liking so I went with the backup size 3X and a pair of spanx. (without the spanx it hugged my lower belly area a little too much for my liking). The reviews were accurate as far as wearing your hair down, so if you have your heart set on doing that I would save this dress for an updo occasion. Overall yet another RTR WIN!!!!
The compliments, the sparkle, fun ,fun, fun!!! The fit was awesome. I felt very comfortable in the dress. It had a slimming effect.
Very pretty dress Very pretty dress. It fits a little snugger in the hips and tummy than I wanted it to, so just make sure you have a pretty flat tummy if you want to wear this.

Amazing dress!! I got a million compliments on this dress. I felt sexy and I was so comfy in it! I felt like it ran true to size. I have a full chest and I felt very comfy in this dress. The long sleeves were my favorite part. It was low cut but nothing too exposing and it hit just above the knee. I LOVED THIS DRESS!!

Got lots of compliments! The size L fit like a size 8 would.  The size M was more like a 4/6. I was a little worried about the cleavage showing too much, so I pinned the shoulders to my bra.  So sparkly.  Would rent again.  Customer service was great!

Beautiful dress! Fantastic and flattering dress -- the 2X is rather small for that size, but has plenty of room for a 14 or 16. The ruching and draping is very flattering, and the dress is quite comfortable. The green color is beautiful!

I wore this dress to a pageant to cheer on my friend who competed and I got compliments ALL night!!! Fit is kinda tight, i recommend going one size up. hard to get into because of the delicate beading but overall definitely worth it!!!

Gorgeous color that made this a perfect fit for something other than black! Fits true to size, I did need some undergarments to make me feel better about the waist. I'm full busted and this did show a bit of that - but in a tasteful way. I was worried that the color was going to be "too much" but it was a tasteful green - not too over-the top. Would definitely rent this again.

Wore this for my nephew's evening wedding. I wanted something dramatic and flattering  I was able to wear the small but decided on the medium instead. Both were hard to zip into and definitely needs to go over your head. My spanx one piece hid any tummy bulge and I got compliments from men and women alike... Including the bride. Very comfortable and easy to dance in, which was important to me. But most importantly, it was flattering.
Beautiful dress, but I couldn't wear it Lining in right breast was sticking out.  I couldn't wear it.  Also, the dress didn't sit right on my shoulders.  I was pretty disappointed.

I wore this dress to my Christmas party and it was the perfect festive frock. This dress has some stretch and rouching to it, but there's only a small side zipper, so you have to pull it on over your head. I'd recommend doing your hair after since the sequins catch when you slip it on.  I wore small and it was perfect - the backup XS wouldn't go over my hips
Loved this dress for NYE! Fit like a glove. Neckline is asymmetrical (supposed to be that way).  Would definitely rent again!
Great dress.  Picked the XS because it was a little shorter on.   Sequins did get caught a little on hair but not a big deal.

Wonderful sparkly green dress for a St Pat's fundraiser-it was a hit! Fit was true to size & a little forgiving because of the gathered sides.  Make sure that you have the side zipper down & pull the dress up so that the lining lays flat. You may need an extra hand getting the invisible zipper up because of the gathering.  Very comfortable once on!

A great dress to stand out in! I ordered the L and the XL to wear for my 30th birthday party. The L was a little tight in the hips so I ended up wearing the XL. The XL was little loose in the shoulders, but not unmanageable. I loved the rouching in the stomach and that it had some elasticity (especially for sequins). It was actually really comfortable for a long evening. I got so many compliments on this dress and felt like a rockstar. Definitely not a blend into the crowd kind of dress!
I feel like a million bucks Sleeves were snug, and I would have liked a deeper V for more room in the bust

Sparkly holiday fun! I really enjoyed my rental - prompt, hassle free delivery, no issues at all. The dress is incredibly sparkly, a great color to stand out in the crowd, and easy to wear. Overall it is flattering, as other reviewers have said, but I did feel like the ruching made my post-baby tummy look a little rounder than it usually looks in my clothes (not usually my trouble spot) - I was able to wear the Small but opted for the Medium, because it was more forgiving on my stomach area, though made the v pretty deep. Great length, easy to entertain in, no tugging or riding. I went with bare legs and a pewter shoe and didn't have any trouble with itching. I recommend this!
So many compliments and such a fun, sparkly dress to wear! No complaints whatsoever!

Perfect to party in! I wore this dress to a work Christmas party and it was an absolute show stopper.  People are still saying how great the dressed looked!  I ordered the XS and S and wore the XS because I wanted it a little tighter, both fit perfectly though.  The dress has a little give to it, so really either size would work.  The dress has a thin lining underneath the sequins, so I noticed that you could still feel the sequins at the hem line and sometimes around the cuffs.  It wasn't really noticeable to me once I got moving though.  The dress is a great cut for all forms and the V neck line looks very classy on.  It is a little darker green than what is in the picture, but like I said it was stunning on and I received compliments all night!

Love love love love this dress Ladies, take note! This is NOT a shift dress. This is a tight, form fitting dress. I don't know why I thought it was a shift when I ordered it, but when I put it on, it didn't take long to figure out how wrong I was! ;) 
Don't be vain. Order the 3x. Trust me! 
I wore the 2x with Spanx panty hose, and still showed my tummy problem areas quite a bit. But you know what? I didn't even care, because this dress was so rockin. I felt gorgeous in it, and got SO many compliments. I would have felt more confident in the 3x, so I'm thinking of ordering it again. 
It showed the smallest amount of cleavage and was perfect in that department. It was a beautiful length. The sequins didn't hurt or bother me a bit. The color was perfect for me. You can't really push up the sleeves, so be aware of that. I went to the symphony in it, and felt like the entire audience was looking at me! ;) It was a wonderful night in a wonderful dress!

Perfect fit with compliments all night! I loved this dress! Very comfortable, perfect length, and showed some skin without looking trashy. I revived compliments all night long! I wore it with spanx and it literally hid all my problem areas. I would definitely rent this dress again!

Amazing Dress Very flattering. I received so many compliments. Yes long hair DID get stuck in the sequins- mine was just short enough not to, but when bumping into other girls on the dance floor...their hair got stuck on my dress. I was worried about the sleeves being large enough, as I have pretty big arms, but they were just fine!

Great, effortless dress.  No need for lots of accessories as the dress is enough! Great dress!  I wore it for a fundraiser and it was a huge hit... received lots of complements :)  Order process was seamless.  I will definitely be renting from RTR again!
I LOVED this dress.  It felt good to wear and it got a million compliments. I got a medium and a large and the large was a little tight--but I did it.

nice dress Did not have a chance to wear it, changed my mind last minute. The dress is nice, but its a little too big on top for me and the decollete  is too large. Ordered size Small it fit well, but not what i expected.

My bachelorette party- obsessed with this dress! I rented this dress for my bachelorette party and it was absolutely perfect and great color. I wore the Medium and it fit great. The seams might have been "off" a little bit, as the V in the front of the dress seemed to skew to the right, but it didn't bother me too much. The Small fit, but was a little too tight, and not as comfortable. I got so many compliments and was able to have a great time out for dinner and dancing.
Tons of compliments in this dance friendly dress! Great fit, super comfy & the color ensures you won't look like every one else.

The Compliments on this dress were never ending. I was not impressed with the dress until I put it on! It fits perfectly at my waist and I was even able to wear a bra with it! It looks good on short people like me even though it looks shorter on the model it still came down to just above my knees which was perfect. I got compliments all night on this dress and was very happy with the way it fit. Very true to size.

Unique party dress! This dress is normal enough to not look out of place at a holiday party, but unique enough so you do not look like what is typically on a rack in a department store. The metallic shimmer is tasteful and does not look "tacky" on. The front plunge is deep enough to be sexy but not too revealing either. Perfectly cut in that respect. I am quite small chested so I did not fill out the top well without a bra but if you are a person with a B or more in chest size,I think you would do fine without one. 
I believe this dress would be flattering for most body types, and am confident NO ONE will be wearing your dress1

Got compliments all night!!  It was great dress, and I loved wearing it. I'm right between a 2 and a 4, but I liked the tighter fit of the 2 (especially on top, I felt very secure!). I had been concerned about the length but it was absolutely not an issue. I love this dress and would rent again!!

Sexy little dress. This dress is short but not too short.  The deep V in the front is very flattering.  You don't need to wear a bra as the design is very supportive.  It also has pockets which is such fun.  I'll rent it again.
It was so comfortable and unique! Everyone loved it and asked me where I got it from.  It fit true to size. I have a larger chest and the dress was a little tight and I couldn't wear a bra.

Low-cut but very flattering I rented this for a company holiday party and ended up going with a backup dress because it was too low-cut in the front. If it hadn't been for a party of coworkers I would have rocked this - it's so flattering, and it's easy to wear with a regular bra with a little plunge! And the best part - it has pockets!! I usually wear an 8 but this fit perfectly in a 6.
Great balance between Sexy & Elegant! Sooooo many compliments.  Loved this dress.  One of my best RTR dresses!

Fantastic Party Dress! This is a great dress for a fun celebration. I happen to wear it for my birthday. I have a very small chest, and it gave the illusion of cleavage, which is always appreciated :) I will say, however, that it might be difficult to wear if you have a larger chest. The 2 was too big for me, but with the 0 I could only get it zipped up all the way if I did not wear a bra. Luckily the dress doesn't need one! It's lined well, too, so it's a good winter dress. Great color.

And I included a photo of how I wore it to work before the party, it makes a great skirt, too! No one new it was a full dress until we got to the bar. Great rental!

There are pockets!  Dress was a little busty for a day-to-night affair but was perfect for the evening. Pictures are pretty true to form. Got tons of compliments on the dress and loved wearing it! Very comfortable. Perfect fit for a dress I didn't even try on!
Amazing fit! Beautiful color.  Form flattrering

Great Color Great color and great fit. I was a little self conscious of my boobs, but they weren't overtly provocative, but definitely sexy. Loved the pockets. Longer than I thought, but with heels looked great.
Great Dress Lots of compliments, pretty fabric, fun to dance in-  there were some snags in the dress but you couldn't really tell.  A little too deep in front to wear a bra.

Shiny & stands out in the crowd! Hated to send this one back! It was absolutely gorgeous. The metallic fabric looked even more gorgeous in person and looked great in photos. The v-neck was prominent, but the fabric was thick enough that I did not need a bra. The skirt was super cute and flared - short and fun, but not so much so as to not be comfortable. I wasn't familiar with the brand beforehand, but I am a fan now!
Cute, but Strange Fit The flare of the dress came up too high on my waist and did not flatter my figure.  The bust fit was good, and I wouldn't have needed a bra.  I didn't end up wearing it.

Love this dress - received many compliments! Fits true to size - I'm petite and 5'3" and the 2 fit just right. The cleavage was perfect - not too much (I'm a B cup). Lightweight, the metallic fabric is not itchy, super comfortable and is well made.
This is absolutely gorgeous, and I got tons of compliments! Stunning I am very busty (32DDD) so I couldn't fit into my normal size 2. Very small throughout the top. Overall a beautiful fit.

Perfect, festive dress for my birthday/Mardi Gras in New Orleans This dress was so cute for a day spent on Bourbon Street and at the parades. I liked how low cut it was. It was very fitted until the waist and I didn't even need to wear a bra. It hit right at my waist and flared from there, and it was very flattering and slimming. It also wasn't too short - it hit right above the knee. This can be dressed up to be really fancy or dressed down to be more of a fun/party dress. I usually am between a 2 and a 4 and went with the 2.  I would describe the color as a rose gold. I would SO rent this again!

Fun dress! This dress was a blast. The fabric is really interesting and the dress flares out at a nice spot on the waist. The cleavage is definitely revealing, but I never felt like I was going to fall out. I loved this dress a lot.

I love the unique color of the dress! It's even better in person. Its fun, flirty & fits fabulously  I was actually worried about the sizing because I am usually between an 8 and 10. The 8 fit fine, but it was longer than I expected. Since I don't have big boobs, I could actually fit into the 6! I am glad because it was the perfect length and it fit like a glove! I didn't need to wear a bra because the dress totally supported and pushed up the girls! This is a flattering dress for any body type!

Shimmer, pockets, and no bra! FABRIC: Gorgeous, much nicer in person. Use flash for all photos to really make it stand out. Not itchy despite the shimmer. Medium thickness.

LENGTH: Hit just above the knee (I'm 5'2) so definitely longer for petite girls than on the model. I think it balances the low cut of the top though so I prefer that it isn't mid-thigh.

FIT: True to size. Didn't notice the tightness in the ribcage, but I'm smaller in that area. It was tight in the bust but I've got a large chest (32DD). Definitely gives enough support to be worn without a bra (even for naturally large breasts, like mine, that are obviously more prone to gravity than augmented ones). Made "the girls" look fantastic and almost fake (see the group picture) but I did have to keep adjusting and tucking them in throughout the night. In hindsight, wish I purchased It Stays body adhesive to keep everything in place. 

CUT: You will have cleavage and tons of it - but if you read the reviews, you already know this. Again, body adhesive would have been helpful (not Hollywood tape since anyone with large breasts knows that is no where near strong enough to hold things in!). Fullness of the skirt is forgiving if you're eating/drinking a lot. Also the pockets are obviously awesome and super convenient. 

OVERALL: Gave 4 stars due to the tight fit on the bust and feeling like there wasn't quite enough fabric to cover me completely without my breasts popping out a bit. Nonetheless, a comfortable, sexy, shimmery show stopper that was perfect for a holiday party.

Great party/date night dress! I'm usually a size 0, but because the zipper on the side of this doesn't zip up all the way (so you have to put the dress on over your head), the size 0 could barely fit over my shoulders.  The size 2 turned out to be perfect and I loved the shimmer on this dress!  It has the perfect flared skirt... the V neck in the middle was a little too low for my personal taste but fashion tape helped to solve that problem for the most part!

If you're petite with a short torso it may not fit right. This is an awesome dress, but if you're petite framed or have a short torso, it might not fit right. I was too heavy / broad around the ribs for the size 0 and it wouldn't zip, but the size 2 was too long in the torso -- the plunge from shoulders to sternum showed bra (I had to safety-pin it) and also there was a big huge gap at the shoulders, so it looked quite obviously too big.  It was a great dress but not for my frame.
Great dress!  lots of compliments. a little too revealing for my liking but great

Loved this dress! Was worried it would be too short but it was perfect. So many compliments  I was worried it would be short cause I am 5'9 but it was prefect length. If anything I could see it being long on a shorter person. Great fit was not able to wear it with a bra but it fit well enough I felt comfortable and loved wearing it. May have to rent it again!
Perfect Fit! Accentuates you body in all the right ways!
gorgeous, very flattering, amazingly unique material loved it.

A Birthday Extravaganza As most of the reviews reveal, the dress is wearable without a bra and is longer in person than shown on the model. I do think that it runs slightly large, but is mostly true to size. I did fit into the size 6, but the cleavage was over the top for me, so I ended up wearing the 8. The pockets also a major plus, and overall a very lovely, fun party dress!

Stunning Dress This dress is, like many reviewers state, much more striking in real life. It also provided me much, much less bust coverage! I wasn't able to find any sort of bra to wear with it (I'm a 30G/32DDD) so I had to go bra-less, which for me wasn't really ideal. I didn't feel that comfortable wearing it because even though I taped myself in, I felt like one of my girls was ready to go flying out at any moment! My husband, however, was smitten. The dress is extremely flattering, great length. I'd post a picture but my phone crashed and I lost all of my photos! It really was a knockout dress!

Such a fun dress. The color is absolutely gorgeous. The pockets are great too! Its a great dress. Runs true to size. The dress works for a lot of different formal occasions. I got a lot of compliments on it at my sorority formal. If you have a larger bust, there will be a lot of cleavage, and the dress can be worn with or without a bra. Super fun to wear.

Looks better in person! Tons of compliments on this unique, flirty, fun dress It runs slightly small but not enough that I would mark that down on overall fit. The tight fitting part is the bodice area with a deep v-neck cut. The metallic color and fabric are so pretty! The length appears shorter in the image and on this model than in person and I am tall (5' 9''). The fit and flare cut is very flattering. Wore to a formal dress rehearsal dinner and got lots of compliments and it was unlike anyone else's dress that night.

The dress fit so perfectly! I got compliments on it all night! The dress was true to size.  The material was a little stretchy, so there was some room.  The dress also has pockets which was nice.  Also, in person the color is very metallic, almost like a bronze.  The model's picture does not do it justice.. I wanted to keep it because I liked it so much!

Loved the fit and flare, perfect for smaller chests! I'm usually a 4, but this dress was swimming on me in the chest and ribs so I downsized to the 2 and it was perfect! Sparkly and flattering for mommy tummies, I was even able to wear a regular bra since the plunge landed right at my bra line! The girls looked perfectly perky with the fit of the dress and I received compliments all nite. The dress was in good shape, a few frays I had to tend to but not noticeable with all the sparkle. Pictures don't do it justice! Another great rental, I've never been let down!

Heads Turned.. I rented this dress for my 21st Birthday. Knowing full well from other reviews that this would run very tight on larger busted women, I decided I was okay with that and went for it. It was true, I had to struggle into this dress a bit, but without a bra the dress was still very supportive, and I felt quite like a celebrity. The material is absolutely beautiful and I was comfortable all night.

N/A Great fit!  I'm 5'1, 32C, 115 lbs and the size 2 was perfect.  I got the 0 as a back-up, but there's no way I would've fit in a smaller size.  Like the other reviews said, great support and thick fabric, so didn't need to wear a bra. Very deep V, but I don't have much cleavage so it still looked very appropriate.  Length was right at my knee, which played well given the deep neckline. Compliments all night!
So comfortable and such a pretty color The dress fit well all over - worried, because i'm small on top that it would be baggy in the chest area, but it wasn't.

Wore this for my 20 year reunion. Got tons of compliments and felt beautiful all night. I ordered the 4 but ended up wearing my backup 2. The 4 was a little loose in the waist but the main problem was the bust. I din't feel supported or covered at all. Seemed like a possible wardrobe malfunction in the making. The 2 was much better still had a sexy dip in the bust but didn't feel like I would slip out. It was a little tight in the waist, but not uncomfortably so. All in all it was a hit!
Great fit! This dress is fun and flirty, works best for cups 36c and down  Low cut, but very flattering definitely a show stopper

Wore this out in Vegas for my birthday, and it was the perfect party dress! Tight across the bust (and that's saying something with my build!), so I sized up. Other than that, it was super flattering, and such a fun dress (loved the fit and flare skirt!).
this dress was perfect for a cocktail event a little bit tight in the the bodice, but overall, true to size

Friends I am a pear shaped woman who normally wears a size 8 body con dress or a size 10 shift dress.  This dress was perfect because it was A-line and flattered all the way through.
