Your breasts (I'm a 34C) will be on display so you need to be absolutely comfortable with that if wearing a bra.   I would not recommend wearing this in mixed company, but if you do, it might be best to go bra-less as it makes the dress less "sexy."  I wore this with my girlfriends and they still could not stop staring at my chest.  Altogether, it was cute dress for a dark dinner theater event. Got lots of compliments. I would rate higher if it wasn't so worn.

Beautiful playful dress I wore this to a friend's wedding and loved every minute. The color is great and the fit is flattering. The top fits true to size but doesn't have much give around the ribcage. The bust is very low cut and I wasn't comfortable skipping a bra so I just let it show (luckily it was black & copper so it matched). I got tons of compliments and had a blast dancing in it!

You look like a present all wrapped up! I loved this dress! I am 5'6 and weigh 135 pound and size 6 fit me perfectly! I would recommend this dress if you have a fuller bust as the V is very deep and you definitely need to be fuller to fill out the dress and not risk flashing anyone. I wore the dress to my sorority winter formal and got comments through out the night about how beautiful the dress was. The copper tone is darker than in the picture but still very pretty. The dress is perfect length wise, if you are shorter than me it might be a tad too long(depending on what style you're in to).
Overall great dress and I would highly recommend it

Celebrating my 28th birthday at a beautiful top floor restaurant of downtown Atlanta - perfect night The dress was gorgeous! So much prettier in person. Sized down based on the reviews and the 6 fit perfectly. I wear a 34D-DD and was able to skip the bra and not have too much showing. Highly recommend this dress - complimented all night - would definitely rent again!

Unbelievably gorgeous color and cut! This was an amazing dress!! Very hourglass figure friendly, comfortable room at the bust and hips, with a small midsection. Fit like a glove, and I was comfortable!!! In love.
Sexy in Vegas This dress made my chest look amazing! Hugs you in all the right places. Got a size 6 and it fit well. Very very pretty for my girls night out!

Flattering, comfortable and so fun! Loved this dress! I was a little self conscious that it was going to be really boob-y but it looked great! It was very comfortable AND it had pockets! It's also a little longer so you can get away with the lower cut in the front. I can't wait to rent it again :)

JUST SWELL  Great dress, ran a little on the small side in the bust and was forced to wear the back up size but looked amazing. I have absolutely no curves in my torso at all and this gave me some shape

Love this dress! I was a little scared about renting this dress due to the low cut front and the flow bottom (I have a big butt) but the dress couldn't have worked out more perfect! I normally wear either a 4 or 6 and ended up wearing the 4 in this dress. Also, the pockets were awesome since I was at an event wear I couldn't bring a purse or clutch! I'd definitely recommend this dress!!

GET THIS DRESS! Perfecttttt dress for a night out!  GET THIS DRESS!!! The sparkly fabric and daring neckline make it perfect for a night out! Also no one has mentioned...IT HAS POCKETS!! I rented this for a night out in Atlantic City and was about to keep my phone and wallet with me without carrying a purse. This dress is perfect for a night out (would be perfect for a NYE party) but definitely too over the top for a more formal event.

Meeting with ananda zing stylist in SoHo! I loved this dress! It was a nice little surprise to find out it had pockets as well. I loved the fit of the dress in the waist, but I wish the v neck wasn't so deep. If you're chesty I would recommend not wearing a bra. The color was amazing and I received so many compliments. All around, definitely a great dress to rent!

Loved it - perfect for my bday party! 
Loved it fit great !

Gorgeous, I'm no size 8 If only the dress came one size larger, this would have been perfect. There was no room for a bra, but plenty of support. Very flattering all around.
The color is so pretty! I wore a size 2 and runs true to size. I wore this for my bachlorette/birthday party and it was so fun!

Super fun and flirty! I wore this at my friend's bachelorette. We had a party and then went to rooftop of The W for bottle service. It was perfect for the occasion. I normally have to wear a bra, but did not need to with this dress. think it would have been a little more secure with fashion tape, but the bust was tight enough that I did not have any wardrobe malfunctions.

One of the most beautiful dresses I've worn! This dress made me feel like a million bucks. It was fun, comfortable, and fit my body perfectly. This dress has a deep neckline, so you might feel a bit exposed if you have a bigger bust… wear it If you're comfortable with some cleavage showing. SO Flattering! I rented two dresses for a futuristic/space-themed wedding, this one and an Herve Leger. I assumed I'd wear the Leger, but ones I tried this one on I couldn't leave it in my closet.  It was incredibly flattering, and for a girl with a small chest, it made the girls look spectacular!

Sparkly! This was another great rental! It is quite revealing so if you are a busty girl this may not be the best choice for a wedding. It is more sparkly in person, and the bronze color was perfect for a fall wedding. I still have people asking where I got this one! Def did not want to return and would rent again!!

First RTR experience was a success! I have only good things to say about this dress and my first experience with RTR. Every other girl who wore this dress looked stunning, so right off the bat I was convinced it was a winner. The shimmery bronze-y color really made me stand out at the fall wedding I went to, and the cut was sexy but not risque. In certain lights there was a purple tinge to the fabric but I love that aspect of it. Obviously, the pockets are a huge plus, too.
Stunning cut and color! LOVE THIS DRESS. I got compliments all night, I honestly want to go buy it. It's low-cut, very deep-V so you'll need a deep plunge bra.
Junior Prom ish Cute dress,but less formal that it looked in the picture, a bit of a "juniors" style

Perfect. This dress was gorgeous. I wore it to a rehearsal dinner and loved it!  I got so many compliments.  The beading on the top is beautiful and the fabric is very flattering and forgiving.  I vary in dress size, especially ones that are tight around my ribcage (which is where I am biggest)).  I ordered a 6 and 8 and ended up wearing the 8.

Gorgeous dress! The dress is gorgeous. It was more structured and more of a neoprene material on the bottom than I was expecting so it wasn't the most flattering right above my hips, but it wasn't enough to not wear the dress. The material on the top is much thinner than the skirt, so the zipper would get stuck right where the fabric changed. Although the description says you can wear a normal bra with the dress, I don't see how since the top cuts in on the shoulders and the straps are fairly thin. I wore a strapless bra and had no issues. The only note I would make is that if you have a larger bust the dress becomes very high waisted. I wish that I could have had one more inch of the top fabric so the waist seam was at my natural waistline rather than above it. I kept trying to pull the dress down. The dress is gorgeous and was perfectly cute and stylish without being revealing to chaperone my students' prom. The dress is true to size, but a bit short if you are tall. Wore it with black pumps and it looked good. Wish I had taken a full length picture to share! This was my first RTR experience and it was incredibly simple and efficient. Thanks RTR! Will be renting again!

Classic, fun, flattering dress I loved this dress. I found the dress roomy in the chest area but I am relatively small busted. It's longer than it shows on the model and I am 5'10". This dress is so versatile and really flattering. It was comfortable to dance in and provided great coverage. The beading details are pretty :)

Fun & Flirty! I originally wasn't going to wear this dress because the top was a little snug, but I decided to go bra less and it was much better. I wore it to a work event and no one had a clue. The beading is gorgeous and make picking jewelry very simple! I would definitely recommend this dress and rent it again!

i kinda looked amazing... i was/am madly in love with this dress, it was comfortable, looked absolutely stunning and was just fun to wear. i could twirl without having my skirt fly up, thankful to the thick fabric. i don't think that i can call out any negative features about this dress, it was yet another great experience with RTR when i needed a last minute replacement dress. 
xoxo chloe

Perfect formal dress for a 14 year old young lady! Amazing and age appropriate dress!  Beautiful fabric with a heavy skirt and beaded top.  Some stretch to the bodice.  She looked and felt beautiful, and got tons of compliments!
Classic look Well fit, pictures do it justice!

The dress arrived on time and fit well! This dress is great!  Fits true to size and is very figure flattering.  However, it did not have as much wow factor as I've felt with other dresses I've rented.  It's a very good black staple dress.
Fit really well! Love the cut! Loved this, I think I'm a little heavy right now, so I would tell others to order a size smaller. Definitely wear heels with this outfit.

Great, fun, flirty  Nice heavy material. Shape of top kind of awkward so you need to maneuver your bra should you choose to wear a normal one. I got so many compliments on this dress! Worn to a Vintage Hollywood formal for my sorority.

It looked perfect on my hourglass body & it was comfortable! Pros: Didn't have to wear a bra, which never happens for my 32DDs. I wasn't dancing or anything, but it fit so perfectly and was so easy to wear all night long. I forgot I didn't already own it! It looked beautiful in pictures. 
Cons: Hard to find a bra to go with it, but that worked out just fine!
This was by far the most comfortable dress I have rented The fit was wonderful it allowed me to breath I felt so pretty and everyone loved it
I LOVE THIS DRESS Made my boobs look great.

Great dress for an evening wedding! This dress was the fourth one I tried on for this wedding - so I was feeling a little dismayed, but it fit perfectly and was the right combination of comfortable, yet elegant. The skirt is a thicker material that is really well made. The sleeves dip in a bit, so you can't wear a regular bra with it - have to go strapless, but didn't bother me at all. Would rent this one again.
LOVED IT, wil rent again I wore the 2 to an evening wedding in October (5'4" ~120lbs).  Beautiful fabric, not too clingy, and very easy to dance in.  I hope to rent this one again!

I ordered this dress for my 13 year old daughters Formal day at school. The dress arrived on time, perfectly pressed, and ready to wear.. Fit was perfect!! i am so happy with rent The Runway!! I will use it all the time for myself and my daughter.. Given her age she has a lot of  Bar and Bat Mitzvah's to attend and of course cannot wear the same thing twice.. This is a Godsend for me!! Thank You Rent The Runway!!!

Was flirty and glamorous I wore this to a charity event and I loved it . I like this style of tighter on body and a fun flirty skirt.  It is perfect for cocktails or even more formal because of the detail on the top.
LOVED this dress and got so many compliments!  Fit is pretty true to size, I wore a 4 and I'm usually between a 4 and a 6. First time using RTR and couldn't be happier.

Perfect dress for my friend's NYE wedding - I got complimented on it all night! It fit perfectly and the skirt was a really nice thick material so it didn't swing up too much when dancing. I have a bigger bust, so I did go a size up and that seemed to work, but if you have a C or smaller, your true size is probably fine.

Beautiful dress The dress fits great, it is a little longer then on the leggy model (shocking!).  It looks like it would have been scratchy under the arms but it really isn't at all.  I was able to wear a criss cross bra, just made sure the straps didn't pop out the front as it cuts in a little bit from your armpits up to the shoulders.  Really fun dress!

So amazingly gorgeous, yet still comfortable. I wish I owned this dress.  This dress for beautifully. I had seen several reviews that said it ran a little big-- but for me it seemed to fit perfectly. It was so flattering but still comfortable. 

I loved how the bottom part of the dress was a thicker material. It was easy to dance in without having to worry about it flying up. The top part is also beautifully embroidered with pearls, so there's no need for a necklace or excessive jewelry. I wore a racer-backed black bra and the straps were totally hidden.

Perfect Fit! This was my backup for a dress that wasn't in stock. They also only had one size of this dress and i ended up wearing THIS dress' backup to my Formal. Luckily I had a choir concert the next day and was able to wear this dress too! it fit great, a little scratchy but over all a really comfy and flattering dress.

I won an award with my company that night!  It was amazing! The dress was described as being good for petite, busty women.  I found that I had to go up size because it put too much emphasis on the busty.  Other than that, it fit true to size.

Perfect dress for an evening wedding! This dress was great. The fabric is a bit heavier than I imagined, but it was still perfect for me. I wore a strapless bra with it because the straps are not that wide and you'd need a good halter bra to make sure they don't peek out during the evening. I also went up a size because while the 8 fit, I am larger in the chest area and the size 10 was just much more comfortable in that area. Keep that in mind if you're busty. Otherwise, I highly recommend this dress!

Great for a black tie wedding on new years eve! Fit true to size, no complaints. Skirt hit a few inches above the knee.  Was able to wear it with a racerback bra. No steaming or ironing required when I received the box.  Great find!

This dress was so comfortable! I was able to dance and move with ease! I got so many compliments!!  The dress fit me perfectly and I was so comfortable! I will absolutely tell my friends about Rent the Runway and I'll be placing another order soon!! I received compliments all night!

Rented for my daughter  (homecoming) Beautiful dress.  Fit true to size. She wore the 0.   It was not the typical dress all the girls wore which made it that much more special.   She is 5"5 so length was perfect for a young girl.

Comfy dress, easy to dance in  The dress was very comfortable! It was moveable and easy to dance in. One con is that the split between materials is very obvious, and it is a strange switch from the gentle fabric on top to the very thick fabric on the bottom. It looks slightly cheap, but that might be because the dress had been worn so many times.
Really elegant and can be worn anywhere!  very comfy, sexy, and got so many compliments! Wore it to a bridal shower during the day and then to a formal event at night and got compliments at both!!

Effortless Elegance The dress was comfortable, easy to wear, and the skirt was never an issue on the dance floor. My dress had a few pulls (the top is embellished) but unnoticeable to anyone else and looked great in photos. I recommend this as a safe dress to anyone who wants to not think about their dress or play with it throughout the night.

Great fitting cocktail dress. I did not end up wearing this dress because I went with my other RTR option, but that's not to say that it was not a tough choice. This dress fit and felt great. It is a fun and flirty cocktail dress and I will definitely rent it again in the future.

This was a great dress.  I felt like a princess twirling around it all night. Great dress!  I usually wear a 4 but the 2 fit wonderfully.  I was worried about the bust size from other people's descriptions but it fit and was not tight at all.

Perfect dress for a company holiday party! This dress was perfect for the occasian; a formal holiday party for work. The beaded detail was so pretty and added some holiday sparkle on a otherwise basic black cocktail dress. I am a true size 10 and the dress fit great!
Beautiful dress It is a beautiful dress, and fit true to size. It is comfortable and was  nice length (but much longer than the model.) Plenty of room in the bust.

Beautiful dress! I was very pleased with this dress because it was made well and I was very comfortable.  I ordered a size 4 and a size 6, but I did not bother trying on the 6 because the 4 fit pretty well.  Although it was a nice fit, I would recommend ordering your true size and the size down because I felt that it ran larger than smaller.  It was about an inch or two longer than I expected, but I had no complaints.   All in all, this was a very easy process and I can't wait to rent from RTR again!!
I received a ton of  compliments  The dress fit amazing and looked new!
Wore this to a wedding! Runs a little big and was a little long. Otherwise really pretty dress and super flattering!

Sexy, cute, classy birthday dress Great fit, especially on a petite frame such as mine - slender at the top, defined waist with a heavy satiny skirt. Gives a flattering silhouette. Love "starry" detailing on the top. Very romantic.

The perfect little black dress with some sparkle! This dress was stunning and is one of my favorite rentals from Rent the Runway. I ordered both a size 2 and 0, and ended up going with the 0 because it fit so well. No need for much jewelry since the top is gorgeous with the embellished pearls and sparkles. I'll definitely rent this dress again!
Dress was perfect for holiday party! Fit was a little large, but my backup size was not available.  Perfect for my office holiday party!
Perfect fit.  Classy and feminine. Thanks RTR
loved the glitter made it dressy and classy easy to move around it, comfortable

Perfect for a work/professional cocktail party Wore this for a professional networking gala that was borderline black tie. I think the fact that it runs a bit long is actually great, because it felt super appropriate even with 3-inch heels. It definitely runs large -- I usually wear a 4 or a 6, and I easily fit into a size 2 in this dress. Absolutely beautiful and great quality. Loved it!
Great dress! Loved the dress and the fit! The 2 was just a tad too big and the 0 just looked much better on me.  I wore it for a medical school formal.

Super versatile and flattering!  Loved this dress! Very comfy but still really slimming and flattering. I was even able to wear a t-back sports bra with it, no strapless needed. The top half of the dress was a tiny bit frayed but really not at all noticeable. The only thing I would say is that it does run pretty big. I'm usually a 4 and even the 2 was a little roomy.

Loved it and perfect for company holiday party. The dress was a little snug up top for me. Still loved the dress..very classy and fun for a holiday party. Received many compliments and would rent it again.

Simple and classic, super fun to wear! True to size, the only downside was that up close some of the detailing was a little worn on the top. didn't want to send it back! Very comfortable and fun for a wedding.

Beautiful dress for a work party The skirt is a nice thick material and hangs very nicely, and the dress cinches nicely at the waist. The detailing on the bodice was pretty but a little frayed in some places. Overall this dress is classy, comfortable, and great for dancing and photos.

Fits perfectly! I loved this dress!  It was the first time I used RTR and it was so easy to order and return.  The beaded detail was pretty but a little worn.  The dress fits perfectly and was great for a larger bust.

Pretty and comfortable dress! I rented this for a bachelorette party. I felt slightly overdressed but it was so comfortable and extremely flattering; I received many compliments throughout the night. The material is slightly heavier but I didn't notice once I had the dress on.

Comfortable & flattering I love this dress - second time I have rented it. It's incredibly comfortable and very flattering. I wear it with no bra and Spanx, but the latter is really not necessary. The skirt is VERY full so be prepared for it to flare out quite a bit if you are curvy/have hips or are pear shaped. i have worn it to black tie weddings and felt it was dressy enough - would be perfect for a Fall/Winter wedding as well.

PERFECT for formal work gala! This dress looked great for a gala event that I attended for work. It does run a little large, as I ordered a 4 and then a size 2 as a back up. I ended up wearing the 2 & it was perfect. 
Was slightly a little longer than I expected (but I am only 5'4), but was fine as it was a work event. 
Would recommend for a similar occasion!

Perfect Dress for a Holiday Cocktail Party! I loved this dress! I was originally afraid it was going to be a bit too simple for my Christmas cocktail party but the beading gave it just the right amount of pop! The dress was extremely comfortable and easy to move around in as well. Really happy with the rental! Originally I ordered a Size 2 but I wound up wearing the backup size 0. Would rent again :)

I would stay away from this dress if you are short.  I'm 5'1'', and this dress was awkwardly long on me. It seems like there is just too much fabric in the skirt of the dress. The size zero was perfect on my upper body, but it accented my hips and did not flatter my lower body at all. I did not end up wearing this to the wedding.

Gorgeous Detailing Pictures don't do this dress justice.  The bodice has such intricate detailing.  What you can't really see in the pictures is that there are little pearls and sequins.  I absolutely loved this dress and would definitely rent it again!

I rented this dress for a formal, black tie gala and it was perfect!  I ordered the 10 and 12 and wore the 10. Loved the sequins and sparkly-ness of the dress, yet it was very classy. The sequins weren't bothersome at all. The bottom is a heavier material but was very comfortable. Loved the dress and how flattering it was - wanted to keep it!

Beautiful, classy dress! This dress was great - very true to size and comfortable. The silver details on the bodice are so beautiful and more striking in person. Keep in mind that this dress is a little long, I'm on the tall side of 5'6" with long legs and this fell at a very modest length, which was appropriate since I was at a wedding. If I were going to a party or on a date I would've wished it were shorter. If you're looking for a classy, fun take on the LBD, this dress is perfect! This is the kind of dress mothers love, mine wanted me to buy it :)

I wore this to my senior prom! The night was one to remember! The dress fit perfectly! You don't have to worry about getting a special bra, I just wore a standard criss-cross black one! It was super comfortable and the top is gorgeous! I didn't realize there were little beads sewed on until I got it in the mail! Perfect dress!

got a lot of compliments the dress was a little loose
normally waer a 6 and the 4 was still a little big
the dress looked great and was perfect for dancing and having a good time!! wasn't scratchy really comfy.

Love this dress - super sassy! I wore this for a premiere party and couldn't have felt more fabulous.  It fit me perfectly and I felt super comfortable in it.  Got lots of compliments throughout the night. Who doesn't want to sparkle?!

I rented this dress for my Birthday and it was beautiful!  Everyone loved it :)  It fit well (gapped a bit in the shoulder, but I'm really short) and was perfectly sparkly for a Birthday celebration.  People complemented me all night on it and I loved the dress.
WOW dress I rented for my engagement party. When I walked in the room everybody reaction was WOW. The dress fit like a glove and was extremely comfortable. Perfect for a New Year's party!!!!
Sexy This was a great dress.  Very sexy and ran true to size.  Ended up not wearing it for my christmas party.  Felt that it was just a little over the top sexy.

I wore this dress to my homecoming dance.  It was beautiful and everyone loved it!  Even though this dress was snug, it was very comfortable.  I normally wear a size 0 and it was true to size.    You would never know this dress was rented!

Rent the Runway is amazing. I attend so many parties every year and I can never really wear the same dress twice. RTR lets me have a new designer dress for every occasion without the expense of buying tons of dresses that will never be worn again!!!! I love Rent the Runway! I rented this dress for NYE and I got compliments all night! It fits perfect and was so sexy and comfortable at the same time. I danced all night long and was glittering like a disco ball from all the DJ lights. Its definitely a showstopping dress!!!

Classy, sexy, bold. I chose this dress as a second rental option just because I wasn't' sure what kind of dress I wanted to wear for my company Christmas party. This dress was great, it hugged right and fit perfectly and didn't ride up or look too short. The only reason I chose the other dress was to tone it down a bit. Loved this dress and would rent again!
Perfect for my birthday party The dress is super sparkly and formal looking. It was comfortable and the length was perfect. I did a high bun and it really showed off the one shoulder look. Loved it
sexiness This dress is very fun but beware...it is also VERY form fitting:)
A no-fuss, statement dress – perfect for NYE! This dress combines stretchy fabric, a side zip (ruched side) and a great liner. The tulip hem is even more beautiful in person!
A guest at my friend's wedding came up to me and said she loved my dress. The dress fit perfectly and I love the color.

I shined bright like a diamond! I actually ordered this dress as my back up for my sorority formal but fell in love with it once I put it on! I paired it with tiffany blue/mint accessories. I sparkled everywhere I went and received so many compliments on how beautiful my dress was! The dress fit great; fitted but not snug, appropriate length, and flattering on my pear shape. This dress did not have any serious cons but it did ride up a little and the sequins were mildly irritating when I first put the dress on but in the end that did not bother me. The dress is a little darker in person but still a great gold dress. RTR facilitated a fun and easy process through out.

I got so many compliments on this dress at a holiday party! Everyone wanted to know where I got it! This dress fit great! The ruching on one side had a great slimming effect and the dress accentuating my arms and shoulders rather than my hips/thighs which I'm constantly trying to minimize.

A girls night out in Vegas after a work conference. This dress was really comfortable.. It has a bit of stretch to it. I didn't even have to wear a bra. The sequins under the arms were a bit scratchy, but nothing too terrible. I got tons of compliments, even from complete strangers. I love this dress!

This was a perfect fit, I would definitely reccomend this to anyone.  Very comfortable as well. I loved the one shoulder style and the gather at the waste.  The glitter was not too overwhelming and had the right amount of pizzazz.  I wore it for a formal event on vacation with black strappy sandals.  I did not wear a necklace but you could have gotten away with a plain choker style,
Turned the guys' heads all night, and girls kept stopping me to say how fabulous I looked! Dress ran absolutely true to size. I couldn't have been happier with my experience!!

My husband asked if we could keep it. the sequins was not scratchy at all.  The lining did tend to ride up a bit, but that may have been due to the panty hoes.  I was able to wear a strapless bra without a problem.  The dress has a black thread running though it, so its darker than the pictures look.  It looks better in person!  Got tons of compliments.  I will wear this one again.

This dress was so comfy and fun! The fit was great and I did not need my back up size (2) since it was stretchy. Dress did not rub and was light weight so worked for warmer weather. Wore on my bachelorette party and was so glad I rented this!

The Perfect Vegas Dress! This dress fit me beautifully, I received both the size 4 and 6 and chose to wear the size 4.  I typically wear a 4 in dresses so this beauty fits very tts.  The dress is more beautiful in person than the photos, and is constructed really well.  It hugs the curves and manages to hide the flaws.  I recieved numerous compliments.  The best part is it's ridiculously comfortable for a formal dress.  Don't hesistate to rent this one!

A great dress for a formal! Very flattering cut. They only had size 6 left and I usually order a 6 and 8 just in case. However, this dress fit wonderfully. A few of the sequins were snagged but it wasn't a big deal. The dress is more gold in person than in pictures.
Great dress! Fit perfect!  This dress fit perfect and was very comfortable!

Amazing! This was an incredible dress!  I have an athletic build and usually wear a 4, and this fit perfect.  It was for a formal party, and I received compliments all night long.  My date's friend told me that he couldn't look at anything else because the dress drew all his attention.  I was even told that they didn't need a disco ball when I was on the dance floor.  This dress made my night incredible!!

The PERFECT address for my birthday party!!! I received so many compliments and felt beautiful! Cold have worn the 2 or the 4, went with the 4 as the 2 was cut too high in the armpit and the sequins were scratching me. Dress was comfortable, and just gorgeous

The compliments on the dress were nonstop! That dress made me unforgettable.  Normally I'm a size 6. I ordered a 6 and then for my backup size I chose a 4. The dress runs a little large so the four ended up fitting the best. Overall, it fit wonderfully and was incredibly comfortable.

This dress was awesome! Fit great. I am petite - only 5'1" and it was a great length.  This fit was perfect for my body. I wore it for an event where I had to do a lot of moving and running around. There was a ton of stretch. I was able to be comfortable throughout the evening. I got a TON of compliments. I would definitely rent this dress again. The sequins were beautiful and the dress really didn't need accessories. I wore my diamond stud earrings and black stappy shoes with a gold chain detail. PERFECT. Thanks RTR
Tons of complements on my bachelorette, fit perfectly, great fabric, in love!  I'm usually 4 but 2 fit better. The dress is great for any party event! Loved wearing it. Made me feel special.

I had an amazing time in this dress - made my senior prom AMAZING! This dress was great: slipped right on and then I was ready to go. I am usually a 2/4, and decided to go with the 2 for this because it let you see the distinct hemline a bit better. I am busty at the top, but still had a lot of room which was great! It doesn't move around that much - I never had to adjust myself for pictures. Perfect, perfect dress, very flattering and eye-catching!

The quintessential  NYE dress! I got sizes 6 and 8, this dress has give so the 6 worked perfect. I normally run between the two sizes.  The fit was comfortable and it was the perfect choice for a NYE party.  I did wish the dress had more structure in the waist since it had a tendency to get a little gathered in that area throughout the evening.

Didn't end up wearing because it was too big, but may try renting again in smaller size! Gorgeous liquid gold dress! Looks much more glittery in person. It was my backup dress that I didn't end up wearing. I was nervous that it would be tight around my hips so I ordered a size up and it ended up being too baggy. It made my decision to go with the other dress much easier though!! (Mark & James by Badgley Mischka Take a Twirl Dress!)

I still included a photo so my fellow shorties can see where the hemline fell

This dress turned heads everywhere I went! I tried both the 0 and 2 since I wear both sizes pretty regularly. Both sizes zipped pretty well but I felt like the larger size fell a lot more attractively and gave me a little more room to eat and drink whatever I wanted.

Perfect Formal Dress!! This dress is amazing and was the perfect dress to wear to my sorority formal!!! It was so comfortable and fit my body really well!!! I would recommend it! wear with spanks and a strapless bra. Rides up a little bit.

What happens in Vegas stays in Vegas...or get a sneak peak on RtR!! This was the perfect dress to wear in vegas! I loved the one-shoulder and glam look! I paired it with a black leather jacket and went from dinner to the casino feeling lucky!
Pretty and comfortable.  I do not recommend for a formal affair on women taller than 5'3". Its more of a "night out" dress. If you are under 5'3" its appropriate for weddings, etc.

Great dress! Wore this in Vegas on my bachelorette trip! Was perfect for a girly night out (Thunder Down Under & dinner!). Was very comfortable. The darker shade of gold is really complementary to skin tones. The dress is way less tulip-y in person FYI but very pretty!

Absolutely loved this dress. I felt great in it and got compliments all night. This dress fit like a glove. Usually I wear a 4 or a 6, so I was nervous that it might run small and the 4 might not fit (there were no 6s left at the time). Thankfully, it fit perfectly. The tulip hemline isn't as obvious in person. It was slightly scratchy under the armpit, but I barely noticed. Overall, very very please.

i sparkled! this dress was pretty and it did the trick for my greek formal. however, from the reviews i expected the dress to be more figure flattering and when i put it on it did not nip or tuck at all. it was a bit longer than i expected but not too long (i am about 5' 8). although you would think this dress would be stiff because of the sequins, it was actually quite a stretchy fabric which is why i didnt think it covered my unfortunate lumps and bumps as nicely as i wanted it to! this would be a beautiful dress on a girl with a flat tummy and great curves or a slim body, but it doesnt hide love handles or anything of the like! i was going to wear a spanx under the dress but it was such a hot day, i decided i looked good enough without the spanx and i rocked the dress as it was... all in all i thought it looked nice.

Got a ton of compliments.  Loved this dress. Fit great, flattering, has grippy tape along the neckline so it stays put. Great draping, invisible zipper. I wore it with a good strapless bra and it was totally fine with my small bust. A show stopper!
Perfectly fit and fancy. This dress hugged me in all the right places. Even though the dress covers up well on top, the one sided sling look is really sexy, showing just enough skin.
VEGAS WEDDING!!!  I wore this to our Vegas wedding and it was perfect!

Unique Party Dress "It's so shiny!" was the most common comment about my dress. The shiny gold color and the one-shoulder neckline make this a really unique piece. I wore it to a sorority semi-formal and it felt appropriate for the occasion.
The material was good, there are just enough sequins to give you sparkle but not enough so that you're weighed down under a heavy dress. There's also a little bit of stretch in the fabric. This is both a pro and a con for this dress, the stretch makes it fit curves really well, but it also makes the dress shorter on you if you're curvier.
Very sparkly and pictures well I wore this to NYE party and the theme was white and gold. It's flattering and very sparkly. The inner layer is kind of tight so it holds the waist area well.
I wore this dress for my engagement party! Fit like a glove!  The sparkles were beautiful, but not over the top.  Great length and I loved the one shoulder strap.

Lots of compliments I'm the Vice President for a non-profit associates board. I rented this dress for our annual gala, a Mardi Gras themed cocktail party. This dress was perfect for the event and theme. I got compliments all night long. It was super comfortable and very flattering. My only complaint is that it was a bit tight under the arms, but when I went up to the size 6, it was a bit too baggy. This was my first experience with RtR, and I am very pleased. I will definitely rent again.

Very flattering and stunning.  I felt sexy and confident in it and got complimented immediately. The dress was a perfect fit.  Because I have such short legs, I was afraid it would be too long, but it was the perfect length for me, a couple inches above my knees.  I wore it without a necklace because the pearls I had chosen just didn't look right with the one-shoulder dress.

I got this for our 5th anniversary dinner, which might have been slightly over dressing, so I wish I could have shown it off more at a club of something, but on a Sunday night in a small beach town, it was hard to find anything, but the pictures are great!

Probably my only complaint -- and it's a small one -- would that the seguins around the armpits were a little uncomfortable, but it didn't make a difference.  I would rent this dress again.

Fabulous "Look At Me" Party Dress! I wore this dress for a NYE party I hosted. It looked amazing and I got tons of compliments! It definitely provided the sparkly, center-of-attention look I was going for. I ordered a 2 and a 4. The 2 fit but was a little tight and wasn't as forgiving as the 4. I will definitely rent again!

Wore this for our wedding reception/departure dress (changed toward the end of the evening). Dress was super comfortable (much easier than a wedding gown to dance in!), fit well, and was fun to wear. I'd rent it again in a heartbeat!

Great dress; pretty and comfortable.  This dress worked out very nicely for my 30th Birthday Party.  I received many compliments and felt good wearing it.  The only thing to watch out for is it tends to ride up when you sit down.
New Year's Eve  The dress fit perfectly and was very comfortable!

Compliments galore! I received soooo many compliments!  Endless...

This dress is fabulous.  I deducted one star because it was a bit shorter than I'd like.
Great dress, great fit. Tons of compliments all night loved it and would definitely rent it again. I would have liked it if it was a little shorter but since I wore it to a wedding, it was just fine.

I wore the dress for my bachelorette party. I was worried about the sequins hurting, but was comfortable all night with the slight stretch material! It was flirty but conservative (a little long if you're on the shorter side like me). It wasn't as gathered at the waist as I thought like the picture shows, but was cute regardless.

Looks good, unforgiving An eyecatching dress, indeed! Lots of compliments, and overall, I was very pleased with this rental. Two things:
1. Be forewarned, this dress is WAY more gold than the silver/bronze-y look in the model pictures. It's still beautiful, I was just surprised.
2. This dress is unforgiving. Be at peace with your midriff and upper arm gods, because this dress will definitely highlight both.

This was my first time using RTR I wasn't sure the dress would work but it was EVERYTHING! This dress gave me life. I needed something for a birthday party and I love sparkles! I wasn't sure this was the dress for me, but once I tried it on.....it gave me life! This dress was very form fitting. It flattered my tummy area and accentuated my curves. I ordered an 8 & 10. I think the 10 would have been a bit more comfortable for me but it had a different type of lining in it that I couldn't even fit over my shoulders. That was disappointing for me, which is why I only rated a 4. But the size 8 worked out wonderfully. Other than having to pull it down from time to time with all the dancing, I loved the dress. I will definitely be renting again.

Felt like a stunner in this gorgeous dress! I had the great opportunity to where this gorgeous ensemble to a Beyonce concert, and felt like a d-d-diva! :-) When I opened the box, I immediately fell in love with the artful stitching, tasteful yet flirty length( a big plus being 6"1'), and perfect cut to flaunt my curves in the right places. It was supper comfy, super easy to dance in, and super fun. I recommend!
Great dress!!  Wore to a black tie wedding in Las Vegas. Received so many compliments! Highly recommend!

Perfect and special for my bachelorette party! The dress fit wonderfully, the 0 fit me as well but was a little too tight to wear for a long night out. The material is stretchy, and the sequins do not scratch the arms. I got a lot of compliments and would highly recommend!
gorgeous and comfortable This dress is perfect for long lasting events. It is extremely comfortable. Despite being sequined, it is not heavy and the fabric has a bit of stretch so it moves with you.

My friends talked about this dress weeks after our trip. It was definitely a perfect dress for the occassion. Loved how it shined and fit. This dress fit perfectly. I celebrated my 25th bday in Vegas and wanted something that said "birthday". This dress was perfect. I got a ton of compliments and it photographed great. It also fit really great too, I'm a 4-6 size and the 4 fit better in my case.

The dress was even better than I had expected. I rented this dress for a rather formal/clubby event at the end of my commencement week. I absolutely loved the dress and the way it fit. I have kind of broad hips so I was nervous that the fabric might bunch in an unflattering way but it actually was very flattering and I received many compliments! Runs true to size! Definitely a great rental, totally worth the price!

Favorite Dress ever! I rented this dress for my bachelorette party. Unfortunately, I broke my arm the week before and had to wear a sling, which regrettably hid the beauty of this dress. I could have easily gone down to size 4, but found that my swollen arm would only fit through the arm socket of a 6. 

I would enthusiastically suggest this dress to anyone considering it. The detail is amazing. I felt beautiful in it even though I was broken and bruised.

Beautiful & elegant sequined detail.  The color is beautiful & true. I got compliments all night!!!! A little tight under the arms, but I have broad shoulders.  The lining had stretched a little past the dress, so I had to hem it with double sided tape.  It is a little hard to zip.  You cannot wear a regular bra with it because it will show through the holes in the back.

Knocking the socks off my amazing Airman! The dress was amazing. I was a little scratched up under the arms from my arms rubbing on the material but over all I loved it. A little tight in the back area but the midsection was true to size. The dress is prettier in person for sure!
great sparkle Wore for a black tie wedding in November. Got compliments all night! Great fit!

Absolutely gorgeous and perfect for a formal wedding!  This dress was the perfect choice for a formal wedding in Savannah, GA. It was the perfect length on me and the size was true to size. I have a slightly bigger bottom and this dress accentuated that perfectly! Not too much, but perfect for my shape. It did rub a tiny bit under the arms, but you forget it pretty quickly. Wish I owned this gorgeous dress! Also, I won the RTR Style Awards for this dress, so others must have loved it too! :)
Beautiful dress and very faltering!  Its a little itchy and it can be hard to hid a bra strap in the back but other than that I loved it and was very happy overall! Received compliments all night

Looks even better on!  I didn't want to return this dress! This dress was awesome!  I usually wear a size 6 but they only had the 4 and I had lost some weight recently so I went with the 4 and it was perfect!  Granted, I did need a pair of Spanx, but I got compliments all night.  Seriously though, it was tough to send this one back I loved it so much.  It barely needs anything to dress it up, and I already had about 5 pairs of shoes that would go with it.

I got compliments all night! :)  I love that it was glamorous and sexy, but I felt covered up! The dress was pretty, fun and very comfortable to wear.  I wore a strapless bra and tried to keep it hidden behind the strap in the back.  Despite some heavy use of the provided double-sided tape, my bra peeked out through out the night.  Styled with black velvet shoes and small earrings + matching cocktail ring.  I got compliments all night and am glad I stood out from all of the black dresses!

Perfect bridesmaid dress The dress was a great choice to have as a bridesmaid. The bride wanted bright gold and this dress delivered and was still able to look classy. The only downside is that it is scratchy. Also, like others noted the lining of the dress hung about two inches longer than the dress itself. I was able to pin it up without it being an issue. The dress is starting to show some wear....
awesome dress but the lining had a tendency to show along the hem line great looking dress but a bit scratchy around the arms of the cap sleeve
Everyone loved it! It was a hit! Fit perfectly!

Tons of compliments  Loved this dress. Perfect for industry parties at NYC Bridal Fashion Week. Sequins under the arm a bit itchy but forgot all about it as soon as the night got started. Fits pretty true to size but I would order up one size for your extra size instead of ordering down. I wore a 4 which is typical for me.
I love this dress.  It was perfect for the occasion - a formal anniversary party.  The liner peeked out a bit at the bottom but it was nothing a little fashion tape couldn't fix.

Sexy and sparkly  The previous reviews for this dress were right on: under-slip shows, sequins itch and leave scratches, and the dress is beautiful. It was a little sexy for this particular wedding I went to, but it was still a great dress. I wanted to wear the larger size (a bit more modest) but there was absolutely no fit difference going from a 6 to an 8. Also, the slip showed more in the 8 so I wore the 6 which fit like a glove. I would rent it again, but for more of a party setting. It would be a perfect New Year's Eve or Vegas dress.
Beautiful Dress I absolutely loved this dress!  I got compliments on it all night! The only problem is I thougt it ran a little big.  It still looked beatiful though!  The back was the highlight?

Best rental yet! This is an amazing dress! I am 5'5", 115 lbs and the 2 was a perfect fit. If you have a smaller bust like me, you probably won't have to wear a bra either (the back of the dress makes it hard to wear one). I got compliments all night long! Even the bride made mention of how much she loved my dress. Little did they know that the $600 gown was rented for far less. Thanks so much, RTR! This dress was another winner :)

Great dress! Loved this dress! I wore it for a wedding in New Orleans. It was very flattering and I got so many compliments! The only thing I was annoyed about was that I couldn't wear a normal bra with it. I thought I would be able to. And I didnt bring a backup stick on bra... So, I had to saftey pin the bra to my dress. But other than that- it was great!!!

Super-Fab! I am 5'5, athletic build, and this dress actually made me look like i have a waist. the 6 fit perfectly, and the lining was thick enough so I did not have to wear a bra or pasties. it's a good length for a wedding, right above the knee, and is forgiving. I received compliments all night! It should be noted that the dress seemed a bit darker than in the picture.

Dress was beautiful and got so many complements on it. Sparkly and perfect for a wedding.  I normally wear a size 4 and was surprised that the bust on the 4 was so small I couldn't zip it (when that area is never an issue for me) but the 6 fit well. Super pretty and otherwise cute. Liner kept sticking out on bottom and the fabric was irritating on my underarm. All in all great rent for an event and worth it for the night!
Gold Sequin Stunner I loved this dress. It was a snug fit. I didn't wear a bra with it and was fine. The material has sequins so it is a little uncomfortable and itchy around the armpits.

Disappointed, but ended up ok The sequence on dress is more concentrated & sparkly than it looks in the picture. The dress I received looked like it had been worn a bunch before me, and the lining under the dress was hanging below the dress- I had to tack it up. I would have worn my back up dress but it was too big.

Great Dress for a Formal This dress was perfect for my black tie optional event.  It has some stretch and the shimmer/sparkle detailing is much more prominent than the model photo shows--Most of the reviewer photos show it more accurately.  I am usually between a 4 and 6 and the 6 was unavailable so I wore the 4.  I probably would have preferred the fit of the 6 since this was a tad snug, but it worked.  The only negative I noticed is that the lining tends to hang down about a quarter inch longer than the lace layer.

Everyone loved the dress. Strangers came up to me to tell me that they loved it.  I usually wear a 4 but needed the 6 to be comfortable. The fabric is a little itchy under the arms especially because I kept putting my clutch between my arm and my side. The fabric also got caught on itself so it was helpful to wrap it with tissue paper when traveling so as to prevent snags.

Fun, sophisticated, and a sexy dress! I wore it for my engagement photos and it fit the color scheme perfectly. Up close, the colors are a more muted gold/beige design and from afar, the metallics really shine and pop. The back shows just the right amount of skin. My only complaint, and why I gave it a 4 star rather than 5, is the attached underneath slip was longer than the dress so it hung out or I had to adjust the dress. I would still rent the dress again.

Best rental yet! This is probably my favorite dress that I've rented! The fit and color were amazing and I got tons of compliments. I thought the gold would wash me out since I'm so pale but it ended up being perfect. Highly recommended.
Loved it! I wore this to a formal holiday party and absolutely loved it. Great cut and fit. True to size. Very flattering. Many compliments.

Perfect amount of sparkle! The sparkles did itch a little, but really didn't bother me at all.  I got a TON of compliments on this dress.  This was my first RTR experience and I LOVED it!  Will def be doing this again.  Only other complaint was I wore the 8 because the zipper on the 6 didn't work.  Could probably have worn either size, but had to settle for the 8.  Was a little big but was fine.
This dress is WAY more brilliant and beautiful in person than the photo can show Like the other reviews said it's a little itchy under your arms but it doesn't even matter it looks GREAT on

First time using RTR and it was a great experience!  I will do this again! This dress fit like a glove, no gaping in the back or at arms- perfect!  The length was great- it hit me a few inches above the knee.  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars is that the sequins at the arm opening rub against your skin which was very uncomfortable.

Another great RTR experience! This dress runs true to size and is definitely figure flattering. The cut-out back gives it a little something extra.  Being 5'2" I am always worried about dresses being too long but in my opinion, this was the perfect length because it was still comfortable while I was sitting down.  Some people said that the sequins scratched their arms -- the only time I had this problem was when I was dancing!  Overall, it was another great RTR experience.
Great color, perfect length. Dressy enough to wear to a ball.  The slip runs long, but can easily be folded up with some fashion tape. Fits very well, a little tight around the bust.

Love this dress!  My best choice yet! This dress truly is gorgeous, I received so many compliments throughout the night.  I was worried about the sequins bothering me never my arms, but I hardly felt them.  The only negative was you really couldn't wea a regular bra with it due to the back.

Lovely dress. Very flattering and super comfortable!  Others mentioned that the sequence was irritating, but it didn't bother me at all. The back is very sexy and the dress can be worn with a strapless bra. Other mentioned that a regular bra can be worn. That wasn't working for me. The side straps were still showing. You will love this dress!

I was able to wear a great dress to a wedding and not have to buy it.  I thought this dress was fantastic. It was the perfect choice for a black tie wedding. I usually wear a size 4 but was four months pregnant at the time if the wedding and went up to a size six. The dress gives and flatters your curves.

This dress definitely turned heads! Not too tight so the sequins did not scratch.  It does give some but fit my hips loosely . The bust was snug.  I did not wear a bra because it did show.  It has a beautiful back. RTR must have fixed the lining because it did not show, in fact it was about 2-3 inches shorter which I liked because you could see the pretty over lace of the dress. I think get a larger vs smaller size if you want to be comfortable. I would definitely wear again!

It was a beautiful dress that was easy to move around in.  I got several compliments. I loved the overall look of this dress.  It was fitted but not too tight to be uncomfortable.  I was able to dance and enjoy myself without worrying.  I also did not need to wear a bra with this dress which was necessary for the cutout back.  It was a tiny bit snug through the chest (I am a 36B) which surprised me.  But overall I loved this dress and I will RENT AGAIN!

I got so many compliments on this gorgeous dress! The dress is simple but so beautiful.  The dress fit a bit tight, a friend had to zip me into it. It was fairly comfortable but I ended up with scratches on my underarms because the sequins are a little sharp. Overall it was a beautiful pick  and  it definitely turned heads!

This dress makes you stand out!  It's very form fitting, but great for a formal wedding. The dress is fine. It certainly makes you stand out. I got a ton of compliments. It's more formal so I wouldn't wear it to a casual wedding. It's also pretty form fitting and doesn't leave a lot of room for curves. It zips up the side so I had a little trouble zipping it near my bust line. If you are curvy, expect your curves to stand out. 

It's great to dance in and the length is perfect. A lot of dresses I have rented from RTR end up being too short. This was perfect with high heels. Final note --  the material is a little scratchy. 

Definitely makes you stand out! Great dress!

Bachelorette Party Dress I wore this dress for my bachelorette party and it was perfect! I'm really tall, so I was hoping to find a little bit of a longer dress and this was the perfect length (still short enough on me). I ordered the 2 as my original size and the 4 as my backup size, and I ended up wearing the 4 because the 2 pulled. Like other girls said - you can see the liner in the dress. This is true only if the dress is too small. Lots of liner showed with the size 2, but the 4 did not show the liner at all.  The 4 was the perfect size.

Beautiful dress....figure flattering. I am usually a size 6...but the size 6 wouldn't zip up over my bust.  So I tried on the size 8....and still needed help zipping the dress...seems that side zippers always pose a problem for single-person zip-ups.  The dress fit like a glove and hid all of the bad areas.  By the end of the night I had a little chaffing under my arms from the sequins, but I didn't notice until the very end of the evening....and by that time I had been wearing the dress for 7 hours.  I would definitely wear this dress again!

My Beyonce Dress I got so many compliments on this dress.  It was very sparkly & fit perfectly.  Best compliment I received was that it was a "Beyonce Dress" so I obviously felt great in it all night.  My only complaint was that it was a bit scratchy under the arms but it was certainly bearable.  I paired it with black shoes & purse but tan would also work.  I wore minimal jewelry because the dress alone was enough: drop earrings & no necklace.  I originally wanted to rent the Silver Wave Bangles but they were unavailable so they sent me the Polished Gold Links Cuff instead, which looked great.  I would definitely rent this dress again!
Runs small; especially if you are larger in the bust area.  Also sequins could have been itchy. Probably wouldn't rent this…

Played up my best assets while hiding some of my flaws.  Loved it! This was a second look I ordered.  The dress is much more beautiful in person.  Online it looks as if it's a heavy fabric with a lace print on it.  It's actually mesh material with sequins all over.  It's gorgeous!  It looks like a very expensive dress.  I ordered the size 4 and size 6 and wish I had listened to the other reviewers when they said it runs small.  I probably would have been better off in an 8.  I'm usually a size 6, but this hugged my body a little too much for the conservative event I went to.  It was fine and I received a ton of compliments on it.  Another imporant point is the bra- I went and purchased a NuBra specially for this dress. It was a total waste and I couldn't use it.  Instead, I ended up using a regular bra and used the tape provided to hold it all in place.  Occasionally, a strap would poke out, but my husband was on alert to adjust at all times.  This dress is a winner!  I wouldn't hesitate to rent again-- only a size 8 this time ;-)
Classic & Beautiful I wore this dress for a black tie wedding in Manhattan.  I am typically between a 4 and a 6, and the 4 fit perfectly.  I'm 5'8' and it wasn't too short on me either.
Didn't end up wearing it. Was too fancy for the occasion.  Liked the fit. It worked well with a strapless bra. It was too long. A lot fancier than the pictures show in my opinion.

Cocktail Turn Up the 4 fit, but since I was attempting go for a cocktail look and not club i wore the 6. I won't say it runs small, cause I'd been eating all day and the 4 DID fit, i just wanting it looser look. Great dress. Really cute and classy and the back gives it some extra fun. Got lots of compliments from women of all ages.

Felt beautiful and got lots of compliments I felt gorgeous in this dress and got lots of compliments.  You'll stand out without overdoing it.  I wore this for the rehearsal dinner for my wedding.  That said, the reason I am not giving it five stars is because I had issues with the slip of the dress most of the night.  My maid of honor had to keep adjusting the dress from the back.

Loved this dress and danced the night away! This is a great dress!  It is super sparkly and flattering.  It isn’t too short and it was a little stretchy which ended up being helpful. I ordered this dress as a back up since there was a heat warning put out for the evening of my event and the dress was definitely more comfortable to wear than a floor length gown. The dress is a lot sparklier in person as compared to the picture but I received so many complements on it regardless.
Great dress for an indoor evening/formal wedding. Everyone liked it and complimented. Very happy.... The fit was just right - I danced in it all night comfortably.

Perfect for a Gatsby Affair! I am 5'10'' and between a size 6-8. The 6 was too small but the 8 fit me perfectly. The sequin material bothered the skin underneath my arms over the course of the night, but other than that a very comfortable dress! I got many compliments on it and everyone loved how sparkly it was. Would highly recommend!

Pretty Dress But Not My Favorite I ordered a 2 and 4 because I got nervous from reading the other reviews that it would be too small but I definitely made a mistake. The dress was not flattering on me in a 2, I felt frumpy. Don't get me wrong it was a beautiful dress but I did not feel beautiful in it. Maybe if I had gone with a 0 my feelings toward the dress would be different. Also the material was incredibly uncomfortable and as noted by all the other reviews, the slip hangs out the bottom. I did still get a lot of compliments purely for the fact that it really is a beautiful dress. I would not rent it again, though.

Looking chic and shining bright First off, props to RTR for overnighting this dress to me after I decided to make a change for a more formal style dress. I decided to rent both a 2 and a 4 based on the reviews for this dress. I went with the size 4 for the wedding I went to because the top of the size 2 was too small for my body since I couldn't zip it up all the way. I liked how the size 2 fit around my waist down but unfortunately I could not zip it up. As mentioned, the fabric is not metallic and is beautifully crafted with gold sequences. The dress photos especially well under particular lighting and the use of an SLR camera. I feel the dress most resembles the left side of my photo. I didn't mind the feel of the sequence but but the end of the night my skin felt itchy. Also the lining does peek out of the dress which can be annoying but I put fabric tape to keep it in place and it worked! I was afraid of the sequences coming off the dress but everything seemed to stay in place. The zipper was also still tricky to pull up on the size 4 but I managed to pull it up easier than the size 2. I would also suggesdt wearing a sticky, one sided bra because my strapless and regular bra showed through the cutouts. Beautiful dress just wish it felt more comfortable to wear on for the whole night.
Very elegant, the back of it makes it sexy but classy! Pretty long, hit almost the knee. Definitely wear with heels. Otherwise fits perfectly to size... And you get to wear a regular bra!

Want to feel great? THis is the dress for you. I rented this dress for my 15th anniversary celebration.  The size 8 zipper was tough to work with but my lats were too big for it.  The size 10 accommodated my lats but was lose around the belly.  Some of the sequence had been lost and a few runs but only if you looked closely.  My husband loved the dress. My photo wont upload, sorry.

So many compliments! Great dress! You will get complimented! It's surprisingly forgiving once it's on, but you'll need a different bra solution (I wore the NuBra Lite). It also scratched me pretty fiercely around the arm holes. The zipper is hard to get up at the top - definitely thought it was going to get stuck or I was going to zip my skin up. Luckily, neither happened. Overall, I was super happy with it - danced all night and had a great time at my friend's wedding!

Great Holiday dress! I rented this dress for my work Christmas party.  It was very cute!  I usually wear a 4, but decided to wear the 6...the 4 was just a little to tight and short.  The fabric is great..very festive!  Although the sequins did rub on my arms, I didn't mind because the dress was so cute!

Great Dress! Was perfect for the Great Gatsby event we attended!  The dress was a little snug around the bust and the sequins would get caught on the sheath underneath. Other than that it was a nice dress! I would recommend it.

Beautiful dress - lots of compliments The other reviewers weren't kidding - it runs small, the sequins are scratchy and that stupid liner hung down about 1-1/2" below the hem I wore some gold metallic Nine West shoes that matched perfectly. . I wore a stick on bra and that worked fine. Overall a stunning dress with some issues that we women have to learn to deal with to look beautiful =)

Show Stopper  I worn this dress to my boyfriends opening night on Broadway and it was a HIT! I was very comfy and I felt like a star in it all evening. I am a bit busty and this dress was very flattering to my chest and curves. 

I  love RTR and use it for everything now! I was worried about the dress getting to me in time so I called and they were so helpful and had it to me by that evening!

Glamour that turns heads! The sequins (sewn into the lace) are very scratchy.  It definitely irritated my arms, but I sucked it up for the glam!  
I liked the fit and length.  I could wear a strapless bra too.  
The slip underneath did poke out a little in the back, but it wasn't a big deal. 
The 4 had a broken zipper so I'm glad the 6 fit me well.  It runs large (I usually wear a 4). 

Overall very fun dress - got lots of compliments!

Beautiful dress
 I have broad shoulders so I choose to wear a size larger than I normally wear.  The lace top was tight on me but otherwise the dress was very comfortable.

Beautiful dress, lots of compliments! This dress fit true to size and had beautiful lace detail. It's an illusion neckline so the lace at the top has no underlay and then the lining is shaped like a strapless dress. I wore a strapless bra to show off the lace better. I loved this dress and got tons of compliments. I would definitely rent this dress again!

Gorgeous dress
 Favorite dress I've worn to date. I felt so pretty and received so many compliments. I have a smaller natural waist and my trouble spot is my belly - this was the perfect dress to combat those issues
Beautiful, on trend dress Pretty dress, love the sheer lace top. The cap sleeves were not very flattering on my arms.

Sexy and classic! Love, love, love this dress. As far as size I normally am a 0-2 and the 0 fit perfectly. The top of the dress fits like a corset which was great.  I am a 28 E in bra size and it fit perfectly up top. There is elastic in the hooks to allow for bustier people. I am 5'7" and the dress hit right above the knee. I got loads of compliments all night long!

I got a lot of compliments on this dress, however it was tight in my rib cage. This dress was very pretty and appropriate for a black tie invited wedding. Rent the Runway sized me down and not up and I should have worn a size 4 not a size 2. I'm 5'1, 115 lbs, customer service should have known better not to give me a size 0! The corset area was so tight I had a hard time taking deep breaths and sitting down. But I did like the dress and the compliments I got on it.
Tight on top; loose in midriff  Not worn, dress was too tight on shoulders but too loose around my stomach. Uncomfortable

Literally had people admirably staring at me throughout the event. Made me feel so confident! Didn't realize that the whole dress was lace, which I don't usually like but it was gorgeous. I usually wear a 6 and it was close fitting but not overly tight. Built in slip + lace meant that I didn't need to suck anything in

I wish I could buy it. I LOVED this dress! So classy and beautiful. Think along the lines of Kate Middleton style. The one thing I noted is this dress has a built in corset and it got sort of uncomfortable after eating and sitting down for a play. It wasn't so tight that I wanted to take if off immediately but It was noticeable. It made the fit look amazing though!

It was okay It was a pretty ho-hum dress, it fit well and it was pretty, the fabric is nice but there's nothing really WOW about it.  It has no real shape... I ended up not wearing it.  The lace is really pretty though.
RENT THIS DRESS!  My chest is large and was tight yet comfortable in the dress!

Guests were asked to wear black to this party and I wanted something pretty & not too revealing. Both sizes fit me but the 10 was just a little too tight and I knew I was going to be dancing at this party.  I went with the larger size and was very comfortable.

This was one of the prettiest dresses I've ever worn. I didn't want to return it! This dress blew away my expectations. The lace is gorgeous in person and I received so many compliments. I was nervous about the bra situation, but I didn't need one. The dress, specifically the bust, is so well made it gives you great shape and support without smashing your chest. The dress was a bit longer on me than it is on the model, but it was still a flattering length. I would rent this dress again in a heartbeat!

Loved this! This dress worked out really well. There isn't a huge size difference between the 4 and the 6 but the 4 was slightly better so went with that one. I felt great in it and it was pretty comfortable though the material doesn't have a lot of give.

Black Tie wedding hit I received so many compliments in this dress. The 8 was a little snug in the bust and waist and the 10 was a little big up top. Ended up wearing the 10 so that I wasn't uncomfortable all night. The dress doesn't require a bra, but you can wear one if you want to.
Beautiful dress I'm usually between a 2 and 4 and the 2 fit perfectly. Usually 2 is too short on me (I'm 5'7) but this one fit great! Detailing in front is also very pretty

Loved this dress!  Felt comfortable all night! The fit was great, I wore the 8, it was true to size.  The only thing I would prepare people for is that it is a bit thicker than I thought, so wearing it for an outdoor...summer wedding in Atlanta was a bit warm...I would save this one for fall/winter occasions!  But I felt great in it all night, it is the type of dress that once you put it on, you won't have to fuss with it!
Nice elegant black dress Wore this to a funeral, was good choice for the venue

Lots of compliments on this dress.  This dress was really pretty, but definitely needs some jewelry to provide that wow factor. The lace around the arms was kind of tight and scratchy, making it not fun to dance in.  It was pretty, but semi boring and uncomfortable on top, hence the rating.
Perfect! This dress fit perfectly, and was absolutely gorgeous! I wore it to a charity gala and I got so many compliments! I would definitely recommend this dress!

Perfect for the occasion  I liked it but wouldn't have chosen this dress for my body type if I had tried it on first.  I have small shoulders and a large bust (34d) and the lace neckline was too high on me and was a little itchy.
It was the perfect dress to wear to a wedding. The dress look lovely on and I got lots of compliments! Very simple and classy dress.

Classy yet fun! The dress was a replacement dress and I was so pleased with the results. I am glad that I got this for a work awards ceremony. I felt perfect in it. 
My back up dress - the 4 fit well, but I just felt more comfortable in the 6. It was the most comfortable dress that I have gotten from Rent the Runway yet!
Really enjoyed wearing this dress!  fit well could have used a smaller size but may not of fit through the hips.

Great lace LBD! After reading the reviews, I went with this dress for a wedding on a cool spring evening, and I am glad I did!  I paired it with black tights and emerald green statement earrings.  The lace neckline is beautiful.  The bust line has very little give, so if you are larger chested, definitely size up as a backup.  Same with the skirt, it runs very fitted through the hips, so size up if you're a pear-shape like me!  Overall, great dress, would recommend to anyone.

Beautiful dress, very comfortable I wore this to a friend's wedding in May.  I wore it with a strapless bra, and it worked out fine, but make sure that your bra is tight because there isn't really any way to adjust or pull it up once the dress is on.  The 6 was just a smidge tight up top, but it fit well in the waist and hips, so I went with it over the size 8.  The length was good, even when sitting in church.  Would definitely recommend!
Complimentsss Fit was great and lace on top was gorgeous.  I liked the built in boning, and it is a very classy length.  Very flattering in the stomach area and not too tight.

Classic little, black dress. I rented this dress in the 8 and 10. Ended up wearing the 10 because the 8 was too tight, but the 10 was a little big in the waist. This dress does not stretch. I did receive a lot of compliments. It is a classic dress that will never go out of style.
Size down!  Cute, but lace doesn't pop in pictures or in a dark room. Runs very big in my opinion.
I honestly never felt prettier!  I received so many compliments throughout the night. I loved this dress so much that I didn't want to return it!  It fit perfectly.

Awesome for graduation! This dress was perfect for my graduation ceremony.  It hit just above the knee and was very professional. The lace around the neck was beautiful. The only complaint I have is the lace on the sleeves stuck up a little, but it was something that only I could notice. Dress was comfortable and classy.
How easy it was to get a dress for my event. Dress was gorgeous, the sizing just ran a little small.

Pretty! I loved wearing this dress, I received so many compliments on the lace detail and it was really comfortable with plenty of room in the hips, and nice that you can wear a standard bra. Highly recommend for a cocktail party or wedding!
Pretty but didn't wear it I ordered this as a backup but wound up not wearing it.  It is a really cute, classic LBD and I would rent it again
Classy but sexy I wore this for a bachelorette party. It was perfect. Just  enough class the little bit of sexiness.

wish I owned it! I loved the fit of this dress! It was forgiving in all the right places with me being wider in the hips. The lace was very nice quality, and I loved that it was high in the front but open a bit more in the back so it wasn't too stuffy :) It was the perfect length for me, and I was comfortable wearing taller heels to the wedding without feeling like it showed too much leg.  Really do wish I owned it!

Tons of compliments and another option from your traditional LBD! I received this dress as a last minute back up because the original dress I ordered didn't fit me properly. I wore a ten, which was a smidge too big, but that makes sense because I almost always wear an 8. It was super comfortable with room for my bust (34dd) and still looked very flattering. I received compliments all night!

Amazing! I wish I owned this dress! I can't say enough fabulous things about this dress.  This dress was my 5th rental and my absolute favorite thus far.  It is perfect for a winter wedding/party.  It is so classy and fits like a glove.  It is incredibly flattering and I received so many compliments. I wear a D+ cup and didn't need a bra.  There is a corset in the dress which might take some people a little getting used to but it's actually not bad at all and helps give you perfect posture.  Some people made comments about the sleeves and chest area being uncomfortable but that was not the case for me.  I would recommend sizing up for your backup size considering the dress is lace.
This dress was perfect!! I rented this dress for a wedding, it was classy, comfortable and ran true to size. I received compliments all night long! Would definitely rent again.
Cute little black dress, wish I could keep it. Fit like a glove, a bit short when you sit.  It was a great dress to dance in, very comfortable.

:) I got so many compliments on this dress!  It has a built in bra in it so I chose not to wear a strapless and it held up pretty well. I'm 5'4" and the dress fell right above my knees. The material has a little but of pull which was awesome for dancing. 

For a first time renter, I can say I was highly impressed and cannot wait to order again!!

So many compliments!!! I rented this dress for my best friend's wedding where I was a personal attendant. I got so many compliments on it and everyone kept asking where I got it from. I did wear a spanx slip underneath because it did just smooth the lines of my bra and underwear but it was very comfortable to wear and move. I would definitely wear/rent again!
Very flattering Absolutely loved this dress. It was flattering and comfortable. I wish I would have gotten a picture in it. Highly recommend it!

This dress is perfect for a formal occasion or black tie event. I wore this dress to a black tie wedding and felt amazing.  It fits very snuggly and an inner lining with hooks really cinches you in at the waist.  I would definitely rent it again!

Gorgeous lacy dress!  The dress is fitted and accents your curves. The dress flares out a lil so it helps hide some tummy pooch. No need for spanx! Inside of the dress on the back is also a latch which helps cinches in the area under the bust so you can wear a strapfree bra or even go braless without feeling naked up top. While the dress appears to hit the model mid-thigh, it hit me just above the knees for my short stature (5'3"). I loved this length on me!

Ribcage area is a lil snug so you might need to size up if you have a wider ribcage area or bust. I tried on the next size up and while it was more comfy in that area, the excess room in the chest and hip area was no bueno! Way too roomie. I have a small chest (34A). The capped sleeves look like it might hinder arm movement, but I was able to lift and hold my two kids all night without a problem.

The lace around the collar of the dress is free standing and tends to flop down in the front. The lace around the cap sleeves stays up just fine though.
Great for a winter wedding! Loved this dress. Got slightly stretched out as you wore it. It was perfect for a winter wedding.

Felt great in this classic lace dress! Had to wear the larger size (I rented a 6 and an 8).  The 6 fit everywhere aside from the chest/shoulders area.  Lace does not 'give' at all and I didn't want to run the risk of ripping the dress from hugging someone or busting out the wrong dance move...LOL!
My friend pictured with me actually rented her dress as well - they were very similar in style.
Overall, very nice dress for a classy, elegant event.

Elegant and beautiful dress I ordered a 2 and a 4. The 2 was a little tight, the 4 was a little too baggy and actually seemed surprisingly longer, so I went with the 2 and it worked out fine.  My only complaint is that the lace rubbed against my neck at the top, which was a little irritating.
It is a beautiful dress, and I got a lot of compliments. I wore it to a wedding and it was perfect. I would definitely recommend it!

Dress fit perfect! I really liked the lace detail. I am 116lbs, 5'5" and this dress zipped up perfectly with no problem. I also ordered the 0 but it felt a little tight around the chest area (bra size is 34B). I decided to wear my hair up to show off the beautiful neck line and back detailing. I would recommend this dress. I have a short torso/ long legs so the dress hit a few inches above the knee. Perfect for any event and I got tons of compliments.

Beautiful material, best for taller folks with slimmer hips/fuller bust This was picked out by a RTR stylist as a backup dress when my original dress didn't make it to me in time for my flight to the location of the wedding I was attending. I was sent the 4 and the 6; the 4 was too tight in the hips by far but fit better at the waist and bust, whereas the 6 fit over my hips and was a bit loose on top and didn't cinch my waist as much as would have been optimally flattering. However, I got a padded strapless bra to wear with it, and that filled it out a bit. The looser waist also made it easier to sit and eat and not get uncomfortable. However, the sleeve-type top part was a bit looser than would be ideal, as it's definitely made for someone with a longer torso. In sum, it wasn't the perfect dress, but it definitely worked out, and I would even consider renting it again for the right occasion.
