This would be perfect for someone a few inches taller with a less pear-shaped body than mine (straight up and down, or fuller bust). Would work for all seasons.

So many compliments! This dress was perfect for a fall wedding! The fit was great. The material is not stretchy at all so make sure you order a size up as a back up. There were a few pulls in the lace on the front of the dress, but since it was black, it wasn't anything that anyone else would notice! I was able to wear a strapless bra with it. It was comfortable enough to dance the night away. I loved this dress!

Pretty Lace but Narrow in Hips & Shoulders Thought this dress was well made and lace was pretty but the hips were way too narrow for a pear shaped person.  Usually a 2/4 in Shoshanna fits me perfectly but this dress is very narrow.  As others commented the shoulders especially are quite tight.  Very elegant dress but not for me.
Beautiful dress with elegant details that ran true to size! Dress fit exceptionally well, with an inner lining and clasp that helps define your waist. Very well made and worth it!

Dress came right on time and it was in perfect condition! Great quality looked just like picture. Fit true to size had an extra clasp on bust so no need to wear a bra. Not a ton of give to the dress but still fit nicely! Def would rent again!

Pretty dress for a fall wedding What makes this dress pretty and unique is the lace at the top.  I rented it for a fall wedding in the Northeast and paired it with sheer black pantyhose and high black patent pumps. It wasn't my favorite rental because of the comfort (or lack thereof), but I got compliments on it and everyone thought it was unique.  As other reviewers have said, the material has no stretch to it and there's structured boning in the midsection, so definitely go a size up if you're used to wearing fitted clothes. Overall I was happy with this dress but it wasn't my favorite rental.
Great experience! Loved the dress. Loved the dress! It was fitted but still classy. I'm usually a 4 but I ended up wearing a 6. I recommend ordering a size bigger than you typically wear.
Elegant and forgiving!  Beautiful dress! Classic but also unique. Very flattering.

Loved this dress! Very flattering and comfortable.  This dress is awesome! I wore it with a gold belt to a winter wedding. Beautiful neckline, no necklace necessary. Can be worn with a black or nude regular bra or a strapless. Comfortable all night. I didn't want to send this dress back. It's the best LBD.

Loved this dress.  Wore it to a wedding & received tons of compliments.  I ordered a size 2 & a 4.  Wore the size 4..  It fit great.  Only thing to note as other reviewers stated-it's lace so there's no give.
Perfect for a wedding This dress was perfect for a fall wedding.  Was longer on me than on the model which was perfect for the dance floor!

I wore this for a wedding in Germany! It was beautiful, got many compliments! This dress was amazing. It was like a giant pair of spanx! I wore a sticky bra to give the girls some shape, and wore control top panty hose for some extra tummy control. It was perfect for the cool weather and I felt stunning. The only con would have been the arms. They were snug, so if you feel like your weight gain could be in the arms then this could be a problem. My arms have always been my struggle area! My profile wont update so it won't display my about me info. I am 5"10, 34D chest, hourglass shape, and I weigh 150lbs! I wore a size medium and it fit perfectly.

Absolutely LOVE! It is tight, but actually super comfortable since the fabric is stretchy I wore it to a winter wedding and it was perfect. Pretty warm as far as dresses go and I loved that it had a little festive flair without being too over the top. Really flattering too. I highly recommend wearing a bright, colored earring that pops with the dress. I wore the XS but could have made the S work too, so def size up, not down, if you are unsure.
Felt like a million bucks!!!  The back was my favorite part of the dress! It was elegant and sexy at the same time. I loved it!
Gatsby themed wedding  Fit so good! Was extremely comfortable! Got nothing but compliments all night long!

I had tons of compliments!  I absolutely love this dress and so did my husband. This dress fit like a glove I'm a size 2 so the XS fit perfectly and there was just enough stretch to be comfortable. This dress will definitely make you feel sexy!

Fit perfectly Loved this dress! I fit into both the small and medium, but decided to wear the medium as it wasn't as tight on my arms. I did wear a strapless bra to fill out the bust a bit. It was perfect for my 1920s themed birthday party. Would recommend!
This dress was so comfortable and stretchy and flattering!!!! Fits fairly true to size.Im usually a 10/12 and wore an xl for added comfort.

Perfect for a Vegas Wedding - classy and glamorous!  I would highly recommend this dress! The material is comfortable (surprisingly for a sequined dress) and I feel that it would be flattering to many different figures.  It has enough stretch that it hugs in all the right places... and be prepared - it is even more eye catching in person than in pictures!  LOVE!
Never felt more beautiful!  The dress was a perfect fit, it was able to breathe during the of dead summer in NJ, but I never got chilly with the AC, because the full length arms.

Classy, modest (but flattering) dress for a formal charity gala with my clients and coworkers. Dress runs a bit small (i.e. the large was tight for me and I'm typically a size 8) and tight in the arms. But once on, comfortable and flattering though strapless/backless bra and spanx are a must if you are curvier. The beige underslip hangs out of the bottom and shows in the very high slit in the back which is why i give it a 4 instead of 5 stars. But overall a good choice for a more conservative event where you still want to look nice, not boring.

The wedding was a formal, black tie affair. This dress was absolutely stunning.  I received compliments all night.  Beware- it has a low cut back.  You cannot wear a strapless bra and after nursing three kids, I needed something... sticky cups worked.  It was a stretchy and breathable material.  It was form fitting and accented my curves.  Love, love, love this dress!  This was my first experience with Rent the Runway and will not be my last!
The dress was stunning! The fit was amazing, perfect length for a charity gala and I got comments ALL night!! I would definitely recommend for a formal event. It was super comfortable as well!
Beautiful and comfortable dress! Awesome dress! Wore a size bigger than usual as it is very tight, but stretchy and comfortable!

This dress is gorgeous! The arms are tight and I wore a size up (a small
instead of an xs and it fit perfectly)

The dress was a hit...and the dress fit PERFECTLY! I will definitely be renting again in the future! The dress fit like a glove and was very comfortable and secure.  The only thing was the split in the back did show the slip underneath...other than that, the dress was flawless!

The dress was perfect for a 1920's themed gala--a modern twist on the art deco era flapper girl I wore this dress to a black-tie gala at the National Building Museum in Washington, DC. The theme was 1920s speakeasy, and the style, cut, and pattern of the dress spoke to that theme.
The dress is definitely meant to be form-fitting, but with the right size, it shouldn't ride up in the back and the mesh-covered cut-outs lay just so that the dress still looks completely elegant and classic in a room where everyone is wearing various ballgown length and cocktail style dresses. 
I felt confident wearing this on stage during my event and I received numerous compliments throughout the night. I would highly recommend!

Just ok Rented this for my daughter to attend a wedding
pros:  dress fit her shape perfectly (sleeves a bit hard to get up)
cons:  lining kept showing in front and on split in back

not my daughter's fit info on profile
Great Gatsby Theme Great for the formal event I went too! wonderful dress, great fit

This dress was perfect for this black tie wedding. I received so many compliments!  The fit was perfect. I didn't wear a bra because of the low cut back, but no one could tell. It hugs your body and was extremely comfortable. I didn't try on the medium because the large fit so well. I'm 5'7" 145lbs, have an hour glass figure. I highly recommend this dress!!!
Dress worked beautifully for my friend roaring 1920 theme party. Dress fit like a glove!  Great dress!  Easy to move in. Loved the deep v back of the dress.
Standout dress I usually wear small and was able to wear a small in this dress. I did have a little room in the top because I'm about a 32B. Overall this dress was beautiful.

Gorgeous I felt like a celebrity wearing this. It made me feel beautiful and confident. It was very form fitting but so comfortable and easy to dance and party in. Hate to return this. Would rent again in the future. It's a definite head turner.

Made me feel glamorous, elegant AND sexy for a black tie gala! Such a gorgeous dress, and the back was miraculously both low enough to be really breathtaking, but didn't show my bra (I've always been too cheap for strapless anyway). I'm tall and lanky, but this flattered my body and made it look like I have a butt, which is incredibly difficult to achieve.  Overall, if you're thinking of getting this dress, GO FOR IT - you won't regret it!

Perfect for a winter wedding! I wore this to a wedding in Ireland right around Christmas time. The small fit perfectly, and was true to size. The only issue I ran into was the slit in the back was different sizes on the two dresses that were sent to me, and not just because they were different sizes. the small slit was MUCH longer length wise than the medium, and I ended up having to pin the slit a bit because my bottom was almost showing. Other than that, the dress fit wonderfully and I received many compliments.
This dress just absolutely sparkles and the design pattern is very flattering. For fitting dress, but the pattern helps flatter the fuigure, even with the tight fit

The dress was so comfortable and easy to dance in! I received many compliments all evening long. A surprisingly comfortable dress that looks absolutely stunning on. The dress does run very small. I normally wear a size 4 or small. Thankfully my backup size was a medium and although it runs long the dress itself fit nicely.

Stunning! I received uber compliments! I would have worn a medium if it had been in stock. The large fit, but I could tell it was loose in some places where it should have fit more snuggly. I would definitely recommend this dress for future renters.

LOVED this dress! I received so many compliments! Very figure flattering. I am curvy and didnt have to wear crazy spanx with it. Also, surprisingly comfortable. I thought that the sequins would make it scratchy but the lining made it wear very well. Most importantly, easy to dance in!

Classy yet sexy It is a tight fitting dress, you can't hide anything underneath it.  This was the first time I had to buy shapewear for a dress, but with it on, I felt and looked great in it!  I received compliments from strangers the whole night.  It's stretchy enough to dance in.  You can't wear a bra with it though, so keep that in mind.  I have wear a 36A bra, so keep in mind that it might be tight for someone with a large chest.  Overall, I loved the dress and the look!

Stunning dress! I wish I'd listened to the other reviewers about how small this dress runs.  I am a fairly standard size 8, sometimes a size 6.  I ordered the large and a medium as a back-up.  I couldn't get both legs into the medium, it was TINY.  The large fit, but I would've been much more comfortable in an XL.  It's a stunning dress, very comfortable, and I received loads of compliments.  I would definitely recommend, but get the bigger size!

Everyone gave me such nice compliments with this dress. I was 26 weeks pregnant in this dress and my bump was not squished at all. I'm usually a medium but the large fit great, arms were a little snug. Material was sequined so it was scratchy, but gave just enough shine without over doing it. Couldn't wear a bra because the back cuts low. I would wear it again.

I felt sexy, sophisticated, glamorous, and comfortable. You can't ask more in a dress!  The instant I put this dress on I fell in love. This dress gave me curves I didn't realize I had and fit me like a glove as if it was tailored to me! This dress was extremely appropriate for the wedding I attended and I was the talk of the night in my gorgeous dress! Everyone wanted to know where I got it and remarked on how wonderful I looked! This was very sophisticated, fun, sexy, and comfortable. I'm truly sad to see it go! Because this dress has so many sequins I did get changed at the venue vs driving for an hour in the car with it which was nice (purely for comfort reasons)! Otherwise there's nothing really negative to say about it!

Elegant dress for the Metropolitan Opera, style hit the mark for formal, open back was flattering. Elegant dress for the Metropolitan Opera, style hit the mark for formal, but not "out of place" formal. The attire that night ran from sweatshirt and jeans, then mostly button up work attire, up to long gowns, if you can believe it. This dress has wow factor, great shimmer in low light. Ordered 8 and 10, dress label read M & L, respectively. Daily, I usually wear a M, however, I wore the backup size 10; and the 10 was tight. To avoid visible lines and smooth out the bumps under the arms, use proper undergarments. Considering the open V back and tightness, I wore no bra with breast petals, corset to fit into the dress more comfortably and give curves, thong, thigh highs no garter. Per recommendations from a previous renter, double-sided tape was needed to conceal liner at the back slit, very easy to apply. Rent this dress: strong, sexy, flattering look. An enjoyable evening with the music, my husband and my outfit ;)

I received a ton of compliments and loved this dress - perfect for a 1920s gala! This dress was so glamorous and beautiful - I absolutely loved wearing it and felt great in it.  As mentioned in almost all the reviews, the lining does show in the back slit, but I was able to pin it.  This dress was so snug it really held me in and I actually sized down because I felt like the tighter fit was more flattering.  It was so body-hugging that I was able to get away with not wearing a bra which was great! This dress was just so beautiful I absolutely loved it and felt confident and great it it all night.

So many compliments on this dress. Great for an evening wedding at a old New England Mansion. Detailing on dress is wonderful but it is form fitting. I made the mistake of waiting too long to reserve this dress and ended up having to rent a size down. The dress looked good all night but it the kind of dress that you should size up rather than down in. Also, be mindful of the slit in the back.

I received so many compliments on this dress! Beautifully classy. The material is very stretchy so it fits many body types well. I wore this dress to a wedding while 4 months pregnant and the dress showed of my little bump while not being restrictive. I received so many compliments the entire night and felt very sexy and confident in this dress. The dress arrived with a small snag in the upper mesh on the right side so you could see the under layer almost like a run in a stocking. It wasn't noticeable enough to be a problem but I was aware of it all night. Would definitely recommend this dress for a formal affair.

I wore this for my bachelorette party and received so many compliments. What a stunning dress! The dress fit perfectly, I decided with the XS as it fit snug and I felt the comfiest in it. The only problem was the slip which would show at times. I had read that double sided tape would have helped but I didn't have any on me. I highly recommend this dress!

Best Dress I've worn at RTR  I felt like I was in between a small and a medium. I was on the fence of wearing the small but felt like it fit better length wise and it was so tight it acted like a spanx. It turned out to be the best choice! I received so many compliments from people. I felt amazing in it. It was comfortable and you can move in  it. I didn't have to wear anything to hold my tummy in because the material of the dress did that for me! It is a low back but I believe a low bra converter would work. (although I personally did not try it). The pictures make the low back look super low but it was more of lower mid back. My favorite RTR dress yet! The quality of the sequins are amazing and all in place!

It runs small, it's super tight.  Order a size up I am 5'2 at 110 lbs, petite build. I usually wear a size 2 or 4 in a dress so given the size and reviews, I was sure a small would fit perfectly. Once I got the dress and tried it on, I realize it runs really small. It is extremely tight. I should have ordered a Medium. I ended up wearing a different dress but it's a gorgeous dress, just order a size up.

Office Christmas Party Hit! I wore this dress to my firm Christmas party in the new Mercedes-Benz Stadium here in Atlanta, GA and it couldn't have been more perfect! Everyone loved it, it was comfortable and I rented it at a steal. ;) I would recommend definitely rent this dress again and recommend it!

This was my first holiday party with my company and it was truly remarkable. A night to remember! This dress received compliments all night! The back exposed the perfect amount while still keeping me classy. It was not too heavy and hugged my body well. I could walk with easy and the shoulders were snug enough but not too snug that I never felt it was going to slip off. I am 5'1 so this dress came down to my mid-calf, which was what I wanted,  if you are my size and looking for a shorter cocktail dress this might be too long. (Please disregard my face in one of the pictures, I don't like taking pictures but it has no correlation to the amazing dress!)
I felt like I was on a red carpet!   Perfect fit! I recommend wearing spanx. I received compliments all night!
I did not wear this dress to my event, but loved the fit.   Tight fit, you can't wear a bra or spanx with this.

One of my favorite dresses ever! I've attended 5-6 formal events at West Point over the last few years and rented from RTR for two of them. This is definitely one of my favorite dresses I've ever worn. It's comfortable due to the stretchy lining, flattering for lots of body types (including my bigger hips/thighs), classy yet sexy, and basically made me feel like Beyonce. I liked the overall fit of the large size better, but I have broad shoulders and lifting has made my arms bigger so the sleeves of the large just didn't quite do it so I went with the XL and was very happy! Got tons of compliments, would definitely recommend!
best dress so far.   very sexy, comfortable and great length.  do not need a bra!

It is classy and sexy. Rent this dress!  The dress fit me like a glove; I felt like it was borderline true to size/ runs small. The liner in the back of the dress does show a little on the bottom, but it didn't bother me.

I felt beautiful, the dress was comfy and it went great with the Great Gatsby 20s theme! Fit is snug, I normally wear XS/S and I wish I has the medium to at least TRY. I didn't even attempt the XS! haha-- The slit in the back pulls and you can see the tan underlayer which is annoying but I pinned it and it was okay.. It was def the only thing that bothered me! Didn't need to wear a bra (looked funny with one, even the sticky ones). Overall very pleased with my purchase! LOVE the back <3

This dress will get you compliments from total strangers. This dress was super comfortable and fun.  I received compliments from friends, family, and total strangers.  The long sleeves were great for the fall weather but the low-cut back added a fun bit of sexiness.  If only I could make this a permanent part of my closet!

Beautiful, well-made dress  This dress definitely runs on the smaller side and shows off every curve--shapewear is your friend if you rent this dress! Weight was perfect for colder weather and the low back was a great detail, but definitely required a sticky bra or a backless bra converter if you need some extra support. The sequins were beautiful and I felt like a million bucks--I got compliments all night. I was sad to send this dress back--will definitely rent again!

James Bond themed 40th bday party! This dress is fricken rockin! I got SO many compliments on it and I even landed me a man that I am still dating ;) haha.  It's super sexy without being revealing.  The small fit, but wouldn't have been as comfortable for me.  The medium was perfect, could dance the night away in it.
Get it!  Wore this for a black tie optional fall wedding. Love! Great alternative to a floor length dress. Requires no accessories.

The building where the wedding was held was a 1920's speakeasy.  The style of the dress was perfect! The dress runs smaller than I anticipated.  Being open in the back, I think the dress runs more tightly to stay in place.  Also, plan undergarments accordingly for the open back so no bra straps show.

So Many Compliments!!!  This dress was amazing. Stretchy. Flattering. Loved it. The church was warm therefore I was SUPER warm but other than that, perfect for a fall wedding. I received SO many compliments on it.  I'm thinking about renting this same brand for my birthday!!! Make sure to wear a backless or low back bra.

Perfect for a NYE Black Tie Optional Wedding! Loved this dress and will rent it again if I have the opportunity. I would say I am a mix between petite and athletic. I am 5'4" and 115 lbs.

I found it to fit pretty true to size - I have athletic arms, so the sleeves were a little tight, but I didn't mind. I wore a backless strapless bra, only because I have a small bust and wouldn't be able to get away with wearing no bra. I didn't wear Spanx. My husband did have to pin the liner in the back so it wouldn't show, but that was the only con to the entire dress.

Overall, very comfortable since it's made of a stretchy material. Received TONS of compliments all night! One of my more favorite rentals from RTR.

Sexy and sophisticated This was a last minute, overnight-ed back-up dress and it was INCREDIBLE!  It was comfortable all night and the fit was true to size. Prepare to not wear a bra or find a backless, strapless substitute. I was unofficially "best dressed" according to a few other women at the event.

Love wearing this, it was very dramatic.   Like others have said, the dress was pretty stretchy and the material didn't scratch at all.  Depending on your size, spanks may not work as the dress hugs your curves, the back is low and the slit up the back is high.

If you have anything other than stick arms, this dress is not for you!
 I got this dress as a backup, and I'm very glad my first choice of dress fit well.  I do not have fat or large forearms by any means.  They might be a tad muscular, but definitely not considered large.  I could not event get this dress on because the sleeves would not fit over my forearms.  Definitely not the spot I was concerned would not fit when I ordered this!

GLAM to the max! This dress makes you feel like a glamorous diva once you slip it on! It's form fitting yet flattering. The sequins aren't excessively sparkly, which was a concern at first. A tasteful, classy look for a formal occasion!
Great and comfortable dress! Very comfortable and so many compliments. Black tie event perfect.
Love this dress Great length, super sleek and sexy but covered up enough for a winter wedding.

Very flattering This dress was perfect for a cool spring day. The material was thicker, so it covered up imperfections. It has pockets, but it definitely doesn't make you look wider. I really liked it!
Loved this; and I received so many compliments! This is a great dress! It was a perfect fit and I loved the pockets. Many people complimented me and I felt great.
Very comfortable and flattering Really nice quality dress.  Easy to wear and style.  Would rent again.

Well made, very pretty, lots of compliments  The dress was beautiful, somewhat casual. I wore it to a rehearsal dinner, I did feel it was a bit short for my height (5'8") standing up was fine, but when I saw down and had to scoot over in a car, I'm afraid I showed a little too much to my boyfriend's grandmother. I'm not sure this dress would work for someone with a bust. I have none and it was a bit tight.  Overall, I really liked the dress and would rent it again.
Nice pattern, good for winter/fall occasion.  Pretty pattern, but the cut of the dress made me look way larger than I really am. I wouldn't recommend this dress for a person with a narrow figure.

The dress fit perfect, and was great for the wedding venue on the beach!  Very preppy :) It fit really well, nice material, in great condition.  Received a ton of compliments, and can't wait for my next RTRT!!

Professional and flattering I'd wear this dress again for work or a more conservative event like a baby shower.   Its a warmer fabric so I do not suggest you wear it in the summer.  Its very flattering so I think any body type would look nice. 
In clothes I wear an 8 but for dresses with a zipper up the back or side I always size up because I have a larger rib cage.  With this dress I wore the 10 and the zipper barely made it past the beginning of my ribs.  If I ordered it again I'd get the 12 just to be safe.

Great pattern and fabric., easy to wear.  Would rent again.  Wore it for dressed up business meeting Perfect fit for athletic body.  Great length...a touch shorter than the knee but appropriate for any business function.

Felt sophisticated and classy.  Great fit. Makes your waist look great! I felt so sophisticated in it. Very classy. 

The material was a little thick for a outside event in the spring.
Loved the dress. Very comfortable and classy. Lots of compliments!  Runs small in the chest. Loved the pockets and thick material. Would rent again.
Cute--not formal enough for some weddings It was a cute dress, flattering on as well--just not fancy enough for a downtown wedding.

Not exactly what I expected I chose this dress for a free RTR Pro birthday rental and it was just fine.  Definitely check the DVF size chart, because it runs a bit smaller than some other brands - but I did find it to be accurate.  The 4 fit as well (more snugly), but since I was going to my birthday dinner I wanted to have plenty of room to enjoy dessert.

When I say it wasn't what I expected, I didn't anticipate the fabric being almost like a weighty upholstery.  Also, the colors are fairly muted.

This was definitely not my favorite rental, but it was free... so I would say it was worth what I paid for it.  I'd recommend it for a work conference or something since it's pretty conservative and still comfortable.

Wore it for my graduation! Really cute dress, my only problems were the fabric was heavy for an outdoor summer event and it was a bit short when sitting (I'm 5'9").  The pattern was very pretty, it has pockets(!), overall a great dress!
Loved this dress and so did my finance! The perfect dress for multiple occasions.  The bust was a tad bit tight on me but it wasn't uncomfortable. The rest was true to size.
Pattern Perfect I loved this dress so much that I kept it even though the event I rented it for was canceled.  My husband liked it even more.  Thanks RTR for the impromptu date night!

Great dress! I actually thought the fabric was silky and light from the picture but it's fairly thick and heavy. While it wasn't ideal for a summer wedding, it was good quality and I was able to not wear a bra because of it (which I can rarely do with a full chest). The dress had pockets too which was great. The fit was true to size.

Great colors and fit! The fit was great! Only issue: If you're planning on wearing it for a long wedding or event, consider getting a size smaller. The dress tends to stretch as the night goes on. The event I wore this to began at 2 and went until midnight. By the end of the evening, it was practically hanging off me. Great, cute dress, got a million compliments!

Perfect fit, classy and fun! I could NOT have asked for a better dress. I wore it to my boyfriends graduation, where I'd be meeting his parents for the first time, so I needed something that was tasteful but still represented my personality. This dress was it. I'm usually a size 4 but I found that going down to a 2 was much more flattering, since the material is a bit thick and can look bulky in some areas. I'm so glad I got the size down because the 2 fit like a glove, especially at the waist and bust (which I was worried about). Got so many compliments on it, I wish I could keep it! (Also, this was my first rental) Definitely recommend!

. I wore this to a wedding in Greenwich CT last week.  As other reviews note it is heavy material so looks a little more formal.  I rented the 2 and 4 and was able to fit into the 2.  It is definitely tight and slimming in the waist and up area.  It has pockets -- unpopular opinion, I don't love pockets; their practicality is overrated and they tend just to add a lot of fabric in the hip area unnecessarily.  The black in it makes it easy to match.  You can undo the button at the top to make it a little less formal / conservative.  Overall I liked this dress and would rent again.

Comfortable.   Well Made.
 I rented this dress for a more casual wedding.   The dress is cuter on than it looks online.   The material is thicker and had a nice fit.   True to size.    I am smaller on top, so this might be a bit tight on someone bustier.    Would rent again.

Cute Retro look! Loved the look of this dress and got tons of compliments, I don't think it photographs as well.  The top runs very small, I ordered a 4 and 6 and had to go up to accommodate my bust, which was basically smashed to my collar bone in the 4 (but otherwise fit every where).  Its a great fabric, and suitable for a lot of occasions!

This dress was my backup but it should have been my first selection This dress was warm for winter and looked so cute with some knee high brown boots. Everyone complimented it all evening and I was fashionable even during a chilly Denver night.

Unique pattern  This is a great transition dress for spring or fall. The material has some texture to it like a tweed but thinner. The pattern is really fun and the peep hole on the chest adds a bit of fun to the look. It was a bit longer on me than the model which makes sense since I'm 5'6". Sizing was pretty normal.

So many compliments on this dress. The dress is true to size, but I am a DD so it was a little tight on my chest.  The fabric of the dress is thick so I wouldn't wear it on a hot day.  I wore it on a cool day and was very comfortable.
Great work dress. Rented this dress to wear to work.  It runs small.  I'm usually a 2/4 but the 6 in this dress fit perfectly.

Elegant and timeless style Tight on the bust!!!  I had to go up one size just to fit my chest and it was still a little snug.  Overall I really loved it and I got plenty of compliments at my pinning ceremony for nursing school.

Comfy, professional, fun This was a great dress for a client dinner where I didn't want to be too buttoned-up (at Southfork Ranch from "Dallas" - see photo).  I'm standing in a way that makes it look "pooched" in front -- that's me; not the dress! The dress was very flattering, comfortable, and cute.  The keyhole neck is fun but not too revealing.  The 8 was a bit loose (comfy for dancing).  Material is heavy ponte so it doesn't tug anywhere.  Would rent again.
Great dress! Dress was made of a more casual fabric than I was expected but worked great for the event I attended!

Great, comfortable dress! I initially tried this dress on at the RTR pop-up shop near me, then rented for eater weekend.  Other than the fact that it was a little snug in the bust area, it was really comfortable.  The material is textured and a little thicker, which made it a good choice for a cool March weekend. I LOVED the pockets in this dress - I think they make the dress really versatile in terms of formality and really comfortable. I would definitely recommend this DVF - I would totally buy it for myself if I could find it!

Super cute and unique pattern, great quality fabric! I rented this dress as part of my unlimited subscription to change up my winter work wardrobe.  I absolutely adored the dot pattern and the high quality fabric.  It is nice and thick and great for cold weather.   The fit was perfect!  The zipper stuck a little bit and was a pinch hard to zip all the way on my own, but I managed with some maneuvering and twisting about.   I got quite a few compliments at work.   Looked great with tights and booties.

Perfect for a fall, "garden party" wedding Sorry I didn't get a better picture...but the dress was a hit!  The colorful pattern makes it stand out, and  the quality material is thick enough to keep you warm on a chilly fall evening.  It was classy, chic and fit like a glove.  Would definitely recommend!

Meeting the parents in style! I wore this dress to a wedding where I met my bf's parents for the first time. The dress got rave reviews. The length and fabric were very classy/appropriate, but the color/fit/keyhole at the top added the right amount of sexy. It was also comfortable for dancing during the reception, with no need to skip the cake.

Great dress!  This dress runs small, I normally wear a 4, but sized up after reading the reviews and I am glad I did. Wore to the office and got several compliments. At the end of the day the material around my bottom looked weird, it could be that it was due to me sitting all day at the office. Because of this I gave it a 4, but it was fine.

Great dress for cooler climate This was the perfect dress to wear to a bridal luncheon on a dreary April in Connecticut.  As many other reviewers have noted, the material is very thick which made it a good selection for a chilly day - this would not work if it were even remotely a warm day!  I paired it with a jacket given the chill in the air.

I am a size 8 in box stores (JCrew, Banana Republic, etc.) and am usually a 10 in designer.  The 10 fit perfectly and was comfortable.  I loved the pockets which came in handy since I ended up not taking my large day bag and opted for a smaller clutch (not pictured).

Great luncheon dress! I wore this dress to the anniversary party of a ladies service organization. The fabric is very thick and the dress is lined, so definitely not for warm weather. I wore black pumps and a cardigan, but you could also pair it with tights and boots. It is a very flattering cut! Although the 6 fit it was snug, so I went with the 8 for a longer length and due to the older audience at the event. I received so many compliments and plan on renting this dress again!
Great Fall Wedding Dress! I got tons of compliments on this dress. The fabric was a very substantial tweed type of fabric. It does run quite small and is tight in the bust.
Loved it! Great fit and quality. Fabric was a little heavy but was fine for a September evening wedding in Cali. Retro-feel.
Comfortable and easy dress to wear at a wedding The dress was comfortable and I received many compliments on it at the wedding I wore it to.

I wore this to my friend's post-wedding brunch and it was very cute! Loved the pattern and the fit is flattering! I will definitely rent this again for a Bridal or Baby Shower or another post-wedding brunch.

This dress fit perfectly! I loved this dress, and it was perfect for the event - a semi-formal party in a large event venue. The fabric is thick, and this worked to my advantage as I'm often cold in venues like this. It kept me warm enough that I could go sleeveless without needing a sweater. It's very slimming and was not at all tight across the chest, which is a problem I have with a lot of other dresses. I would definitely rent this again!

Business Casual Dress with Pockets and Polka Dots The dress if a more of a pink then a creme color like in the photo. I wore this for a large community event, so it worked well as a business casual outfit. I rented it because it had pockets! I was able to keep my iphone in the pocket most of the night, but of course it bulged out of the dress. It is a great dress for a long night of standing and was very comfortable. The dress was a little shorter than expected...went about two inches about the knee. Paired the dress with a belt and I was good to go!

A Great Alternative to the LBD for a Rehearsal Dinner! This was the perfect fit for a Fall Rehearsal and Rehearsal Dinner. I was planning to wear it with nude pumps, but the night ended up being a little chilly so I opted to wear black pumps with black tights and it really made the colors pop. I received so many compliments! This dress is a little on the short side and the material wasn't exactly what I expected (its a tweed like material), but otherwise, its pretty true to size AND it has pockets. I'm always sold on a dress with pockets for events like this - great for storing lipstick and iPhone so a clutch isn't necessary!

Celebrate in style I wore this dress to celebrate my friend's 30th birthday. I styled it with black tights and black pumps because we celebrated in NYC in March - brrr. The dress was super comfortable and fit great. The fabric is on the thicker side, so I wouldn't recommend this for the summer.

I rented this dress for an early fall wedding and overall it worked well.   This dress worked well and the low rental fee was great, however it was not my favorite dress I've gotten from RTR.  The dress looks a much different color in person than it does on the model and in pictures.  The peach dots are much more pronounced.  I almost thought I had been sent the wrong dress because it seemed so pink on the hanger.  The 6 fit great up top, but it was big on the bottom.  I would have liked to try the 4.  However, the bust would have probably been too tight and the length too short.  I'm 5'8" and even the 6 was a little short.  The extra room made it very comfortable though.

great fit and structure I rented this for a rehearsal dinner.  DVF usually runs pretty true to size so I opted for my usual size, 4.  It was my second dress, so no free back up option.  I ordered it crossing my fingers that it would fit, and it did.  I wore with black tights and black flats.  While I loved the dress and the structure was great, it felt a bit plain at the same time.  overall though, I was happy with it!

Wish I had gotten a picture... I really liked this dress. I wore it to a rehearsal dinner and got lots of compliments. I ordered the zero and the two, but the day before they were due to arrive RTR called me and told me the zero had been ruined. They offered to overnight me an extra dress, and let me pick any style I wanted. The one I picked didn't fit so I emailed them and they overnighted me yet another dress in the next size up. Awesome customer service! I wish I had gotten a picture in this dress - if I find one that someone else took I will add it.

Rented this dress for my cousins bridal shower.  Perfect dress for a shower, loved the pockets! Really cute dress.  Material is a little heavy - perfect for a winter or early spring event.  Good length for someone who is 5'4".  I rented both the size 0 and size 2.  Both fit but I went with the 2 because it gave me a little more room under my arm pits and in the bust area.

Very expensive looking dress that fit well.  Great fitting dress. I'm always between a 2 and a 4, and I wore the 4 in this. The fabric is very comfortable and expensive looking. I wore this to a rehearsal dinner and it worked great. Would recommend!

Perfect for a country club wedding! Loved this dress! I actually wore the looser-fitting size 4 to work the day before the wedding since it arrived early, and the tighter 2 to the wedding itself. It was perfect - classy, yet sexy. The dress came to just above my knees, would've liked it a little bit shorter, but was still able to keep a little sexiness with the "optional" cleavage!  Was fitted in the ribs and looser in the hips for me. Great rental!

Perfect Wedding Guest Dress I am between a 2 and 4 but went with the 4 for a little more dancing room :) I had so many complements on this dress! It's a little tight in the bust. I did not button it in front creating a bit of a V-neck.

I got a lot of compliments on wearing the dress, and I was really happy with how well it fit! I'm 5'4", so the hem length hit me right at the knee (unlike the model's photo). As a 36DD, a size 12 accommodated my chest just enough without feeling like I would rip the dress. But since there is a slit at the chest, be prepared for people to sneak glances at your cleavage.

Loved this dress for my bridal shower Dress was very comfortable. I wasn't expecting a thicker material and thought it would have more flow. It fit great in all the right places. 

I received a ton of compliments and overall was very pleased with the dress.

So I ended up not wearing this dress. I almost always am a 2 sometimes even a 0 but I hardly could breath once I zipped this dress up. The material really does not give at all, so just be mindful there is no stretch. Overall the dress is fine, but I opted not to wear it since it really didn't do anything for me and decided to go with a backup I had in my closet. The colors were pretty but more muted in person than the vibrant colors they look in the photos. I'd probably opt for one of the other amazing dresses RTR has over this one

I was the perfect dress for a day time charity event I'm generally somewhere between an 8 and 10 so I ordered both but the 10 just barely fit in the ribs. It was perfect through my bust and hips.  I loved the fit though!  the slight flare was perfect.  I'm short, so the length worked for me but any shorter and I think it would have been too short for the charity event I wore it to.

Beautiful pattern with minor issues I got this dress for a wedding in January and I was pleasantly surprised that the dress is a heavier material. The pattern itself is much darker and pronounced than in the RTR picture but it's beautiful. I wore the 2 but changed into the 4 as my underarms started hurting from the tightness of the dress. I paired the dress with a tangerine cardigan and black tights and heels.  

Cons
Because the dress is heavier and more quilt like, it bunches when you sit down. If I hadn't had black tights on, some folks might have seen my underwear when sitting. The pockets on the side were great but it also made the bottom half of the dress balloon out. This wasn't a huge deal since my hips are small but could make someone with larger hips or a butt seem bottom heavy. I also recommend sizing up since the stiffness of the dress doesn't give much room to move or eat fully without feeling a bit uncomfortable.
Great dress. Rented for a rehearsal dinner. A little heavier fabric than I would normally choose for spring weather but great fit.  Forgiving since the fabric is so heavy and there are pockets.

Wasn't able to wear I actually wasn't able to wear this dress. I ordered a 4 and a 6  but neither one would zip up past my chest and I'm not  a big busted girl. It's made beautifully and the colors are nice. The fabric was a little thick for a summer wedding

Bf's wedding. Gorgeous pattern. DVF!! This was an incredible dress that I wore to a best friend's wedding in the early fall. My normal size is size 4, but after reading the reviews and being a curvy gal, I decided to go with the size 6. The pattern is breathtaking, however, the fabric was a tad uncomfortable, but the day was so perfect, it made me feel amazing! Got a ton of compliments too. Thanks RTR!!

So flattering! Worn for a summer bridal shower, fit was amazing and definitely hides midsection imperfections. Didn't take any full body pics (sorry) but the pockets add a nice touch and the cut is very flattering. Thick fabric so might be a bit warm but overall an amazing dress.

A great party dress... I had to wear my size up because the eight was a bit tight across the chest.  Wearing the 10 did make the skirt a bit fuller but it was very comfortable and looked great.  I loved the pockets...

Was fun to wear - fabric of the skirt was beautiful and balanced well by the tighter top. Depending on the fit, I can wear a 6 or a 8. In this one a 6 worked well and would for other pear-shaped women as the full skirt is really forgiving. I was a little nervous that a gathered skirt would make my waist and hips look wider, but the tighter fit of the top helped balance the fuller A-line skirt. I wasn't sure if the look was going to be too busy, but thought the dress worked really well in person.

Perfect dress for a formal concert. The dress fit true to size and it felt just fancy enough for a classical music concert. Fits a curvy girl body perfectly, super comfortable and huge plus that it has pockets!  I received many compliments on the outfit.

Love the mesh Great fit and flare dress. I loved the mesh detail on the neck and back. Skirt flares out a lot and is kind of poufy but I like that. The bodice is pretty tight but I am a 36DD. Arms were a little tight as well but the material does stretch. I am 5'9" and the dress was long enough (possibly slightly too long for what I wanted, comes down almost to knee).

This was a great dress for my aunt's 50th birthday surprise party!   The dress fit really well.  I rented my usual size and a size larger and was able to wear my typical size 8.  The skirt was very flattering for my curvier bum.  And the pockets were a great place to stash my lipstick and occasionally my hands during the cocktail hour. The top was nice for the winter event due to the long sleeves.  The mesh part of the top gave it interesting detail without being too revealing for a family party.  I received many compliments.  It was perfect dress for the winter cocktail party at my aunt and uncle's country club.
Christmas party with the in-laws What a wonderful dress. It was a hit for the small gathering at my in laws. It was great for my figure and very comfortable. I ordered size 14 but ended up using 16.
Very nice & comfortable. Flattering without being showy. Fits nicely, love the pockets. Attractive dress. Easy to accessorize. A great dress overall.

Perfect for a fall wedding! I loved everything about this dress and was so upset that it had to be returned! The spandex top made a wonderful slimming fit and the skirt with pockets was perfect for dancing and being comfortable all day. The material is a little heavier, but I was hoping for that since it was a cooler fall day in New York. If you are larger on top, I would recommend going up a size--I could see the sleeves being tight with a larger bust. Perfect dress though for me!

Classy Dress for Holiday Party I rented this dress for my husband's holiday party and it was beyond perfect! Super comfortable, great fit. The mesh in the front is not risque enough that I looked like I was dressed inappropriately for a work party, but gave it enough of a touch that it was great for an after-hours event! I'd definitely rent again. Length of the dress was also is also not an issue - and I'm 5'10.

So many compliments! I wore this for Thanksgiving (I had a few family meals to attend) and got compliments everywhere I went. So many cousins wanted to know where they could get the dress/which designer it was. My boyfriend told me if this dress is one that ends up for sale when RTR clears out their stock, I need to buy it. I loved the fit, the pockets, the full skirt, the sleeves - the whole dress!

Loved the dress. It was very comfortable and I was able to wear a regular bra.  I received many compliments and really enjoyed wearing the dress. It was comfortable and it had pockets! Best ever!  Loved the detail on the neckline.

Picture Perfect Memories Where do I even start!!!
Fits like a glove
POCKETS
Numerous compliments
Made me feel super confident
Super comfortable, classy & appropriate for a fun night out our work event. Cool weather appropriate Fits true to size. Helps slim the flared skirt bottom if you wear a belt with it.

I want to own this dress! I loved this dress so much, I felt really classy all night and I loved the fit. I have flabby arms so having the longer sleeves made me feel so confident! My only regret of the night is that I didn't get a proper picture in it... Highly recommend!

Super comfy, very flattering dress Pros:  Comfy, SLIMMING; Pockets a hint of sexy
Cons:  When you raise your arms you also raise the hemline - wear boyshorts underneath to be safe!

Dress is a tiny bit racy!  Many compliments. I chose this dress because of the tight bodice, fish net and back zipper.  It was for a Vegas-themed fundraiser.  The dress shows quite a bit of cleavage so I wouldn't choose it for a professional event.  I have a long waist and shorter legs and the dress fell right about the knee.  I paired it with a think belt and I thought that gave the dress a more finished look.

I give it a 10! NOTE: I am currently about 134 lbs and 32D - post baby!! not the same measurements as entered before..

I got this as a replacement for a dress that I originally got.  I love the peekaboo front, and the cut of the skirt.  I wore it to judge a scholarship event, and felt great.  It was the perfect mix of dressy yet understated. The 6 fit, but was a little snug, I probably could've used the 8 since I am still breastfeeding and my boobs got huge as the event went on before I could nurse.. Oh well.  Loved it!

Looks better in person The dress exceeded my expectations. Looks much better in person. I am petite so I had to use temporary hem to make it shorter for the party, It is maybe 0.5-1 inch below the knee.  The length is very appropriate for more formal event. For the price...would rent again! Great for petites!
Love this dress! Comfortable, flattering and tons of compliments!
perfect for my sister-n-laws engagement party in New York.  Wasn't too fancy but definitely dressy. Very comfortable and form-fitting

I was unable to wear this dress because it showed up dirty.   Though this dress showed up dirty, it appeared to be clean until I put it on.  The fit was PHENOMENAL.  It runs very large.  I am NEVER a size 2 due to bust and butt, but this top had room to spare.  Excellent selection for a curvy woman.  Wish the replacement would have shown up...this was by far my favorite dress in the four I ordered!!

Perfect for a formal fall wedding // Flattering // Comfortable // Stylish I'd wear this again in a heartbeat! It was flattering, comfortable—a major compliment from someone who loathes dresses and lives in jeans—and breastfeeding-friendly. I wore it with matte black tights and black flats for a polished look for a formal wedding. (Note: My bust size is actually 40DDD.)
yay for pockets! I typically wear a regular size 12-14, but this size fit perfectly.

Super comfortable dress that stood out from crowd I love the mesh neckline but the cut was a little low for me, so I added a black tank underneath. I loved the style and comfort of the dress, although the bodice didn't fit as smoothly as I would have liked. Still, I got tons of compliments on the dress and really stood out among all the plain black dresses!

Loved the dress, got a ton of compliments!  Would rent again! **HAS POCKETS** This dress is great for an hourglass figure--I'm generally a size 8/10 in the hips, and a size 6 everywhere else.   With this, you don't have to worry about your butt sticking out!  Fits snugly around the waist and arms, so may not be a good choice if those are "trouble areas".  Length will be longer than it shows on the model depending on your height... I'm 5'5'' and It hit maybe two or three inches above the knee.  My dress came with a few threads coming out on the skirt from wear but I just snipped them and besides that the dress was perfect.

Cute, but not for people with long torsos. This was a dress that I really wanted to work. It was so well made, and has a nice weight to it. The dress fit great and the top portion was so flattering, but the skirt was just a little too short for me (a woman with a longer torso). It didn't elongate me the way dresses of this style should.
Flattering cut I rented this for a formal-ish party. It fit so well that the boyfriend went looking to buy it. The fabric is thick and soft, although the skirt is looks a touch worn up close.

Class and Sass! What a fun flirty dress! Just enough class and sass. Wore it with fishnets and boots! Super adorable, wore the smaller size because it was more fitted through the waist but both looked great!

Beautiful and comfortable This dress is much prettier in person than in photos. It hit all the right notes for me - elegant but not overly fancy, super comfortable and it has pockets! Always love a dress with pockets. The 10 fit just as expected, though I was (as I always am) worried about it being too tight in the chest, but too loose elsewhere. It has a nice stretch to the top, so no problems there.

i got so many compliments all night!! the dress fit perfect. i usually wear either a 6 or 8 but the 6 fit perfect. everyone asked where i got it from, i was getting compliments all night long. i loved the dress so much!!!!
I didn't wear this dress. Skirt was fuller than in pic.  Material heavy.
professional cocktail party with dancing. loved the flouncy feel of the dress and loved the pockets though I didn't use them to store anything.

Perfect fit - super cute.  Very comfortable.  LOVED this dress!! I wore this dress to a very high end but FUN "Super Ball" themed party with scads of high net worth individuals.  This dress was perfect - just enough flair to make it unique but also super wearable and comfortable.  The way it fell on my hips was ideal.  Just the right amount of poof to the skirt.  AND it has pockets.  It was adorable and sexy at the same time.  Received a ton of compliments.

Comfortable, fashionable dress for an unseasonably warm Thanksgiving day! I rented this during RTR's 3-for-1 Thanksgiving special, and I'm happy I did! My family doesn't dress up for Thanksgiving, but I always try and wear something a little nicer than just everyday casual-wear. This dress was perfect for that. The top was stretchy and had a lot of give, good for my larger chest, and the skirt was full, making it possible to eat all the Thanksgiving food put in front of me. The mesh v-neck is totally appropriate for a family event, but I still felt a little edgy and cute. Loved it, I was comfortable all day!
. Loved fit and cut.  The cutouts were a bit deeper and more noticeable than expected.  Fit well. TTS. But V a bit more than expected but my height.

I wore this to escort my daughter when she was on Homecoming court. Perfect for Fall! This dress wasn't overly flashy and was perfect for a brisk Fall football game to escort my daughter onto the field.  She was the queen, but the dress made me feel like a queen too.

Beautiful! The fit of the dress was great as I'm currently 5 months pregnant...it really hid my bump!  Loved the black and silver colors.  Felt very comfortable.  The material was a little thick so if you are one who heats up quickly I wouldn't recommend this.

Great dress! The picture doesn't do it justice. The first person I saw complimented me in my dress. I felt amazing. It is so flattering and yet so comfortable! The pockets are deep and held everything without adding bulk. Great dress!!
Wore it on my bday and for some promo pics. Loved this dress! Very comfortable and fun. The waist was a little high for me and I'm high-waisted.

The perfect amount of sexy These dress is made for ladies with a fuller bust.  The top is extremely flattering and can be worn with a standard bra.  The mesh cutout is very sexy, but not super revealing. The top has some stretch to it; smoothing the figure. The shirt is full (read: puffy) with pockets.  If you are much larger on the bottom, this may not be the most flattering. True to size and the perfect length for 5'7"  I was hoping the bottom was a bit flasher - the gold is much more matte than as seen on the website.  Because of the understated color of the detail - it would be appropriate for any event, not just cocktail.

Sexy yet classy! Runs true to size and is so comfortable! The meshing on the chest adds for a little modern (and sexy) touch with the skirt being a more classic look. I wore with black tie-up strappy heels and big gold and black earrings. No necklace necessary. Adorable dress!

Simply classy. This dress is so comfortable! I usually wear a size 4, but the size 2 fit way better, with a tiny bit of extra room around the waist. The fabric was high quality, and the overall design and details were perfect for the event I attended (which was my husband's graduation). The v-neck line makes the whole look even more flattering.

Great fit, skirt was a little rough around the edges I wore this number for a rehearsal dinner party. It's a great option if you're not sure if people are going to dress casual or fancy - it definitely sits in the middle, so it's a safe bet! I loved the fit of the top - it felt molded to my body and the cutouts add interest. I deducted a star because the skirt looked ragged in places - it required cutting a few strings so it didn't look messy.

Comfortable to dance all night! This was my first RTR experience and I can't wait to do it again! The fit was perfect. I didn't need to try on the backup size. This dress was so easy to wear and kept me warm for the fall outdoor Wedding ceremony. Showed a little more cleavage than expected but in a subtle way so was still appropriate. Length was also great for petite women.

Figure flattering dress This dress was cute, fit true to size, and seems as though it would be flattering for a wide variety of body types. My only real grievance is that the dress sent to me wasn't in the best condition. It looked like it had been worn pretty hard. Also, this is the second time I've received a dress that, although cute, looked almost nothing like the picture on the website. The skirt isn't gold, it's more like a muted silvery gold that isn't really metallic or shiny like in the photo.

Great dress Such an elegant yet slightly edgy dress!  Got several compliments from a high-fashion NYC crowd. It felt a bit tight across the top, but I'm 36C with broad shoulders and larger arms. The material is stretchy and forgiving.  Loved it!

So comfortable! This was my free birthday dress, and I loved it. I actually wore it all day (covered the mesh portion with a blazer and cami for work, then wore it as is for my date night) and it was really comfortable. I think I could have gone down a size given the stretch in the fabric but the 10 wasn't available for my dates.

Nice alternative to the LBD.  Wore this to a formal banquet, got lots of complements, it was a comfortable dress, pockets were fun and the skirt was a heavy, stiff material.  If you rent the same size I wore, confirm with RTR that the condition of the dress is good. The one I wore has a lot of miles on it. If it was in my BFFs closet I would not borrow it.

Good dress for cold weather Wore this for a holiday party. The netting at the neck and the back was an added bonus I didn’t notice when ordering. The embroidery on the skirt was really pretty, a little shiny but not overly flashy. Dress had pockets and hit just above my knee. True to size.

An understated sexy dress that makes you feel fun, fresh, and beautiful! This has been my favorite dress I've rented so far. I wore the dress to a wedding rehearsal/dinner in late October, and I couldn't have asked for a better dress for the event. The top fit perfectly and was so flattering. I have a fuller chest and always worry about showing too much cleavage. While this dress certainly provides a peak of skin up top, it is understated and fun at the same time. The length was perfect, and the bottom of the dress was so pretty and classic. 

The rehearsal dinner was at a very nice steak house, and I was a bit surprised at how casual some of the guests dressed. While I was certainly on the more formal end of the spectrum, the mesh up top and flare of the skirt made the dress feel appropriate even among some of the jeans and sweaters.

Wore it to bridal shower I attended, got lot's of compliments!  Very comfortable dress, dressy without it being too formal for daytime shower! Dressed it up with Black tights and booties!  I was worried that the dress wasn't age appropriate for me, but I got lot's of compliments and my daughter said it looked just fine!
True to size, comfortable, great pockets, beautiful fabric. A true WIN! Fits well, zipper , seams and fabric all well made and comfortable. My favorite thing about the dress ... loved the POCKETS!

Loved the dress! This dress was gorgeous! I'd rent it again in a heartbeat. The long sleeves and stretchy upper body of the dress made it super comfortable to wear, plus it showed a nice bust line in a very discreet and classy way. The skirt is full but not so full as to be unflattering - it fell beautifully. It's short enough to feel young but I had no problems sitting down in it. The pockets were quite useful and adorable, too!

New Years Eve fun dress! This dress was sweet and fun! The only con I could mention is that the waistline isn't the most flattering for short torso, large busted girls. With that being said, I was able to wear a very low cut bra and pull the dress down a bit to give the illusion of a longer torso. 
The material was perfect for a NYE river cruise on a boat - thicker and provided some warmth. It also had a little give to it (which was nice since long sleeve dresses tend to run tight in my arms). And pockets were a fun touch. 
I rented the 10 and 12 as my backup (I wasn't sure if I should rent my backup a larger size or smaller, but to err on the side of the zipper - haha - I went up). To be honest, there wasn't much difference between the 10 and the 12 - I ended up going with the 10 as it was a tiny bit shorter (more flirty). 
This was my first RTR and I will definitely be renting more - shipping and return was a snap to boot.

Loved it!  Comfortable and cute! This dress is very comfortable and has pockets, which is great.  It fit true to size but was a tad tight in the bust (I'm a 34C) but I didn't go up in size.  I'm petite (5'2'') and the length was great.  I would definitely rent again.

Look carefully at the pics. I had to pass on this. I ordered this one but ended up not wearing it because of the fit. It hits really wrong on the torso for me at 5'4".  I was hoping for some cinching or something but it left my waist completely undefined and it just hung there.  I was concerned that the 14W would be too small but I wonder if the 12 might have fit me better since it would've been tighter.

Cool look for chilly nights! I would buy this dress if it were a little longer in the waist to fit my long torso. It is adorable with a little bit of edge. Top is a heavy knit so quite comfortable, and the skirt looks more luxe in person than pictured. Wore it to a fundraiser for Align Ministries where a fairly conservative/covered-up look was important -- this dress fit the bill without having to hide my rebel, rebel side. Can totally be worn with a standard, deep-v, black bra.
The event had a great DJ and entertainer!  The 14W fit perfectly.  It was cute, comfortable and the perfect length for my event. I received several compliments and felt confident at my event.

Wore this dress to a Christmas Eve dinner. It was super comfortable and looked great The dress was really comfortable and was true to size.  It was a little short on me but I was wearing tights so it was not a big deal

Cute party dress! This dress is super cute for something where you need to dress up but also look conservative (work event, family party). I love the fabric of the skirt in contrast with the top. I wore this with black tights and ankle boots with heels and received a lot of compliments.

This dress was absolutely perfect for my law school Fall Bash! It was super flattering!! This is a great alternative for those who always wear LBDs. The top is a ponte-like knit which makes it very flattering and smoothing. The mesh V is pretty deep so if you're smaller chested that may be a problem but it worked perfectly for me. The flouncy skirt covered some problem areas. Obsessed with this dress!

Beautiful colors and super comfortable all night I rented this dress for a wedding and loved it!  Got tons of compliments and the colors were gorgeous, could easily wear during the summer and early fall.  The only tiny issue was some extra material at the top, but I had read other reviews and was expecting that.  It didn't take away from the fit of the dress though, and overall I was very happy with my choice.

Very pink and colorful. Received a lot of compliments!  I am 5'7 so I rented the long but it was too long!  I was constantly tripping over the dress even with my heals on. The dress is also very low cut, I would suggest double sided tape.

Friends The dress was super comfortable.  The other reviews said it was big in the chest and I wore a bra and just put some tape and everything stayed put.  I had about 3.5 inch heels on and the dress was long but I wasn't tripping over it.  Overall - I LOVED this dress...

Beautiful! The dress was gorgeous. I fell in love with it right away, except I definitely didn't have the right body for it as it was huge in the bust area, and went quite low cleavage wise. I had to play with it a bit to make it fit properly and I'm not too trusting of dress tape. It was also long and I was always afraid I would step on it with my heels. Otherwise, gorgeous dress!

So elegant Perfect for a summer wedding or a nice evening out.  Beautiful dress, fit perfectly but it will test your abilities to sit up straight as the v neck is a bit plunging, the fit for me was perfect!

One Of A Kind. PROS: No one else had anything like it on.
CON: Like all the other reviews have stated, the top is big.

This dress was perfect for the vineyard wedding we attended.  Bright and colorful.  I added a gold plated belt to give it a little "umpf." (got it from jaideclothing.com, in case someone asks).  Other guests loved my look.  I received a number of compliments and I felt very confident.  I was kind of prepared for the peril of the big top after reading ALL previous reviews on this dress.  It did come with fashion tape, which I used all of it and a safety pin or two helped. I am a 34D so the top was not extremely baggy like some reviews, it just needed some tweaking so that I wouldn't flash other guests.  I wore a strapless bra, which in hindsight wish I had gotten a deep plunge bra with straps.  Just a preference...why wear strapless when I didn't have to?  I'm 5'6", the 4L was perfect. I've been wearing a 6 lately in my work clothes so I ordered a 6L as an alternate but the 4 was perfect. The band around the waist is not stretchy, so when zipping the back, that is the area where you need to tug a bit to get the zipper the rest of the way up. I wore 3.5 inch heels and the bottom swept the floor nicely.
Also rented the Alex Bittar Serpentine Cuff and the Lilly Pulitzer Elephant Clutch.  LOVED BOTH.
Also, I live in Louisiana but the event was in Virginia.  Given the 4 day rental window, I had the items shipped to my parents' house in VA, it arrived on Thursday as expected. Since mail doesn't run on Sunday, I shipped it out on Monday when I got back to La.  Easy peasy. My first time using RTR.  I will most DEFINITELY be back.  Mardi Gras season will be rolling around soon enough....so happy RTR exists!!!

Beautiful dress - bit long Loved the dress - color was amazing, material was nice. Only complaint it that it was a little long. I had 8" platforms so it was okay, but because of the pleating you wouldn't have been able to help the length any other way. 

Having said that, the fit was wonderful. flowy, but flattering, and the synched waist was the best. (with a belt of course)

Great dress 
Beautiful dress.  Loved the colors.

The dress is pretty. However,I didn't find it flattering on me and decided not to wear it. It's a little loose up top around the waist, which I felt added bulk to my top half.  The pleating does not go all the way around. I couldn't tell if that was the design, or if it had been worn too much and the pleats have fallen.  The length was great and I could have worn 2-3" heels and been fine in it.

Perfect for a Black Tie Wedding in the beautiful Wine Country! Loved everything about this dress! The colors, the fit, the flow. The only challenge was the length. The 2R was way too long for me and the 4P required a pair of high platform heels. Other than that, the 4P fit perfectly. Fun to dance in too! Would absolutely rent from RTR again.

Eye-catching, feminine and flowing - great dress if you want to feel beautiful.  I wore this dress for our engagement shoot. Truthfully, I was a little unsure at first because the fit isn't usually what a go for - form fitting and flattering. Instead, the dress was very soft and airy. However, after seeing the way it photographed, I couldn't have been happier! I felt very feminine and romantic wearing this dress - I'd definitely recommend it for anyone wanting to feel beautiful.  

This dress fits mostly true to size, but is slightly tight around the waist. If you have a small waist/rib cage, I'd recommend sizing down. If you're more straight up and down (like myself!) opt for your regular sizing.

Effortless and fun  Yes, the bust is large but nothing that a little fashion tape can't solve. I wore this to a beach wedding and the length was a little long, but would have be perfect with low to mid heels. I also wish I had ordered a smaller size as the waist wasn't as fitting as I would have liked it to be. 

To avoid echoing the previous reviews I'll leave it at: flattering, fun and definitely worth the try.

Gorgeous dress, but not for me All the existing reviews were very accurate. The colors and fabric are gorgeous. And, it's true to size. However, the dress was a lot for me to manage. I have a relatively small bust (34C/36B), and the neckline is very low. I pinned it, but still felt very self-conscious all night. I also ordered a 10L because the 10R and 12R weren't available. I'm 5'7", and I definitely didn't need the Long. I wore 3 in heels, and it was still too long. It was a lot of fabric to manage all night. And, as everyone has mentioned, the waist band is very tight. I have a relatively small waist, and the band was still very tight on me. Overall, it's a gorgeous dress and would look amazing on the right person. If you get the right length, have a small rib cage, and can fill up the bust line, this is a beautiful, effortless dress. But, this wasn't the dress for me. Nonetheless, I loved my first Rent the Runway experience, and will definitely do it again!

Felt Glamorous & Comfortable All Night! Loved this dress from the second I put it on until the moment I took it off! Fit great and got tons of compliments all night. The dress did run a bit big in my smallest dress size, so used double sided tape to keep everything in place in the bust. I'm 5'9 and wore 4 inch heels and the hem on the long was about 1/2 inch too long, if I'd had time I would have gotten the free hemming in Henri Bendel the day before. All in all great first experience w/ RTR!

Perfect spring wedding dress Pros: beautiful color and comfortable

Cons: too long if you're short, stepping on it a lot. Safety pin is needed to keep from showing too much cleavage.

Obsessed. This dress ran a little large. I got a 2 and a 4, to be safe, and the 2 was slightly big in the waist (where it's fitted) and therefore the top was too big too. A simple pinning took care of the top part but because the waist was too big, the dress hung and made it longer in the back. I'm completely obsessed with this dress in every other way so I wasn't too mad about it.

This bright dress will help you stand out! I really liked this dress online, but loved it so much more in person.  The color is vibrant and the dress is definitely going to help you stand out in the crowd of LBD's.  I'm 5'2" and I was able to wear flats while wearing the 2P.

Gorgeous dress for a friend's wedding!  I'm 5'2 and had on heels, the dress grazed the floor. True to size but you need to have tape on hand to keep the extra fabric on top in place. Otherwise, great dress!

Comfortable, gorgeous, and would definitely rent again! Fits true to size. Like others said, the chest area is a little baggy but the fashion tape that came with dress fixed the issue. I'm 5'9" and wore the regular with flats. It was perfect- the dress just hit the floor. The 6 fit but was tight through the torso and uncomfortable so I went with the 8.

Beautiful dress
 Loved the dress, a little big on top...went with my other choice
Really unique and fun for a summertime blacktie wedding. Tons of compliments, flowy and comfortable Fit very well and was easy to dance in. Would definitely rent again

Elegant & Beautiful! This dress was absolutely beautiful! I loved the way it flowed when I walked and the light fabric made it perfect for an outdoor wedding on a humid day.  The 0R fit better in the bust and length, however it was too small in the rib cage area so I couldn't zip it up.  I ended up wearing the 2R, and even though it took a bit of getting used to with the fit, it looked amazing.  I'm 5'2" and wore about 4" heels, so the dress just grazed the floor and I had a bit of trouble not tripping myself walking on it at first, but it worked out.  I had to keep checking to make sure my bra wasn't showing since the bust area was a little big, but I made sure to keep pulling the middle of the dress down to create a more tight look with the top so it wasn't a problem.  Unfortunately, I didn't receive the fashion tape that usually comes with the dress, so that would have been helpful.  But overall, it was a fabulous dress and I got tons of compliments on it.  If you can get past the tightness of the rib cage, you won't regret wearing this one, you will feel like a princess all night long!

I wore this for a masquerade ball and made a mask that matched incredibly well.  I'm short, so even with heels the dress was long. It was also incredibly big from the bust. All of the reviews said that, so I figured with an 8 I would be ok--I also didn't want it to be too tight in the waist. 
It fit really well in the waist so I wouldn't have been able to size down, but I needed a lot of pins to fix the top. Because there was so much cloth to pin there was no easy way to do it so I don't think the dress looked as nice as it could have.

Vibrant floral print! Ended up selecting another dress to wear which was more formal, but would gladly rent this dress again! The color is more vibrant red and pinks in person, and very pretty. The top drapes like a blouse and I would advise ordering down a size if small chested. The waist hits at the bottom of the ribcage and was loose for an 8 and I imagine a 6 would have been a better fit for me. Looking forward to an event where I can rent this dress!

I wore this dress to a fraternity banquet It was a little shorter than I had hoped so I had to wear a low wedge heel. I also had to use double sided tap to close the front because it was way too revealing when I sat down. The colors of the dress were beautiful in person and photographed well. I would definitely recommend this dress!

Loved this, but wasn't right for my event As someone who is smaller on top, bigger (in every way) on the bottom, this dress fit like a dream. I didn't end up wearing it, but I will probably rent it for a beach wedding I have later in the year. It's so flowy and romantic! It is definitely brighter than in the photo though - pink as opposed to red.

One a kind, figure flattering dress! I loved this dress! It was comfortable, flattering, and beautiful. I received a lot of compliments while wearing it. I wore it to an Indian wedding reception and fit in perfectly. My only comment is that if you're not comfortable with a lot of cleavage showing, you will want to pin it closed a little.

Loved it - comfy and cute The 8P was the perfect length for me in flats, I'm 5'5. There is no give at all in the waistband but the flowiness of the dress is flattering and comfortable. Like other reviewers said, it is suuuuupperrrrrr low cut. I saftey-pinned mine because otherwise it was just showing way too much.

Gorgeous dress, very feminine and great for a summer wedding. The reviews all said the same thing and I agree, it is way too large in the top and I'm a DDD cup so I don't know how most girls made this work.  Even so, it is still a gorgeous dress and fit perfectly in every other area.  Got many compliments and felt great!

Stunning dress! This dress is a beautiful color and print, and the pleats add a really nice touch. I found the 4R to actually be rather long, so be careful if you're not tall. Really loved this dress :)
Loved the dress - comfortable and fun Fit great, but definitely needed a pin to keep it together!

Beautiful and glamorous This dress was perfect for a formal summer wedding. The color and pattern stood out and looked glamorous without being flashy. The fit and pleating also made the dress very comfortable and forgiving. I'm usually a size 2 or 4 and I went with the 2 on this one. I got the Regular length and the dress was a half inch above the floor with 3.5 in heels. Unlike some other reviewers, I thought the top of the dress fit really well, although I did use fashion tape as a precaution so that my bra wouldn't show if I leaned over. Overall, it was another great experience with RTR!

Awesome dress, beautiful colors, and perfect fit! I rented this dress for my engagement brunch. Mostly, I loved the vibrant colors of the dress, which makes it perfect for any formal spring/summer event. It's a very flowy dress; I had some issues everytime I stood up or walked up stairs because my heel would get caught in the dress. Regardless, the dress was so worth it. I did use some fashion tape to make sure I wouldn't flash anything ;) It was a true fit to my size; usually when the fabric around the chest/back area is not very stretchy I have to go up in size, to a 4 or 6 (thanks swimmer shoulders), and a 4 was perfect.

Beautiful red/magenta/pink colors I ended up in the 6L.  I expected the waist to have some stretch to it, and it definitely does not.  It was a snug fit right at the half inch waistline but worked out fine.  I'm 5'10 and wore flats.

Gorgeous colors on this dress! The dress fit well except for the top part which was loose. I had a normal bra on which was going to pop out to be seen if I hadn't stuck the neck part firmly with fashion tape. The dress would also have been longer if not for the 4 inch heels I had on. Other than that, the dress is so beautiful, you don't to accessorize so much. I only had the Southern Plantation earrings on (mystery bling!) to complete my look.

Unforgettable color, lasting impression Pros-the color is absolutely amazing and photographs well.  Unlike many other dresses, this has a built in liner, so there is no risk of see through.  The fabric is very light weight and flows beautifully. I would highly recommend this dress.
