Cons-shoulders are a little large, fabric tape worked great to secure. I do have a small bust, so this may have been the issue, but tape worked perfectly.   The dress  is long.  I  ordered a regular based on the reviews.  I did not want it to be floor length, so that I could dance in it.  The regular with heels was perfect.  It was just enough to expose my heels.

Great wedding. Highly recommend back-up being the smaller size! I am a solid 4 and the 2 fit much better. I usually size up, but this is a size down dress! Also had to use fashion tape for the bust, worked great. Very comfortable, lovely dress. Highly recommend for summer weddings!

Gorgeous colors! The top was a bit loose, but nothing a little fashion tape couldn't fix.  Wasn't as long as I thought it would be, which was fine since I didn't want to wear super high heels.  The dress was super comfortable and the colors were amazing!

Lots of compliments on the dress! Much more beautiful than expected :)  It fit pretty loosely in the bust area and was a little lower than expected so some tape will be needed for most. Was also quite long but such a beautiful pattern and material!

Felt like a movie star- I adore Halston Heritage and this dress!! It does run a tad large so if you are petite on top or more modest fashion tape is a must. The long was a tad long as well, and I am a tall girl! Nothing a pair of 4" heels can't handle. But worth noting. The color is to die for and it feels breezy and great for dancing the night away. Winner!
I would definitely rent this again beautiful dress!

Very roomy Bust I am a full c cup and I ended up having to tape this dress to my boobs so that when I leaned forward at dinner you couldn't see my nips.  Other than that, it was a cute dress. Nothing special.

Made me feel pretty The dress is very pretty especially the color and I felt pretty in it. Material felt great. I needed few pieces of the double-sided tape to keep the top part in place from opening. Long length was perfect! I could wear flats (in the picture) with not much trouble as well as heels. You do need to be careful going up the stairs but other than that no problem. I almost wanted to sleep in it but unfortunately had to take it off after the event.

Got a ton of compliments on the dress!  I wore the 8R to get the length, I decided to wear it with flats so it would hit the floor. The only negative was the top was pretty loose. I loved the dress. Very comfortable and perfect for a winery wedding. I probably would have been ok with the 6R.

Very Comfy dress!  By far the most comfortable. The top was just a tad large.  I wore a padded bra and used fashion tape to keep the opening secure.  I wore gold flat sandals which complimented it perfectly and the dress just brushed the ground.  I had to be very careful walking up and down stairs to not step on the dress.  It is more vibrant in person than in the pictures but would be great for most events.  Works well with a black shawl if it is cool outside.  Worn with House of Harlow 1960 Fortune Teller earrings.

Beautiful dress! A little loose up top but fashion tape helps. Really loved this dress, especially once I taped the front with fashion tape to make sure I didn't flash anyone. After that was able to wear a normal bra. Length was good, maybe a half inch long on my 5'4 frame with 3 inch heels, but didn't really bother me.

LOVED IT! The dress is beautiful - I loved the colors and the material is just gorgeous. I highly recommended! I received compliments all night! It's very comfortable and easy to dance in. I was sad to return it :)

Lots of compliments for a perfect wedding!  The color and fit are both really beautiful for a warmer wedding! As other reviews state, the top does run a bit large, but it was fine for me! When going up or downstairs, the dress is a bit long. I am 5'6; I would get petite if you are shorter than me for this dress!

perfect for a formal southern wedding.  It ran a little large, but I used the hollywood tape to keep the top in position for modesty's sake. 
absolutely gorgeous dress. tons of compliments. I am petite, 5'3" and wore 4 inch heels, and the 6 R was still long. Fine for sitting and walking, but a little long for dancing

Loved this dress! Super comfortable and breezy for a beach wedding. I'm 5'4" and the 0R was still a little long on me which made it difficult to dance in, etc. The waist however fit perfectly. Overall it was a great dress for a beach wedding - so many compliments and it was very comfortable all night long.

Perfect for my formal outdoor work event in the summer. It was a bit loose fitting in the chest area, so I used a small safety pin to keep it closer together. I wore flat sandals but I'm tall so it helps. It still scraped the floor slightly so probably best worn w/ heels. Going up stairs was a little challenging bc you have to pick it up. The flow of it was amazing and the color was great. I received so many compliments. I'd definitely wear this again.

Husband's boss's daughter's wedding Dress was beautiful and I was looking forward to wearing it but it didn't fit.  It was too tight in the waist and way too long from the waist to the shoulders.  Considering I had tried on at least 20 dresses at Macy's so I would have backup in case the rentals didn't fit and very few of them fit, I was not surprised this didn't fit.

This one is a keeper!  I would rent this dress again any day. It did run a little large, and it is definitely meant for larger busts. I am on the C/D cup border and did not need fashion tape. The length was perfect and just skimmed the floor in 4 inch heels. The pattern and colors are gorgeous, the stock photo does not do this dress justice. 
This dress was actually sent to me bc the original dress I ordered was damaged in my size and this option turned out to be better than my original dress. RTR customer service was amazing and Emily stayed on the phone with me and walked me through many alternate options. It was like talking to your best friend, helping you through a major fashion crisis. She eventually suggested this dress and im so happy she did.

This dress was prettier in person I loved this dress it was beautiful .  The only problem was that it was soo long.  I tripped on it all night.  I am 5'5 and had on 3" heels.  It was still too long by a long shot.  I had such trouble walking around all night.

Beautiful, comfortable Maxi So many compliments on this dress! It was super comfortable, but the waist band was tight and ran a little small. I used a safety pin to keep the top from being too revealing. I am 5'8" and wore flat strappy sandals and the length was perfect. I did think it was short for a "long" size but it worked out. Recommended for sure- but I would size up for the waist band.

This dress is a beautiful color! I was even photographed as a "Fashion Favorite" at the event! As others have stated, the bust area of the dress runs large. I used one strip of the fashion tape provided to keep the dress in place and had no problems with it the entire night. The dress was also a bit long on me. I wore 4.5" heels and could have used another half inch of height to make the dress easier to maneuver. Overall, it was comfortable, great to dance in, and eye catching, which was exactly what I wanted for a black tie gala.

Gorgeous dress, but very large on top! I gave this dress a three star rating only because it was so large on top!  I loved the dress, the color and pattern, but I ended up having to pin it in the back so that my boobs didn't fall out.  I'm 38 D and I was swimming in it.  The ribbon around the waist was a tad bit snug but wasn't an issue.  I have another friend who had previously rented this dress and had the same complaint, and she's not very large on top; I figured I had the girls to fill it in, but nope.  It's just abnormally big and loose in the top.

Beautiful, soft, flowing pleated fabric with vibrant colors!  Photographs well.  I wore this dress with a 2 inch heel and it was a perfect length.  The band around the waste/upper torso was snug (which was surprising because my upper torso is my smallest feature) and did not give at all.  The dress wasn't as comfortable as I thought it would have been bc of that band, but I did really like the way it looked.  If I was to order this dress again I probably order sizes 6 and 8 rather than 4 and 6.  I received a ton of compliments and I truly think my dress was the best guest dress at the wedding!  I will absolutely order from RTR again.  The shipping was easy and the carrying case was really convenient.

Perfect fit for a formal Wedding I could not say enough good things about this dress. The way it moved when I walked, the pattern and color - everything about this is dress is amazing. I received so many compliments about the dress, especially the beautifully colors. I did have to use some fashion tape around the top area, as it was a little big. I ordered the 2L, I wore heels otherwise it would have been way to long. I will definitely keep this dress in mind for another occasion!

Wore for a formal work dinner party in November and even though we were inside-it was just right. Great fit.  Many compliments!  Felt beautiful and comfortable all night.  Would recommend fashion tape for the top and if  you are small up there (like me!)- size down.  I am 5'9" and wore 3" heels and the dress grazed the floor perfectly in the 4L.

Great dress! I wore this out with my husband on a date but I didn't get a picture of it. It was a beautiful fit, great colors and fit like a glove. It was a heavy fabric so it was comfortable to wear in the winter with tights.

Fun, comfortable dress for a date night or night out with the girls.  Fit true to size.  Need strapless bra or bra w convertible straps. Dress photographs black and red, but looks more sparkly grey in person.
Beautiful pattern and material! Loved the cut of the bodice and flow of the skirt. Great day dress Great fit but looses some stretch.

Hip pattern and nice fit I wore this dress to an August wedding.  The fabric is quite thick, but it helps hold the shape of the dress.  In terms of fit, it's very true to size.  I'm typically a 2/4 and debated between XS and S.  Ended up going with the S.  Happy renting!
Sassy, colorful and fun! This dress fits great, is really unique and different and is very flirty. I loved the fabric.

In LOVE with this dress!  Stands out without being loud.  This dress is unique, fun, and sexy.  I agree with many others that the dark portion is more navy color.  The shimmer is subtle and beautiful. The fit in the torso is snug but comfortable.  The material is very think but stretchy. I wore a racerback bra but didn't really need one.  I paired this with a red sweater, tights and black suede shooties.  I loved this dress it was a hit with my husband.

Got tons of compliments on this dress when I wore it for Christmas Eve. Loved it. Great fit, super flattering and very comfortable. Loved this dress so much I bought it. I wish it was made in more colors and patterns. Great dress for busty ladies.

I want this dress, gorgeous This dress was bomb - only thing is it is HOT (yes, it is - but I mean temperature wise). I sweat my butt off in b/c I was a dancing machine, but since it is dark you can't tell. Stretching, form hitting and total knock out dress.

Cute dress, awkward fit. My date for the rehearsal dinner lived this dress. I liked the pattern, shape, and material but the fit was awkward on me. You could see my bra peeking on either side of the dress so I had to keep covering it with my hair. Maybe a size up would of covered my chest, but then I think it would of been too loose around the middle.
Love the material of this dress!  Beautiful dress but not as forgiving as I hoped it would be. Super comfortable and fun! Different!

I wore this dress for an engagement party and loved it!  It is super comfortable & very flattering. I usually wear a small but had to order a medium since they were out of my size.  It was a little big in the arm holes and I had extra material in the back but overall I still felt fabulous in it.  The picture of the dress on RTR shows a peep-hole in the back, the dress I received did not have this cutout; it was still very pretty just a little different than what was pictured on the site.  I loved this dress so much; I wouldn’t hesitate to rent it again.
it was a bit heavy and hot for the beach but very cute fitting it was a bit heavy and hot for the beach but very cute fitting. i wore it to a beach bachelorette

Super fun feminine dress!   As others have described the colors do look a lot different in person then they do on the model. The sparkle of the grey is super fun and adds and extra element to the dress. I ordered both the S and XS and honestly didn't see much of a difference between the two sizes. I ended up going with the XS because the skirt was a little more full on that one. Overall a perfect dress for a wedding!

This dress was perfect for a dressy restaurant date night! The material was a heavier weight and very stretchy, so it hugged my torso perfectly. I also loved how much it flared at the bottom. It was very flattering and I think it would look great on anyone!

Fun! This dress was perfect for a summer wedding in an art gallery. Other reviewers mentioned it perhaps not being great for warmer days because of the heavier fabric, but I didn't find that to be the case - especially when you're inside most of the time. The fit was very flattering. I ended up wearing the XS because the S was baggy around the waist. It stretches, so it might be good to size down if you're unsure.
Fun and cute I didn't love the grayish material as much as a thought I would. Fun and flirty style though.
Great dress, great service! Wore this for my work christmas party, it was perfect!

I wish this dress was permanently in my closet.  I love this dress so much, it fit perfectly and was very comfortable. The material is quite thick which is nice and wasn't too hot. I wore it with a regular bra and pushed the straps in but you may want to wear a razerback bra instead.  I got so many compliments on this dress from family members and friends to random people in the hotel lobby. Would definitely rent it again.

really nice dress! I would recommend to anyone. This was a really nice dress. It was comfortable, would fit anyone, and looked great. The only issue was that it was stretched out around the arm holes by the bust but not very noticeable. I actually decided to buy the dress after wearing it out.

easy breezy dress for all occasions, dress up or down! I rented this for a mama's cocktail party then wore it the next day to my kids' dance recital--worked for both! forgiving stretchy fabric, fab print, just lovely to wear. I'm 5'8" 120 lbs, xs great fit, thumbs up!
Very comfortable and fun dress! It's actually dark grey and red, but not noticeable at night time.  Thick material.   Had a little twirl to it.

Made my daughter'a 8th grade dinner dance unforgettable! A perfect fit! My daughter said she felt so sophisticated compared to her friends at the dance! The background color of the dress is actually more of a dark grey - not black as we thought. The material is a knit which made it very comfortable for her to dance in all night. Definitely recommend this rental.

Beautiful dress! I wore this to a friends engagement party and I felt great! Unfortunately I didn't take a full length picture! But this dress is beautiful. I am normally a medium in everything and that is the size I wore. I am a double D in my chest and I didn't have to wear a bra (which was great) it held the girls up nice since the material was on the thicker side. When I originally tried it on with the bra you could see the side of my bra because the top doesn't have THAT much give - but it was great without the bra.  I would definitely rent this again. My fiance loved it as well.

Loved it! Wore it to a boozy brunch - was surprised by sizing. This dress was SUPER cute; it was short, but not too scandalous. I was surprised that I fit into the small, I'm typically a Medium and the small fit perfectly, not too tight at all. Maybe it was just stretched out a bit! Would recommend and rent again - the colors were so fun together.

I sent it back because it did not look good on me.  This dress is not made for petite girls. I am a size 0- & 5'3'' tall and this dress like swallowed me and was very unflattering. I had to send it back. It is definitely a heavier material and a pretty dress just not what I was looking for.

Dancing away and all the wonderful compliments I received on my dress!! :) I typically wear XS and the dress fit perfectly. My legs are short so the dress was a tad longer on me than the model, but it was perfect for the evening wedding I wore it for. The material is heavy but wasn't hot, even when dancing!  I received so many compliments on it throughout the night, my husband even heard ladies talking about it and RTR on their way to the bathroom!  It was perfect and I can't wait for the next event when I get to rent again!

Wanted something different for a wedding and this was the perfect dress! The dress fit beautifully and I received so many compliments. The material is a little thicker than I was used to but it didn't get too hot.

Beautiful dress!  I wore this for my mom's 50th birthday night out. Received compliments all night! Thicker material, beautiful colors, somewhat conservative length, gorgeous cut. This dress hugs your curves in all the right places. Sexy but appropriate. I have a fairly narrow bottom half but it would definitely also flatter girls with wider hips. I wore it with a regular bra and was just fine. I usually wear a 2/4 and the S was perfect. Rent this dress!

Rather short The dress fits well. The material is fairly thick and heavy. The top of the dress cuts a little funny so depending on your bra, it may be visible. The dress is also pretty short. I'm 5'8 and the medium size was waayyyy to short. The large was ok, but I'm glad I'm not still in catholic school because I would pass the "finger tip" rule. Regardless, it's a cute dress.

rehearsal dinner So perfect for a pear.  Fit like a glove, no need for a bra.  Also was very flattering the way it flared out on the hips.  I want to own this dress.  My sister is a size 0/2 and rented the small and said it looked terrible and was too big.  So be careful if you're tiny.

This dress ran a little big, but I absolutely loved it. I was complimented all night on it. The shape of the dress is very flattering and it is a very comfortable dress. It runs a little large. The extra small was even a little big on me and I am typically a size 2.

XS is too small for a size 2. Rent the Runway suggested I order an XS despite the fact that I'm usually a size 2. They were out of a S in this dress so I went with XS since RTR suggested it. Was too small! Next time I'll trust my gut and not get an XS.
Loved this dress This dress was very comfortable and cute, I would buy it if I could. This is the world's worst photo, but it was flattering and stretchy in all the right ways.

Great dress - different, comfortable, and very flattering!   This is a great dress!  I felt comfortable all night and received lots of compliments on the design.  

Definitely order two sizes -- I felt that it ran a bit small, particularly in the bustand waistline.

Overall the dress had a great pattern that made it stand out but ran big The dress has a great pattern that catches your eye and is unique; I had a lot of people that commented how much they loved it.  I was struck by the fabric though, I didn't expect it to be a stretchy fabric and the XS ran very big on me.  I am petite but I didn't expect the dress to almost hit my knees.  I also thought it looked black on the website but it's actually a dark gray that has a shine or glitter effect to it.  It was very comfortable though!

Classy and Fabulous The moment this dress arrived I was happy! I wore it to my daughter's first birthday party and got compliments the entire time! It fit true to size and the length was perfect. The material is on the heavier side, so I wouldn't recommend it for an event in the warm weather. I can't wait to rent again!

Great colors! I didn't end up wearing this to the wedding I was attending but this is a great dress!
The dark charcoal gray and blood orange colors looked amazing!
Like the other reviewers, it is definitely a heavier fabric which is why I ended up not wearing it to the outdoor wedding.
But this is such a cute cut.  The fabric is rich and very high quality.
You'll need to wear a clip at the back of your bra to pull the straps in so they don't show but very easy to solve.
Great dress and I would have worn it to another event if I had time!

Cute dress! got lots of compliments  i ordered the dress in Medium bc the S was unavailable. dress fit comfortably though i wish i had the small as a point of comparison. you may wan to go strapless to use a convertible strapped bra.

Color stands out! This dress was definitely different than expected, but ended up being great. It's a heavier, almost sweater-like material with a slight shimmer. It definitely looks small on the hanger, and stretches a lot. Definitely size up for your backup size. If you have issues with extra skin around your armpit area, this may not be the dress for you -- the top definitely cuts in and that area will poke out. Had to wear a strapless bra -- the straps on my x-back bra stuck right out.

In all, I liked it. I was glad that I rented the necklace in the model photo as well - it was a perfect complement to the dress.

Perfect "night out" dress I rented this for a birthday dinner at a rooftop restaurant. The material is super comfy and the pattern is fun and unique. The chest area can be a little snug, so I'd recommend going a size up for your back up vs a size down. I had fun wearing it and would highly recommend it!

Comfortable and easy to wear!  I like the way this fit it was the perfect length! I didn't like that it hugged my stomach area and made me feel like I had a tire around my middle but other than that it was great! Made me feel special.

Super cute style with a great fit. I want to buy this dress!  Wore this dress for a winter wedding with black tights and black heals and it was perfect. It's a slightly heavier fabric so it felt appropriate for a winter wedding.

Loved this dress!  Had a nice stretch to it...received lots of compliments Since the dress has stretch, the top fit nice and tight and the bottom flares which is very pretty!  Length was perfect on me...not too short.
Perfect dress for holiday party!  Nothing negative to say here. It was the perfect party dress for the holidays. I wore it to both a work & friend party that weekend! Great fit and very flattering!

This dress is gorgeous and so comfortable! Definitely a crowd pleaser! This dress is perfect. I ordered a M and L and the M fit true to size. The fabric is so comfortable, and the dress is the perfect length. I felt like a million bucks! I have yet to have a bad experience with RTR yet. My dresses always arrive on time and in great condition.

Cute for Florida wedding! Fits great on short girls.  The colors are a bit darker in person than in the picture.  Went nicely with the necklace pictured as well and the gold alligator bracelet that's also rentable on RTR.  It's not lightweight- it's kind of thick and stretchy.  Was perfect for a January wedding in southern FL.
great dress for dancing.... put on some grey lipstick & stood out...

Just enough shimmer The picture doesn't show it, but the dress is actually more of a dark gray with a little shimmery pattern.  The material is pretty forgiving, and looked great with sparkly heels for NYE.

lots of compliments - and comfy! wore this for a winter wedding with tights and boots.  it was a hit and i was comfortable all night long.  not too short on me - i'm 5'6" and not too tight - i'm usually a 6-8 these days with hips and a bust

Great Dress! I rented this dress for a wedding in Southern California and it was perfect for the occasion. I rented the small and medium and both fit, but I was just more comfortable in the medium...really could have gone with either. The fabric is heavy weight but was not hot at all. I received so many compliments and a friend even went online to buy the dress while we were at the wedding!

Twirl the night away in this flirty patterned dress Wearing this dress on a high 70- low 80 degree day (on the last weekend of September) in an un-airconditioned church confirms that the weight of the fabric is quite noticeably heavy, but since I followed previous ladies' advice about sizing down, its stretchy thickness kept things aloft when I decided to go sans bra because I forgot to pack a strapless or convertible racerback. The cut of the armholes will show off regular shoulder straps because things get narrower towards the neckline.

I chose this dress for its demure neckline and modest length, but most importantly, its eyecatching pattern!  The mini thumbnail led me to assume the dress was black, but in real life, it's closer to the color of an old timey tv screen with no reception, with bit of shimmer, which makes it even more fun.

Turned heads at a hair show after party! This dress was wonderful, very slimming and flirty. Worn to an after party at a hair show. Very stretchy fabric and very comfortable! Was a little short, which made some dance moves impossible. Lol. And be sure to wear a strapless bra with this one. Boyfriend couldn't keep his eyes off me ;D

The location The dress was PERFECT. The material is so forgiving and looks great on any body type. Wasnt too short or tight. I got more compliments on this dress than anything I have ever worn. I didnt want to send it back!

Perfect for a Birthday Party! Rented this dress to wear for my daughter's first birthday party.  It was a ladybug theme so this was the closest I could get without looking silly.  The dress was so comfortable and looks great on.  The skirt flares in just the right spot!  I put a collared shirt under it because it was winter to make it a bit more seasonal.  One of my faves.  Can't wait for another RTR sale so I can buy it!
Such an easy process! Great fit, very flattering- the perfect dancing dress!

Amazing dress! Received a ton of complements and was very comfortable all night.  Dress definitely runs somewhat small. I was worried about the fit at first so went for the L, even though the M would have been fine. Didnt have room to pack both sizes:)
The material is on the heavier side so perfect for a cool, outdoor wedding. The cut is fantastic and very comfortable. 
Overall this is a great dress!

Love the print and feel! This dress fit like a glove and has a cozy thick feel to it. The only thing I wasn't too thrilled with was where the dress flared out. It was longer in the torso than expected and I was hoping the pleats would start at my waist and they ended up being right at my hips. I felt like there was a little too much emphasis for my liking. Other than that I loved it!
Great Fit! Really Figure Flattering  I loved this dress I wore it for a party and got so many compliments! Great dress I wish I owned it!!

Sassy, sexy, and original! This dress was such a great choice for an outdoor summer wedding - the material is a bit thicker than average BUT - and this is a big bonus - the fact that it was thicker actually totally allowed it to absorb any sweat, which was pouring aplenty as I danced my tail off at an August outdoor wedding! No sweat stains = awesomeness. It's flirty, just short enough to be sassy, and has a wonderful, forgiving cut. I don't have a racerback bra, I bought one of those convert-your-bra to a racerback clips for this dress, which worked perfectly (7 bucks).  TOTALLY would buy this dress if I could. Received lots of compliments on it all night!

I enjoyed an amazing evening at a work function with my husband.  The dress is fabulous! It was truly stunning and such a flattering fit. The one thing I wanted to mention is that on the model it shows that there is a cut out in the back, however mine did not come with a cut out and I was ecstatic! I was wearing it to a work function and I was afraid the opening might be a little much. So I was thrilled and felt gorgeous. Would definitely rent again!

Dress was perfect for my sister's engagement party. It was light and form fitting!  I loved the color - looked exactly like the picture. The sleeves were a little snug so I had to go up a size. I'm usually a size 0 but the size 2 was definitely a better fit. The length was perfect; just above the knee. I received a lot of compliments. My sister actually told me about this site and I am so thankful she did. Perfect dress!!!

Easy to wear! The color is stunning in person and lining make it comfortable to wear. I ordered the 4 and 6 and ended up wearing the 4 (5'5 130lbs). Great length, hitting just above the knee. Yes, the sleeves are a little snug but not enough of a reason to slight the overall fit, just know you're not going to be doing jumping jacks in this. Pair with a chunky statement necklace. Fun and festive for a holiday party! Do it!
Loved that the dress has pockets! Sleeves fit a bit snug but were the perfect length. Overall dress was great!

Dress was statement enough - needed little accessories  I felt comfortable in the dress and got a lot of compliments on it during the event and afterwards (in pictures).  Like a lot of other people have stated in their comments, the sleeves were snug, but not to the point where it was uncomfortable. I wore this on a cool early spring night and found it to be the perfect dress choice. The AC was high in the restaurant/venue I was at, and the sleeves on the dress kept me warm.
I got so many compliments.  It is so classic looking! This dress fit me like a glove!  10 out of 10!

A fun party dress! First off, it's a really heavy material and it's hot. I wore this for a bridal brunch or something to that extent and was glad I could take it off after a short time.  The plus sides are that it is very comfortable, conceals flaws, and is a great color! It wasn't overly short either, considering I'm 5'10", that's always a worry.  It was really a great dress for the occasion!

Great Dress for a Fall Wedding! Rented this dress for a fall New England wedding and loved it! I'm on the taller side and thought the dress was a perfect length (just above the knee)! The dress has some weight to it which made it perfect for an outdoor cocktail hour. I was stopped many times by other guests telling me how much they loved it. One of my favorite rentals!

Beautiful color! I received a size 10 and 12, I did not notice any difference in the way they fit... I compared the dresses together and noticed about a half an inch difference in size.

I do agree the arms were rather snug.

I received several compliments and informed people where I rented the dress... Many were shocked to find out it was a rental!

Rehearsal Dinner This was a really cute dress, the teal color was a little darker than it looks in the picture. Sleeves were tight and didn't seem to have any stretch, I don't think my arms are that big. Boobs were a bit tight too, I'm a full 34D, definitely should have sized up to a 10. I only had to wear the dress for a couple hours so it wasn't too big of a deal but could not have worn it for an entire day. The pockets were great!

Absolutely gorgeous dress!  I wore it for my wedding shower and received SOO many compliments on it. It ran true to size.  I read some comments about the arms being a bit snug and I could see why this was said.

My best friend's wedding I tried the 6 first but it was too tight in the bust and would not zip up. The fabric has no stretch at all. The zipper is also really hard to zip up. Luckily, I had my friend there to help me zip it up. The pockets are a super cool plus. I got many compliments with this dress. Loved it!
This was the PERFECT dress for an evening summer wedding. Lots of compliments! Fit perfectly! I ordered a size up from what I normally wear and turned out to be just right.

It has pockets! I loved this dress.  I wore this for my daughter's first communion.  The pockets were perfect for church to hold tissues and such.  I loved the color and the soft lining.  It was absolutely perfect!
Well made and comfortable dress... plus, it has pockets! Like the other reviews say, the arms are a little snug so I sized up.

Got so many compliments on this dress! The dress was a tad snug compared to other 14s I've worn, but once my husband had me zipped in, I felt like I could wear it all night long and be comfortable. I helped my mom set up for the party in it, danced in it, everything. Got a lot of compliments all night long. Will definitely rent this one again!

Pretty dress for a fall wedding! So comfortable too with pockets to boot. Length was perfect, I am only 5'1" and it fell at my knee. Size 2 fit perfectly. Top was a little snug but wasn't uncomfortable. Overall was very comfortable and I loved having pockets!! The lace details were beautiful and it even looked good with riding boots when I decided I couldn't bear the pain of wearing heels.

Loved the color for a fall wedding, perfect length for dancing! The medium weight was perfect for a fall wedding in Boston. I paired with a nude heel since the color was so unique. Very comfortable and flattering to wear. I did not have any issues with the sleeves being too tight but I could not comfortably lift my arms above my shoulder height because it would pull up the rest of the torso fabric in an awkward way (not really a big deal for a semi-formal wedding).

Great fit, love the color I teach 12th grade and May means a lot of events, so I did an 8-day rental and used the dress for our senior luncheon and graduation at the US Naval Academy. It was perfect for both and I received plenty of compliments on both occasions. I run between a 12-14, so I went with the 14 and was quite comfortable in this dress, even in the arms (which some people commented on). I would rent this dress again.
Beautiful color! The color of the dress was beautiful and the quality was obvious. The dress itself ran a little big, but the arms were pretty tight so I couldn't wear a size down.
very comfortable and sleeves help those of us who get too cold in air conditioned rooms. Pockets! fits true to size

Perfect color. Bright and fun This dress came pre-stocked with complements. My favorite part was the pockets for my phone and car keys and it was a handy place to stash a camera's lens cap when I took pictures at the wedding. 
The dress is comfortable, flattering, and you can't tell in pictures how bright and expensive it really looks close up. I was in Florida at an outdoor wedding and I wasn't too hot in this dress. I loved the cut too - very  flattering for petite girls. It didn't make me look shorter and the 3/4 sleeves were great. Some people say the arms are tight, but it was not restricting for me and felt right. If you have larger arms than average maybe size up, but overall a perfect fit. This was paired with Kate Spade green earrings (suggested by RTR) and they were perfectly matched. I was going for "modest but fun" and it was great.

Great dress that was also quite comfortable! This was my backup dress, so I'd ordered a size larger to make sure something would work out for me.  I could have easily worn a 12 in this dress -- the 14 was pretty roomy.  I liked that it was long enough on me -- I'm 5'10" with a shorter torso, so length can really be an issue for me.  It was also great to wear a normal bra under this dress -- added to the comfort factor.  I got soooooo many complements on this dress, especially on the color, which was a gorgeous teal.  The nude under layer was very sexy and looked great while being very comfortable.

Elegant in lace! I rented this and another dress for a ballroom dance weekend at a nice resort/hotel. I wore this one on the "more formal" of the two evenings as the lace lent a nice elegance to the dress. Although it was a shorter dress, it worked for the formal night and allowed me to dance without stepping all over a long gown. My only complaint was that the torso, which was quite fitted, creeped up repeatedly as I danced, being that my arms were raised to shoulder height. Assuming most people wouldn't be in a dance frame all night, this wouldn't be an issue!! I have a larger chest/ribcage, and the 10 fit very well, not too snug at all. In the 8, the sleeves were too tight for my arms as it is lace (not really any give) and they come to the elbow. The dress was otherwise quite comfortable and breathed quite well for being fully lined. And the pockets are ALWAYS a bonus for me in a dress.

The dress was super comfortable!  I rented this for a holiday party specifically because I wanted a "holiday" color and I thought it was green. The dress was not green at all, I'd say more teal but still VERY pretty. I was not surprised though since other people had mentioned the same. I wore my true size (6) and it fit perfectly and was comfortable. I loved everything about this dress and would rent it again!
great customer service! dress fit great, really well made. I'm 5'8", 184 lbs, big bust.

Absolutely gorgeous. I rented this for a wedding, but, unfortunately, wasn't able to attend because my daughter got sick.  I did try it on, however, and found most critiques about this dress to be true.  The green is a more emerald bordering on dark teal, but it is absolutely gorgeous.  It's just thick enough and hid just the right things (no need for Spanx!)  The arms are definitely tight (and a lot thicker fabric than I envisioned), but I imagine I would have gotten used to them as the night went on.  The 8 felt a little large elsewhere, but didn't look like it swallowed me whole.  Definitely size up if you're worried about the arms!  I rented the Kendra Scott gold Jill necklace to go with this dress and it looked great with it.
Loved this dress. Got so many complements. Such a beautifully made dress. Absolutely loved it.

Gorgeous color and compliments all night! I wish I owned this dress!! I had read reviews that the top runs small and it definitely does. I'm usually a solid 4 and I went with a 6 and it fit perfectly. A little big throughout the waist and hips, but I slapped on a thin tan belt to match my shoes and it worked perfectly. 
I got compliments all night long and even for days after! I will be renting this dress again!!

The dress was absolutely gorgeous! I received many comments on the vibrancy of the color and the cut The fit was perfect for my frame. I have a shorter torso so the dress hit at just the right spot to define my waist and not over accentuate my hips. The length was a nice knee length on me. I did find the sleeves and shoulder area to be a little tight when I first tried it on, but it got more comfortable the longer I wore the dress. I wore nude peep toe wedges and simple pearl jewelry that allowed the dress to shine on it's own.

I felt beautiful and my confidence was at 110%! The dress fits fantastic!! I loved it so much that I am actually considering buying it. If you're doubtful about this dress, don't be! It was a little on the short side in the back but not too short to not wear it.

Classic sophistication, very Audrey Hepburn.  I loved this dress. I wore it to a religious service and it was perfect. It was modest and flattering. The lace was thick but not too hot (the place was air conditioned). The skirt had nice movement and wasn't too puffy. Plus, what's better than pockets!!! I wore it with my favorite pearl and rhinestone statement necklace and simple earrings. The sleeves were not too right as some reviews complained, but not roomy either, definitely fitted. Overall, I highly recommend this dress. The color was amazing.
Classy and beautiful This dress was great for a fall wedding on Nantucket, fit well and was very flattering.  I will agree with others that it was a bit snug through the arms.
Loved the dress Fits true to size.  Arms are a bit snug which makes it hard to zip up by yourself.  I thought it was gorgeous and would have loved to have kept it!

It didn't work for me, but a luxuriously-lined, fabulous dress I'm biggest right under my chest (like when you're pregnant) and this beautiful dress sadly hit me right there. The quality was to die for, with all the luxurious linings, the length was perfect (which is hard to say for someone who's 5'2") and the sleeves were comfortable and covered nicely and the bonus of nice, hidden pockets! But, I wouldn't have been able to sit down all night and breathe at the same time. So, with much disappointment, I opted not to wear it.

Gorgeous dress! I rented this dress for a summer wedding.  The color was gorgeous and it was very comfortable.  It seemed a little bit, but because other girls said that the sleeves were tight, I might not have fit into a smaller size.
Comfortable & cute! LOTS of compliments! Very flattering and comfortable, arms are tight as previous comments mentioned.

Perfect choice for a fall wedding. Not only was this dress beautiful, but it was incredibly comfortable. Lining was silk, pockets a plus and not once did I feel uncomfortable or restricted. The dress was a hit! Only thing I would say was that at first the arms felt a little snug, but loosened as the day went on. I paired it with nude heels and purse. I also tried it with a black belt and heels, might be more suitable for a winter wedding.

Beautiful dress - but... This dress is really great on the hanger and I'm sure (I've seen y'all's pics!) looks great on some women.  I'm pretty busty, which combined with the full skirt on this dress, made me look sort of - large - which of course is not great.  

It was also a heavier material than I anticipated - and since it was a warmer fall day than anticipated, I went with the backup dress.  

Really great color though - and if you're slim up top, you'll look amazing!

This dress was so comfortable and classic! I wish I could have worn it more than one night! I am normally a size 4 but with a newborn, my chest (36D) made the 4 of this dress a bit snug. I felt most comfortable in the 6. The length was great...sitting at my knees (I am 5'6"). This dress was so "busy" with the beautiful lace that I kept my jewelry simple with a pearl drop and pearl studs. If I had the right bracelets, you could definitely dress it up on your wrists :) Would recommend this dress to anyone!!
I wore this dress to a rehearsal dinner and it was perfect!  The fit was great, very comfy!

Gorgeous, comfortable, and flattering! I have rented this dress twice and it is one of my favorites! Most recently, I wore it on a bachelorette weekend in Nashville and it was perfect for a night out! The cut and fabric are perfect for a full figure.

Comfortable, pretty, but saw other women wearing it I wore this to a cocktail party and loved it. It fit true to size and looked good on. But I wore it in a weekend of big parties in Washington, and I saw a woman wearing this dress in purple at the same cocktail party. The next day, I saw it in green at a brunch. Lovely dress, too popular.

great dress, was a fun color for a cocktail party, loved the lace Dress it a great color, but didn't fit the best for those with a long torso. it flared out above my hips and made me look large. Would be a very pretty dress if I didn't have a long torso. As others recommended, wet up a size.
i was not happy with the dress AT ALL.. chest area was tight. the dress is definitely not for curvy. order a size up, dress is not for bustywomen

The color was Stunning!  I adored this dress, i went to a wedding in Scotland and i got SOO many compliments! A lot of reviews said the arms would be tight, it wasn't so much as tight more snug but comfortable to dance the night away.  It is a heavy dress but the way it lays no need to worry if its windy. I will rent again!

Beautiful fit and material. I wore this dress on a Saint Patrick's Day bar crawl with friends.  The dress was the perfect weight and the lace was gorgeous.  I felt like it hugged me in all of the right places and gave me an amazing shape while concealing parts of my body I didn't want to flaunt.  Plus it had pockets!

It was perfect and I will absolutely rent it again!

This was a 'panic and call RTR' dress - they were AWESOME -  Super cute dress - a few spots where the lace was ripped, but not noticeable - a little warm for an outdoor July wedding, but really comfy and flattering!  This dress was sent to me overnight when my original dress was a no-go, the stylist was very patient and got me the replacement dress in less than 24 hours, from NJ to Seattle!
good for any occasion fit great ,not really stretchable

This was my first RTR experience and the dress was exactly what I hoped for! This dress is extremely comfortable and my expectations for the process and the dress were all met. The only "con" was that UPS didn't leave the dress the first day (I didn't realize they required adult signature) so I didn't actually get to try it on until the night before the wedding. If it hadn't fit, this might have been a very different review. Luckily it was a perfect fit! Good quality material. great color, and the fit/look was exactly what I imagined. I liked that it was lined and the lace was really lovely. It didn't seem "new" it had signs of being worn before, but that is to be expected. Definitely going to use RTR again for other special events.
super comfortable would recommend, loved the color and it was super comfortable and flattering.

Felt beautiful I needed a dress to wear to my boss's wedding, where three other senior executives from my department would be in attendance, so I needed something relatively conservative. This dress was perfect: neither my chest nor my rear were hanging out, yet it was cute and fun. I normally wear size 6 in dresses but size 8 in pants because I have bigger hips. I am also relatively tall at 5' 9". I ordered both the 6 and the 8, and while the 6 fit everywhere, it was about an inch shorter than the 8, and since I wanted the extra length because of the nature of the event, I went with the 8, which also fit well and wasn't too loose. I was worried about what other reviewers said about the arms because I have fat upper arms, but I had zero problems. It's true that this dress is hot, it was a 50 degree day so I was fine until we started dancing, when I got super sweaty. I would not wear this for a summer wedding, but it would be perfect for all other seasons. I paired it with hot pink heels and gold earrings. I loved this dress and felt comfortable and beautiful!
Comfortable and loved the pockets! Fit great, super comfortable, fun and flirty while modest.

This dress was nice to wear for a party. I rented this dress to wear to a holiday party. I didn't have a problem with the arms like others, but it was definitely too small for me in the shoulders. I wore the 14 instead of the 12, so that I could move my arms around! It's also way more teal than green and VERY bright.

Perfect Dress for a Luncheon! No cons on this little number - it fir perfectly, and the length was great. I wore this dress to a charity luncheon, and got many compliments! It wasn't too fancy - the perfect dress!

beautiful color and lace! The lace and color were beautiful. Size was a little small particularly in the arms so glad I ordered a size larger than my usual! Love the pockets! Overall was very comfortable and pretty!

Perfect dress! I wore this for a wedding where I started the day by doing the bride's makeup, and wore it all the way through the reception. It was comfortable all day, and looked great. It fit my DD bust and my midsection, but wasn't too loose everywhere else.

Classy Wedding Dress I really enjoyed this dress! It was my second choice after the first one I received didn't fit. I was impressed with how fast RTR was able to accommodate me with an alternative! I got tons of compliments on the dress, it was easy to dance in, and overall it just made a statement. It was nice to be one of the only people not wearing the usual black dress too. The fit in the arms was slightly tight, but it didn't prevent me from feeling comfortable all evening.

Other reviews are true, tight fit at the top Loved the color, loved the design, the pockets make the dress flair out at the hips a little more than I'm used to. Wore this for our anniversary dinner and thought I looked great. Definitely has a tighter fit across the top and arms, but not uncomfortable. More snug that the rest of the dress.

This dress! This dress saved the day. I had originally ordered the magenta version of this dress and picked this up as the backup. It's pretty, flattering, gorgeous color and covered enough for a church wedding. The lace was pristine.

Beautiful dress with a great fit! This dress is gorgeous. The color and detail are stunning. The fit is very true to size, however as others have mentioned, the arms fit a little tight. Once I had it on for awhile I didn't even notice. I received several compliments throughout the night! And the ordering and return process was simple and convenient. This was my first rental and I will definitely be doing it again!
This dress was great.  It is very casual though, not a formal fabric.  I loved it! I really liked this dress and felt very comfortable in it.  I got tons of compliments.  It fit well.

This was my first dress I rented from Rent the Runway.  It was gorgeous and got great compliments. Fit: LARGE. I wore some wedges, and with my 5' 1" frame, it barely made it off the floor.
Pros: FLATTERING.  I really think the design of the dress if flattering for women with different shapes.  I am not busty, so one of my concerns was the top being too loose.  I wore a strapless bra, and just made sure I inched up the waistline every now and then.
Cons: NOTHING major, just the overall fit.  However, I absolutely loved the dress.  I am so sad I have to return it, but will probably rent again!
Beautiful print fit well, but elastic was some what stretched out, so I couldn't blouse it as much as i would have liked to, and it made it very long. Very pretty pattern, though.

I wore it to my birthday party and everybody complimented me:))  It is such a lovely dress.   Pink is my favorite color and I absolutely love this dress even if it was a little too big on me.  I'm flat-chested so my bra kept showing.  I wished there was an adjustment on the back of the straps so I can slide it up or down.  It was also a little long on me but I wore my 3-inches wedge shoes and it was perfect.  The dress was very comfortable - perfect for the hot weather that day.  I'd rent it again in a heartbeat!

Loved this dress! I wore it to a beach themed bridal shower.  I wore the 'LL (the regular lengths weren't available), with flats it wasn't too long.  I just had to be careful when stepping back as I would catch it then.  Overall this was a great dress, I loved how it fit and was comfortable while moving around with bridesmaid duties during the luncheon.

Great dress, If you have large Breasts Size UP- Didn't even need a bra! WIN! I got lots of compliments on this pretty dress. The fabric is not very formal and I rented it "just cause" on a Saturday I had a lot of events to run around to. I tried the MR and it fit better everywhere else but the LR fit my bust so I went with it and like I said- didn't even have to wear a bra which in Texas in the summer is a total win!

perfect, loved it! not one bad thing i can say about this dress! didnt want to send it back. can easily be dressed up for a fancy occassion and easily dressed down to be casual. fit like a glove, super lightweight and very comfortable.

Excellent customer service- prompt delivery and overall great experience! Will rent again!! I wore this dress on a date to celebrate my birthday. We went wine tasting at several wineries and the dress was perfect for the occasion! Beautiful colors and pattern. The fit was a little large on top as previous reviews stated. I would have worn the extra small but the length was too short- It probably would have been better to order the extra small long. The small regular was long enough but it was a little big on top and I needed to keep adjusting the straps. I loved wearing this dress! It was beautiful and I look forward to renting more dresses!

Perfect "Shower" Dress  I rented this dress for my baby shower, and at 35 weeks, it was perfect for my "bump" and the occasion! I'm 5'2" (ish) and was able to wear the dress with platform sandals and it did not drag on the ground. It was so comfortable to wear all day, as well as light and airy, which made it perfect for the luncheon by the pool in the Sacramento heat! I may rent this dress again for a wedding I'm attending in June, as it was that great! So many compliments received- this dress is fabulous!

Comfortable and colorful maxi, great for destination wedding I wore this dress for a destination wedding in the Santa Inez Valley in California in May. I loved wearing this dress! It was so comfortable, but the material made it feel dressy enough for a wedding. I paired it with gold jewelry and a dark denim fitted jacket when it got chilly outside. It ended up being a bit long on me because I decided to wear flats instead of wedges, but the midsection of the dress has an elastic waistband that you can fold over a bit to make the dress shorter so it wasn't an issue. I would definitely rent this dress again, can be dressed up or down for a variety of occasions.

This dress was perfect for my 10 year HS reunion!  This is my second rental from RTR, so I was excited to see this dress! It looks exactly as it does in the photo, the color is amazing!  I am definitely busty (36DD), so I was concerned about the spaghetti straps, but a strapless bra held everything in place. I rented both the medium and a small, and the small ended up fitting just fine, plenty of room in the bust and everywhere else! I'm 5'3 so I had to wear my tallest shoes (around 3.75 inches), but since the waist is elastic, you can pull up the waist a bit to make it a little shorter (which I did when I switched into flats at the end of the night).Can't wait till my company holiday party to pick out my next rental!
The dress was beautiful! This dress fit great! It was very comfortable to wear to an outdoor wedding (in August, in Texas!!) Received many compliments!
Wonderful!! Great dress! After reading reviews I went with XS L and it was perfect for wedges. XS R would have been great it I was going with flats. Such warm colors, would highly recommend!
Nice dress, I rented for a rehearsal dinner on a beach. Was perfect for event  Was a little long and a little big in chest but over all worked just fine. I still loved it

Beautiful. Perfect for late summer Napa wedding I rented this for a friend. It fit her so well and made her look slim and elegant.
The only downside, and it was minor, was that the straps were a touch too long. It wasn't a big deal, though, and did not distract from the dress.
The weather was unusually hot, so the light silk was a good weight.

Stunning  The dress was absolutely gorgeous.  The fabric is very soft and vibrant in color; the pictures dont show the true beauty.  The fit is amazing.  Im usually a large but the medium fit perfectly.  It was great in disguising the belly.  The elastic waist is high enough you can pair it with a nice elastic belt for an extra pop.  I wore the dress to an evening baby shower and was complimented alot.

Flattering pattern, gorgeous impact! This dress was a hit with my boyfriend and other wedding guests.  One of the most flattering maxi dresses I've worn and perfect for a beachy wedding.  I didn't want to send it back, I'm definitely purchasing a dress from this company for next summer!

Fit notes: The top is a little low.  I'm about 5'7 and the regular length I could only wear with flats - if you're on the tall side/wearing heels, consider geting the long.

Great dress! I am 5'10" and with 3" heels the Small Long skimmed the floor. I don't have a great picture of the front, but this picture shows how long it was (I have my heels on in the picture). It was a little big up top, but it was chilly the day of the wedding so I ended up wearing a cardigan with it.

Love this dress! I rented this dress for my brothers engagement party and could not have been happier!  I was worried about the length as I ordered the Regular, when I called to speak with someone she could not have been more helpful, I planned on wearing sandals and it ended up being the perfect length.The fabric was light and airy and perfect for a hot July evening in NC. I received many compliments and the Arabian bangles I ordered completed the look. I am small chested so the dress was a little big uptop but nothing a little tape didn't help.  I will rent this again!

Wish I didn't have to send it back I rented this dress to take as a daytime option for an weekend trip and wedding. I wore this dress to lunch and to get my hair done, and I love it. It was the perfect maxi. I got a lot of compliments on the dress, and much to my surprise, the long was perfect with 4 inch heels. I love that this came in a long! I did use stylist tape around the bust because I have a shortish torso, so the straps were a bit long for me.
Such an amazing dress, fabric was perfect for the beach wedding.  Definitely go a size down.
I wore this dress for my 1 year anniversary! It was everything I wanted and more.  I loved the colors and how comfortable it was, however it ran a little large. I would recommend going down a size!

Very comfortable, cute dress! I wore it with a camel colored belt. The straps were a little long for me because I'm a 34A so the dress gapped in the front a little bit. My hair was down so I just cinched the straps at the top in the back to tighten them up a bit. I wore with flat sandals - I'm 5'9.5 and it was a good length, not dragging.
fits and flows lovely fit perfect.  long, so be sure you don't trip.
Cute dress This dress was cute but I didn't have the right bra to wear with hit so I ended up wearing something else. It is a little baggy up top but the length was good.

The dress was beautiful and definitely bump friendly! I found this dress in the "Bump Friendly" section.  I wanted a special dress to wear to my baby's gender reveal party.  The dress fit great, was comfortable and showcased my growing bump!  I went with the Small/Long instead of Medium/Long.  The top of the ML dress was too big.
Great maxi, runs large/long. Great maxi, runs large/long.

Beautiful summer maxi - you're sure to get tons of compliments wherever you wear it! I wore this dress for my RTR Promo Video as an RTR Campus Rep. I filmed on Newbury St and the Boston Commons and got LOADS of compliments and looks as I was filming. The dress is a perfect mix of summery pink and purple, and looked great with gold jewelry. I ordered the XSR and the SR after reading the comments that it runs large (I usually wear a S or M), and ended up wearing the XSR (the SR was too big in the bust). There is an elastic waist so the dress is flowy yet flattering, and the length was perfect to wear with sandals. I would DEFINITELY order it again next summer!

Rehearsal Dinner I ordered the medium and the large and the medium fit perfectly.  I normally wear a large in these types of dresses because of my hip measurements.  Make sure you get the smaller size down!

Dress was stunning! Loved how light and flowy it was.   The fit was okay, like other reviews the top was a little large, I ended up safety pinning the elastic to my bra so that it wouldn't keep sliding down. Other than that I loved it!  Its nice to find a maxi dress that hits the ground when wearing heels!!

Great dress! The long is very long! Perfect length! I got both the long (S) and the regular (M). I had to wear the SL because of how long the straps were. Thank you very much for giving us the tape, or it would have been too revealing. But I loved the dress and received so many compliments on it!

Really wanted to love this I really wanted to love this dress but it really is on the larger side.  I wore this for a september barn wedding and the pattern and color are beautiful.  The fit leaves much to be desired.  The straps were way too long and I pinned them in the back.  I also added a belt because it hung very loosly around my middle.  Defintely NOT for a straight and narrow figure.  Would be much more flattering on a girl with curves.

Fun Dress Loved this dress, what I will say is that it was a bit tight on my hips-however thats my problem area and happens a lot with me, I'm a serious hourglass though, I kept pulling it down all night because of that, but again thats more of a testament to my specific body type. The dress itself was cute, light, and fun, and well worth the price!

Incredible Maxi! Hands down my favorite rental from RTR to date... This Maxi has it all, great color and pattern, x back straps (I hate MAxis where the straps fall down), cinched waist perfect for belting. Literally cannot say enough good things about it. Wish I had a full length picture to share!

It definitely runs big (And long) so if you are hesitant definitely size down.

The dress was so comfortable!!! I had a hard time sending it back.  I got so many compliments in this dress, and I felt like a rockstar! The fabric was amazing. It was the perfect length with flats (no dragging, but no awkward ankles). I really didn't want to send it back

Very cute and comfortable for a hot day! Definitely go with all of the other reviews and get a smaller size than normal. I rented an XSL and SL and wore the XSL, it fit great! The fabric was great and flowing in the hotel summer air. Definitely recommend for anyone!

Perfect! I was worried this dress would be too big...but it fit perfectly! The xsr was the perfect length for flat sandals. I wore a bandeau underneath and had no issues with the top being too big. Loved the feel of the fabric! Very impressed with this dress and I would love to rent this again!
fun and easy The small fit perfectly.  reccomended with a strapless bra that is low cut.

I loved this dress!! I picked this dress for my birthday weekend. I received several compliments! The dress is very flattering and slimming. It does run big. I'm in between a small and medium and I wore the extra small because the top was too big in the small. Also, I meant to order the long but realized I ordered the regular size. However, it still worked. At 5'7" I was still able to wear 3" heal.

Overall, I would rent this dre

Fun and Casual! I rented this dress for Labor Day weekend to wear to a casual family BBQ. It is very pretty and I received a lot of compliments. The only down side is that the top has very long straps and was very loose on top. I ended up wearing a cute bandeau since it was so low and kept drooping down. I actually think I would have been better served to have rented the XSL. The XSR was just a little too short for me, but the top part of the dress fit much better. I'm 5'6 and a half. So hopefully that helps some of you girls out there!

Comfy but elegant This dress was super comfy and the perfect weight for an outdoor wedding when it's 80 degrees out! The fit was nice, I wasn't sure if I would be a M or L, but the L was unavailable so I put all my eggs in the M basket. The L definitely would've been too big, the M fit everywhere except the bust area where it was too big but I just used some fashion tape to ensure that my strapless bra didn't show. The dress was SHORT. I am 5'7" and it did not touch the ground when I wore flat sandals. This worked for me because I never wear heels but consider getting the long if you want to. Got a lot of compliments - the colors are beautiful and it's a flattering dress.
Loved the colors and the comfort! The top was definitely a little large so I had to safety pin it on the back to lift it up. So comfortable!!

Loved it.  Beautiful Dress. This is a great dress - so comfortable and so very pretty.  I received a ton of compliments on it.  It does run big, I ordered the SLong and the XSLong and ended up wearing the XS - mostly because of the size of the top.  Luckily, it was more than long enough and without heels it was dragging on the ground.
I loved wearing this dress and would have kept it in a heartbeat.

Beautiful, comfortable dress for date day Based on other reviews that it runs large, I ordered an XS but was worried about the long length since I didn't want to wear heels.  When I called RTR and explained that I wanted to wear flats, they still recommended the XSL, which was a perfect length for me.  The XSL hit right at the ground without dragging.  My backup size was a SL, which was too big in the waist and straps and way too long (probably about 2in extra).  The straps are about 1cm too long in my opinion, but nothing too bad.  The material is light and flowy, and the elastic waist gives a lot and still makes the dress look great if you indulge in a nice lunch or dinner... or both!  Transitions very well from day to night.  Overall very flattering and I wish I had this in my closet now!
GREAT DRESS!!! I wore this for my baby shower, and at 7 month pregnant it fit perfectly!!! I LOOOOOOOOOOOOved it!!

I wore this to a bridal luncheon...it was comfortable, easy to dress up  and wear more relaxed! Love I am fairly tall and wore this with flats I. A small long...it went to the ground ! Material is loose and flown!

Brightly colored, form fitting and flattering This dress is beautiful and comfortable. The material feels like silk against your skin-- the only complaint I have is that the top runs big and can be loose. I had to keep readjusting the top, which tends to be annoying. Other than that-- it was a great pick!

Great dress I wore this dress for a brunch following a wedding celebration. This dress was great. I ordered the XSR dress, which fit great. I am not the tall (5'4" tall) and the dress was the absolute perfect length with sandals. It was a nice material. The bust area did feel slightly big, but I wasn't flashing anyone my "goods" by any means. Loved the dress. I would rent it again!

It was the perfect Hawaiian vacation dress! It fit's very well, it is long though. I was torn between the small and XS, but I am glad I got the XS because if the small were longer, it would have been too long. With platform wedges, it still just barely grazed about the floor. Which is perfect!

Perfect for a day at the vineyards I almost wore the small, but it was a little tight on my chest, so I went with the medium.  The fabric was light & flowy, which made it very comfortable.  The length was perfect...I started the day in high wedges, and ended up in flat sandals, and both worked well.  The elastic cinching at the waist gives a nice silhouette.

This dress is gorgeous and got compliments all day! The length was perfect for my height (5'7") with 2.5" heels, and fit great through the body. My only complaint would be the length of the shoulder straps, they were a little long and non-adjustable...maybe my bust (32B) wasn't enough to fill it out?  This caused my strapless bra to peek out every once in a while if I didn't make sure the dress was pulled up.
I didn't wear the dress.  Was way to long and large for my 5"5 frame.

Perfect Vacation Maxi Dress I really loved this dress.  It is simple with a fun print and a flattering cut. I read that this dress runs a bit big so I ordered the medium long and it fit perfectly. I was able to wear a small wedge heel and the dress hit the floor perfectly. Luckily I wore this on vacation to Mexico in February so I can definitely rent this again in the summer!

Beautiful and flowy, works great as a maternity dress! I was 33 weeks pregnant and about 145lbs here. Dress worked perfectly for the bump! The length was perfect for flats and I'm 5'4". The top is a little loose, but worked well.

Perfect Maxi for warmer weather! I wore this dress for a wedding at the Santa Barbara Zoo- I liked that it had more of a "wild" and colorful pattern for the event. I paired it with a coral-like gold cuff also available through RTR. I was worried that the sort of slouch-ey midsection would not falter my hourglass inure, and that the dress would be too flimsy for my rather large bust. I have to say, the dress was neither- very pattering, very comfortable, and very light (so be sure to add it to your "favorites" for hot summer weddings!). The color was great, it worked well with a very good strapless bra, and it was not too sheer for being so airy. I wore nude pumps, but a gold gladiator sandal or straw wedges would also be so cute. The price is right and the dress is great! One weird word of caution- the dress was VERY static-y for some reason. Consider bringing a "Bounce" sheet to rub down the bottom and you should be all set!

Great maxi! So flattering!  This dress was great. Comfortable, flattering and the perfect length to wear with wedges. However, it did run large, and the straps were very long so I would go down a size.

Great dress! I wore this to a casual wedding rehearsal dinner outside.  It was perfect.  It definitely runs a little big.  I am not normally an XS and this was still a little big in the boobs. It does run long, but I could get away with flat sandals without dragging the floor.  
Love the dress.  Would absolutely recommend this!!
Gurls got Bachelorette Bliss in this dress! Wore this fab dress for night #1 of a bachelorette party in Newport! Makes a short girl feel tall!! FAB FIT!

All of the compliments I received on this dress made my night! Loved it!  The dress definitely runs big, I am usually a S/M in dresses and was able to wear an XS. I also got the long fit because I'm 5'6" tall. I was able to wear a 4" wedge and the dress still fit perfect. I would definitely recommend it for a fun night out!
Comfortable, beautiful dress Very comfortable, great colors for a beach rehearsal dinner.  Lots of compliments.  The straps are really long!  I needed fashion tape to hold it up!

Long length is great for the tall ladies. Fitted up top, which was perfect for me (no need for a bra!) and super loose through the hips. The length is pretty long, I'm 5'10" and it hit mid-shin on me. A cute dress that was very fun and comfortable to wear. Plus pockets!!
Favorite rental of all time!   Perfect for a day trip in New England, followed by a beach trip.  Rented and wore the 2 (I'm usually a 4), since previous reviews said top was on the larger side.
Comfortable dress=good time Perfect dress for a late summer day wedding.  Very comfortable...loved the length and the pockets.
This dress was so adorable!  Wore it to a bridal shower as the MOH. So many compliments! It was a bit long on me (I'm very short) but it still looked great. The bust fit perfectly. Would recommend!

Really great dress! Cool and comfortable! I thought the fit was true to size. I am large chested and there was good coverage. I managed to make a strapless bra with convertible straps work. My collarbones stick out pretty far and sometimes dresses with this cut are a little uncomfortable, but since this was my free birthday dress, I thought I'd take a chance. It was a great surprise that the straps were elastic-like, very stretchy and comfortable. The dress is light and great for hot weather. The skirt gives plenty of room for those with good-sized hips. Unfortunately I forgot to take a photo of me wearing the dress. I'm between 5'10" and 5'11" and it hit about halfway between my knees and ankles, which was exactly what I was hoping for.

perfect for outdoor wedding in October!  First time with RTR and all good things to say! It fit true to size. I go between a 4 and a 6 depending...but this was definitely a 4....so I would say true to size or even one size smaller. The straps are a little stretchy, did not need to wear a bra...but I think it could have been a little tighter on top. But, I loved it. Was perfect for a wedding in Tahoe. Paired it with my own brown belt and also wore a jean jacket and felt very comfortable all night. Classy with pockets. Lots of compliments!
This dress was great! The bust and waist were a bit tight, as the material had no stretch, but it still worked.

Incredibly soft and comfy!  A joy to wear.  Very flattering.  Elastic straps.  Well-lined. I just adore this dress!  It is incredibly flattering, very unique, and well-lined and has a little weight to it.  And perhaps most impressively, it is incredibly comfy to wear... it's almost like lounging around in sweats or a robe.  The material is super soft.  I felt gorgeous in this dress and I'm looking forward to wearing it again in the springtime (if I can wait that long!).

Casual Cool Wore this to work with a blazer.  Loved the fit (could have probably sized down) but flattering even with horizontal strips.  Adored the pockets.  No real downfalls except maybe wearing a strapless bra but honestly really liked this.  Could have worn it to the beach or fun day party.
Perfect dress for a bridal shower. I felt good in the dress.  I felt the pleating accentuated my waistline a bit, but not enough to make me not want to wear it.  I felt good.

Way too long on me  Pros: Beautiful dress
Cons: if you are 5'2 like me, the dress will come to your ankles. I didn't wear it.

Very comfortable!  I wore this dress for my daughter's birthday party. I was running around and doing a million things. It was unseasonably hot out, but I was cool & comfy the whole time! I could move easily in the dress without have to adjust the dress. I loved the look and was perfect for a casual event!

Pockets! So easy!  I just love this dress. It was maybe a TEENY TINY bit big, but really, just so comfortable and easy. I put it on, and felt dressed. I wore it to my 30th birthday party, and felt special and ladylike. I also didn't wear a bra, and felt totally comfortable.
Couldn't have been happier with this dress! It fit perfectly, and I got tons of compliments! I was worried it would be a little too big in the chest area based on other reviews, but it fit perfectly.

love love love this dress! i'm usually btw 2 and 4, but 2 fit perfectly. there's no rib in the waist, but the 2 still fit very comfortably and i don't have a particularly small waist. the dress was tea length on me, perhaps a little longer, but i wore high wedges and it looked great. i chose to wear it without a bra and it held everything in well. the cut gave me a great figure and it was easy to keep this dress casual for dress it up a bit for a dinner. the pockets are a great addition and the fabric is super comfortable. it's not thin, i would say perfect for spring or end of summer. overall, i would rent this dress again.

Beautiful dress - the skirt is very flattering, but top was too tight I ordered this dress to take with me on my honeymoon. It was GORGEOUS - but I should have ordered two sizes larger.  I had read all the reviews and decided to order it in a size zero (my normal size is zero or 2).   I am not busty (34B), but I have very broad shoulders and a very narrow waist. This dress was NOT ideal for my body shape because the top was very tight and constricting. I couldn't wear a bra with the dress - and it cut into my arms (giving me a weird muffin top around my armpits).  Even if I had ordered the size 2, it would have been to tight in the bust/shoulders. I think a size four would have been A LITTLE better --- but overall, the cut of the dress is not meant for broad shoulders. 

I ended up wearing the dress with a black camisole to cover my shoulders/arms - but it was super warm outside and I was uncomfortable, so I didn't wear this dress for very long. 

If I could have fit into this dress correctly - it would have been AMAZING......but just not for my body style.
I love the fit and fabric of this dress!  On a bigger bust the top might not fit properly. It curves in a lot, so don't get a size smaller.

Amazing Summer Maxi Dress I rented this for vacation in Charleston, SC. I had my eye on this dress for a while and was really happy with the rental. I would have prefered a size 0 but only the 2R was available. It was larger than I would have prefered, but would definitely rent the 0R again. I'm 5'3" and wore this with flats, didn't think the length was awkward at all. Paired with a big sun hat I loved strolling the streets of low country in the dress. I recommend it!

Perfect summer dress! I wore this for a work fundraiser and it was great! The fit was slightly tight up in the top, even in my normal size - didn't really even need a bra. Love the pockets and the material - it was super comfortable all night!

comfort and style!  This is a great dress, very comfortable and easy to wear. I'm 5'2" so it was a bit long on me, but still looked cute with heels. The torso also cuts inward, so there is potential for side boob issues, but I did not encounter any. I wore this to a graduation and dinner and got a ton of compliments, felt super comfortable and very trendy.

Narrow chest The cut across the chest is narrow. I'm very flat chested (34A) and the side cuts came in too much on me. I can only imagine if I had a larger chest. I typically wear a 0 or 2. The 2 made me look like I was swimming in it, though the chest coverage was appropriate.

Perfect fit. Cute dress. Loved this dress. It fit perfectly (I am 5'7", 120 lbs, athletic build with broad shoulders, long legs, wore size 2) and is very flattering. Like other reviews stated, the fabric has weight to it, but this was perfect for a warm fall evening. The dress feels very well made. Would definitely rent again.

Modest, comfortable dress I wanted a cute dress to wear for my birthday, so this was my second choice, but I ended up loving it. I wore it to work all day and then out to dinner. The sporty cut is very flattering. I thought it was a bit long, but very pretty. Loved the pockets.  Both the 6 and 8 fit, but I went for the slightly tighter 6 because the 8 was a little baggy in the bust.

The easy feel, the fresh modern look, and the pockets! I loved the Clare V. striped bag with it!  I wore a padded strapless with it to feel out the chest a little more as I have A cups. The waist was just slightly high, but I have a long torso. I would say this dress would look best on taller women bc of the tea length. Mostly, this dress feels easy and chic, fun and modern. It is so comfortable, and the fit at the straps looks great. It is summery, but I rented for a Southern Californian lunch.

Felt so comfortable and chic! Fantastic dress! Can I say pockets? Wore this for my doctoral graduation, including the ceremony, drinks, dinner, and dancing. I was comfortable all day and night, and received so many compliments. I ordered both the 0 and 2, and was worried when they weren't able to send the 0. But the 2 fit perfectly, in large part because of my athletic shoulders and medium-sized bust. I suggest sizing up for your back-up size. I paired the dress with black dangly earrings, a bangle, and bright red wedges. Rent this dress!

So comfortable! Wore this to a friend's rehearsal dinner on a warm June night. Super comfortable and very ladylike. The pockets add a little bit of interest and I liked that it could be dressed up with a few accessories and worn to a semi formal wedding (or something of the like) or worn with some sandals/flats out to a summer-y casual dinner. A great rental all around! (P.S. Please ignore my messy floor!)
