Comfortable, clean look, with pockets! I requested sizes 2 and 4 in my order and I'm glad I did as I ended up wearing the size 2. The dress was extremely comfortable and I wore with a strapless bra. The length of the dress is as many other reviews have stated: a bit long for the shorter gals. I wore with nude heels and it looked very put together. Loved the pockets! In all a lovely dress!

Mountain wedding This dress is super cute! I was between the 6 and the 8 and went with the 6 because the 8 wasn't available. It's tight in the bust and rib cage for me but still workable. Very comfy and versatile dress. Is a little long on me but I think heels will help the look.
Small but flattering  Wore to a bridal shower. Lots of compliments--beautiful material, pockets, straps are elastic, but the waist was tight. Still flattering though but def size up

I ordered this as a backup dress in case my first choice did not fit & wore it to a graduation party I LOVED this dress! It was a little long on me, but I am short and used to everything being too long. It was incredibly flattering on and it has pockets! It is lined, but outside on a hot day in South Georgia I was comfortable. I got so many compliments and will definitely be renting again.

Cute, preppy casual option This dress is a borderline 3/4 stars for me. It was cute, mostly comfortable (a little tight across the chest/ribcage), and fit true to size. It is a LOT of fabric, and a heavier material - for this reason I would recommend for ladies on the taller side. Did not find the stripes or shape of the top (fuller coverage) to be all that flattering. A bit torn on this one.

Great lightweight dress. Perfect for an early Summer Wedding Fit perfectly. The height for a renter recommended in the description felt a bit off. The dress was long, hit at my shins and i'm 5'8. I wore 3 inch nude heels and felt great. I do recommend a "smoothing piece" like spanks or something, only because of where the band around the waste hits, it isn't restricting but it can accentuate the crease. Could wear a strapless bra no problem, don't know how bigger busted women would do, but it worked for me. Got tons of compliments and highly recommend renting this dress!

It is fun and flirty and a perfect outdoor wedding dress! I went with the size smaller than my normal, but overall I loved the dress! It is fitted around the waist, which is perfect for me because I got dem hipppsss and booty. I feel like the fit was one point and I received a ton of compliments throughout the day. I was able to wear a strapless bra without any issues but you could definitely go braless, those bad boys aren't going anywhere. There really wasn't anything that I would have changed about the dress. The best part being... POCKETS! *swoon*

Beautiful - tons of compliments! This was a beautiful & super comfortable dress. I wore it to a wedding and it transitioned perfectly between the afternoon ceremony & evening reception. It definitely ran big, so I would have preferred a 00, but the 0 was fine. The length was unique & I received so many compliments on this dress. I wore nude strappy heels (then changed into sandals) which were a must with the length. The pockets were super cute, too! Overall, great choice!

I would live in this dress!  Comfortable, lightweight and with pockets-- this dress was a dream for a sunny outdoor wedding where the couple encouraged us to dress with the outdoors in mind. Got tons of compliments, danced with ease, and could pair with a practical colorful wedge. I would have kept this one!

Gorgeous! I feel like this dress looks a lot more drab on the website than it does in person, especially if you wear it with heels. I rented this dress for my engagement photos and couldn't have been happier with it. It's casual but still looks polished. The length is great if you're average to tall height (I'm 5'7) but might be too long otherwise. I wish I could have kept this one!

Must be TALL to roll with this dress The dress is gorgeous and well-made. The material is not see-through at all and I loved the stripes. However, the dress in size 10R fit perfectly waist up, but the length hits me at the ankle, which did not help my short height and was not at all flattering on my hips. The waist band in the middle and flowy skirt exaggerated my hips, so I had to return the dress without being able to wear it to my event. Like they once sang in the 90s, by Skee Lo: "I wish I was a little bit taller..." :)
Wish I liked it more. Not made for short women. The length is awkward and the bottom of the dress is bulky.

I got a ton of compliments on this dress! The bust was a little tight, but not so much that I needed to go up a size. I'm tall (6'1) and this still hit at my shins. I can't imagine how long it would be on someone of average height.

Perfect for girls night out!! I originally rented this dress for Thanksgiving but we had a freaky cold front ruin my wardrobe plans that weekend! (I ended up stopping at Target for leggings and a sweater.) I loved the fit and how classy it looked paired with black wedges and a small Kate Spade bag that I rented along with it.  Ended up wearing it a few days later for girls night out at a wine bar!

Flattering fit, perfect for short girls I rented this dress for my birthday, going to NYC to see a Broadway matinee. I loved the material and the pattern, very classic and cool. The fit was wonderful. It was quite flattering, even with a strapless bra. I went with the 12 for a little more comfort in my large chest. The length was great since I am only 5'4'' - it started raining in the city and since it wasn't a full maxi length, the beautiful dress didn't get ruined along the wet sidewalks. All in all, a really fabulous rental! I may end up renting it again in the future just to get some more use and photos out of it!
Bridal Luncheon Dress fit very well, and loved the pockets! The black band at the waist has no stretch in it, so you probably want to size up for your back up size
So casual-chic! I loved this dress. It's soft and flattering and it has pockets! I recommend a sticky cup bra as it's difficult to "pinch and lift" through the fabric.

Easy to wear and flattering This dress is very comfortable, easy to wear and flattering.  The material  is nice and remains wrinkle free throughout the day.  Stripes are cream and grayish, with a black band at the waist.  I wore a strapless bra with the dress.  This dress is very pretty, but I recommend it for someone over 5'6" (I am 5'3" and feel that the hemline on the bottom would have looked nicer if it fell at my shins like the picture, but it came to my ankles).

Cute and comfy! I rented this for a daytime, family party and it was perfect for that! It was super comfortable and I love the pockets. The material was heavier than expected and it wrinkled easily - which, for a casual daytime event wasn't a real problem. I typically wear a 4 and the 4 fit very well with only a little extra room.

Great print and interesting length! Rented this for a friend's bridal shower. Loved the fabric, cut, neckline, and pockets! Was slightly large in the waist but overall fit fine. Would buy this dress in a hearbeat!

The dress is quite eye catching, just wish it fit better. I wore this to a First Communion last weekend and found the dress to run very small in some areas and large in others. The straps were stretched out possibly to prior usage which meant they fell off my shoulders a lot. the dress was extremely tight in the chest area and while I liked the unusual length of the dress, it is longer than I anticipated. Additionally, this material wrinkles quite easily as well.
This dress looked great for a summer outdoor work event. Looks great on - I thought it ran slightly big.

Effortless chic casual dress The 0 was a really good look and length for me but a bit snug on my wide ribcage so I wore the 2; big difference between sizes.  I'd definitely rent this again in spite of the slightly pilly tummy area (both sizes, the tummy area?).  The description says crepe; it's not, but it drapes and moves nicely.  Straps are slightly stretchy, very comfy.  No armpit cleavage, no side boob, not sheer.
Best dress ever.  This dress is perfect. Comfortable, soft, pockets, unique length, room to fit a whole wedding dinner in it, cool to dance. The best.
Great for a garden wedding! Best for those tall women out there. I am 5'10" and wore 4" wedges; absolutely loved the fit!

Comfortable, flattering dress! Loved the weight of this dress. It wasn't too heavy, but didn't blow up at the barn wedding we attended. I'm larger chested and I really liked that I didn't feel like my chest was smooshed or looked like a loaf, like some high necked dresses do.  I really loved the pockets, too! I'm not normally one for a high-low dress, but this one was so perfect, I'd highly recommend it!

So comfortable, cute, and fun! Loved, loved this dress. Got compliments and felt great at the event. The waist ran a bit tighter than I'd prefer but the size 6 still worked; didn't even wear a bra! It's more lightweight than it appears. I wish I could buy this dress.

A Winner! This dress was comfortable, stylish, and effortless. It was made of incredibly soft material and although the torso was fitted, the straps were a bit stretchy so the fit on top was really flattering. The pockets were a fun touch! 

I wore it with a statement gold and black necklace, a black clutch, and a black pashmina (for fall wedding). Despite lots of dancing at this wedding, I kept my 3" heels on my feet because the length of this dress really needs the extra height. I had to wear a strapless bra (but nothing crazy like backless or low-back - just a regular nude-colored strapless bra). 

I ordered a 2 and a 4. I usually wear a 4 but was concerned based on reviews that it might run large. Nope! It's totally true to size and the 4 was perfect. My belly isn't as flat as I'd like these days, but the pleating on the front was really flattering and covered up the area I felt insecure about so the fabric lay flat. All in all, a winner!

Comfortable, classy, chic Rented for nautical fleet week / airshow and was an excellent, comfortable choice.  Very easy to accessorize, flattering length and pattern.  Only complaint is the short torso and slightly too snug back/shoulders for those gals with more athletic upper bodies.
so comfortable, got lots of compliments  easy to wear, perfect for a summer wedding in the mountains .

This was the perfect dress for a more casual wedding! I normally wear a size 2 but needed the size 0 in this dress. The 0 fit very nicely and was breathable on a hot summer day. I loved that it had pockets!

loved Wore for a bridal shower. Fit was perfect. Had a little bit of stretch with it.. loved the fabric. Fit was true to size. The only issue I had was the white slip fabric underneath was longer than the dress so I had to pin up the underneath part so that it didnt show..  Would totally keep this dress..  got lots of compliments on it.
Telling everyone about my love for Rent the Runway! Gorgeous dress, love the pockets! Perfect for a day wedding or wine tasting weekend. You'll look and feel very elegant and classy in this dress.

Not friendly to busty women Beware if you are bustier. This is not friendly or flattering for a full chest. I'd also be cautious of this dress unless you are toned in the chest and arms because the sleeve style exaggerates any excess fat in the front chest area. I'm 5'6'' and this dress was longer on me than pictured on the model so really the only thing being shown off in this dress is your arms unless you are tall.

Effortless and classy pantsuit I loved wearing this pantsuit at a formal event. It was elegant, classy, and flattering. The 0R was overall a bit baggy/longer on me, so I pinned it up a bit at the shoulders, and it was perfect. Definitely recommend this piece!

Very fun romper - can be dressed up or down! I wore this to a wedding rehearsal dinner and loved it.  I can't always do rompers, as I am fairly tall.  This one didn't ride up at all.  The buttons at the top are difficult, so you'll need someone to help you undo them every time you need to go to the bathroom.  Other than that, it was great.  Definitely something I'd want to own!
LOVED this! Would definitely rent again. I could have easily worn the 12, but went with the 14 since I was headed to a big dinner and a night out & didn't want it to feel snug!
Amazing I loved this rental. This is possibly the best item I have rented. It fit amazingly well although because I am so short, it was a bit long but I was still in love.

Simple, yet Stunning!  Fit overall was good, little tight on the legs when I sat down. Some people complained about it being difficult to go the bathroom...I didn't have any problems.  Extremely comfortable. Id didn't want to send it back.
Looks absolutely gorgeous Fits perfectly.

Great Fit! I was a little worried when renting this outfit. I am normally a 10-12 in size and the size 12 was booked for the dates that I wanted. I wore this outfit for my graduation. I wanted something comfortable yet stylish at the same time. The jumpsuit was perfect. It was not too tight. The material allows for some stretching and breathing room. I am 5'7" and the length hit just at my ankles… so it may be a little long for someone who is shorter. The back does have a nice opening so you can either wear no bra a bra with no back.  I paired it with a pair of flats because the last thing I wanted to do was take a spill while accepting my diploma. I added some simple accessories to dress it up a bit more (also rent the runway). I would recommend this outfit as not only is it nice but allows you the comfortability to move around a lot.
Want to buy this piece! I wanted something different than just a dress for a recent wedding.  I got many compliments.  I believe the jumpsuit ran true to size.  Would definitely rent again!
A Modern Classic Wore this on my birthday date and I loved it!  Great modern cut and super comfortable.

I felt amazing in this outfit and to top it off got to meet one of my most favorite celebrities!  This romper was amazing!  I felt like a million dollars and I was a bit worried since there wasn't a second size available to try for the dates I needed.  So glad I read the reviews because they were right - it does run a little large so the 2 was perfect!  
My husband had purchased me a VIP experience with Bette Midler while she was in town for a concert in our area and I knew I had to look fabulous.   I was so thrilled when Better herself was wearing a pants suit for our photo.  I was comfortable all night.  I would absolutely buy this one!  Will rent again for sure!!
Thanks RTR for making my "once in a lifetime" opportunity a success.

Great Jumpsuit! Comfortable and classy! I wore this to a work event and felt so pretty in it! It wasn't too dressy but I felt classy wearing it! Very true to size! Great construction.  Material was thick enough- no bra was needed. I have a slightly thicker mid section and this created a great silhouette that made me feel sexy.

Great jumpsuit, hard to button I loved this, but the buttons at the neck were almost impossible to do. I had to get friends to help, and even wore it one day with a blazer so I could wear the back open.
Loved the way it looked! Very slimming, and the A-line esque top helped hide any tummy issues.  a bit of work taking off to use the rest room, apart from that really great! will rent again!

Fantastic fit, classy and edgy Wore this for my grad school graduation because I wanted to feel grown up and edgy at the same time.  This jumpsuit is comfortable and flattering, and feels extremely well made.  I tried the 6 on first, and it would have worked, but I'm glad I went for the 4--it was perfect (I am more often a 6 or 8)! I felt appropriately dressed for the occasion yet sexy at the same time, got a ton of compliments.  Wish I could have kept it!

I LOVE this Jumpsuit so much - didn't want to return it! Got SO MANY compliments!! LOVE LOVE LOVE! This jumpsuit was sent to me after my original dress I ordered had been returned damaged.  I worked with a wonderful stylist to help me find another option for a wedding I was attending that weekend.  She found this AMAZING Jumpsuit and another Dress.  I wore this to the Rehearsal Dinner.  True to Size - don't know how it would fit if you're tall.  I'm 5'4 and it was a PERFECT fit!
Fun jumpsuit! Fit was good- fun romper. Liked how it had pockets. Wore it to a baby shower during the day, but could have definitely worn it into the night. Definitely recommend.
Loved this!  Casual, but dressy.  Wore a blazer with it for warmth.   Fit just like I expected!

Great jumpsuit! I have pretty long legs and my proportions don't usually work for one-piece jumpsuits. This one fit like a dream, made me feel sexy and was very comfortable, too. The fabric was great, it was pleasurable to wear and I felt very polished with minimal effort. I would suggest checking this piece out if you are new to wearing jumpsuits.
It fit like it was made for me.  I loved how I felt and looked in this outfit. I wore it to a bridal shower. I cant get over how sexy I felt. Got several compliments.
Great look! This was awesome but curves can make it ride up in certain areas. I went a size up and it was perfect.

I rented this for a rehearsal dinner party. This is an awesome outfit! I typically wear size 4, but because I am shorter I rented a size 2.  I'm glad I did.  It was still a little long, but with heels it worked just fine! I ould definitely rent again.

It was my cousin's rehearsal dinner so looking good and feeling great were icing on the cake! This jumpsuit was absolutely perfect. I wore it to a rehearsal dinner with black heels and it was a hit. I was SO comfy the whole time and I got so many wonderful compliments on it. I plan on renting again for another wedding later this summer. Seriously, cannot go wrong. I am 5'10'' and ordered a size 6 and it fit perfectly. I have longer legs so I was worried it would ride up like other jumpsuits I've tried, but that didn't happen with this one! Only con I can think of is when I was sitting down, sometimes the neck part would ride up and I'd have to readjust so I didn't feel it was too tight. Oh and I couldn't wear a bra with it because I didn't want it to show through the back. Next time I may wear stick ons or something.
Comfortable, great fit! I was very nervous to rent my first jumpsuit but I LOVED it! It was a fun, different outfit that I felt so good in. Very true to size.

Chic, flattering, and comfortable! This jumpsuit was one of my favorite RTR rentals... I wish I owned it! I was a little unsure about renting it, since jumpsuits have been really hit or miss for me. It's extremely comfortable and flattering, which tends to be a rare combo to find. You can easily dress it up or down depending on the occasion... I wore it on a Valentine's Day date with my husband, and it was perfect for the occasion. The slit in the back makes it impossible to wear a regular strapless bra (unless you don't mind it showing), so plan to wear a backless bra.
Very comfy and flattering! Great jumpsuit that I wore to a rehearsal dinner.  Got many compliments!
Worn to my husband's residency graduation.  20 weeks pregnant in this photo. Fits comfortably with my growing bump. For reference: current weight 110.

A must rent!  I rented this jumpsuit for a casual bachelorette party. I was a bit nervous about getting in and out of it based on the reviews - there is one button and a zipper and neither were an issue. I loved this jumpsuit, got a ton of compliments, and would definitely rent again!

The outfit arrived a day earlier than it was scheduled. Great service wonderful outfit.  This  was very comfortable and Chic! The back does open up more than I expected I had to wear a shawl to cover up the back for church. Other than that I loved it I want to rent this outfit again.
Comfy and cute! Loved this! The length was perfect for my 5'3" short legs. And bonus, the top section hid anything that needed to be hidden 😉

This jumpsuit was super comfy & BEST OF ALL..I didn't have to wear a bra!! This jumpsuit was a little large under the arms and longer than I would've liked in the legs...however, with the perfect pair of pumps the legs fell great over the shoe so it didn't look frumpy. I loved this look and the feel of it.

Comfortable outfit, fit perfectly and got a ton of compliments.  Fit true to size - ordered backup one size up but didn't need it.  The length was right about at the ankle (5'6" with a mid-heel).  Has pockets but they aren't that deep so you need a clutch. Super easy to accessorize or not.  It doesn't need much, so, opted for a pop of color on the shoes.
Super chic.  Loved how sharp I looked in all black. I wanted to keep it and wear it for every occasion!

Winner! I would buy this pantsuit in a second! Wore it for my birthday party and felt sexy and comfortable. The slit in the back of the top doesn't lend itself to wearing a traditional bra - I went without one. It was really warm the day of the party (high (90s), yet the pantsuit was lightweight and fairly breathable.

Best item I think I've ever rented  This was the first time I've rented (or worn!) a jumpsuit. I am taller than the recommended height in the description, so I was a bit nervous, but I couldn't have been happier with it. The 8 fit me to a T, and was incredibly flattering and comfortable. The openness of the back is tricky for a bra, but with the way it's designed I didn't even need one. I felt stylish and comfortable the entire night. I paired it with black and gold earrings, a gold cuff, and strappy black heels. It was perfect for my best friends bachelorette party!

Sassy & Comfortable This jumpsuit is EVERYTHING! Definitley fits true to size and isn't too short or cameltoe-ish (sorry yall) for us tall girls! The black is slimming, but the front pleats weren't my favorite. Wore this to my 10 year high school reunion and I got lots of compliments all night.

Perfect outfit and so many compliments! I wore this jumpsuit for a rehearsal dinner and it was absolutely perfect. I wore a size 0 and the length was just right (I'm 5'4"). The quality was fantastic and the overall fit was great- not too tight and not too loose. The back is open though, so you can't wear a regular bra. I wish I could have kept this! Love love loved it.
Cute  It fit perfect and was comfortable

Too big I rented a size 4 with a backup size 6; the 4 turned out to be too big all the way around. The flowy layers on the top made me look wide, as well, although hard to say if I had the right size. I'm 5'2'' and I also would have needed temporary hemming tape or something to get the look of the model. Disappointed!

So fun, and so many compliments! LOVE! I have rather large boobs (34D) and did NOT need to wear a bra, which was fantastic given it has an exposed back. I rented the 6R and the 8R and they both fit, but the 8R had just a little too much room. The 6R fit like a glove!

BEST jumpsuit ever!  Perfect for a bachelorette!  I rented this for a bachelorette weekend and could NOT have been happier with it. It was my first time ever wearing a jumpsuit and I'm officially a convert! The top hit perfectly and was super flattering; the length worked great, too. It runs true to size or perhaps a little large. It was extremely comfortable and I received compliments all night! Definitely need a statement necklace to really up the wow factor. A must-rent (I'll definitely be renting again soon!)
Loved it, very flattering, lots of compliments. Fit as expected, very comfortable.

Flirty Peek-a-Boo back enhances this LBD alternative! Fit: comfortable in the bottom, large in the top Undergarments: must wear with sticky bra or backless bra  Length: Long but was able to shorten the hem with fashion tape because I am only 5'3! Overall: Felt awesome in this jumpsuit! Very flirty with the cut out back slit. Happy with this first RTR experience.

Awesome bachelorette party choice This jumpsuit was a perfect choice for a busy bachelorette evening. The fit was great although it did run large. I would normally wear a 2 in dresses, pants, anything else but ended up in the 0 which fit great. I was relieved that the length of the pants was perfect for me at just 5'4" too. A little tough to wear a bra with so I would recommend a backless or sticky bra. Would highly recommend and would definitely rent again.

Just an OK fitting jumpsuit Just not a great jumper.  The crotch hung really low and I felt uncomfortable walking with it hanging low.  The front of the pants had pleats on them and they did not sit well.  The length was awkward.  I tried my best to make this work but it failed.  I did not wear it

Great Comfortable Easy Outfit 5'8" 130lbs received size 2 and 4

both sizes fit pretty similarly, but the 2 looked like it was a little worn so i went with the 4. Very comfortable all night. I didn't need to wear a bra with the thick material but you could get a strapless bra under it as well.
Rented this for a friends an engagement party in January.  a little lose in the top but since I'm long waisted couldn't wear the 6R. Over all very flattering and got lots of compliments.

It was soooo cute and so comfortable!! So many compliments! This was amazing! It runs large, so order down. I got so many compliments. Didn't wear a bra because of the fit, but it didn't even matter. I wish I owned this!  Will be on the lookout if it ever hits the clearance section cause I will definitely buy it! Wish there was an upcoming event to give me reason to order it again :)

A standout in a sea of LBD's.  I loved this outfit.  It is very stylish for a cocktail party.  Something more than a little black dress.  It runs a little large, so size down.  I am 5'5 and 112 lbs.  I needed a size 0 .  The two was giant!

Perfect jumpsuit! Very slimming! I am 5'6", 130lbs, 32D/DD, usually wear size 2. Ordered 2R. This fit perfectly! The pants cut off perfectly at the ankles. The top was slimming and flowy. The neckline was professional/work appropriate. The jumpsuit was so fun it was perfect for after work. I paired it with black ankle boots and a chunky necklace to accentuate the collar. I loved it so much, I rented the navy colored jumpsuit the following week (Unlimited) for vacation!

I loved it so much, and so comfy I almost slept in it.  I was worried when I rented this because I am tall and usually jumpsuits and rompers like to ride up a bit too much in unpleasant areas.  I rented a 10 with a 12 as back up.  I could have worn the 10 but the thigh area was a bit too tight.  I ended up wearing the 12 and I was not too tall for it!!!  The fabric was so comfortable, I wish I owned this jumpsuit!

Sleek, chic jumpsuit. Both glam and comfortable. The only thing I didn't like about this jumpsuit is using the restroom—there are two buttons holding the back closed and addition to the side zipper, and it's difficult to unbutton them solo. I had recruit a friend to unbutton me so I could use the facilities. :)
I am 5'2" and it was a bit to large overall, it worked but I would have liked it to be more tailored too long and overall large for my frame
I'm a big fan of jumpsuits and this one lived up to my expectations! Comfortable and flattering. This fit true-to-size and was just the right choice for my cocktail event at work.
Super comfy! Can dress up or down. I would rent it again for sure.

This jumpsuit was EVERYTHING!  I rented this for my best friend's bachelorette party. It was adorable, classy, and comfortable. I received tons of compliments! I even tried to rent it again for a different event and it was already taken--I am not surprised!! This is a rental I would do 100 times over again. The sizing ran a little large in my opinion, but the smaller size wasn't available when I needed it so I stuck with the 12. If you're thinking about renting this, do yourself a favor and DO it!
This is amazing! So simple and flattering! If you have a tummy you want to hide, this is it while still giving you shape. So classy! Only downfall is you have to unbutton the whole thing to pee.

I received endless compliments. The cut is super flattering and leaves room to eat & drink! Only con is that you have to essentially undress in order to use the bathroom (by unzipping and taking the top down). Because of the back slit (which is super sexy, and perfectly paired with the conservative neckline), you can't wear a traditional bra. I got away without wearing a bra at all (and the lining of the jumpsuit makes this feasible). So comfortable and effortless. Wish I could own it!!

Celebrated a friend's birthday, fun outfit. Cute outfit, not like anything I had in my wardrobe already so that was fun. You feel sexy wearing it. I bought an adhesive bra to wear with it, since the back does show.  Like others mentioned, you will have to pull the entire thing down to use the bathroom- but that was ok!  I carry my weight in my belly area, and I thought this was a flattering outfit.

Easy, comfortable, stylish. I wore this for a pre-wedding party on a boat cruise along the Seine in Paris.  It was great to have the pants to feel covered in the cool breeze and the top was stylish and I wore it with a turquoise long necklace, cuff bracelet and dangle earrings.  You can do so much with this outfit -- dress up, add a blazer, add a scarf, colorful shoes, etc -- great basic stylish go-to outfit.  Would like to own it!

well made, easy on/off jumpsuit nice fit for a petite lady, timeless and classic black - well constructed jumpsuit! I normally wear a size 8P and the 8R - fit (was a little loose) but it worked nicely.  the only thing I didn't care for was the front pleats on the pants portion of the jumpsuit BUT if you have a bit of tummy perhaps the pleats are a good thing.  Beautiful, well constructed jumpsuit  - this was a GREAT first rental .

Someone told me I should buy the dress! I initially didn't like the fit and was about to wear another dress that I own, but after showing it to my mother and boyfriend, they convinced me.  I was at a friends wedding, and receive compliments ALL night long...just like all the other commenters.  It fits well and you feel like you're attending an award show.

Beautiful color + so comfortable! Got a ton of compliments on this dress - especially because of the color! My normal size fit, but it was a little too tight for my liking, so I went up a size and was much more comfortable. I also got a Long and it was perfect to wear with 3" heels. I was a bit nervous to try this dress because of how form fitting it looked, but it was surprisingly flattering and so much fun to wear. I'd definitely rent this dress again!

I absolutely loved this dress! I ordered an 8R just to be safe of a tight fit, I never even had to try it on. The material fit so nicely on the top and bottom! In the mid section there was a little extra fabric, but it ended up working out. I was unable to wear my black spanx that didn't lay very flat underneath.
Perfect for dancing all night! Super comfortable, great color and the length was perfect. A simple yet stunning dress!
Perfect & Classic for Black Tie Loved this dress! Super elegant and simply, so you can pair it with fun earrings or a necklace. Was a really solid dress and highly recommend to anyone in a pinch!

Marine Corps Red, perfect for the ball! Absolutely LOVED this dress. The cut was great and because of the vibrant color you really don't need to have any special jewelry.  I'm 5'4 and the 6R perfectly touched the ground with 5in heals. The dress is fitted and the material is thick. I would definitely recommend this dress!

The dress was a complete show stopper! The color made me stand out & feel like a star.  This dress is amazing. I wish I could've kept it for myself. I was nervous about the fit because I hadn't tried the exact size, but once I did it fit like a glove. They send you 2 sizes and it was amazing. I had the dresses shipped to the hotel where I was staying and they were already there in the room by the time I arrived- GREAT SERVICE! The dress hugged my curves in the right places and made me feel like a hollywood star. I am 5'1 so I had to wear 4 inch heels and could've gone a bit taller. I wanted the "dragging" look, but it def is up to taste. I added a big statement necklace and it made the dress pop more. I got compliments the whole night- even from the bride! When you put the dress on it looks much more elegant in person. It is very easy to dance in and move around with. It is very comfortable! The only downfall about the dress is that the tighter the dress or the fit the more you can see rolls and other imperfections, etc. Nonetheless, I would recommend this dress & RTRW to everyone! (PS. I tried on like 12 dresses at the RTRW location and this one was the best fit!)

Sexy Dress I wore this to a black tie gala and received so many compliments. The dress is incredibly form fitting but fits like a glove. It does not hide anything, so if there is anything you may want to cover up, this is not the dress for you. Overall I loved it and was asked where I got it at least 5 times throughout the night. Rent this if you want to turn some heads!
The fit was outstanding and was a perfect dress for the occasion!  Very form fitting but comfortable to dance in.

Beautiful simple dress that fit like a glove.  This was a gorgeous dress that was sent as a replacement for my original order. I almost wore this but I was able to pick up my original from FedEx so I stuck with the original. If I need another red dress I will be ordering this one. It was beautiful and very flattering. Its a classic dress that packs a punch!

Beautiful color & great neckline!  This dress was amazing! The neckline is so flattering and the fit was excellent. I don't typically wear red but this color was a knockout. It's definitely form-fitting so if you want something you can eat and be comfortable in, this may not be the best option. I'm 5'4" and wore 3" heels...the dress was still a bit long but worked fine by just holding it up. It did make me look so much taller! Overall I loved this dress and would absolutely rent it again.

Way too small for my curvy figure I am 5'6"' a size 16. This dress was so fitted that I felt like I would have needed to size up 2 sizes in order for it to fit. I have an hourglass shape and it was just really tight all over, especially in the med-section. This was a replacement dress sent to me because my original dress was suddenly unavailable because of a late return or damage. Customer service did a great job of trying to make it right, but in the end I'm still disappointed and without a dress for a wedding tomorrow.

It's always nice being a standout in a sea of black dresses! I got many compliments on this dress, which was form fitting, but heavy enough to hang right over curves. I did wear spanx beneath, and a strapless bra, which worked fine. I wore this to the USMC ball and felt comfortable dancing and moving around in it. The cut was flattering to the shoulders - I'm somewhat muscular, so I think this showed that off well. overall, a win, despite the fact this was my 3rd choice gown and was overnighted at the last minute due to my chosen gown being damaged by the previous wearer...

My husband encouraged me to try something out of my comfort zone & try something different!  I am generally a 6 & ordered an 8 & 10 based on the review. The 10 was way too big & I would have liked to see the 6, but the 8 worked as well. I felt needing it a little loser around the waist also made it a little loose on top. I was still able to wear a strapless bra just fine. I'm also 5'2'' & wear very short heels due to my husband being short & the length was great!

I wore this stunning gown to a Hospice Black Tie fundraiser. I loved this dress and felt beautiful in it.  The color was gorgeous and the fit was flattering, hugging everything in just the right way. I received many compliments.  For foundations  I wore Spanx and a strapless bra. The dress is form fitting and does show EVERY thing. I am 5'6 and wore three inch heels and the length was a smidge long but nothing to worry about.   I ordered the 6R and was pleased with the choice.

This dress was BEAUTIFUL! Great color and very flattering fit!  I am 5'11'' and the length was fine with four inch heels (it really hit right where it hits on the model). The dress was gorgeous and I still felt special in a surprisingly large crowd of red dresses!! It was very flattering and I loved the neckline and back. This is a great dress to play around with accessories. I felt appropriate and comfortable and had a fun night! It was very sad to send it back!!

Great dress - loved that I was able to wear a strapless bra.  Fit me pretty true to size.  
I wear a 4-6 and I went with the 6 to be sure I'd have room, since it is form-fitting.  Spanx are a must - but it's nice that the material has a bit of stretch, so it moves with you and is not difficult to walk in.  Was plenty long - I'm 5"9 and I was able to wear 3-inch heels.
Perfect dress. Fit TTS, tight but quality material

Did not end up wearing because it was a little too plain and not very flattering. I knew this dress was going to be very simple, which is exactly what I was going for, but I imagined it fitting to my figure based on the picture. When it did not, it did not feel very special and overly plain. I have a thin waist and wider hips. While the hips fit well, there was too much fabric at the waist which made it unflattering. My girlfriend also tried it on to hopefully get some use out of it and had the same problem.

I wore this to a black-tie, spring wedding and it worked perfectly for the occasion The dress is beautiful and great quality material. I had to use my larger back-up size because it does fit tightly around the hips/stomach. The 6R fit fine but I felt more comfortable in the 8R as it was less tight around my stomach. However, going up a size for the hip area meant that the dress was quite loose around the chest. Regardless, I wore this without a bra and didn't have any problems. The dress is long, I am 5'6 and wore it with 3.5 inch heels and it was still trailing a little.

The dress is classic and beautiful. The red really made a statement and stood out from the rest I recently wore this dress to a wedding and I received several comments about the dress and how beautiful it was. I even had 2 people ask if they could borrow it for a different wedding! The dress was fitted but not tight so it was very flattering.  I am 5'4"-5'5" (I lie and say I am 5'5"...) with an athletic build, weight around 125-130 lbs. The dress was about 2 inches too long even though I wore 3 inch heels. I ordered the size 2 regular. I would definitely order this dress again and highly recommend it!

I got so many complements about looking amazing and standing out among the crowd. Amazing Gown! I ordered the 6L and the 8L and was so surprised that the 6L was longer than the 8L.  I took a photo of the two gowns next to each on the hanger so show. It was so obvious that the 8L had been altered from prior damage, which lead to the train being shorter. I went with the 6L which fit like a glove. I felt like a billionaire in this dress and loved it. Got so many complements! This dress made the night amazing and extra fun! When you look great, you feel great, and have a great time! I wore a strapless bra and control undergarments which worked out well!
beautiful & flattering dress. very beautiful dress, perfect and comfortable fit.  Rented for a work black tie event.

Nothing is better than feeling beautiful, sexy and CONFIDENT in your dress.  I absolutely loved everything about this dress! I'm 5'9 and curvy ... small up top, bigger lower half. This dress complimented me in every way possible. Great material and comfortable. No wires to deal with, no static materials, no complicated zippers. What you see is what you get. I wore it to the Marine Corps Ball and got compliments on the dress all night. My only suggestion is to wear a spanx piece under the dress. Because the dress is so 'straight' it does show every single curve ... The stomach area can be a vulnerable area.  Spanx saves the day! Great dress made for a great night :)

Loved this curve hugging, comfortable dress! I rented this dress for a black tie family wedding.  It was comfortable and form fitting, and just the right length for me.  I'm just under 5'4", I usually have to buy long dresses in the petite section or have my dresses hemmed  but this dress was a great length on me, most likely because it rode up a little due to my curves.  The fabric is breathable with just the right amount of stretch to hug your curves.  I do have a little belly and it was visible in the dress, but I still loved the dress and think that i looked tasteful.  I also didn't have to wear a bra, even though i'm a 38DD i hate wearing them, with this dress so it was so easy to wear and very comfortable!

How everyone commented that I looked amazing in red ;)  They ran out of the petite, so I had to order the 0R. This worked fine with some magic tape! It's a super comfortable dress. But it does fit like a glove, so you'll have to find the right undergarment to ensure a no-panty line look. Overall, I could dance and walk around in the dress all day. Loved it, and you won't regret renting it!
Stunning at class reunion Even though simple had a bit of train which I loved. Created a sexy shape and felt fab in it.  Great Pick

This dress made me feel like I was at an awards show! I wore a strapless bra with this dress and you could see a little bit of it on the sides, even with fashion tape, but it wasn't too noticeable! The dress fit absolutely perfectly everywhere else and it wasn't uncomfortable sitting down. I've never gotten more compliments in one night! It was just perfect.

Favorite dress I've ever worn!!!` This dress was incredible - seriously my favorite thing I have ever worn.  The color is a vibrant red and the cut of the top is extremely flattering.  I wore spanx underneath to smooth out lines and wrinkles, however the dress was so comfortable I wasn't worried about eating or drinking too much in it.  Also, the length was perfect with 4" heels.  Love this dress and would absolutely rent it again for another event!

Flattering on a large bust and hourglass shape I loved this dress so much when I put it on I immediately went online and purchased it. It is my default formal wear dress, the red is so powerful and slimming.

This was my back up dress, but I ended up loving it! I wore this dress to a commencement ball.  The information on the account is not mine:  I am 20 years old, 5'4, 125 pounds, and my bust size is 34A. I usually wear a 4, but I went with the 2.  I loved this dress it was wicked comfortable.  I was concerned the petite would be too short but it fit perfect! The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because it was a little big in places such as right above the hips and chest.

Formal Polo Classic Fundraiser Dinner I am typically a 6, however I rented a size 6R and 4R after reading the reviews. Both fit, but both were different. The 6R was roomier, but I went with the 4R for a righter, sexier fit. I am 5'6" and wore 3.5" heels. The dress skimmed the floor perfectly. If you are under 5' do not rent this dress. The fabric is thick, but not too thick for 90 degree weather. There is a light slip/lining under the dress. I did not wear a bra, but used pasties. I did pull off spanx to hold everything in. Other than 2 other women in the same dress, I felt wonderful. Highly suggest this dress.
Wore to a black tie New Year's Eve wedding The length was perfect for 3 inch heals. The dress fit and was true to size. The material made it a  little difficult to wear Spanx/undergarments.
Great for a daytime wedding. This dress was so comfortable!

This dress is very flattering and comfortable. The stretch in this dress is key, easy to move in.  Fit is great, except the dress is very LONG. I wore a size 0, am 5'6 and had on 4 inch heels and the back of the dress still dragged on the floor. Last minute had to stress and find fashion tape. Highly recommend purchasing the fashion tape with this dress if you are under 5'6.

Dress was made me feel great! My regular size was small in the hips, so I went up a size & it was great! Dress is very comfortable and was long. I had 4 inch heels and  the back still touched the floor. I loved the cut/ style of dress. Very true to the picture. My husband loved it! I 'd definitely wear it again!

This dress was amazing! Fit like a glove and was absolutely perfect! The material is thick, stretched a little, and was very comfortable. I got tons of compliments and would highly suggest this dress to anyone! Perfect for black tie optional wedding when you're looking for something other than black.

I wore this to a gala and it was perfect for the event.  The dress was beautiful and comfortable.  The color is stunning. The only issue is that the lining caused the dress to twist slightly and the zipper down the back pulled to the side. I had to adjust the dress a couple times during the night to keep it all lined up straight. However , I got a ton of compliments on the dress.

Lovely dress. Fabric is exceptional and the color matches the website. Ordered the 6 Long and 8 Long. I am 5' 7", 135lbs, with a 36B top, and a 32 inch waist. The 8L fit perfectly with Spanx.  The backup 6L, stayed in the bag, didn't even try it on.   The 8L was the right length with 4 inch heals.

I didn't stop getting compliments on my dress! Absolutely beautiful dress! Perfect length if you have HIGH heels that you're planning on wearing with it. The size fit perfectly, except for the mid section. It was a bit loose in the belly and the lower back; I would have preferred a more fitting section (especially in the back area) to show my curves a little better. Overall, great dress though!

I've never gotten so many compliments before! Best dress I've ever worn, hands down. Was picked for me in the Georgetown shop during a fitting, never would have thought to pick this dress on my own! Highly recommend!
I just put the dress on and went. I didn't have to worry about anything.  The fit was a little lose, but in a flattering way. I'm 5'2 and with wedges it was the perfect length.
The dress was very comfortable and I received compliments all night on the bold color I am 5'8" and wore 4" heels and the length was perfect
Fit beautifully. I got SO many compliments. It fits true to size. It's incredibly sexy but elegant.

Fun night! The fit was true to size.  I wore the size 2, typically wear a 2.  It is a very comfortable dress.  I am short so ordered petite.  The dress was still quite long even w/the about 2" wedge heel I wore.  Just held the dress up when walking.  Ease of delivery and returning was great.  Will def rent again!

Stunning! I recently lost 70+lbs and this was the perfect coming out dress! Really wow' everyone when I walked in the room in this gorgeous red dress. Slimming fit and I wore a strapless bra just fine. I do have a large chest and it was a bit tight but other than that it was perfect.
Loved it! Great fit, color, and quality. Received tons of compliments! I'm 5'5", 130 lbs and the 2R fit perfectly. The length was perfect with 3 inch heels. I wear a 26 in jeans and am a 34C.
Awesome dress really stood out from the crowd and was comfortable for dancing 0R perfect for wearing flats at 5'7 - if I was wearing heels i would have needed the 0L for sure.  Gorgeous dress.

Was the backup dress. I ended up loving it! This was my backup dress. My original choice didn't come in the correct size, but I was very happy with the way this one fit. The color is a very bright red. I stood out, and got compliments on it all night.

Called the best dress at the wedding by multiple guests (other than the bride, of course!)!  This is a very body conscious fitted red dress.  The cut is modest but it still shows curves. I wore it with a simple gold bracelet and Tory Burch Miller flats to a semi casual outdoor wedding on a vineyard in Northern California.  The color is incredibly vibrant and the dress can definitely be dressed up or down.  I would definitely rent again!
I felt so comfortable and classy in this dress.  GORGEOUS! So many compliments on this dress. Would definitely rent again.

So comfortable! Loved this dress, didn't want to send it back! Was slightly too loose at the waist but still comfortable to wear, 0L would have been the perfect fit but it was unavailable. Also, with a 34DD I felt perfectly fine with no bra (which is rare). Slightly tighter at the top which gave some support but then was too loose at the waist, but still flattering. Otherwise was perfect though!

Plenty of length with the Petite size I loved this dress, it was very comfortable and I got a lot of compliments.  The 0 may have fit better in the bust, but I would be fearful it would have been too snug around the middle, I had a baby 8 months ago so still had some bulge, but even with that I still felt very good in this dress.  It is very well made and an awesome color! I wore the 2 Petite and still had plenty of length wearing a 2+ inch heel.

Sexy, yet classic, red dress! Compliments all night! I originally wanted this in black and they were out of my size so they sent the red. I was very skeptical, but it ended up being gorgeous and I received compliments all night! I couldn't wear a bra, but the fabric was thick enough that it did not matter (my chest is small). It does hug every curve, and ordering a size up for looser fit is not an option as it then gapes in the chest area and arms. The dress itself is very comfortable and I was happy all night long, even after eating a big meal and drinking all night. I usually wear an 8 and the 8 I think fit perfect. I ordered a L and wore 4 inch heels and it was still long. I am 5 6''. I think I could have gotten away with the regular length and then not stepping on it all night. Overall, I vote YES, and my friends and fiancé certainly voted yes as well!

Simple cut and stunning color Incredible color that makes the dress so much more striking and beautiful in person than it appears online. I received hundreds of compliments on this dress and felt comfortable wearing without shape wear because of the heavy weight of the fabric.

Perfect dress for a sophomore violin recital! I ordered the 2P and 4P for my sophomore recital, and unfortunately, both were a little too big and the hemline was too long for a short girl like me. I called RTR and there was no 0P in stock for overnight shipping, but I made the 2P dress work with a LOT of fashion tape. If I had worn 3" heels or higher with the dress, the hemline wouldn't have been an issue, however, I ended up wearing flats with it and had quite a long train. The fabric almost pooled in the back when I stood still. The color is a beautiful, vibrant orange red, and the cut is quite flattering, as it accentuates your curves. I wasn't able to wear a bra with this dress, however, and I definitely recommend shapewear, as the midsection is a little unyielding (forces you to have good posture), and will hug any pouches you may have. Overall, I was pleased with the quality of the dress and how it made me stand out without being overwhelming.

Great quality dress! I was really nervous about using Rent the Runway for the first time, but I was very pleasantly surprised! I have a very small bust  and large lower portions, so I was really thankful for the packet of fashion tape, even though I didn't have to be. Keep in mind that it is a little long in the back, so I was picking it up as I walked around, but it looked gorgeous in pictures and I didn't stop getting compliments on it all night! My backup size, 0R, was unable to be shipped, so I was happy that the 2R fit, but I had GREAT customer service, and they even refunded me 25% of my order! All in all, it was a wonderful buy and an incredible quality!

Striking!! I ordered a 2L because a 0L wasn't available and I knew I needed the length. The dress was beautiful but fit bigger than I would've liked in the waist. I quickly (and temporarily) took in the back seams, which helped the fit and silhouette a lot. With the quick adjustment, it turned out to be an amazing dress for the night.

Perfect prom dress! timeless  I am a size 4 but the 4 was not available, so I made it work with the size 6 and four safety pins. The neckline looks amazing in person and even though the dress was a bit loose on me, the silhouette made me stand out.

Glamorous dress, flattering fit  First RTR dress that's ever worked for me!  Rented this dress for a formal black tie wedding and it was a hit.  I got tons of compliments throughout the night.  Simple, yet very glam.  Flattering cut that makes your curves look great.  I'm 5'3 and the dress was VERY long.  I wore 4 inch heels and the dress still slightly dragged on the floor but wasn't a big deal, still looked great.
Great color, comfortable and flattering!  I wore this to a late afternoon wedding at my friends' farm and it was perfect!  Super comfortable and flattering, got lots of compliments!
It is beautiful and flows . Easy to wear and to dance in.  Very flattering. Perfect  perfect fit
Gorgeous, flowy dress! The dress was comfortable, flowy and a beautiful color. It was perfect for a summer wedding at the ocean and I received a ton of compliments. I wish I could buy it!

Beautiful dress...but I didn't end up wearing it.  This dress is absolutely gorgeous.   The color/print is beautiful. The fabric is soft and flowy.  The dress is very comfortable.  That said, it was not flattering on me at all and I didn't end up wearing it.  he top of the dress was too big for me, I think because the waist sits at your natural waist and I'm short-waisted. I felt like I wasn't filling up the top. Even so, I am sure this dress would look amazing on others.

Beautiful dress!! This was a perfect dress for a summer rehearsal dinner.  The event day was so hot, I nearly wish I wore this to the wedding instead.  It was light and airy.  I received lots of compliments on it. I'd love to rent this again.  I hated to return it.
PERFECT! Rented this for an outdoor day wedding and it was perfect! Usually a size 2 but the size 0 fit a little better. Comfy and feminine. Would rent again!
Perfect dress for a summer wedding! Loved this dress! The 4 fit but was a little large - the 2 was perfect. I wore a strapless bra and paired it with tan heels.

I loved the color of this dress--for me not a color I usually wear nor one I usually see at events. I felt great in this dress because the cut of the neckline accentuates a nice aspect of my shoulders...and not my flabby arms.  I liked the color because it's unusual and didn't look like everyone else's dress.  The flow of the material made the dress flirty and feminine.  The detail on the waist was a nice touch but a number of the sequins were missing or hanging by a thread.  Rest of the dress was in good order.

Light, easy to wear, and FUN to dance in! I actually had chosen another dress that was damaged and unavailable, so I had to go back and make another choice. I'm so glad I went with this beautiful yellow one! It is much more flattering than I originally thought it would be from seeing it online. I usually wear a 12, but this one ran a bit big and the 10 fit perfectly, even with my sizable bust. I wore a regular bra but pulled the straps together to make it a racerback to hide the straps. This dress was so flattering, the beaded belt pulled the waist in at just the right spot, and was so nice and flowy from the empire waist down. I felt comfortable dancing (and eating!) and didn't want to take it off or return it. I felt like I could dance all night, and I loved how the skirt flared out when I would spin around! I wore it to an outdoor summer wedding in Maine and it was a perfect mix of summery casual but formal enough for an evening event.

Effortless perfection. The fabric of the dress is light and flowing, and extremely comfortable for a warm outdoor wedding in Vermont.  I paired this dress with 3" wedges and then changed into flats for the evening portion and, despite the high-to-low hemline, it worked with both options.  I was able to dance without a second thought to my dress other than it was the perfect selection.  My backup size, a 4R (I went smaller given that I am smaller in the chest area, and the dress has an empire waist which proves to be more forgiving around the mid-section) was unavailable, but the 6R thankfully fit true-to-size.  I did end up choosing to go with a strapless bra, as the shoulder material cuts a bit narrowly for a bra with a traditional strap.  The color is beautifully vibrant and stands out in the best way possible; the beaded detail of the waist is a perfect touch.

Amazing dress to wear on vacation Great flowy summer dress for vacation.  I packed it and wore it while I was away and it traveled well. 
So much fun to dance in and hits the right balance between fun and casual, but also can be dressed up.  The neck is pretty high, no necklace needed and the waist has an embellished detail, so I only wore it with earrings

The compliments! I wore this for my sister's bridal shower and I got a ton of compliments. This dress is super comfortable and the high-low is a little more pronounced... but I liked it a  lot! Usually because of my legs high-low dresses don't look good on me but this really worked. I would definitely rent again!

Beautiful dress....perfect for any occasion. The fit was perfect.  I have a large chest and was scared it wouldn't zip, but this dress accommodated beautifully.  I loved the fit an flare.  The length was perfect.  I wore a halter bra and it worked perfectly.  I am 6'0 tall and the dress came a little below my knees in the front which was perfect.  I wore this for my son's graduation and got compliments on it from almost everyone I passed in the stadium.

Gorgeous dress for a casual wedding This dress was stunning!  The fit was really great, and it was flattering in all the right places.  I have large hips, and the dress didn't accentuate them and hit in exactly the right spots -- skimming over hips and emphasizing my waistline.  This is one of my favorite RTR dresses!

Flowy, hides the curves and is flattering. I have a large chest (34 DDD) and the 10R was a great fit.  It comes in at the waist, and is pretty flowy throughout the hips which is flattering for curvier ladies like me. I got this for Easter, but ended up not wearing it. I would probably rent this again.
50th Birthday Party Great Dress. Comfortable and forgiving

Loved this dress - it fit beautifully. Comfortable, yet classy with a fitted waistline. The dress was true to fit. I had a 4R as a back up, and it was definitely too large. I wore this dress to an outdoor evening wedding, and it was perfect for the occasion. It was slightly chilly though, so I paired the dress with a blue shawl and a chunky blue necklace and bracelet to tie everything together. In summary, I highly recommend this dress!

This is a beautiful dress suitable for daytime or evening. The fit is true to size. I usually wear an 8, but have a full (36D) bust. The 8 was unavailable, so I ordered the 10. The 10  fit fine, though I could have probably worn the 8. There is plenty of room for a full bust with this dress. It arrived in perfect condition, did not require any steaming, and did not wrinkle during the event. It is very comfortable.
Beautiful flattering summer dress.  Fit was perfect, comfortable and cool.
Received comments on wearing something colorful and springy fit true to size, I should have worn a 4 - I wear either a 4 or 6.  Very comfortable.

Lovely to wear This dress was perfect for an outdoor wedding--cool and comfortable! The vibrant yellow was outside my normal comfort zone, but I loved it once it was on and am glad I took the risk. I found the fit to be spot on for my shape and bust size (the lining is thick enough to wear pasties or go bra less).

The color for a Spring outdoor wedding! I got so many compliments and loved the flowy fabric. Ordered a 10 and 12, ended up wearing the 12 because the 10 was too snug in my bust (38D). Slightly fitted just under the breast due to thin strip of detailed beading under the breast bone. It wasn't tight in a restrictive way, but did shift the fabric up occasionally where I had to pull down/straighten it out. I'm a 38D, maybe this wouldn't happen with smaller size breasts/thinner body frame. The dress is flowy, light fabric, bright and sunny colored! I felt both feminine and sexy in it.

Perfect for an outdoor summer afternoon wedding! This dress was light and airy - perfect for an outdoor summer afternoon wedding in a warm climate and comfortable enough to dance the night away! I received many compliments on the dress and felt beautiful all night, a rarity for this plus-sized girl! I am 5'5" and the length in the front came just past my knees. The back was just a bit longer, which I normally don't like but it totally worked with this dress. As others have noted, the sparkly band around the middle was snug, so if your tummy is a trouble spot, go up a size. I usually wear a 16 in dresses and ordered the 18 as a backup. Both fit, but the 18 had a lot of extra fabric on the top. As noted, the 16 was snug around the waist but not uncomfortable. The only negatives are that the waistband hit me at an awkward height in my mid-section (wish it had been an empire waist) and also the back of the dress bunched up at the waist a bit. But given all the compliments I got, I guess it looked fine to others!

Very comfortable and flowy. Gorgeous color Loved the color of this dress and the fabric is really soft and flowy, perfect for a beach wedding. It was a bit long for me since I'm only 5'2", I think it would look better on someone who was a bit taller. Overall a great dress though, would highly recommend it.

Flowy airy comfortable beauty  Petite  5ft.  135lbs. 36A-28-40  workout like a beast stocky petite frame with a full behind, nice waist and decent breasts.  This dress is beyond comfortable go down a size since I wear a 4 and given the past reviews I sized down and it fit like a glove. Light flowy fabric, soft yellow and white flower like pattern. The dress comes with a liner so there is no transparency or stickiness problem.  It hits below the knee for petite frame. It has a roomy bust are so if you are up to a 36C will fit nicely. It has a fitted waist with beautiful detail from there on extremely flowy and roomy. When you walk the dress opens slightly and makes you look like a diva. I wore this for a Superbowl BBQ and everybody just loved it. I would definitely rent it again.

Lovely dress Beautiful color and shape.  Runs a bit large so size down if you have narrow shoulders or a small ribcage.  I am usually a 4 or a 6 if the dress is fitted around the hips, but the 2 fit perfectly.  The color is a bit darker in person than the picture, but I wouldn't quite call it mustard.  It's more of a golden color that is still very pretty for spring and summer.

Hides your midsection w/o sacrificing silhouette, makes your arms look more toned than they are!  I rented this for my bridal shower in September, which was about a month and a half before my wedding (so all of you brides / brides-to-be will know that means I'm nearing - but not yet at - my goal wedding weight!) This dress was so flattering no one could tell, and I felt awesome. The waistband hit just at the ribs so if you still have mid-section weight no one can see it, but it hits low enough that it's much more slimming than empire waist dress would be (to me empire-anything makes you look pregnant ). The slight halter cut also makes your "a little bit" toned arms look a lot more toned than they really are. Have recommended to many girlfriends (including one who has an upcoming work event and is hiding a baby bump!) and will definitely rent again.

You couldn't help but feel pretty in this dress. It was so comfortable and flattering on.  You could wear normal undergarments so you weren't fussing all the time.  Also it was a summer wedding and the fabric was light and didn't stick to me.  I could have probably have worn the 4, but I spent the day eating and drinking and wanted to be sure I had wiggle room. Fun to dance in as well.  Highly recommended.

The perfect beach wedding dress This dress ran small for me. I usually wear a 16W dress, but the 18W was too tight in the chest (though the 20W was a little too big). Length was amazing and I am 5'4. Perfect for a beach wedding. I wore it with casual sandals when I had shoes on, but would be just as great with nicer wedges or heels.

Pretty and sweet This dress is perfect for a spring daytime event. The skirt is flowy and there is a row of beads around the waist that gives it some interesting detail. Wear a slip if you will be outside. Also, you will need a strapless bra but it is worth it.
The people Fit great, super comfortable - loved it.

My bff's rehearsal dinner:) Fit is lovely.  Only con is it's not as slimming as I'd like.  Some dresses make you look thinner than others and this isn't one of them.  Doesn't make you look bigger....just doesn't make you look smaller.

I wore this for Easter Sunday and received SO many compliments! The fit was perfect.  It was easy to move in and because of the asymmetrical bottom, it would work great for tall or short.  I have long legs and have trouble with things being long enough!  It was a perfect length for me.

Comfortable, lightweight elegance. The floral print and gossamer feel of this dress were perfect for a spring wedding. The material is light, and the layers make it "floaty", like something Cyd Charisse or Rita Hayworth would wear in a movie musical. The yellow is bold, without being brassy (think ripe lemon). I wore a strapless bra, since the shoulders are cut quite close to the neckline. Others have mentioned the sequined braided belt, which felt like an unnecessary design detail, but didn't detract from the overall elegance of the dress.
didn't wear.  The shape was odd for my body.  COlors were beautiful didn't wear.  The shape was odd for my body

Flattering and comfortable from start to finish. Being a plus size it can be hard to find a dress but this was perfect.  It fit well all over and didn't require any special lingerie.  I did use some clothing tape to make sure everything stayed covered on the sides but I don't think it was necessary.  
It paired well with several of my shoes so that was nice as well.  I would definitely recommend this dress for a summer affair.

This was my backup dress, but I ended up wearing it This dress fit pretty well. It was loose and flowy, which made it fun to dance in. The color was good for a casual summer wedding. My bra size is 32A, and this dress would probably look better on someone with a larger chest. There was a bit of loose fabric in the front when I put it on, and I had to remember to pull the dress down to keep the fabric from bunching up in front.

this dress was so comfortable ,great for dancing the yellow was exactly as shown ,great for summer it fit true to size , plenty of room in the bust so i went with the 0. I am 5'3 and the length gave the dress a more formal look which was perfect for a Saturday evening beach themed wedding in July.  I wore the backless strapless adhesive bra cups for support ( i am 34 DD) . I wore nude Loubi peep toe pumps and the red sole gave the yellow and white a nice pop of color. Th necklace i rented also dressed up the look even more.It was a hit and got many compliments all evening

Great great dress!! I wore this for an outdoor wedding. Super comfortable, especially on such a hot day. Got so many compliments! I'm usually always in an LBD so this was an amazing change with the pretty yellow color!
Memorable I wore a size smaller than I usually do and it fit snugly. This dress is classy and easy to wear. The beading around the waist is really a nice touch. The color pops in a crowd.

Great dress! Fit in the right places and great for a summer wedding. Great dress and really loved the subtle high/low. The one thing that was a little different is that in pics it looks like it really comes in at the waist but it actually comes in a little higher- more empire waist. Great for dancing (and eating)!
Amazing. Seriously. I got so many compliments on this. I want to own it. Was lovely, fit well, flowed. Just perfect.
Elegant and comfortable for summer Very Elegant and perfect for a summer event. The fabric was light and flowing.

best dress I've ever rented! I rented this dress for my nephew's high school graduation. I've rented 10+ dresses from RTR and this has been my favorite! it fit like a glove, the length was PERFECT for my tall frame, the color was beautiful, the fabric was breezy (which was fantastic for Texas in June) and I felt beautiful! The beading was right at my waist & was a wonderful detail. I paired it with nude wedges & gold drop earrings. I would recommend this dress for women 5'8" or taller. I'm 6ft and it still went past my knees, so I imagine it would make short women look shorter

GREAT DRESS FOR SUMMER DAYTIME PARTY! wore this to my son's 1st bday party. fit great, like others have said the neck is a bit tight but i'm petite so wasn't a problem. I'm 5 feet tall about 115 lbs, it kept my post partum belly and slight saddle bags hidden which was nice. FOR SHORT PEOPLE: it is quite long i wore white sandals < 1 inch tall and it almost hit the ground. (see picture). I'm 32D and the boob section was a little loose. if bigger boobs would have fit great. overall great and fun dress, got alot of compliments, would rent again.
Beautiful and feminine, perfect for a summer daytime wedding! The dress ran true to size and was very comfortable.
It was really pretty but I needed a 2 very flowy, nice colors, I really like this dress and plan to rent it in the size down
Lovely Really enjoyed this dress. Gave a nice splash of color (I usually wear black) but it was an Easter party and it was perfect!

ABSOLUTELY BEAUTIFUL I was so concerned about the size 12 not being available and settled on the 14.  It fit PERFECTLY.  I am busty and was a little worried, but it was as if the dress was made for me.  This is a PERFECT DRESS for a summer wedding.  It's beautiful!   My husband and Daughter LOVED it and I'm thinking about purchasing it.
Beautiful airy fabric and great fit to accentuate the waist. Perfect for summer weddings! No cons, I loved the dress!
beautiful and comfortable This was a back up, and I didn't end up wearing it, but I wish I had a reason to wear it! I was beautiful and fit perfectly!

Nice dress for brunch but pretty average for an event Runs big, needs a non-standard bra. The 2R was baggy and I was on hyper nip alert the whole time, so make sure you have the right bra for the halter neck. Color is lovely - nice detail around the waist. I was able to wear it to a post wedding brunch, but wouldn't have opted for this for anything fancier than that.

Summer-Spring Dress with Perfect Flow! I received this dress as a last-minute replacement because the original dress (Tracy Reese yellow dress) I ordered was unavailable to be shipped in time. I wore this for my engagement photos and specifically wanted something yellow to be reminiscent of LaLa Land/Emma Stone - this dress totally fit the bill! Lots of flow that photographed well and a modest top that was made interesting/unique because it cuts in a bit at the collarbone and is "pleated." The attached rhinestone belt is understated and adds just enough pizzazz to make this a great wedding guest dress. When I tried it on at home before the photoshoot, my fiance said it was one of HIS favorite rentals (and I've rented, like, 10+ dresses from RTR). My biggest concern was that the high-low hem would be too long on my 5'3" frame, but it didn't look weird at all; also, the only available size to send me was a 0R, and I'm usually a 2 in dresses... the 0 fit GREAT! I have a smaller bust (32C) and tiny waist though, so perhaps its more true to size for larger busts. Fits great on large hips because of flow!

Perfect for walking around outdoors - the fabric flutters beautifully in the breeze! The fabric is more elegant that I expected so the dress is more formal that I would normally wear for work. I work outside showing condos and the color in the sunlight was incredible. Perfect fit also, especially for someone with a small waist and large bust.
This was great for an outdoor wedding in july! I loved how unique the color of this dress was. It fit perfectly and was so flowy and fun to dance in. I also love that it was a high low dress.
Great! Really pretty detailing.  the belt is beaded.  wore with a racerback bra.  Length was good flowy and pretty.

Soft and beautiful!   I wore this dress for my nephew's baptism.  The fabric on the inside of the dress was so comfortable and soft.  It was very flattering and bright.  It fit true to size and I was very happy with it.  This was actually a back up dress that I ordered when my other dress was not available at the last minute.  So happy!

Bright, lovely and comfortable! I really loved wearing this dress.  It was very flattering and comfortable too.  I am tall (5'10"), which I think worked better for this dress since it hits mid-calf on me.  I got lots of compliments and ended up referring a few people to RTR.
Perfect for a summer wedding! I wore this dress to a black tie optional wedding in NYC and it was perfect! Fits true to size and very comfortable. I would definitely recommend it!

Looks great and very comfortable; was a little loose (i.e., not tight) Unfortunately this dress had smells of BO in the underarm area. Additionally there was a rip at the bottom of the zipper however it was not noticeable.

I'm in LOVE!  This dress is absolutely STUNNING!  I received so many compliments! The dress runs a tad big.  I ordered a 2R and a 4R - a 0R would have been perfect but I wasn't going to be around to have another size sent to me overnight.  The 2R was fine it was a just a little loose in the tummy area.  Other than that, the dress is absolutely stunning!  It was perfect for my curvy figure and the perfect length considering I'm 5'1".  This dress paired perfectly with a great pair black strappy high heels and doesn't need much jewelry.  The details and embroidery on the dress were just beautiful - this truly is a show-stopping dress!  I would definitely recommend this dress for a formal black tie event!

Fitted, flattering, comfortable Gorgeous dress, excellent quality. This dress stood out in a room with 5 other ladies wearing RTR dresses. The rose embroidery demands attention, while the neckline keeps the dress classy.

Nicely fitted, just a bit of stretch, even with my size 2 bust and size 6 hips, I was able to fit into the 4R and it looked perfect from head to toe. It felt a bit snug in the hips, but not too bad. I was soon dancing away and didn't feel restricted by the mermaid cut. Big busted ladies should probably size up.

The regular length was a bit short, but I like short heels so it worked. I'm 5'6, and I wore 1" heels and it was perfect.

Compliments all night long! I wore this dress for my senior prom. I choose it because it was everything I'd dreamt of for a prom dress, and it delivered. It fit perfectly, and the details were all beautiful. It was surprisingly comfortable too, I never wanted to take it off! SO many people complimented me and this dress all through prom night and even in conversations after regarding who was best dressed at prom. I definitely recommend this dress!!

I loved this dress when I saw it, It fit perfectly and was very classy for the black tie!   Pros- Very classy and sexy, not to heavy
Cons- It was tight around my arms , and the bottom kept catching on my heels

Gorgeous dress I ordered the 10 and 12 but ended up wearing the 12. The 10 fit but because I have a booty and wide back it was snug. The 12 fit well and everyone complimented it all night. Wore high heels to keep it off the ground.

This dress is a stunner! It's the right amount of conservative & sexy. I wore the 4L dress for a 10 year anniversary banquet. My backup was a 4R however, considering I am 5'9", the 4L fit just right. I decided to wear black pointed flats with this dress as when I tried on 3-4 inch heels they peaked out at the bottom of the dress and I did not want shoes to show at all. The dress is light weight and easy to move in. I recieved so many compliments! I have been renting dresses with RTR since my high school homecoming dance and prom in 2012 and wouldn't go anywhere else for my dresses!

The dress flattered my hourglass shape. The material was gorgeous! I'm a 34DDD and the top was super snug. It's not a very giving fabric so I chose to wear the larger of the 2 sizes I reserved. Very comfortable everywhere else but snug around the bust all around.

Perfect for a black tie event! This dress is a stunner. I wore it to a black tie wedding where I didn't know many people, and I was stopped by numerous guests (and the photographer!) to compliment the dress. I don't have a perfect figure, but this dress did a wonderful job of playing up my assets while disguising my flaws. I was a bit worried that I wouldn't be able to move in it with the "fit and flare" style, but it was comfortable enough to dance in all night. The Regular length was perfect with 3" heels -- I was worried about getting my heels tangled in the tulle, but that wasn't an issue at all. I'm usually a size 8 in dresses -- occasionally a size 6 in designers that are cut large, and occasionally a size 10 in some high end dresses -- the 10R fit me like a glove.

This dress photographed so well! I received a ton of compliments!  I'm usually a size 4, so I ended up ordering a size 4L and 2R. Surprisingly  the 2R fit perfectly! I didn't have to force myself in the dress. The top was not scratchy at all. I wore this dress from 5pm to midnight. The only minor thing was I am small chested you could see a little bit of my bra in the back. This dress was one of a kind, received soooo many compliments the entire nights!

Beautifully elegant!  Rented this dress for a black tie wedding in DC and it was perfect!  It was elegant, had a rich color without being flashy, and  fit like a glove for my athletic, larger chested body type. I am 5'2" so I had to wear 5" heels in the 2R, but had no other issues. I received so many compliments on this dress. It was truly beautiful and made me feel beautiful in it.  I am already dreading sending it back. I would definitely recommend renting this dress!
Got so many compliments that's my Facebook page almost erupted! Loved it. Ran true to size, very flattering on curvy girls like me, fabric was great, just a beautiful dress.

Unforgettable! This gown is perfection! I fell  so in love with it, I wish I didn't have to  return it! The fit so figure flattering and the gold detail is stunning. Got endless compliments all night. It was even comfortable to dance in which was a huge plus!
fit like a glove, should have rented the long ( i wore 3 inch heels and i'm 5'4) not the easiest to walk in, just have to pick it up

This dress is wonderful! Well made and intricately designed, it made my NYE that much sweeter! Pros:
What else can I say. The dress looks just as gorgeous as it does on Rent the Runway. It’s very well made, and the patterns are intricate and beautiful.
