It even has a little bit of beading as well, which you can’t really see from the photos there. It was very comfortable to wear the whole night, and feel like it does have a little bit of stretch to it. Not a lot, but enough when you sit down, move around, etc. If you want to stand out from the rest of the crowd, this is the dress for you. :)

Cons:
Not sure if “cons” is the appropriate term here, it’s more like “things to be aware of.” With that said, I am 5'4" and this dress was a tiny bit too long. Some other issues are that it's a little bit long, and I had to wear 4" heels with this one. The collar of it was also a little bit itchy due to the gold stitching. This was only a minor irritation though, and if I didn’t think about the itchiness, it did not bother me. B/C I wasn’t aware of this, my collar bone was a little bit red for a couple of days. This is definitely not a deal breaker though, just something to note when you wear this dress.

Final Thoughts:
Despite the concerns I have with this dress, I was extremely happy with my rental. It was exactly what I needed to ring in the New Year! It's pros definitely outweigh any other issues I had with the dress.

This was rented for my Daughters 23rd Birthday Unfortunately, the pictures uploaded could not show the joy she had wearing this 'for fun' on her day because it was received 'after' her birthday, so it just shows the 'try on fit'.
I will just write what the pictures shows, 
May Daughter loved the dress. She loved the material as well as the detailing of the dress.
It fitted her well. She's a bit more 'hippy and top heavy' then I, so we had to go up (i think) in size to a 6R.
Over all, the dress was great (to her). (see photos)

Until my next review,
Stay under His wing and He will forever protect you.

This dress was stunning, I loved it! I wore it to my prom and received so many compliments.  There were no problems with the dress! It was absolutely perfect! Renting is such a great idea. Especially for a one time event like prom. You get such a bomb great quality dress for an affordable price and end up not spending nearly as much if you were to actually buy a dress. Unless you know your specific fit details, I recommend that you go to the store and try the dress on to ensure that you choose the right size and therefore receive the perfect fit. I was a 2L in this dress an a 4 in another dress.

This dress was absolutely beautiful and comfortable.   I usually wear a 4 but always size up in formals.  This dress was no exception. In my About me I'm 128lbs but with holidays was more 134lbs if that helps.   I wore the 6L and because it was Mardi Gras, wore wedge sneakers.  If I had worn my regular 3-4 inch heels, I think it would have run short.  For this party, it was perfect.  This was my replacement dress for a size that they didn't have on my original order.  I'm so glad they sent it because my first choice was so boring!

Stunning dress! This dress was absolutely amazing.  The fit was perfect and flattering, but somehow super comfortable.  I could bend to sit and danced all night despite the mermaid style cut.  As many other reviewers have mentioned, the gold embellishments are way better in person than they are in pictures.  I received tons of compliments, and I think it really stood out at a ball full of thousands of women in formal gowns.  My husband absolute loved it.

Nice dress, lots of compliments, odd fitting The dress is very pretty, but runs small.  I always wear a 4 (other than DVF which runs small and I wear a 6).  The 4 felt too tight so I wore the 6.  Both were short (I am 5'6 and wore my normal 4 inch heels - the whole shoe showed, so I would recommend getting a long).  Also, I had to continuously adjust the top of the dress to prevent my bra from showing through the mesh (I had a normal black strapless bra on, it seems like any bra would show in this situation).  I received a ton of compliments, and was happy with it overall, but I have found other dresses to be more forgiving and flattering.

Great dress. Fits well and looks stunning. Felt like a million bucks Loved the dress. I wore it to my senior prom. The material is just a little stretchy so it fits and and conforms to your waist line. You can definitely feel and see the quality of the dress. Made me wish I rented all of my formal dresses in the past rather than buying. if you are 5'9" or taller definitely go for the long version .

If I could but this dress I'd wear it every other day I recently lost weight so I didn't know what size would fit. I got an 8 & 10. Both fit but the 10 was more comfortable.  I felt so so wonderful & beautiful in this dress. People were complementing me on the dress, even a week after the event people remembered my dress.  I am short but with platform heels the dress did not drag.  I even did the Katniss Everdeen twirl in the dress.
This dress is a show stopper!!
I wore this dress to a scholarship gala I worked. I received many compliments.  Great fit, mermaid style dress. I received compliments all night.

Cinderella moment I wore this beautiful dress to a charity event and received compliments all night, including from women -- and men --  I didn't know.  (Many opportunities to sing Rent the Runway's praises.) One thing that's maybe not apparent from the photos is that the tulle at the bottom really moves when you dance (see 2nd photo) - which is fun! I'm 5'6.5" and wore 2 inch heels, which was perfect for the regular length.  I also wore a regular bra (w/ plastic see-through straps).

Loved the dress! Got tons of compliments all night.  Fit like a glove. I was able to wear flats with the 2R and I'm 5'4. I didn't wear a bra with it, because the top is fairly low cut and my bra kept peaking through (especially if I lifted up my arms).

This dress was perfect for a black tie work event.  The fit was accurate for a 6. I'm 5'8" and got the long size so I could wear heels. It was a really impressive look and was easy to dance in. Definitely put me on the best-dressed list.

Gorgeous dress for a black tie affair I wore the 6L to a New Year's Eve black tie party.  I ordered the 8R as my backup size and it was too short and had too much material in the stomach.  The dress is stunning and pretty comfortable.

I seriously felt like a a superstar in this dress!   

Okay, so I absolutely LOVE this dress and I felt beautiful in it! I ordered a size 6L and 8R. Both sizes fit great, but I ended up wearing the 6L because I liked that it hugged my curves a little more. I wore this dress to cover the red carpet for an award show. I also attended the award show. I received compliments the entire night, which made it even harder to return the dress the following day.

If you want to light up the room, then get this dress! I definitely recommend it. 
By the way, I'm 5'8", 140lbs, and have a slim build but I'm hippy :)

Gatsby themed black tie wedding. I got several comments that I had the best dress of the night! This was not the dress or earrings that I reserved, so I was EXTREMELY disappointed when I got the notifications within 5 minutes of receiving my shipment notification and was very worried that the outfit would be outside of the Gatsby theme.  But, when I received the dress, I couldn't get over how beautiful it was, and that it fit like a glove.  JUST RIGHT in every way.  It was slightly shorter than some might like, but I have a tendency to be clumsy, so I was glad I didn't have to worry about tripping - plus my shoes were too cute to hide.  Several people commented that it was VERY true to the Gatsby theme and one person said my dress would rival the bride's.  (Not to worry, hers was stunning).  My husband was disappointed that I had to send it back and would like to see me wear it again.

I felt beautiful in this dress! First RTR experience! This dress is beautifully made, the pictures don't do it justice. There are 2 layers of lining nude/ black and a tulle overlay with pale gold embroidery. The bottom of the dress has no lining, just the embroidery tulle with tiered black tulle with the sheerness riding high when sitting but someone would have to pay close attention to notice . The dress overall is lightweight and was perfect for a formal night out in Miami. The dress hugged my curves perfectly without being tight and was surprisingly comfortable all night. I wore 4 inch heels and the length was perfect for my 5'9" height with my heels visible only when walking, the tulle caught on my heels a few times and may have been problematic if I had danced much. The chest area fit me perfectly without a bra but anyone larger than a C cup may find the chest too tight. I generally wear a 10 top in expensive clothing and an 8 bottom. The dress is semi fitted from hip to mid thigh but not constricting when walking. I highly recommend! Elegant and classy!
This dress turned heads all night. I felt like a queen wearing this dress! Beautiful gown. Incredible detailing. Comfortable. Luxurious.
I loved this dress for my 25th Birthday Photo Shoot. Very elegant! The dress fit. I have a small waist the dress was a little loose. But I love this dress!!!

Ridiculously amazing dress! This is my first RTR experience.  This dress was so amazing!  I couldn't even make it to the event from the garage because so many people on the street were stopping me to tell me how much they loved my dress!  I'm not even exaggerating.  My husband and I were cracking up b/c I just kept saying "thank you!' again and again until we got to the party!  The dress looks like a million bucks in person - it really does.  None of the pictures do it justice.  I loved it. The dress was a giant hit and I felt so happy and great about it.   I maybe could have gone down a size b/c I did feel like the dress had been worn a bunch and therefore stretched, but at least it was comfortable.  I ordered both the long and regular and definitely needed long.  I noticed many many other RTR dresses at this formal affair and someone even had on the back-up dress that I decided not to wear (whew!).  I strongly suggest/beg that RTR track which cities or even to which events their dresses are rented.  RTR is becoming too popular!

I got so many compliments on this dress all night long! Absolutely recommend. I'm 5'3" and size 0R just skimmed the floor when I wore 4" heels. I went without a bra and was not worried about mishaps at all. I danced all night and didn't have to worry about readjusting a single time. I read other reviews about chaffing on the arms, which did happen for a bit, but it was not bad enough to where I thought about it all night. This dress was absolutely gorgeous!!

Perfect for a Gatsby themed wedding! I wore this dress to a Gatsby themed wedding and got so many compliments! I was one of the only girls there with a floor-length dress, but it was so comfortable and easy to move in, I had no regrets :) I would say it runs true to size. I'm 5'4" and wore 3.5" heels, and the regular length was perfect!

Gorgeous and Sophisticated I wore this to a winter formal for my local bar association.  This dress is a stunner.  The fit was fabulous and I received so many compliments.  Overall the length is a little short (I wore flats - I'm 5'6") so if you want to rock a serious heel and are over about 5'3" look for the long length.

I wore this for a company Christmas/Anniversary Ball, and felt like a goddess. I am about 34-25-36, and have the gift/curse of being fairly athletic (small waist, strong limbs/decent shoulders) so dresses sometimes give me problems in the shoulder/arm hole area when they fit everywhere else. I didn't have a problem here- the dress fit perfectly through the hips and bust, and left my arms perfectly free. There was a tiny bit of material that could have been taken in around the waist/lower back area, but not very noticable- and I'm picky. It doesn't have a lot of stretch, but it's not meant to, and I was able to sit with just a little arranging, and even dance later on without too many problems. Not only did I receive numerous compliments from other coworkers and guests, but some of the bartenders who served us all night informed me that I won their internal best dress debate! 
I wore it with my hair in a half-done ponytail a bit like the model (mostly because the guys were rushing me and I ran out of hair time) and some simple black strappy heels. Important note on shoes- I was grateful for the solid style heel cup at the back (not sure what this is called!)  so that I was not stepping on taffeta all night.
Really a stunner though, constant compliments and the perfect choice for our fairly-formal ball.

Beautiful, stand-out dress!  I didn't add a photo because the pictures I got in it were really bad. But the dress was awesome! I am EXTREMELY large chested and was so worried I wouldn't get this closed. I am 5'2 and about 165 pounds and wore the 12R. The 10 was so far from fitting me I thought there'd be no way the 12 would fit, but with me and a couple teammates, we got it zipped and it actually looked really good! The dress is SO comfortable. You can't tell in the picture but there is a very classy gold sequined detailing right along the bottom before it turns to tulle. It is gorgeous. I got so many compliments on this dress, I just want to find another excuse to wear it. Like others have noted, you can't really wear heels, I'm 5'2 and wore flip-flops and the length was perfect. So if you're planning to wear heels, get the Long size. Highly recommend this dress for anyone curvy or slim, it is so beautiful and so comfortable!
Stunning, black tie event dress Wore this for a black tie wedding - favorite RTR rental by far. Received so many compliments from strangers! Gorgeous details, would own if I had the option!
I received an award that day but the dress was the real winner! I love it.  The details in the dress were the details. It is even more beautiful in person!
Everyone loved the dress  The 8R was s little short with my 3" heels and I'm 5"1.

The event was great, the dress fit like a glove. The dress was gorgeous and fit like a glove.  Received many compliments throughout the night from people that I didn't even know.  I did have an issue with my dress being delivered, for the second year in a row, RTR managed to put someone else's address on my package and I had to go pick it up at the UPS facility.

This dress is a showstopper. I felt like a movie star in it and it fit me like a glove.  I am pretty short too but the Regular length with heels worked perfectly.  The dress was easy to zip up and was very comfortable to wear.

I received countless compliments from other who attended the gala to which I wore this gown. Overall, the dress fit well except around my chest/rib cage. If you are a smaller person with broad shoulders and a larger chest, the dress is very tight around your chest/rib cage. Because of the tightness around my chest and rib cage, the dress dug into my skin around and underneath my arms leaving red marks where the fabric sat on my skin.  If you have a larger chest/rib cage, you will need some type of minimizer bra to make the dress work. Despite the challenges, the dress was worth wearing because it is a total standout!

My husband said this dress was his favorite of any dress I've ever worn. I  was a little worried because I am curvy in the hips and my backup (bigger) size was not available. This dress fit great and just as described.

This dress was everything! It came exactly on time and I received quite a few compliments! 💃🏿 My 2R fit perfectly with heels. It wasn't as form fitting as I'd imagined it would be but still looked really, really good. I wore this to a formal gala and felt quite elegant.
felt like a million bucks! not the easiest to walk around in but very easy to get on and off.

This dress was comfortable and I felt great in it all night. Highly recommend! I ordered the 8tall and 10tall. They fit the same but the 10tall was longer and felt more comfortable. Recommend this for girls over 5'10.

Received Compliments all Night This dress fit perfectly. I ordered both the 2 and 4 just in case. I usually wear a 2 and it fit great. I have 32DD-DDD size breasts and it wasn't too tight. I think the breast area is made well to accommodate different breast sizes. I have a small torso but large hips. The hourglass shape of the dress was perfect. About half way through the night I did start to feel a little scratchy around my left shoulder blade area, but it was really no big deal. With the size 2 the length was perfect with some 4 inch heals for me. However, I did notice that when I tried on the 4 it was shorter than the 2. They were both marked 'regular'.

Stunning AND comfortable! I always get a ton of compliments when I wear a RTR dress, and this was no exception.  I wore this for a 1920s themed gala, and it was a hit.  It was also very very comfortable.

I tried on a 4 and a 6, and, to be honest, they didn't feel any different through the stomach and hips.  There was a slight size difference in the shoulders and bust, though.

I wish I had taken a good photo in this dress :-(
perfect  All I can say is loved it as well as everyone else.

Besides being an amazing wedding 
I felt  fabulous in this dress. I received compliments galore I wear normally a size 8 if the dress has a stretch in the fabric , As I am a 34 DD chest 

I tried on the 10r it fit just fine but I wanted a bit more movement , so that is why I went with the 12R
the length , fit and cut was great . I wish I could wear it again . But this is a dress that everyone is going to remember

Everything was packed so nicely.  I felt like a princess.  I got so many compliments.  Great dress. I am 5'6 without heels, and I wore 5 inch heels, so the dress was maybe slighty short but good enough for me.  If you are taller, keep this in mind.

I loved this dress and received many compliments. It is fitted and great detail, but classic.  It was very difficult and tight to get over my wide hips, so had to go with a 12 (I'm usually a 10) but felt like a million bucks in it. Received compliments, photographed well, and the bride told me a month later that people had commented on it being a nice dress - they didn't know me (or my name).

Stunning Dress for Gatsby theme This dress fits like a dream. I am a pear shaped 150lbs 5'7" and was worried about this hugging my oddly shaped hips. Can't even tell. The dress material is thick enough to smooth out any imperfections. No need for spanx. I wore a 8L but had to choose flats. I wished it was longer. Still beautiful, flattering and classy. returning was so hard :( 
For the Gatsby theme, wore with a bridal pearl headpiece and thin, short pearl necklace.

Red Carpet Godess Dress Holy Golden Mermaid, Batman!!
I loved this dress! Ladies, if you have a booty... get this dress. :-) It will show it off quite nicely. 
I wore this hair up and minimal jewlery, I just let the dress shine.  I can't tell you how many compliments I got on this dress. (I even had some people ask me who my stylist was.. haha!) 
And the best part? The dress is surprisingly comfortable! I wore it all night and STILL didn't want to take it off at the end of the evening.  
I wore 3 1/2 inch heels, and it was the perfect length.

What made that occasion unforgettable was getting endless complements on the dress. It was unique! Now I got his dress for a prom I went to with a friend. And it was honestly even prettier in person. I am a short girl, 5'2 and just over 100 pounds. It was wonderful, the dress was unique and classy. Now, I rented 2 of the same dress. I didn't think I would need a back up. But it was free, so I thought why not get one. THANK GOSH I DID. The size I thought I was ended up being too big. And the back up ended up being the one I wore. Now, if you want to dance and move around in this dress it may be difficult, especially if you are wearing heels. It has this trim on the bottom that can get easily caught. So make sure you find heels that match your height and the dress. My bust size is a solid b. No matter what size, I recommend wearing one of those "no backing" bras. I highly recommend getting this dress no matter your size,  and I will definitely rent another dress from this website.

Elegant and different The event required either a black or a white gown.  I get tired of wearing black all the time.  This dress was so different from everyone else's.  I got many compliments.  Also, I am very short and somewhat curvy.  The gown made me look and feel taller and thinner.

I am generally a size 6 so I was surprised and pleased to be able to wear the 4.  It was very comfortable to wear.  Like many of the designer gowns, the zipper was a bit of a pain.  The only other issue was that it was difficult to get in and out of our SUV as the gown is very narrow at the knee.  I don't consider this a big issue but if your venue has a lot of stairs, you may have a challenge.  

I would definitely rent this again.

Beautiful dress! Lots of compliments! The only thing was that I ordered a 6L and with heels it was a little shorter than what I like but it worked out anyways! It touched the floor when I was flat footed and with heels I would've like about 2 inches more length but since it kind of tapers in the back it ended up working out.
Black Tie Wedding Awesome dress, photographs beautifully and is very comfortable. Highly recommended!

Ridiculously flattering I LOVE this dress and hated to send it back.  It was extremely flattering on my hourglass/pear figure, showing off my curves without being scandalous.  I normally wear a 4 or 6, but almost wish I had rented the 2 as my backup, as the 4 was slightly large.  I'm fairly short and was able to wear low heels with this dress, which is always a plus as most long gowns require giant heels for me.  I was also able to wear a normal strapless bra, and didn't find that it showed at all through the night.  The dress is so beautifully made, from the multi-tone gold thread embroidery, to the intricate beading at the knee, to the flowy layers at the bottom.  I got lots of compliments. And best of all, the dress was totally comfortable -- no scratching under the arms, no need to constantly pull and tug to readjust.  I wish I owned this dress!
Great dress to work to work. Received lots of compliments on it A little tight in the chest but otherwise a great fit
Great dress for daytime  Loved the fit and comfort. Modest cut but not too frumpy!

Beautiful weather - really comfortable dress! Loved the fit and the quality of the dress.  I have a broad back but this dress in a 4 fit fine - zipped up perfectly.   I have a small bust and I'm a straight and narrow body type.  Not sure for straight and narrow body type/small bust how flattering this dress was given the stripes as it didn't appear to emphasize small waist and larger bust.  Given my body type I'm not sure I would wear this style again but overall the dress was beautiful and I LOVED the color.    Will rent Kate Spade again!

Bridal shower perfection  Went to my cousins bridal shower in this Kate spade w matching necklace. Everyone loved it! I am between
A 4 and a 6 and the 4 was a tad tight but still fit well. This dress is true to size. Wore w grey d'orsay pumps. Lovely for Easter weekend!
Beautifully fitting and flattering dress! I had to wear the larger size, the smaller one had a ripped zipper, but it still fit fantastically and was comfortable all day long!

Perfect for a daytime vineyard wedding. This is definitely fit and flare.  The 8 fit just right at the top, but ended up wearing the 10 so I could have a bit more breathing room.  I loved the pockets!!!  Comfortable for sitting, dancing, and mingling all night. The material is light with no lining, so it wasn't too hot to be outside for the entire event.

Fun dress!!! I wore the 6. My D cups would not fit in the 4 so I had to size up.   Even sizing up though it was still a bit tight in the chest. Loved the pockets. I had so much fun and felt so pretty in this dress.

Rented this dress for a springtime baby shower I loved this dress and my husband asked a few times if I could call RTR and just buy it. :-) 
I wore it to a friend's baby shower and received compliments all day. When I stepped out of the car, a couple of fellows said 'you look just like a picture.' The fit was absolutely perfect. Very feminine and classy, but still fun. I kept it simple around the neckline, but the recommended blue stone necklace would have really been great.
So many stripes! This dress is bright and easy to wear. Fit and flare is flattering. Material wrinkles very easily though.

Cute dress, preppy and fun style The zipper on this dress was nearly impossible. Needed help getting it up and was almost positive I wouldn't be able to wear the dress but gave it one last chance and got lucky. It wasn't too tight- I could pull both sides of the dress together easily, so it seems like the zipper is not a great quality. That being said, once it's on the dress is flattering and fun. Skirt was fuller than I expected.

Comfortable and modest dress that still stands out. Plus, great customer service from RTR! I ordered a size 4 and size 2 as a backup; both were too small. RTR was willing to ship a size up to my hotel in another state. It was a wonderful customer service experience. The dress was quite fitted in the waist, but photographed beautifully. I got so many compliments! Like others have said, the zipper was a bit tricky. I think it was too delicate for a thicker fabric. Otherwise, it was perfect. Thanks, Rent the Runway!

Perfect for my bridal shower! Received tons and tons of compliments on how beautiful this dress was! The zipper was pretty tricky on the 8  and the 10, definitely make sure to have someone around to help.

Sweet summery dress  Rented hoping to wear to work and then to support favorite team at afternoon indoor event.  Material is lovely although less polished than I expected.  Sadly, the length was too short for me to feel comfortable and waist was little too high.  It would be lovely on a younger or slighter frame.
Comfortable and has POCKETS! I had to wear the large size (12) because it really does cinch in at the waist.  But it was extremely comfortable and I loved having pockets.

Love this dress, want to own it Loved this dress. Wore it to my birthday dinner with family and then to a sangria tasting event. Love that it has pockets. It was kind of hard to zip by myself but I figured it out eventually. Super flattering. I wish I owned this dress.

Possibly my favorite dress from Rent the Runway so far I wore this for a graduation and a mother's day brunch and I got so many compliments. If you're worried about the horizontal stripes, don't, the A-line will save you. Great for a lot of body types.

Perfect Summer Stripes! This dress is ideal. It is cute and classy yet the colors and style of it make it unique and sexy at the same time. The material is amazing and although it is thick it has stretch and beautifully clean lines. Got this through my Unlimited subscription and I have actually worn it to work (law office) and also to an all girl brunch in Manhattan! Love it!!!

Wore this to an evening  wine tasting event at the Chicago Botanic Garden. It fits true to size but there is a lot of material at the waist area.  I have a 30" waist with 34" hips and the extra fabric was not flattering to my build.  But it is a beautiful dress so if you have narrow hips go for it!
Nothing Side zipper was very tricky, but loved the dress.
Great dress with a flattering cut! This dress felt terrific on and fit well. The fabric is very nice quality and has a bit of structure to it so that it has a crisp sillouette. I loved it!

Loved the fit of the top! I ordered the 12 and 14 and really could have worn either, but between myself and my husband we could not get the zipper past where the seam for the waist and the seam for the pocket met on the 12.  The top had just the right amount of give to support and flatter my chest while the neckline and sleeves kept the dress from looking too formal.  The skirt needed a good ironing, but moved nicely when dancing.  I loved the pockets and would highly recommend this dress!
Could not wear the dress Just a bit snug. If this had come in a 16, I would have been all over it.

Great dress! I wore this to my sister's baby shower. It was perfect in terms of formality. It is flattering and has pockets! My only issues was that the hook and eye at the top of the zipper dug into my underarm which made it uncomfortable eventually.
only that the dress was in great shape. It did not look like it had been  worn before The blues and pockets are quite lovely but it just wasn't anything memorable

Amazing dress - I didn't want to send it back!! This experience has me hooked on RTR! I had rented another dress that didn't work at all and RTR customer service sent me this dress instead. I was a little hesitant since it wasn't something I would normally have gone for but I was blown away! The dress was in great condition. Only worn a handful of times if any -- I certainly couldn't tell. Both the 2 and the 4 fit me. I ended up wearing the 4 to dinner and the 2 to the fundraising event. 
The colors were so vibrant and springy and the fabric was really luxurious. The pockets were a huge plus. This dress is definitely a sleeper... 
I was the best dressed at my event, by far, and got lots of comments about how great I looked! I REALLY DIDN'T want to send this dress back. That's how much I love it. I might even buy it now!
Great dress for a rehearsal dinner The bust was tight in the 12 so I wore the 14.  Very fun dress that photographed nicely.

Feminine and classy I wore this dress for my 30th birthday party. The celebration happened to be on a boat, so the blue stripes had the perfect nautical feel. The skirt was full and had great movement even though the fabric was pretty heavy. It was fun and flirty, while not being too revealing or flashy. The chest of the dress was tight even though I'm not very busty, so I did wear up a size. I was a little worried about the cap sleeves annoying me during the night, but I didn't even notice they were there. Overall, this was one of my favorite rentals.

Love the dress!!! Wore this for my sons baptism. I'm still nursing and am top heavy 36dd. Needed the 8 for the waist but 10 for the top. Loved the dress got lots of complements. Only complaint was the pleats. I had to do a lot of ironing as they were all jacked up, so plan ahead for that.

Cute dress, but too short and tight in the ribs  The flare of the dress and the short length made this unwearable for what I wanted—an everyday dress that I could wear to meetings, etc. It just felt way too young for me.

Made me feel amazing for my closest friend's rehearsal dinner.  Husband asked if I could buy it :) The fit is pretty true to size and I was surprised that the vertical stripes did not make me look or feel larger than I am.  The one issue I did have, which was mentioned by another reviewer, is that the zipper is pretty tricky so I'm glad the size 10 gave me a little room to try and work with it.  Definitely worth the fight with the zipper though and I would absolutely rent it again if not for all the other amazing options I want to try.

Fun dress for the airport! This dress not only looked cute but it was super comfy (especially when you are flying) It ran true to size for me, the zipper was a bit tough but once it was on it was awesome!!!

The rehearsal dinner was dressy but not formal.  This dress was perfect! The top is very form fitting and the skirt is obviously full making it perfect for a pear shaped figure.  I loved the hidden pockets, which I didn't find until late in the evening. The material has stretch which made it comfortable.  The fabric has some body, which makes it crisp and fresh looking, without making it stiff.  I'd rent this again in a minute for the right occasion.

I felt so pretty and feminine in this dress.  The fit was great. It felt very 1950's but modern. If you're 5' 5" or under, this dress is NOT going to hit you at low/mid-thigh like the model, it will hit at your knees. Zipper was a total pain, but I was able to get it to work.

Perfect work day outfit. Dress fits nicely on most figures though bigger busts may struggle. Consistent with previous comments, the zipper is hard to get up and could use a helper as it is at an awkward angle. Dress does wrinkle in transit, and could almost stand a light starch. The wrinkles came out easily with just a steamer ,though it did not look perfectly pressed and crisp as I think it is meant.  Very full skirt (not for windy days!) but cute and flattering fit. Not too short.

This dress is great for a daytime event. Very Classic! This dress is great for a daytime event, very classic. The skirt has a lot of volume but not too much. The cap sleeves are cute and the material is very nice, pretty thick.

Beautiful! Rented this for the brunch after my wedding.  LOVED IT.  Perfect for a brunch, shower, (informal) baptism... the pattern is gorgeous, and it fits like a dream.  It was also a bit conservative on me because the length really hit at the knee (I'm about 5'6").  My measurements were about: 35-27/28-38.

Loved this dress. Very comfortable, flattering and the side pockets are perfect. I wore this dress for a women's conference for work, and received so many compliments. I will definitely rent this dress again.

Perfect for a cruise around Manhattan! I loved this dress and it was perfect for my event. However, I normally wear a size 4 and when I tried the 4 on it was a little too tight up on top so I went with the 6. My favorite part was of course the pockets! It made my night so much easier so I didn't have to carry a purse around. I would recommend this dress to anyone!
Got so many compliments in this dress I wore a size 8. It was pretty tight in the chest but overall I LOVED the dress. I got a ton of compliments on it.

Perfect for an outdoor bridal brunch.  Both the 8 and 10 fit but I ended up going with the 10 so I had extra room in the arms (which are definitely my problem area). Other reviewers were right about the zipper being a struggle; it's not because  the dress is too tight either. Plan to have a buddy when getting ready. 

Fabric is thick without being hot. Well constructed. I received lots of compliments. My boyfriend summed it up perfect by saying, "You could wear that again and I wouldn't be upset." Definitely a winner!

Such a fantastic dress for multiple occasions! I loved loved loved this dress. The fit and print were so flattering and the length was just right. I loved that it had pockets and just a little bit of stretch. I would totally rent this again!

Cute on other people, not on me I picked this dress out as a replacement for the original dress I had picked for my engagement photos, which had gotten damaged.  It looks adorable in the photos and on most of other women in the gallery, but on me it was very unflattering. The combination of the striped and the stiff material made me look a lot bigger than I really am. It's a very cute dress, but I think it works better on slimmer women.

Annoying zipper is worth the trouble!
 Obviously the dress is quite forgiving on the bottom since this is a fit & flair style, however the top tends to be a little tight for a full bust. If I was one cup size smaller I would have worn the next size down. 

The zipper sticks on the center seam which is frustrating, but worth the trouble for all the compliments I received on Derby Day!

This was SO comfortable and the pockets are quite deep. LOVE this dress!  It was super comfy and the colors were great for any event. It is somewhat warm because the fabric is really thick. I wore shorts under it because it comes up a bit in the back when you sit down. The arm openings were a little tight so I had to go up a size. And the zipper is definitely a two person job. But overall LOVE this dress!
The dress was perfect for the entire day. I went from church to brunch to broadway to dinner!  Pockets are amazing. The whole dress is super comfortable.

Great dress for a daytime event!  The fit is true to size and great for a larger bust.  The material is light and comfortable for a warm Spring or Summer  Day. The colors are beautiful. I  wore this to my son's christening and received tons of compliments. I would definitely rent this again!

I rented this dress for a family party. I found this dress to be a little uncomfortable, but it's not the dress - it's me! I have a wide rib cage, so dresses like this (without any stretch that are fitted to the upper part of the waist) are tight on me. Other than that, I got lots of compliments on this dress and felt beautiful wearing it.

perfect for the kentucky derby! i rented this dress for the kentucky derby and it was perfect! the neckline laid a little weird on me but otherwise i was very happy with this dress. the cut is very flattering and the cotton fabric was perfect for the daytime event. i would rent again!

Flattering dress, beautiful colors I wore this dress for my daughter's first birthday party.  The colors are beautiful, the dress is classically flattering, it is comfortable, AND it has pockets!  I gave this dress four stars instead of five because the zipper was impossible to get up (even with my husband's help) on one of the dresses sent to me.  Additionally, the dresses both arrived wrinkled.

Perfect dress for my bridal shower! This dress was gorgeous and comfortable! Perfect for my bridal shower. The ONLY negative was the zipper. I tried on the size 2 first but the zipper was broken and wouldn't zip all the way. The size 4 ended up being a more comfortable fit anyways so it all worked out.

loved it! loved this dress, beautiful color and fit - 
some notes:
the skirt is pretty full and the top part tight, especially if you a larger chest. 
Zipper was in an awkward spot, my husband did have to zip it up.
I did get a lot of compliments when I wore it.
Would rent again

Fun style and super comfortable! Wore this dress for a wedding. The fit was fantastic on this dress. The pleats give volume to the dress and the pockets are a fantastic touch. It is a classic style and was incredibly comfortable to wear all evening. The dark blue fell at the smallest part of my waist which helped make it look even smaller which I think is an overlooked and subtle addition to this dress. I would recommend this dress to anyone who likes the style!
I got a ton of compliments on my dress and people couldn't believe I rented it! The two sizes I received were too small, but the stylist was great and shipped me a size up!

Great experience!
First time renting from RTR and would def do again! Dress was very flattering and ran true to size
Great dress Fit well, looked amazing. No belt needed. Wore this to a party for Easter and to church the next week as well. Super cute, got lots of compliments. Great color.

Born to wear kate spade! I chose this dress as a second option and fortunately my first choice dress did not fit, because I absolutely fell in love with this dress the second I put it on.  At first I was very skeptical about wearing stripes but with some encouragement from my cousin decided to give it a try.  The material is on the heavy side so I would be cautious depending on climate.  Otherwise I would totally recommend this dress.  I received many compliments on the dress from people I had never met.

Perfect dress for a wedding AND my favorite rental to date! The fit was perfect but if I had a slightly larger bust it would have been a bit tight at top. The dress is extremely flattering as it is fit and flare and has pockets (I love dresses with pockets). The material was very comfy too (I wore this to an outdoor Florida wedding in July). I matched the dress with the recommended necklace and blue shoes. I received compliments all night.
I received so many compliments on this dress! Very flattering dress.  I just had a baby and have some extra weight in my midsection, and this dress was awesome hiding it!
The dress was flattering and perfect for a small graduation party. I liked it so much I bought it later!

Bright fabric, fun colors Too tight in bust and waist runs too high for my shape. I wore it, but after I saw photos, wish I had dent. Too tiny and no give, designed for a smaller framed woman. Pretty though.....

Felt fabulous! Like other reviewers said, this runs about 2 sizes big.  I always have problems finding stuf that fits in the bust area (34J), and this dressed worked great!  The material is super thick so it doesn't cling, and showed just the right bit of cleavage.  Definitely recommend this one!

I loved this dress- sassy, sexy, fun! I typically wear a 12 but based on the reviews I ordered an 8 & a 10.  I ended up wearing the 8 and it was perfect.  Nice, heavy material, you can wear a bra if it's low cut with wide straps.  Portrait neckline is so flattering and the color says "look at me"!  I would rent this again!

I wore this dress for my sorority semi. I originally wear a 12/14 but read reviews that said to size I wore this dress for my sorority semi. I originally wear a 12/14 but read reviews that said to size down so I ordered the 8 and 10. I went with the 10 because I felt like the 8 made it shorter than I liked. They both fit great. The dress is made out of thick material so it's warm and soft. I received compliments all night. Definitely size down a size or two!
Tons of compliments I went down 2 sizes and I could have gone down 3. Glad I read the reviews!

Cherry Red Dress was so much fun! Definitely go at least one size down, this dress is very forgiving.    I probably could have gone 2 sizes down and been fine.  It has a thick, spongy material, and it very comfortable.  It's a little better if you've got a bust to fill out the top, but I didn't think it was too much cleavage.  Comfortable, fun, and I would totally wear it again

Loved this dress! Super comfortable and easy to wear.  Lots of room for cleavage without showing too much (great for busty girls).  Perfect at a black-tie-optional wedding.  Does run large--definitely size down.

Loved the Fit!!!! This dress does run large! I normally wear a 12/14 and got the back up as a size 10 due to other reviews stating it ran large. So thankful for the back up! Got soooo many compliments on this and felt amazing!!!

My step-sister got married and I didn't have to be a bridesmaid! This dress definitely runs big! I ordered a 10 and an 8 as back up and ended up wearing the 8; I probably could have gone done another size, as the fabric is a bit stretchy and it's cut quite generously in the bust and straps. It's a lovely material though - it's got nice weight and texture, which really helps the skirt stand out.  I also liked that there was boning at the top of the bust; it helped the dress maintain that great deep v.

This was the perfect, festive outfit for my company's holiday party!  This was a perfect find for my company's holiday party! The color is a standout and the fabric was heavy and felt rich. I also could not get over the neckline, it screamed for a statement necklace to finish it off! 

All of the reviewers are right, this dress runs very large and I'd glad I listened to their recommendations. I wore for the 4 for the extra length but the 2 fit just as well. 

Overall this was a great rental and I was sad to return it. You'll definitely stand out in this bright red and adorable shape!
Red dress with a little cleavage This dress is a nice basic red dress. I found it hard to find a bra to wear underneath that did not show. Perhaps I should have gone a size down.

The dress helped make the night special! Pros: Loved the weight, fit and cut, especially of the neckline. I am also pretty tall and the dress was still the perfect length. I honestly wish that I owned this dress permanently, my boyfriend couldn't keep his eyes off of me!

Con: I usually wear a 4-6 in dresses and could have easily gotten away with a zero in this dress so I'm glad I rented a 2!

Wore to a wedding Loved the fabric, it was a great material and the perfect red! I usually wear a 6 sometimes an 8 and i wore the 2. It was a little small around my arms but fit my waist and bust perfectly. The 4 was too big on my top half.

Everyone loved this dress on me! People commented that this dress ran large and the ended up using the smaller size and that is exactly what happened to me.  I loved the dress it was amazingly comfortable and I received nothing but wonderful comments about how it looked on me.  I cannot wait to rent my next dress!!

Cocktails, lights, dancing, snacks and friends! The fit was flexible, a little looser than I expected. I rented a 16 with a backup 14 and I'm SO glad I did, I would have been swimming in the 16. I considered belting the dress I wore, but ended up wearing as is in the picture (because you know, there was food at this event). I loved the dress, excellent plunge to give you dramatic cleavage, especially if you're full chested like I am. The dress was perfect for dancing!

Wore for Christmas wedding! Super fun and cute. Definitely order a smaller size than usual. I wore two sizes smaller for sure. Fun dress, thick material. I added a belt to add some fun for the holidays!
Comfy and Classy I wore this to a reggae concert and felt fabulous!

Love love love!!! This dress fit me perfectly!!! I loved the length and the color!! It was perfect for the semi-formal event I was attending. It was great material as well... super soft!!! I ordered a 4 and a 2... Because I saw that it ran big.  I am usually a size 6 in dresses. I could have word the size 2... but I wanted a little bit more room in the chest area! Overall... AWESOME dress!

Very flattering and comfortable! The color of this dress is really vibrant. I loved it. The neckline is beautiful - the contoured V shape is pretty and a little sexy without plunging too deep or showing too much cleavage. The A-line skirt is super flattering. The fabric was nice and thick, almost like scuba fabric, so it was comfortable and everything looked nice and smooth. 

Definitely size down! I was nervous about it but after reading reviews I sized down and it was great. I ended up wearing the 4, and usually I wear an 8 (sometimes a 6 depending on designers).

Perfect for a holiday wedding! Wore this dress to a winter wedding (the week before X-Mas); it was perfect! So flattering, loved the stretchy material - made it very comfortable to dance and run around in all night! Warning - it definitely shows cleavage - it was on the cusp of being a bit too much for me, but I received so many compliments! I'm usually a size 16 , but this dress runs very large - so the 14 fit perfect!

I rented this dress for our sorority's spring formal, and got compliments on it all evening. After looking through other reviews, I ordered two sizes - one my usual size, and one a size down. I ended up wearing the smaller dress, and LOVED it. The dress is definitely roomier up top and was a little large for me, but the dress has wire along the neckline that prevents it from falling open or fitting too awkwardly.

Super flattering dress for all body types!  I read all the comments and I can confidently say this dress runs crazy big. The weekend I chose I had the option for my regular size (16) and a size 10. In the picture I am wearing the 10! I was nervous with all the reviews about size that it would be too small as most people got two sizes down but this fit really well. My cleavage looked outstanding (haha), just put some pasties on and the dress held my D cups up all night. The length was appropriate for the event hitting me just above the knee I am 5"10 for height reference; though I learned if I ran up steps it bounced up and all the bridesmaids saw my situation under the dress. It's got some weight to the fabric but it was easy to pack in my bookbag, no wrinkles! I loved this dress and felt really good in it.

Loved this dress! So comfortable and such a fun color! Received so many compliments! Glad I trusted the reviews on this one! I normally wear a size 10 and I ordered the 6 & 8. I ended up wearing the 6, but probably could have worn the 4 had I gotten it as my backup. It's a weird material, but it's stretchy and very comfortable. Would definitely rent this one again!

Flattering and sexy, but runs big I sized down based on previous reviews and am so happy I did.  I'm usually a 10/12 depending on brand, but the 10 was way too big. I wore the 8, but I probably could have even worn a 6! This dress is gorgeous and super flattering.  I got TONS of compliments!
Beautiful! Loved this dress, so flattering.  Runs super large!!! I normally wear a 6, and the 0 fit just right.

Pop of red and the right cut to lay flat given my widish shoulders and small chest
 Fabric has stretch and is thick enough to cover flaws. Was comfortable and easy for dancing.

Cute, fun & comfy cocktail dress! I rented this for a unique situation at a military ball.  Since my husband is deployed, his unit was invited but the ladies were asked to wear cocktail dresses instead of a ball gown.  I wanted something comfortable that I could dance in but not look out of place with all the formals and this was perfect!  No shapewear necessary and bra friendly! It does run very big.  I am normally a 10/12 in most items I rent because I am hourglass shaped but I was a perfect 8 in this- could have gotten away with a 6!  Length was great. Got compliments all night, I would definitely rent again!

Cute dress in a fun color! This dress was flattering but definitely ran large.  I didn't find it to be super low cut like some have mentioned.  I loved the pockets and the color of the dress was perfect for a Miami bachelorette party.

This dress was extremely comfortable and flattering! I felt very confident and beautiful This dress definitely runs large, but I don't know any woman who isn't thrilled to size down. It laid beautifully and the color is stunning. My only complaints were the dress straps which kept slipping along my shoulders (I just used fashion tape to keep them in place) and the way the fabric folds under the neckline was slightly visible from the outside. So easy to accessorize as well. One of the few outfits that I didn't have to buy anything new for which was a major plus. A sparkly statement necklace, black heels, purse and wrap were all it took to feel completely put together. I would definitely rent again and highly encourage anyone with a large chest and an apple body shape to rent it! A real showstopper for women with real bodies!

This dress was so flattering and made me feel so beautiful. The fit was great, very flattering. Pro - Beautiful Dress. Con - The dress I tried on in store had pockets, but the one I wore didn't which I thought was odd.  Make sure you wear a push up bra it makes a huge difference!

Very Cute, Very Red - Totally runs big! I normally wear a 14-16, but ended up wearing a 12. Could have fit into a 10 if I wanted. Believe the reviews!
- That being said, the fabric is really stretchy so it is super comfortable. 
- Didn't need to wear a bra because the dress was very supportive, but if you really want to wear a bra everything is in the right place for that. 
- Very poofy and kind of short. I'm 5'3" and it was just the right length for me, so just consider that when looking at the dress.
- Got it on time! Great experience!

10/10 would recommend!

LOVELY DRESS this dress was FREE dress from my original order and I most say im glad I got this dress.
normally I wear size 12 and before getting this dress i read the review and it said it runs big and they truly do. i ended up wearing a size 8.

Felt like the lady in the red dress with legs up to there This dress runs very large. I am usually a 14 and wore the 10 and still had to adjust the bust every so often just in case. The material is very thick, so you don't have to worry about it lying on any unflattering lines your body has.

Comfortable and fun dress!  This was a fun RTR for me! The color makes you stand out and the fit and fabric is very comfortable for all-evening wear. Based on other reviews, I did size down one for my back-up rental, but definitely could have worn a size 2. It was loose in the waist and bust. I had to use fashion tape in order for the straps to stay put. But other than that, a sassy but classy look that I'm glad I went with! Got lots of compliments and felt fabulous dancing in it!

Love this dress!!! It was perfect for NYE!! I looked and felt hot! Runs really large, I normally wear a 6, got a 4 as a backup and wore it. I probably should have worn a 2 but a 4 was fine. It is lower cut than I was imagining but I was fine with that. Would definately rent again.

Didn't wear dress. This dress is beautifully made but there is a lot of fabric, so it swallowed me and made me look larger than I am. The front also seemed loose so I didn't wear the dress because I was scared my chest would pop out.

Gorgeous dress. It has a classic look that is extremely flattering.  Dress runs large. I am usually a four or a six, and I was swimming in the four. The 2 fit perfectly. It really is as beautiful as the photos. I would love to rent this again, sometime. You will feel like a movie star!

This dress made me feel and look wonderful.  This dress ran a little small, so my back up size fit just perfect. I'm 5'2" and it wasn't too short where I was afraid of bending over or dancing the night away. Overall, I loved this dress and I would totally rent it again!

It was a beautiful wedding I'm usually a size 12 but I read the reviews about it running large and ordered a size 8 and size 6 as a backup.  The size 8 was great but since I have a smaller chest I opted for the size 6 and that fit perfectly.  The size 6 had some discoloration/stain around one of the armpits but you could hardly tell when my arm was down.

Flattering fit! Perfect for the holidays I wore this to my company holiday party! The dress was stunning. It fit great and was very forgiving. The cut of the chest area was lower than I expected, but I made it work! I received a lot of compliments on it. One note... the material is very heavy... it was great for winter!

Fun and flirty,  so many compliments The dress ran a bit big around the waist. I would have liked it to be tighter but still very comfortable. I was able to wear a bra and the length was perfect. I was concerned about it being too short but it was perfect
Great Winter Dress. Loved it! It was beautiful and sliming but it was so heavy. It was okay for a winter event but I wouldn't recommend for a summer event.

Perfect for Valentine's Day! I rented this for work several weeks ago for Valentine's Day weekend.  The cut was absolutely perfect! Loads of compliments throughout the day and night from my customers.  Paired with pearls, it was a classic look.
Dress is very forgiving and fit well.   The dress runs big so even the smaller size I ordered was a little big for me.  The fabric is thick so this would be a good dress for a fall or winter event.

Most comfortable formal dress.  I normally wear a 16. I listened the reviews and sized down. The 14 fit great and was not tight at all. I love the fit with the higher waist and that you can wear a regular bra with this dress. I wore this for a summer wedding, with the right accessories I think it was the perfect choice. I had many compliments.

What a flattering dress! The color is a true red and the material is wonderful.  Thank you  RTR! This dress made me feel beautiful. I received countless compliments on New Year's ,especially from my husband.

Nice dress but runs way big! This was my backup dress so I probably did not read as many reviews as I should have. This dress runs extremely big!! I wear a size 16 in jeans so I ordered a size 16 in the dress and as recommend went one size down for my second. I only tried on, and wore, the 14 but even that was too big for me. It was wearable but had to use double sided tape to make sure no one could see down my dress. It was also larger than I would have liked in the waist. If you get this dress order it one and two sizes down! With that being said I liked the weight of the fabric as well as the style. Would possibly order it again but only in a smaller size.

Most comfortable dress ever! Runs a bit large. Very flattering! Very nice material! The dress runs large. Very comfortable. Flares out from the waste down which is great if your trying to conceal some problem areas :) No need to wear tummy controls either.

Better for a fall or winter event The dress runs rather large, so I could recommend going down at least a size (even if you are larger on top) or two (if you are smaller up top). The cut is very attractive, but the bottom flares out much more than in the photo so I didn't like it- maybe that's because I have a shorter torso than the model in the photo. It's also a pretty heavy dress and pretty thick. The pleating also doesn't seem to be done too well, because if you look on the inside of the skirt, only the middle sections of the fabric have been sewn together while the ends just flap about (not anything to worry about, but it bothered me).
Perfect red dress!  It's stretchy which nice and comfortable. It was a little big on my shoulders other than that I loved this dress!

Great dress-runs large, definitely get a size or even 2 less than usual! Dress runs larger than I would have liked, but still looked great. The material was thick and so it didn't wrinkle and was very comfortable to wear. Great because you can wear a normal bra with it.

Dancing with my husband when they played our song from our wedding! Trust the other reviews, it runs big! I sized WAY down and could have still used the size smaller. Despite that it still fit great (I just know one more size down would have been perfect). Great for dancing and big busts! I wear a 36D/E and was able to go comfortably without a bra. I'm short (5') and as you can see in the picture it hit at a great spot on my leg for a summer wedding. Loved this dress, was sad to send it back!

Stylist Review I felt amazing in this Slate & Willow dress! I rented for my college graduation and could not have been happier.  This dress is flattering for all shapes and sizes and will make anyone feel fabulous!  This dress runs a bit large so we recommend sizing down for a backup.  The fabric is thick and quite stretchy which is great for those looking for a great fit in the bust, waist, or hips! The dress can be worn with a standard bra and the sweetheart neck is flattering for all bust sizes.  At 5'4" this style hit at mid thigh on me.  This dress could be worn to many occasions including cocktail parties, weddings, and special occasions! We recommend pairing this dress with a great pair of statement earrings and a black heel!

Loved the color and neckline, not crazy about silhouette.  Loved the material and neck line of this dress. I'm pretty busty, so this top gave me enough coverage without looking matronly.  The Bottom was alot fuller than I anticipated. Although I recived alot of compliments on this dress, I didn't love the way it looked on me. I have a short torso with a large bust so I feel that it made me look "rounder".
beautiful dress but ran too large ran too large and now without a dress!

Color, Comfort, & Compliments I normally wear a 16-18 depending on the fit of items but I thankfully listened to the reviews and sized waaaay down for this rental and the 12 was PERFECT!

Pros: Comfort, hiding fabric, perfect length*, neckline showed cleavage but not too much and I could wear a normal bra and underwear with this, hallelujah!

Cons: For me I had no issues BUT if you are taller than me at 5'4" (who am I kidding 5'3.5") this dress will be a little short especially in the back if you have a healthy derriere like myself.

The wedding was flawless! I really loved the cut on this dress but size 2 was very big on me. I felt very uncomfortable the whole night.
My bra was showing and it was very loose. I really wanted it to fit, but it just didn't. I wore it, and got a few compliments but I still felt extremely uncomfortable wearing it. I think a 0 would've worked much better, but sadly that size was not available for that specific day so I just ordered the 2. This dress has a great cut and material but sadly I wasn't able to fully take advantage of it due to size. Still, RTR is a great company that has amazing customer service!

Comfortable and Classy I ordered a 4 with a backup size 2. I ended up wearing the 2 and could have even worn the 0! Although the dress runs large, everything else about it was perfect! It can be worn with any bra and is flattering on all body types. In a crowd of black, sequin, and tight dresses, this one was a standout!

Runs big, low cut I was so excited for this dress to come in, but also slightly nervous due to the other reviews about it being so big. When I got it, the dress did run quite large but the real problem for me was how low-cut the neckline was. The fabric was also very thick and heavy and seemed to add weight in the hip area. At the same time, I am very petite and it is possible the dress would have worked had there been smaller sizes available. I still absolutely love Rent the Runway, but this dress unfortunately did not work out for me. If you are not huge on showing a ton of cleavage or would like something more form fitting, perhaps another style would be better!

So comfortable and chic! I rented this dress for a wedding, and was a little worried about the neckline being too low since I'm so busty, but it wasn't at all. The dress fit me great - hugged me in the right places and flowed out nicely over my hips. I'm on the shorter side, so it was a little longer on me than pictured on the model, but that totally worked too. I would definitely rent this dress again (and its counterpart in navy)!

Wore it for my friend's grad party in Hollywood. It is a classic style and made me feel stunning!! Pros: Great fit for curvy women, material hides any problem areas.
Cons: Make sure you order a size down and your size to compare.
